reviews.author: Ed Mcclain
reviews.text: May not be the prettiest, but it sure gets the job done 👍

reviews.author: Lucho Palma
reviews.text: Terreble locaion no directions all

reviews.author: Adam Antine
reviews.text: Always make a visit to the Field House.

reviews.author: Robyn Forkey
reviews.text: Prescriptions never ready on time. They accidently filled a prescription of mine 2x in 24 hrs and handed it to my boyfriend who had no clue they had made a mistake and wasn't even leaving with the correct meds. I never got an apology and was without my daily nerve pain medicine I've been on for years for almost a week because of their mistake. Pharmacist thinks he needs to police your medicine more than dispense medicine safely to customers. Despite all these problems I was still willing to be a customer until I called in for another medication refill and he asks about another medication and begins to scream at me when I suggest he should focus on the question at hand instead of attempting to police what medicine has been prescribed to me.. he told me I was not allowed to speak with him that way and hung up on me. I immediately had my entire family's prescriptions transferred and was able to talk 4 other families into changing pharmacies for their families safety as well. No one deserves the outrught disrespect and possible sickness or death due to their incompetent and unprofessional staff in the their 100% staff owned business. Shameless, and dangerous business that would only be able to operate in rural communities of upstate NY and VT bacuse they would be run out of business anywhere else

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Great place! Conveniently located right next to the Shops at Ithaca mall. Plenty of parking. A clean, neat store. Friendly, kind employees and I found what I was looking for very well. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cecily Cox
reviews.text:
I’m new to the area and often visit drugstores, so I was hoping Kinney Drugs would become a regular stop. Unfortunately, after my experience yesterday, I won’t be returning.

The cashier, Melissa, made me feel extremely unwelcome. I was dressed in sweats and noticed right away she was giving me unfriendly looks. I greeted her with a “hi” and got no response, which I initially brushed off, thinking maybe she was just shy or having a bad day. But then I saw her being warm and cheerful to other customers.

Throughout my visit, she stared at me with a look that made me feel completely out of place. When I checked out and wished her a good day, she rolled her eyes and looked visibly annoyed. It was incredibly uncomfortable and disappointing.

Customer service like this shouldn't be tolerated. I’ll be taking my business to CVS or Walgreens instead.

reviews.author: Nancy Lauten
reviews.text: This is the no frills no fuss market your grandma experienced. Just great products on a shelf without all the sales promos and gimmicks. There is only one brand of some essentials like Oat milk and they carry their own brands which are generally very good and cheap. I save 20% on my overall food bill by shopping here! Their BEST items are the orange juice, the German coffee, chicken breasts and the cut fruit.

reviews.author: Miriam Epstein
reviews.text: Aldi has good quality products at very affordable prices

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text:
These guys get paid quite a bit more than minimum wage, but the impression is that they don't get paid enough.

Hint: If i wanted to steal something, I wouldn't be stealing 30 cents worth of the wrongly selected species of cucumber on the self checkout out of $20 worth of items. Maybe find something else better to do instead of watching me use the self-checkout?

reviews.author: Mark Olson
reviews.text:
To be fair! I asked for the Mole sauce on the side. So the dish doesn't present as well as it tasted! Beans and rice were good and felt authentic. LOVED THE ATMOSPHERE HERE!
And the service was excellent! Maggie was professional and I assume this is the start of what will be an amazing career for this young woman.

The food was so good I ordered some fish tacos! They were a bit salty but were good!

Definitely a must if you haven't been here.

reviews.author: Rick Blake
reviews.text: Excellent atmosphere, the host seated us quickly and the waiter was prompt.  The decor screamed Mexican and the food lived up to the expectations.  Very good food and the serving size was enormous.  The waiter was very efficient and professional.  Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Beckie Hidy
reviews.text: Great food, employees and atmosphere. A bit pricey, but worth the size of the plates

reviews.author: Nancy Lauten
reviews.text: This market has items I can no longer find in the big supermarkets. Like split chicken on the bone, a huge inventory of frozen foods and flavors no other market carries. Dark chocolate cocoa and cherry turnovers and things that feel nostalgic to me! And their produce is their best category. Fresh!

reviews.author: Aaron Jones
reviews.text:
The best bagels and doughnuts in town come from here.

Ive been making the trip across town in the morning just to grab a couple bagels and doughnuts, it's always worth a detour in the morning.

Make sure you grab fresh ones from the bakery section (I believe day old ones are bagged in 4 packs for a similar price, but are not as fresh obviously) . The bagels are perfectly crusty and chewy on the outside with a perfect balance of density and softness inside. They're unusually moist (in the best way) and have always been very fresh too.

Not to mention, both the bagels and doughnuts are around $1.19/ea! at the time of posting. That's an unreal deal in 2025, let alone in ithaca. These bagels are much better, fresher, and larger (IMO) than, dunkin, ithaca bakery or college town bagels.

I usually just buy a container of store brand soft cream cheese from the cheese/dairy section the and rip right into them, no toaster needed.

The doughnuts are similarly fresh but are fluffy, airy and moist. The oil used for the fried yeast doughnuts tastes clean and unshared with other types of fried food. The amount of filling inside filled doughnuts seems perfect if not generous. Somebody is baking/frying these with care and consistency I rarely see from businesses in Ithaca.

If youre burnt out on the normal ithaca breakfast options these are well worth the stop. I would love to see premade breakfast sandwiches made with the same bagels for a comparably fair price (maybe they do and I missed them? I will check)

reviews.author: Roman Rabinovich
reviews.text: Nice neighborhood supermarket that is neat and clean.  Selection is only slightly less robust than Wegmans.

reviews.author: David Tark
reviews.text: I rarely leave good reviews, but this indian cuisine is amazing! The price, taste, amount were all far above my expectations, and the owner was friendly and welcoming. I am going to visit this place tomorrow before I go back to S. Korea.

reviews.author: tenzin D
reviews.text:
Yesterday I had an amazing experience at this Indian restaurant! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at home. Lady owner is such a
warm and kind person-her hospitality truly made the visit special. You can tell she cares deeply about her guests and their experience.
The food was absolutely delicious-authentic flavors, beautifully presented, and full of love.
Every dish we tried was flavorful and perfectly spiced. The server was also fantastic: attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations.
On top of everything, the vibe of the restaurant is just perfect-inviting, cozy, and full of positive energy. This place has definitely become one of my favorites, and I can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text:
The service is sloooooooowwwwwww. They seemed severely understaffed for the amount of customers they had.  Definitely dont come here if you are in any rush.

We started with the Alu tikki chat, the appearance was not all the way there but it tasted significantly better than it looked. It was very savory, sweet and also spicy but not too spicy. I wish there was more.

I got the Karahi Paneer, the veggies were undercooked and there was something very hard and chewy. Overall the flavor for the sauce was good though.

My favorite part was trying the lamb shahi korma. The gravy portion was delicious. The dish was supposed to be medium, but turned out mild but that was okay because it still turned out great.

reviews.author: 송명후
reviews.text:
Collegetown Bagels is a popular spot right in front of Cornell University. Despite the name, which might suggest they only sell bagels, this place offers much more! They have a wide variety of drinks, including beer, alongside their bagel selections.

While I only had coffee during my visit, I'm definitely curious to try their beer next time I'm in the area. It's a convenient and versatile place for students and visitors alike, whether you're grabbing a quick bite or looking to unwind with a drink.

reviews.author: Woo Young Kim
reviews.text: A lot of options and the ingredients seem pretty good. The taste of sandwiches were pretty average though. The guy at the counter seemed grumpy as well, which isn't the best interaction to start off your day in the morning.  The delivery of our food was extremely slow even though we did not have people in front of us. Good location vibe and outdoor sitting.

reviews.author: Canh Vo
reviews.text: After a full morning of exploring Ithaca, wandering through Cornell University and chasing waters, we found ourselves a bit hungry. Collegetown Bagels and surrounding were the perfect stops. The area was quiet with school out of session, that only added to the charm. We enjoyed sitting outside and soaking in the calm summer vibes - just what we needed. CTB offers a great variety - bagels, creative sandwiches and assortment of drinks and tempting desserts. There’s definitely something for everyone here.

reviews.author: Joshua Roenfeldt
reviews.text: Excellent lunch and our go-to spot for pizza and wings in Ithaca. The thin-crust pizza has a perfectly crunchy texture and holds up well under the toppings. We ordered pepperoni, chicken bacon ranch, plain cheese, and buffalo—each one was flavorful and well balanced. The pepperoni was classic and savory, the chicken bacon ranch was rich and satisfying, and the buffalo pizza had just the right amount of heat. The wings were equally solid and paired perfectly with the pizza. Consistently great quality and taste—highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kimberly StetsonGelinas
reviews.text: Haven't been impressed with the portions on the pizza for quite some time. I usually go for the Buffalo Chicken with a cup of ranch on the side but there's hardly any chicken on it. Today they didn't have Buffalo Chicken available for slices so I got the Tomato & Feta and I dont think they could have possibly sliced the tomatoes any thinner.. tomatoes cost what $0.30/ tomato?

reviews.author: Pam Gueldner
reviews.text: The new owner Philip is great, same level of service as Ned. I ordered 5 large pizzas through their AI order taker and wanted delivery but it was very confusing to understand what was going on with the order. I told AI I wanted delivery, it said okay and it would get delivery details later after I placed my order, I placed the order, gave my credit card but never got a prompt to enter a delivery location, and the AI said thank you and goodbye. I am not sure what happened, but I don't recommend using the AI order system. They don't have their own delivery drivers, so you have to use one of the apps for delivery I believe. Phillip made sure my order was delivered on time and hot, and spent a lot of time with me making sure I was satisfied. Same great pizza, same great service.

reviews.author: Sue Gould
reviews.text: Not your typical Hilton Garden Inn.  We booked here for the location and we were pleasantly surprised.  In the building is a deli, diner, and a pub. We were pleased to find out we could buy drinks at the pub to take to up to our room. The service was great.  We got an upgrade to a two room suite, and it was spacious and comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Thomas Robinson
reviews.text: A great little hotel by the commons, easy walking distance to so many quaint shops and restaurants. Only an 8 minute drive to most places on Cornell campus and free parking in the garage across the street. We booked the Wharton Suite, which was spacious and cozy, with 1 and a half bathrooms. Breakfast was tasty and very reasonably priced. Id definitely stay here next time in town. There are several cafes and bars in the building, so you'll have no problem having a cocktail or grabbing a bite if you want to stay in.

reviews.author: Galyna Shulimova
reviews.text:
Expensive, with no complimentary breakfast, but the room was beautiful and spacious with outstanding views (we stayed on 7th floor)

The hotel is very clean and well-maintained. Located in Downtown Ithaca, it's easy to access public transportation and find breakfast options nearby.

They also have a pool that's in good condition and operational.

reviews.author: Zeyu Hu
reviews.text: A nice small theater for small performance. Does not hold a lot of people.

reviews.author: Mike Darrah
reviews.text: Try Risley's dining hall

reviews.author: Aeowyn Kendall
reviews.text:
This is an adorable cafe on the corner with incredible coffee and lovely service. The matcha latte is not sweet (thank you!) unless you make it sweet, the hot chocolate is rich and reminiscent of the chocolatey-ness of ice cream without being too sweet. The seasonal rose almond latte is truly divine!!! Love that they have soy milk too, it's hard to find!
The morning-glory vegan muffin is delicious - full of fruit chunks!

reviews.author: Person Reviewer
reviews.text: Some of the best coffee I've had in Ithaca! I got an iced latte with the signature maple syrup. If you go there in the morning, it'll definitely be crowded, but it settles down in the afternoon. Nice area to sit outside, and the staff were very friendly.

reviews.author: Nick McGlynn
reviews.text: I'm making some work visits to Ithaca and this has become my daily morning coffee & breakfast spot. Really lovely place with friendly and helpful staff. The morning glory muffin and spinach & feta scone are faves, plus a big cup of their excellent filter coffee. Don't think I've ever waited more than 2 mins to get served. They also accept contactless payments, which most international visitors like myself will prefer 👍

reviews.author: Rasen Shuriken
reviews.text: Bank Coffee has a classy, elegant vibe that fits perfectly with Ithaca. The staff is warm and welcoming, and service was quick. I tried one of their specialty lattes—chocolate orange latte. It was good, though I’ve had better elsewhere. The milk texture could be better.  What really stood out was the atmosphere: calm, relaxed, and a great spot to sit for a while. Being right in Downtown makes it an easy place to stop by, and definitely worth a visit for the vibe alone.

reviews.author: Patrick O'Shaughnessy
reviews.text: Stopped in for a cappuccino at this cute coffee shop right on the commons.   My drink was perfectly prepared and hot.   Nice atmosphere with people of all ages enjoying drinks and treats.

reviews.author: tavers
reviews.text:
Friendly cafe in downtown with nice decor. good spot for a study session or catching up with friends. I personally find this place has a typical underlying smell which is not of baked goods or coffee beans, and I find it unpleasant. This smell/flavor lingers in the baked goods too, even if in have it next day. Although the texture of their pastries is good, the taste is knocked off by that weird smell/flavor. I hope they find the source and fix it.
The coffee was disappointing. It was a bitter flat white, with very foamy milk. The coffee was bad in both taste and texture. The espresso didn't seem to be dialed properly. Would not recommend getting standard espresso drinks.
The staff is very polite and service was quick.

reviews.author: 송명후
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Aaron E.J O'brien
reviews.text: It's a nice market offering a wide range of organic, locally sourced, and sustainable food products.

reviews.author: Amber Donofrio
reviews.text: Super convenient to downtown. I really appreciate the option for small, quick grocery runs and access to local produce. Also always a great selection of premade meals and desserts. This is by far my favorite Greenstar location.

reviews.author: Greg Wilde
reviews.text: Very limited selection of food. Some of the hot bar items were pretty good. There’s also a place to sit down to eat food from the hot bar.

reviews.author: Sonali Gokhale
reviews.text: Great vegetarian restaurant. I had heard a lot of good things about it on the parent’s group & it surpassed our expectations. Wonderful ambience, great service & delicious food. Definitely recommend. The sweet potato & black eyed pea soup & batatas bravas are a must try.

reviews.author: James Poulos
reviews.text: This is a bucket list item for me and it did not disappoint. Everything about this restaurant is joyful especially the food experience. The dishes were vibrant, colorful, and delicious. A worthwhile experience and I am so grateful to have experienced it and look forward to trying out the cookbook. Wish there were more restaurants like this one.

reviews.author: Lake Kubilius
reviews.text: This is the "highbrow" vegetarian spot near Cornell.  The food quality is generally quite good, but it can fluctuate with the seasonal menu changes.  Sneaking in a salt-shaker just in case the chef is phoning it in that month isn't a bad idea.  They have occasional special events that are more tempting for vegans.  In short, keep an eye out for special events and a menu rotation that looks tempting if getting vegan food is a top priority!

reviews.author: Casey Johnson
reviews.text: Tasty Korean and Japanese place. Everything cooked to order.  Just a few tables but worth it is you need to wait

reviews.author: Mariam K
reviews.text:
Honestly, very disappointed.  I got teriyaki chicken and got something that resembled teriyaki chicken soup. For someone who doesn't like soup and doesn't love saucy things, I was pretty turned off. The quality of the chicken was gyro like, and the rice was sticky but off-putting. The only reason I was able to stomach this was because I was extremely hungry. Should have gone with another place. With that said, they are pan-asian and this is the ONE dish I've tried.

I had to drain the sauce into the dish cover. Perhaps it'd be to others liking, curious as to what others have thought of this specific take on teriyaki chicken and rice.

Service was decent, guy was friendly, atmosphere looked small and nice when I picked up.

reviews.author: Julie Anderson
reviews.text: Best locally owned Asian fusion restaurant in town. Everything on the menu is delicious. Out favorite dishes are jam bong soup with potato noodle, sweet potato roll, chicken and broccoli and yaki soba. Rolls are made to order.

reviews.author: Ayobami Ogundiran
reviews.text: This bank of America ATM is located in the clean 409 building (student agency building) just before the 7 Eleven store. It was difficult for me to locate it. So, I thought it would be helpful for anyone who needs to use the ATM.

reviews.author: Julio Arreaga
reviews.text: ATM is not accessible/building is closed due to construction. Other BofA ATM is on Cornell campus and inside of a building which is restricted to students only.

reviews.author: Leo Smith on Bass
reviews.text: It's there... Go inside the door that says "409 Student Agencies". The lobby is open 24hrs.

reviews.author: Bijan Shahriari
reviews.text: incredible local theater that has been in ithaca for the past 35 years. the staff is incredibly friendly, popcorn is delicious (the butter is layered!!!) and the screening rooms are spacious and have great sound and image quality. do bring a sweatshirt though, the room can get a bit chilly.

reviews.author: Evan Smith
reviews.text: What a lovely independent theater kind of tucked away in the Commons. Visited Ithaca for a week and had a free night, so we decided to see a movie. The theater is located down an alley in the Commons or down the parallel street. It’s an old school style theater and very well maintained. Everything was pretty clean, especially the bathrooms and auditoriums. The audio/visual in our auditorium was excellent. The staff were friendly, enthusiastic, and courteous. Support local theaters and skip the Regal for Cinemapolis.

reviews.author: mike kovatch
reviews.text: Nice small theatre showing independent films. I really enjoyed the experience . I Would’ve given 5 stars but my wife and I both found most of our popcorn was burnt.

reviews.author: Martin Gamer
reviews.text: The store is crammed and a little disorganized, but you can still come across some unique, decent finds here, and for discount. For example, I found this vintage stiletto knife in a discount bin (not sure if they even have it anymore). It's worth a stop in if only for the off chance of finding a random treasure like this.

reviews.author: Ubaya Medawela
reviews.text: It’s more or less a clothing store offering all kinds of apparel. The majority of the items cater to cold weather. Some outdoor sporting goods are also available.

reviews.author: Zelda Lassing
reviews.text: Nasty, condescending attitude. I called asking for help for a bike repair, and they said they don't repair bikes at this time of year and to call someone else. When I asked if they had any suggestions, they said nastily to just google some options - "you've used google before, right?" I called for help, not for an attitude. Do not shop with this business.

reviews.author: Zach Jaeger
reviews.text: Killer dive bar in a house across from Ithaca Falls. That pretty much says it all! If you're looking for something fancy, this ain't your spot. If you want good times, great people, and cheap drinks, then come on in!

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.text:
A true dive and a gem at the same time.
Limited options of beer bottles/cans and the basic liquors but the prices are stuck back in time like the bar itself. Classic male restroom perfect for the vibe. A pool table hides in the back.
CASH ONLY.

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Always a fun time and vibe. No dancing bar just pool and drinks

reviews.author: Lorie Durfee
reviews.text: We stayed in the Falls Suite that is located at the Inn, and it was lovely.  We love the old Victorian home.  It was beautifully renovated.  The room was very comfortable, had a fridge and coffee maker.  The bathroom was amazing with heated floors and a gorgeous shower.  We loved that location, right next to the Falls and with a view of the lake.  The staff was so friendly.  We would stay here again.

reviews.author: Lisa Kauffman
reviews.text: The staff was so friendly & service was great! Patrice took my friend,& I on a tour of the new bridal suite & made us some great drinks too. Dani checked us in & out in a timely manner & was so friendly. She came to our room to see if we need anything & even talked to us at breakfast to make sure everything was going good. The owner Carl & the chef Dirk made my husband feel welcomed and talk with him outside with the portable heaters! Even though the restaurant was closed for the winter months, they served a delicious breakfast & service was fabulous! We were able to take our dogs & had a beautiful view of the lake. Jetted hot tub was awesome,& room was really clean. This morning we had a New Year hike to the falls followed by hot chocolate at the coffee hut. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Kim Horgan
reviews.text: We stayed at the Inn in one of the park side rooms. The room was lovely: clean, spacious and comfortable. We loved the large, updated bathroom with a tub and shower. It was convenient having a mini fridge and microwave too. The location was perfect. Right next to the room was the trail to Taughannock Falls. One night of our stay we had drinks at the bar and then dinner. Enjoyed the food and atmosphere for both. The website mentioned a continental breakfast and usually that means packaged products and mediocre coffee. They had a very nice set up with eggs, potatoes, tea and coffee, and pastries. The woman working the breakfast was so nice, she offered to get a piece of gluten-free bread and toast it for me and bring it out. It was so great to have that (it doesn't happen often!) Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. It was our favorite place on our trip.

reviews.author: astrid
reviews.text: Customer service was terrible. I’ve spent around $1,300 on clothes and the cashier Noah was very rude. He won’t even made eye contact either me,  he threw the clothes that I bought and never help me to fold it up. He never provided me with a bag and never removed the security tag on some of the clothes I bought . I spoke with the manager about it and it looks like he didn’t care about, so I will never spend any dollar in this store never again. I came from vacation to Ithaka but the customer service and management in this store is very poor.

reviews.author: Emil
reviews.text: What a great experience! Every single employee i talked to was very nice and helpful. Thank you Mark for help finding the REI Zephyr sleeping bag.

reviews.author: JM
reviews.text: Traveled two hours to this REI to get a new bike and it was worth the trip! I was afraid it was going to be an intimidating process but Mark was super friendly and made it a breeze. He helped me out and had me test ride two bikes and was very knowledgeable. This experience made me even more excited to start my biking journey!

reviews.author: Mary johnson
reviews.text:
I visited this Eastern Mountain Sports location yesterday around 4:30 PM and had a mixed experience. The store itself was great with a men’s downstairs and wide variety there was an amazing sale and a really nice selection of items. I ended up purchasing what I came for because I genuinely loved the products!

Unfortunately, the customer service at checkout was very disappointing. The salesperson who assisted me (I believe his name was Andrew, he was wearing plaid) was unpleasant and rude in his tone and responses ☹️. The interaction made me uncomfortable, and the way I was spoken to almost felt racially insensitive at the time. It took away from what should have been a positive shopping experience.

My family and fiancé even suggested I return the items because of how I was treated, but I decided to keep them since I liked them so much. I hope management considers placing more welcoming and professional staff at the front, because the store itself is wonderful and I would like to shop here again without having the same experience.

reviews.author: John
reviews.text:
Incredibly unprofessional staff. I've worked in outdoor gear shops/spaces as well and while it's good to be laid back, some employees are downright rude while others are too lax. After having a negative interaction with a staff member, I mentioned it to the woman cashing me out and was told that it "filled her cup for the day" and she proceeded to talk bad about her coworker to the other folks working. Time and place! I'm sure y'all are great, but I'm there to buy something, not be part of your coworker gossip.

Anyways, mid gear at mid prices. Go to Mountaineer.

reviews.author: Caleb Graham
reviews.text:
I went to this store just trying to take advantage of the discount and get a north face.but the cashier Andrew I think his name is was being so insanely rude to me for no reason. I’d hate to think it had to do with skin color but I couldn’t help but notice he was very kind and welcoming to the other guests.

Reading reviews he may also be rude to others?

I’d appreciate it if you could either talk to him or just put a sign that certain people aren’t welcome wish is find id love to know

reviews.author: Shruti Sinha
reviews.text: We visited here multiple times over last weekend. Food, coffee, the Mexican bagel, and ended up buying 10 different marmalade flavors to gift to friends. This 100 year old bakery has something to offer to everyone. You can spend a quality time here growing the menu, their merchandise too.

reviews.author: Sam Brannon
reviews.text: There are so many options from bagels to beverages, hot sandwiches to a cold case full of goodies. So many baked goods, and a great selection of oils and hot sauces that would make great gifts. Our food was great, everyone was friendly, and we’ll definitely stop in again when we visit the lakes.

reviews.author: Sara Catrow
reviews.text: Ithaca Bakery is a treat every once in awhile, and it has never disappointed! The food is always fresh whether it's soups or a prepared sandwich, and the breakfast sandwiches are the best in town. I love the salt rosemary bagels, and always save room for whatever vegetarian friendly soup they've got on the menu.

reviews.author: Scott Hamula
reviews.text: Wait time was short, exam process moved along smoothly, and the in-store staff and online doctor were friendly and knowledgeable. They also had a very wide selection of frames on display including several top name brands. Recommend.

reviews.author: TBIRD
reviews.text: This place does not accept Medicaid when it says online they do! If you aren't going to accept it, remove it from your advertisement because driving all the way to the store to find out it was a complete waste of time sucks!

reviews.author: Emily Germano
reviews.text: My 16 year old son and I had several bad experiences at the Cortland visionworks with extended wait times and rescheduled appointments, so we decided to give the Ithaca Visionworks a try.  It was a terrible, demeaning, and toxic experience for both my son and me.  We had a thirty minute drive only for the staff to tell us that they didn't have our appt on their computer and to rebook.  I tried to show them the appointment confirmation and reminders on my phone, but they did not care.  The staff were rude and degrading, it was so bad another customer jumped in  to tell us we should find another eye doctor because this place was terrible.  The staff at the front desk told my son to "stay in his place" when he agreed with the customer.  I do not want to expose my son to this kind of rude behavior.  I would rather pay out of pocket then be put through this kind of experience again.  We will be finding another eye doctor.

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text: Purity Ice Cream Co. nailed the experience. We stopped by after dinner, just an hour before closing, and the energy was still high—lively, welcoming, and very much the night is still young kind of vibe. I picked a gorgeous-looking ice cream that tasted just as good as it looked. Sitting there with my husband, enjoying ice cream in -2°C weather, felt oddly perfect. Cold outside, cozy inside, and a simple little ice-cream date done right. Definitely a place that turns a quick stop into a memorable moment.

reviews.author: Natasha Hamilton
reviews.text: I love eating here!!! The make your own burgers, with all the different types of fries. Today I was serviced by Mario. He was very nice pleasant professional food was amazing and cut thoroughly. Thank you for all your hard work.

reviews.author: Kang Yangmi
reviews.text: Purity is our go to ice cream place in Ithaca. Samantha was so kind and helpful to find flavors that I like which was boomberry and green tea combo. You must try the place if you’re visiting Ithaca!

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text: I'm tired of having to call and get a new card just because I simply need a refund, and then that refund can take months for me to receive. Like why are you just allowing my card to be used for anything, especially if I don't have enough in my account? And then even though I call for it to be canceled, my money to be refunded, they say nothing can be done then the next day they give me some bs charge and steal more of my money that I don't have.

reviews.author: David Herrmann
reviews.text: I was always told 9am to 5 pm was bankers hours but now it’s 9 to 4 I get out at 4 so only can do banking on Saturday nice

reviews.author: Amanda S.
reviews.text: We use Chemung Canal Trust Company for everything. We have had small personal loans, car loans, and our mortgage with them. We have needed them for savings for the kids, our personal account and when we suddenly lost multiple  family members  they were right there with assistance with Estate management. For every financial need life has thrown at us Chemung Canal has been there to help! With the familiarity of a small town bank and the knowledge and experience of larger firms Chemung Canal brings the best of both worlds to its customers.  We Could not ask for a better bank!!

reviews.author: Amanda Gallagher
reviews.text:
We tried this restaurant tonight & I could not be more impressed!

Every item is, or is available, gluten-free. The only things not gluten-free is the pasta & rolls, but gluten-free is available. The fryer is gluten-free only so fries are safe for even Celiacs!

I personally had the fish & chips, which is fried gluten free cod, & was incredible! Other menu items (curry & fried rice special with GF fried tofu pictured) also looked amazing! There is no doubt that will be back again soon!!!! Need to try the mac & cheese and so many other menu options!!!!

reviews.author: Wally Herrera
reviews.text: Visiting from San Antonio and wanted a local spot away from The Commons.  Found Northstar after our visit to Ithaca Falls and wow, did we strike gold. Great vibe, stocked bar (that's also a pop culture scavenger hunt), great service and the best meal we had the whole trip.  Fried green tomatoes that are Gluten Free, yes please!  My wife had the salmon & grits and I crushed the Tamari glazed chicken. Flower Power IPA & the Gentle Violet for the drinks. Thanks Jed & team for a great experience, we'll be back.

reviews.author: sheila angel
reviews.text:
Great Red Curry dish over rice with chicken. It will be hard to opt for something different on my next visit. Although while gazing at dishes as  servers delivered them to nearby tables it appears I will have to try everything eventually. Interesting cocktail list, spirits and spirit free.
Great atmosphere, wonderful service. Will return. No doubt!

reviews.author: Mario Alex Gonzalez
reviews.text: Among the best dining experiences in Ithaca, Simeons is a classic fine dining experience that executes its dishes to perfection consistently. Their appetizer game is strong, with fresh and delicious choice. Their entrees also always blow me away, and if they have the ribeye, it is truly spectacular here. The prime rib is also amazing; and the sides for any entree I’ve ever had have lived up the entree quality. Even if you do not want any, make sure you ask to see the desserts! They have an awesome presentation and are some of the best single serve desserts I’ve ever had at a restaurant. The key lime pie one is my personal favorite and a must try if you are here. This place is expensive, but worth it, and if I were in Ithaca, i would come here and then walk off my meals in the commons, because it is also in a beautiful area.

reviews.author: Christine G
reviews.text: We had a wonderful meal here. The server was attentive and very friendly and knowledgeable. I would recommend this place highly but also recommend checking out the menu online as it is limited, limited but excellent. Desserts are small and perfect!

reviews.author: Andromeda Dickey
reviews.text: The food was so good and the atmosphere was comfortable. We had a wonderful server too! Really loved that this is a sit down place, but still cozy enough to be casual. The food overall was really good, we had a little bit of everything in our group. I had one of the burgers and fries and it was made perfectly for me. The fries were so good too, crispy but soft inside. My dessert was the inside out cannoli and it was amazing. Definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Ornwara Tritrakarn
reviews.text: Great selection of movies! I have been here 4 times and I have never been disappointed. It's pretty cheap for students. The interior is old but in a good way. It has this classic vibe you can't find in big department stores' cinemas. Plus, it's super convenient for those who live in West campus. Having 2 sides of entrance really helps!

reviews.author: Alvaro Diaz Bedregal
reviews.text: I spent many nights during two years of my life enjoying the great movies they screen. A wonderful theatre, friendly people, nice snacks... some of the best memories from school years. It Made me love movies even more and forever.

reviews.author: Michael Stewart
reviews.text: Smaller theater with character.  Reasonable prices (less than the mainstream theaters, and you can buy multi-ticket packs for about $6/ticket or so, in 2017).  Fun place to see classic and second-run movies.

reviews.author: Erica Hopper
reviews.text:
I adore this bookstore. It's one of the first places I visited when considering moving to the area and immediately felt at home. With progressive selections in nonfiction and an assortment of fiction books for all ages, there's something for everyone. I also buy more than I am willing to admit in trinkets from the store because there's always something fun for my little crow brain to desire.

There's always a lot of great events going on at the store, and having had my own events there, I can say that the process is seamless. The staff is amazing and have my heart. Whenever I have friends and family visiting, I take them to BSB as if to say "here is the heart of Ithaca and why I love it here."

reviews.author: Ace Dufresne
reviews.text: Great selection and atmosphere. Friendly, helpful, considerate staff. Beautiful reading room with murals and  places to sit. Regularly bring in community for cool events. I love Ithaca's non profit bookstore!

reviews.author: Chip Eats
reviews.text:
One of my new favorite book stores. Went in with my family for a wonderful signing by  author Signe Pike. She was simply fantastic and it was one of the best book signings I've been to!

It is an enjoyable and comfortable store. The children's selection was great and both kids loaded up on books. I also found a special treat on their shelves which was a signed book by my favorite author.

What a great experience!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Amy Stofenberg
reviews.text:
I never leave reviews this long but this is the culmination of years and years of frustration and disgust.

This bank’s policies are the LEAST friendly to low-income people of any bank I have ever come across. The employees are great - kind, helpful, funny. But the bank’s policies are straight up immoral and repulsive— particularly when it comes to overdraft fees.

They once charged me *EIGHT HUNDRED DOLLARS* in one year in overdraft fees. There should be a cap. I would obviously prefer if they declined the transactions that overdrew my account. BLOCK THE CHARGES. But they would rather make $38 a pop off of someone who is clearly struggling.

I have talked with the bank about this so many times over my 7 years of having an account with them. I had one very kind employee at the Elmira Rd. location who said he understood, and didn’t want to “kick someone while they were down”. He refunded about 4 overdraft fees. I wish the bank had the same moral fiber as that employee.

They slightly altered their policy this past year. Now, if your account is overdrawn less than $50, you have 24 hours to make it right before being charged the fee. If your account is overdrawn $50+, you are charged $38, AND $38 for every single withdrawal after that—no matter how small. The amount of times I’ve been charged $38 for a $3 overdraft - you wouldn’t even believe.

I’ve gone to sleep at night and not realized my account got overdrawn. By morning, I’ve been charged $160 in overdraft fees due to a $50 charge, followed by a $3 charge, a $5 charge, and an $8 charge.

Is the bank *really* so put-out, having to temporarily cover a small transaction for me? Again, block the charges. But they prefer to make $38 off of someone who is poor. What a scam. I have some choice words for this bank that I will keep to myself. Do better. “Community” bank-- hilarious.

I’m moving away from Ithaca and will be closing my accounts this week. Good riddance. *FYI* - my boyfriend has an account at Chase and has never been charged an overdraft fee, even when his account has been accidentally overdrawn by $300. That’s where I’m opening a new account.

reviews.author: Kitty Hall-Thurnheer
reviews.text: Absolutely worst customer service ever at Trust Co. Very difficult to get someone to answer the phone! Extremely difficult to get info out of them--they say they are asking security questions for my own good, but when they ask what branch did I open the account (40 years ago), I'm not able to answer correctly, then they deny info. Closed my mortgage and all accounts with them and moved to Elmira Savings Bank. Best decision ever.

reviews.author: Eric N
reviews.text: Would not recommend.  Went to Tompkins because they are a local business.  Unfortunately they don't treat you like a local business.  BONNIE  is the assistant manager of mortgage yet will act like she is a new hire. On many different occasions she actually acted more like a mob that was holding money over my head then a loan office that I am bringing business to.  Vary sad that this is how any one would get treated.  Much happier now with the customer service at CFCU.

reviews.author: Daniel Richter
reviews.text:
In this episode of "Rate your experience," we dive into the ever-popular Kilpatrick's Publick House. Let us begin.
This particular dining experience went solo. It was a dismal Friday evening. The weather was challenging for those looking to walk The Commons for a nice stroll as the sunset. Rain, miserable rain forced one to find cover. I quickly stepped off the TCAT bus and with alacritous steps, beelined to my destination.
The restaurant was less-than-expected regarding the volume of patrons. Staff was moving about, working frantically for what one would assume a busy night. The floor manager was directing staff, the barkeeps were cleaning glassware and everyone was jovial in their day-to-day activities.
I decided to pull up a stool at the warm/inviting patina copper bar. A few patrons were enjoying an after-work beverage. The barkeep was either 'that friendly' or the patrons were 'regulars'. Nonetheless, a great atmosphere from the start.
Today's meal consisted of my GO-TO; Black & Blue Salad and a new menu option -- the "Inferno Wings". We'll talk about those in a moment.
If you want a steak but not all the sides that go with it, this is your best bet. The salad is an amazing pile of mixed greens (and I mean GREEN) with the yummiest of blue cheese and bacon. The star of the show and most certainly not outshined is the steak. I've NEVER gotten a bad steak from Kilpatrick's in the double-hand times I've dined at this location. Who says the Irish can't cook a damn good steak?! This salad is a meal in and of itself! Plenty for one-person and sharable without a doubt.
Now - let's finally get to why a star is missing from this, what seems to be an epic night of wonderful dining, an excellent venue, and undoubtedly top-notch staff on hand. When I think of the term, "Inferno Wings" I'm excited. Others will be put off due to the presumable heat one associates with the word. The wonderful barkeep brought my salad and my wings and I was so excited to give the wings a shot. I let them sit for a bit, to cool the oven heat, so I could focus on the spicy heat, enjoying a few bites of my wonderful salad. My first bite into them little chicken wings was a quick and instantaneous, shucks! I liken it to the sound of losing on the Price is Right. These wings were wrong. Wrong! Wrong! Wrong! The term inferno as a quick Google search is "a large fire dangerously out of control". Sure, the term heightens my desire to delve into - ONE. SPICY. WING. Nope, not a chance. Unfortunately, these were worse than Tom Hanks acting in the movie with the same name. I've had Totino's on a 3 am Sunday-morning burn my mouth more than these wings. The barkeep was kind and the mentioning of "chef's challenge" will certainly be had in due time. I will give these amazingly talented chefs the chance to prepare the aforementioned in all its glory of being the INFERNO WINGS one expects. Until then, the search for a hot wing continues.

reviews.author: Dahyun Hollister
reviews.text: Food was great, portion was great! But our waitress wasn't that great to took her forever to get us drink refill, she was so rarely seen we had to look around to flag her down to ask for extra sauce.

reviews.author: Steven Wang
reviews.text: Best burgers in town at a fair price. Toppings are good and the meat is well rested. They have a changing selection but if you like halal cart style lamb, I really recommend the lamb burger if it's available.

reviews.author: Jaimie Bennett
reviews.text: We found this Bistro, while returning home from Lake Placid. The food was of excellent quality, with a good assortment of menu items. We had a selection of appetizers, and I had the seafood stew for main course. The service was excellent. It is located in a quiet area of town, a short distance from the University. It is very reasonably priced, food wine & desserts for 2 $60.00

reviews.author: David Skrypnyk
reviews.text:
Terrible service. They welcome you and are so grateful but useless. I sked to open na credit card they failed it. I tried to withdraw in ATM fail again. Online transaction always blocked and i have to wait on their customer lines for 40 minutes to confirm the transaction. I try twice to close my bank account - fail again. And now i get a charge for this terrible service. Ridiculous.
If you have so much extra time and no enough problems in your life, use this bank.

reviews.author: Nicholas Romo
reviews.text: Michael Britt had always taken care of me since I started with M & T back in 2017. He is an asset to the bank and I am thankful for his dedication.

reviews.author: Pratiksha Khanduri
reviews.text:
If you are an international student at Cornell or studying in Ithaca, please do not bother opening an account with M&T. Go to Chase Bank. I had to travel abroad, and in spite of assurances by M&T, I have faced numerous issues in making international payments. Their customer service is non-existent, have to spend over 90 minutes on hold just so that I can get through to the fraud department because all my transactions abroad get flagged. At this rate their customer care hold music is the lead background score of all my nightmares.

I rue the day I opened an account here, don't be me, take your money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text: Made two orders of cheese fries and they only gave me one. There was barely any cheese. Paid $11.12 for what is pictured

reviews.author: Joe Guy
reviews.text: One hour after placing my order they canceled it without provocation, and refused to acknowledge any wrong doing. First and last time trying to dine here

reviews.author: Clarissa
reviews.text: There was a hair in my food and a long wait time, though it was flavorful.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text:
I like the Chinese bbq ribs and the nachos are always fire.

This dining hall is smaller , which I like because I can actually find where things are. I appreciate the easy to find trash can.
Good food choices, aesthetic atmosphere.

The only issue is that the desserts are pretty bad. The brownie tasted like dirt and the cake had overly sweet icing. Also lack of ice cream.

reviews.author: Leon Burbank
reviews.text: Poor selection of fruits and vegetables and pathetic attempt at Mexican cuisine— this place will be the reason why I will cry myself to sleep tonight. If God truly exists, he would not have allowed this non-air-conditioned, sour-smelling Satan’s armpit to exist. If you are looking for food that looks and tastes like this, I think Walmart’s pet aisle has cheaper and better options. As I shoved spoonful after spoonful of this barely edible concoction down my abused mouth, I wished that I am the chandeliers that dimly illuminated this place— hanging motionlesly from the ceiling.

reviews.author: Tanuj Chawla
reviews.text: Must go place for gluten and lactose intolerant. The all you can eat diner offers a variety of starters, salads, soups and main course items. The staff is courteous and will happily take requests. You also get Cornell dairy ice cream(not sure if that was lactose free)

reviews.author: Brittney Colton
reviews.text:
A hidden gem on Cornell’s campus.  Soups, sandwiches and Mac n cheese are all made from scratch.  Personally I love there Gazpacho, it’s incredibly delicious!

The staff and atmosphere is casual and friendly. The design of the cafe also give this place a unique setting on campus.

reviews.author: Ben R.
reviews.text: People are nice, but they constantly get your order wrong. About a quarter of the hot coffees I've ordered have come out iced. I've also had them mess up the type of milk on occasion. I've also had orders stolen. Good environment but challenging to find a seat during the day. Otherwise, this is a good spot. Food-wise, the soups are great, but I've ever tried any of the other offerings.

reviews.author: Valerio Poggiali
reviews.text: Great coffe, perfect place for working/studying, nice baristas!

reviews.author: Eva Milstein-Touesnard
reviews.text: This cafe is very cute but it is hard to find. It is in the basement of the building so if you go inside on either side of the central entrance there are these staircases that look like they’re going to a creepy basement but they actually go there. Or there’s a central entrance that also looks kind of sketchy. But once you find it it’s not sketchy at all! It has an awesome aesthetic and is a great place to study or do group work.

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.text: Good place to study/chill. The music is loud so you may want noise cancelling headphones. Many tables have power strips in the middle.

reviews.author: jillian tristan
reviews.text: When finished at NYU, we enrolled in the intensive program in architecture at The School of Art Architecture and Planning at Cornell. We needed a place to relax, hangout and listen to music 🎶. The Green Dragon Cafe is the perfect place for on campus relaxation 😎. We spent hours studying so we found a special place on campus at Cornell. Playing Guitar 🎸and listening to live music 🎶 performed by well known bands is one of the reasons we love ❤️ the Green Dragon Cafe. My fiancé played rock and roll 🎸 on his guitar at the Green Dragon entertaining other students while taking a course in structures. A visit to Ithaca isn’t complete without a stop at The Green Dragon Cafe.

reviews.author: Daniel Filler
reviews.text: A typical college dining hall, Oakenshields will always have an Asian option, a Western one, pizza, a salad bar, and ice cream. While they pale in variety (and many would say quality) compared to some other dining halls, I highly recommend you keep an eye out for special options/events on the website. It is not uncommon for them to have burgers or some other dish that tastes like real food. The only con is that the line for it will be very long; for that reason they lose on service.

reviews.author: Eben Hill
reviews.text: Missing a star because the food is inferior to that of other Cornell Dining halls. Otherwise it's an okay place that is pretty accessible. Don't go on Monday mornings, as that is the busiest time (burgers).

reviews.author: Krishna Sudarshan
reviews.text: Okenshields at Cornell University left us disappointed on multiple fronts. The food lacked appeal, failing to match the university's reputation for excellence. Moreover, the lackluster decor further dampened the dining experience. It's disheartening that a cafeteria of lesser quality exists on a campus renowned for its premier status. The subpar offerings were a letdown, and the overall experience was a missed opportunity to complement the institution's standards.

reviews.author: Cameron Carr
reviews.text: Baristas are friendly and drinks are great. They have a wide variety of prepackaged cold foods, along with fresh bagels and pastries. It definitely gets busy when classes get out!

reviews.author: Ornwara Tritrakarn
reviews.text: The service is pretty fast and there are many interesting seasonal menu to try. There are two microwaves here. The view is great as you can see the campus clearly. But finding a place to sit can be a real challenge.

reviews.author: Kyle Darlow
reviews.text: Nice refreshing place to get a snack or a drink while studying in Olin Library.  The prices aren't too bad and you get a great view of the Arts Quad when you sit by the windows!  The selection isn't too bad!

reviews.author: Monica Jang
reviews.text: My fav library in the school as Cornellian 🐻💖

reviews.author: Yuemeng Xiao
reviews.text: My best library at Cornell!!

reviews.author: Edmund Husserl
reviews.text: Brilliant!

reviews.author: Sagara Mati
reviews.text: Usually I have a good experience,  but today I had a card to pick up a letter, and I asked the lady if she could also give me the mail in the po box becausei didnt have the key with me. She said no, they don't give mail over the counter. This is not true, because I have done this 8n the past. She said they aren't supposed to be doing that. I have gone there over the years and never had this problem. I said, are you really goung to make me go all the way back to the office, get the key and come back? I showed my ID. She said no. So I had to make a trip all the Elway back and return. I feel since 8t never was a problem before, she could at least have given me a warning this one time and given me the mail. Anyway, I did google this question,  and it states that customer service CAN give you your po box mail, but may request ID.  So she outright lied to me.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: People love to rag on the Post Office, but I haven’t had much in the way of bad experiences. Every time I’ve come in the people here have been nice to me and quite helpful. Sometimes you have to wait in line for a bit but it’s not the workers’ fault that they’re understaffed. Overall, I can’t really complain.

reviews.author: Sherrhonda Ebony
reviews.text: My daughter and I received a notification that our packages were delivered to the mailbox. I went outside my package nor was hers there. The packages were coming from different locations. When I tried to call I was told that the package was scanned and delivered. When I tried to call the direct number to the downtown post office it just hangs up on you. Now I have no way of knowing where the packages are. I was told from one of the representatives (from the 800 number) that the carriers sometimes scan the packages before it gets to the location. That’s insane because if in the process the package gets misplaced it was scanned as delivered when it actually was not.

reviews.author: Mavis Lin
reviews.text: Above average pricing for the sake of convenience. The chicken ramen noodle taste great! (In the beginning of the semester, some staffs added too much soy sauce and charged overrated, but by the end of the semester the operation becomes normal and the noodle improves in flavors too!).

reviews.author: lemonde_
reviews.text: The chicken ramen is surprisingly good for dining hall food. Other things are okay.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text: The tomatoes pasta might be a little too spicy for someone who doesn’t usually eat spicy food

reviews.author: Hao Wang
reviews.text:
I can’t recommend this place if you’re expecting consistently reliable meals matching what’s advertised on their menu.

I’ve ordered online from here many times to avoid the long lines during lunch hours. On multiple occasions the food I’ve received differed noticeably from the advertised descriptions, either containing substituted ingredients and/or missing key components entirely. While the quality can actually be good when prepared as described, in my experience, this has been happening less frequently lately.

reviews.author: Yama B
reviews.text:
By far, the slowest cafe on campus.
Took them around 25 minutes to complete an online pick-up order for an non-customized macchiato latte, and they ended up making caramel latte instead - got my order wrong.

reviews.author: Max Torres
reviews.text: Food was fine and staff was rude. They charge for tap water, don’t recommend. Go like anywhere else and you will find nicer people, better food, and free water with your meal.

reviews.author: Josh Edgar
reviews.text: Ordering ahead made it a fast pick up. Food was hot and had a decent flavor for a quick sandwich. Ice coffee was also worth getting

reviews.author: Sommaya H
reviews.text: good food but be prepared for long lines and wait time. also they ALWAYS skimp on whipped cream or don’t completely fill the cup with coffee- pictures are from separate instances when I got caramel frappes

reviews.author: Eunice Yiu
reviews.text: I graduated five years ago and now I still think about those delicious sandwiches! I wonder if they still have the green goddess, French dip, portabella melt, BLT… I love it all!

reviews.author: Ya Yay
reviews.text: One of my favorite eateries on campus. I like getting a toasted everything bagel with chive cream cheese. It costs about $4 for students. Service is speedy and if you can’t find seating inside (it is a bit cramped in there) you can always go right through the door into trillium.

reviews.author: Steve Pacenka
reviews.text: Nice people make very good toasted bagels with varied cream cheese.  Always consistent. Busy most of the time because of popular location, but they serve very efficiently so the waits are short .

reviews.author: Kelly Murray
reviews.text: Sometimes great, but other times you get the faintest whisper of cream cheese. A coworker and I warn each other when it's a bad cream cheese day, and those days seem to be increasing in frequently, unfortunately

reviews.author: Daniel Filler
reviews.text:
A decent variety of dishes that changes from meal to meal and day to day. You can see specific offerings online, but they always have pizza, a salad bar, chicken (usually grilled breast), and baked goods + ice cream for dessert. The appearance of Mexican and East Asian is common, but not garunteed. Highly recommend if you are looking for clean protein (chicken breast) or some crispy, greasy, sheet-stle pizza. Not for those seeking an exciting or particularly seasoned experience.

P.S. the best meal is usually the Sunday brunch.

reviews.author: Toby Young
reviews.text: Let me begin by saying the staff of the North Star dining hall is not reflected by the food they serve. The staff is consistently patient and helpful, however nothing they can do to counteract the horrible experience in terms of food I had tonight. Boy oh boy did I have a delectable treat on the night of 8/27 at North Star Dining hall! As a freshman at Cornell University, I get unlimited meal swipes, essentially making dining hall food free. However, you could not pay me enough to eat the meal I just consumed for a second time. I waited in the longest line for food I’ve seen at Cornell just to be served the most diabolical dish I’ve ever seen. Let me begin by describing the vegetable options. I was offered an entire bush of broccoli (unchopped to edible size and hardly steamed) and half-cooked baby carrots (that I declined). I added some mashed potatoes to my plate with high hopes (soon to be dashed). After my third bite of the potatoes, my mouth began rejecting it frantically. I felt a slight burning sensation in my mouth as if it was spicy, but forced myself to continue as every other food facility on campus was closed due to the UAW strike. After I built up the courage, I took my chicken drumstick in my hand. It instantly went limp in my hand (bone and all) and all hopes I had for the meal vanished. I took a bite and sure enough, it felt as though I had taken a bite of a rubber tire. At that point, I resigned myself to being hungry. The UAW strike must come to a fair agreement with Cornell university as soon as possible for the sake of all the students.

reviews.author: - Decision
reviews.text: i think the workers in red t shirt are all student workers and i believe his name is kevin or something that ends in ‘in’ and he wears glasses. i only caught a glimpse of the little name pin while we walked past each other from the bathroom yesterday but this disgusting guy does not wash his hands after using the bathroom. please do something about your workers hygiene. 🤮🤮🤮

reviews.author: Matt Clark
reviews.text:
Food is alright, but everything is overly expensive. Prices were just raised. The grill frequently either runs out of things or just doesn't care about order accuracy, as a simple burger is often on the wrong roll, missing ingredients (like missing bacon on a bacon cheeseburger...), or prepared incorrectly (sauteed onions advertised, raw onion received).

Good in a pinch, but you're paying extra for the convenience of subpar service

reviews.author: Sommaya H
reviews.text: Got a grilled cheese sandwich for $4 and it was burnt on both sides and barely edible not to mention the long wait. I only come here for coffee or to buy something that isn’t food.

reviews.author: Marco Parvel
reviews.text: They changed the policy with this place last September. They don’t allow to give free food, fountain soda anymore for any Cornell employees that work outside of RPCC bear necessities. But otherwise food was good here, including pizzas.

reviews.author: Stephen Yang
reviews.text: The definition of a local eatery in Central NY, Carol's Coffee and Art Bar on 177 Front Street in Owego oozes charm and friendliness while serving up tasty handmade menu items. The  everything bagel was a breath of fresh air compared to factory made bagels especially in taste and texture.  The coffee and tea were also excellent as was the entire friendly service team. And of course you'll be inspired and maybe even "surprised" at the high level of art being exhibited mostly by Carol herself! Bravo! #supportlocal

reviews.author: Sharon Poarch
reviews.text: Carols coffee and Art bar, a quaint coffee shop in Owego New York with art for sale and more coffee flavors that I’ve ever seen in my life! we had homemade cranberry orange bagels with bacon, egg and cheddar cheese sandwich. It was amazing!

reviews.author: Lana A LaBonte
reviews.text:
Carol is delightful! She immediately greeted me what a smile & shared all her Gluten Free specialties.
My Dad had the Bacon quiche with coffee & I had the vegetable quiche with a hot apple spiced cider with a cinnamon stick. I hadn’t had a hot cider in years so this was such a treat!
I also got a peppermint mocha on the way out with a couple slices of coconut cake.
My sister recommended this place & especially the GF coconut cake.
I had a bite of the coconut cake & it brought me back to my childhood when this was one of my favorite desserts!
I highly recommend you stop in to see Carol & the wall of all her & her daughter’s art!
It’s a homey feel with lots of love!

reviews.author: Khelsea Harris
reviews.text: The house was really big and tons of space! You can’t wear your shoes in the home. The owners stay in a guest house behind the property so they pop up from time to time. An anti social person like myself found this to be weird ... also the lack of technology (Smart TVs or a cable connection) was a bummer for the toddler traveling with us. Also the house has an eerie vibe at night which was fun. But if you have enough activities planned this house will be fine.

reviews.author: Jason Jones
reviews.text:
A DEFINITE MUST STAY if when visiting the Finger Lakes area:) I was seriously blown away by this place, inside and out! As I drove up to the house (conveniently located int the center of wine country), I felt like I was immediately transported back to a simpler time and place--far enough from the craziness of modern society and yet close enough to get my fix for the city life, when necessary.

Inside of the house, I was amazed to see 5 HUGE bedrooms and 4 bathrooms (great for families and couples), a very homey and old-style living room/dining area, and a full kitchen/pantry (with a refrigerator, washer, and dryer). I was also very surprised to learn that all of the house's inner trim and molding was done by one of the extremely talented and artistic owners.

The outside of the house was equally amazing. First of all. it had the perfect setting for an outdoor play area/ min-courtyard for families and friends to gather. Surprisingly, there was also a beautifully rustic barn-house, accompanied by a garden area and pond, as well as a nice little chicken coop--to make things complete:)

All in all, out of all the places I've ever traveled in the country, I consider "At The Corner" to be the best "bang for your buck" when it comes to the accommodation sizes, offerings, and convenience--especially when you consider its only 15-20 minutes away from the airport, Cornell, and downtown Ithaca. So yeah, next time I roll through the Finger Lakes area, I plan on staying At the Corner:)!!

reviews.author: Jeremiah apgar
reviews.text: Awesome example of Victorian architecture and tastefully decorated inside. The host are great!

reviews.author: Nadine Louge
reviews.text:
The Lansing Community Library is wonderful. It has a nice selection of books and the staff can locate and get any book that is in the Finger Lakes Library System’s 33 member librairies. The people staffing the library are invariably kind and helpful.
Ample and easy parking make it my library destination of choice.

reviews.author: Stephanie Button
reviews.text: They have great community programs. Story times, crafts, leggos, movies and more. We enjoy having this place especially when school is out and we need a good place to get together. They are very friendly and helpful. They just requested a bunch of books for my daughter who has fallen in love with reading a specific series. They go above and beyond in my opinion.

reviews.author: L. Wilson
reviews.text: Very nice little library. Not a huge selection, but very friendly and well organized.  Easy to park.

reviews.author: Ricardo Fernandez
reviews.text: Rustic old inn with a lot of history that has been nicely refurbished by its current owner Eileen who is on site and cooks and serves you a nice breakfast. The accomodations were nice enough and the room was reasonably well appointed and priced. There is a bar, The Corner Pub, that is attached serving your above average pub fare wirh a friendly crowd and staff. Seems like a local hangout. Not much to do within walking distance and not a place to walk due to roads and traffic. Close to Ithaca, NY though and fingerlake wineries  along nearby five finger lakes. Brewery nearby but did not get to go.

reviews.author: Nick Berghane
reviews.text:
Had a lovely experience at the historic Rogue’s Harbor Inn! The staff was absolutely tremendous, the breakfast exactly what I needed and the room was clean and well kept. I forgot something very important to me and they even offered to ship it back to my apartment in providence which was just the cherry on top.

Very much recommend to anyone looking for accommodations in Lansing/near Ithaca!

reviews.author: Gabriel B
reviews.text: I was very pleasantly impressed with the atmosphere and quality of this inn. It’s conveniently close to Ithaca, but tucked away just up the lake. The rooms and building are elegantly and tastefully decorated, the furnishings are modern and well-maintained (especially for a historic building), the staff and Eileen are kind and accommodating, and it’s a great value for the price. I was especially impressed with how thoughtful and meticulous the experience was, both aesthetically and functionally. They carefully attend to the small details, whether in your unique room or serving you food in the dining atrium, and it makes a big difference in your experience. For anyone visiting the finger lakes, I’d expect coming to a place like the Rogues Harbor Inn will augment your experience in the serene countryside with its complementary refinement and sophisticated charm. And, it’s half the price of the more crowded competitors in Ithaca proper, but only a short (and pretty) drive away. I’ll be recommending it to friends and coming back sometime soon.

reviews.author: TheRed Hill
reviews.text:
Casual and comfortable roadhouse bar and dining room. The sauce on my buffalo chicken salad was amazing and seemed house made with a very broad flavor spectrum. The dijon dill salad dressing on a house salad was also very bright and perky! From the dining room you could hear the kitchen staff pleasantly and diligently working away which added a little fun to the atmosphere.

Update: We went back with a larger group and tried a number of appetizers with our entrees. The medium hot buffalo wings were excellent, though next time I may ask for a little more sauce on the side. They were amazingly crispy on the outside and juicy and tender on the inside! The sauce was flavorful buffalo, but with a perfect infusion of black pepper! The biggest surprise was the Irish chips! The malt (vinegar) aioli was amazing and the housemade chips were not overdone and dry as they are at a lot of other places! Even happier with our second visit! The Cowboy Burger was great, too!

reviews.author: Brittany Bauman
reviews.text: My grandma niece and I came on Valentine’s Day and I cat say enough about this place! The food was amazing and the service was even better! The chef treated my niece like gold. He made her sliced apple before her lunch and offered her ice cream after even asking what her favorite Taylor swift song was so he could play it for her! If you haven’t came your missing out!

reviews.author: Lance Kelly
reviews.text: I discovered this place during a sight seeing detour and stopped in for lunch. There was plenty of parking and seating available though it seemed to get busier as the afternoon rolled on. The fried pickles were a good appetizer and the Irish fries would also be a good choice. The haddock was a large piece, however it wasn't served with lemon slices; I didn't ask for them either. The coleslaw was crunchy and flavorful; I prefer mine creamy but I wasn't disappointed. The wooden booths can become uncomfortable after a while. Though there were a couple large groups the noise level was low enough to have a conversation with the person across from me. Our server was excellent and made me feel welcomed while engaging me with conversation. I would definitely go again if I'm in the area.

reviews.author: Tanis and Manny Soriano
reviews.text:
Horrible. 2 young girls working, no uniforms or sense of urgency. 3 ppl waiting for the food part of their orders. Counter girl is also the drive thru girl. Backroom girl emerges with 1 croissant sandwich for 1st waiting guest. Then hands a order of hash brown to 2nd waiting guest assuming he was with the 1st guest. As shes walking back she wipes her nose with her gloved hands!!!  By now its been 8 min since i got my drink. Just as i think im next nope 1st guest had her sandwich made wrong and starts complaining to have it remade, 2nd guest also informs he has more than just hash browns and wants his remaining items. I told the girl forget about my wake up wrap and hashbrowns im leaving. 10 min later.

Worst worst wish i could give 0 stars

reviews.author: Mark Avery
reviews.text: I don't like to leave bad reviews but the worst possible service. I just wanted a donut and came up to the counter. There were seven employees. I stood and stood and stood after several minutes I just left. I never got any service no one even said hello. Maybe you can only purchase donuts at Dunkin Donuts on an App

reviews.author: mike hurd
reviews.text: Employees ignoring us initially. Donuts were all stale. Half dozen donuts are not worth 10 bucks.

reviews.author: Karen Chimento
reviews.text: Unfortunately no longer Purity ice cream.  Despite the big ice cream cone sign that says Purity on it as you come in the parking lot, they haven't served Purity in the last couple years at least and it shows.  The three of us got three different flavors of hard ice cream, and they were all somewhat flavorless and grainy to boot.  I have liked this place in the past, but for the prices they charge, the ice cream should be way better

reviews.author: John Joly
reviews.text: Wow, so disappointing…. The new owners have really let this place go down hill fast.  This used to be our favorite spot for ice cream, but now it’s an overpriced dump.  Don’t go here, go to Scoops or Purity instead, you’ll thank me. Trash piled up, filthy tables, run down play set…

reviews.author: Carrie lan
reviews.text: When I googled to look up the hours it said open, when we got there the sign said open but not an employee in site and my son and I weren't the only people there, other cars pulled in before and after us, the number that is listed on Google is for the pizza restaurant next door, the gentleman that answered was very nice and said they should be open and explained the Icecream shop used to be inside the pizza place at one point. Pretty disappointed that we were led to believe they were open and it wasn't. Not a good look for new customers who wanted to try them out

reviews.author: Travis Virgadamo
reviews.text: I don't like giving a local spot a negative review, but the lack of meat on the subs here is laughable.  Adding an extra star because the bread and veggies were ok.  Step up your meat game or remove subs from your menu!

reviews.author: Bridget Wellen
reviews.text: Looks like not much of anything from the outside, but the food is great. The first calzone I had there was crispy and unmatched by any I have ever had before. Excellent marinara to the side. The second calzone was slightly softer, but still great and probably caused by sitting while I drove to my husband.  The falafels are spectacular.  Some of the best I have ever had. The chicken and beef gyros were also excellent. Worth multiple visits to try everything! My only regret is that we couldn't stay in town long enough for me to order a pizza from them.

reviews.author: Ana Kristina Wambach
reviews.text:
I grew up in New Rochelle, NY and thus got to go to NYC quite often. For me, NYC pizza can't be topped. This place and Franco's in downtown Ithaca are about as close to NYC Pizza as it gets without actually Being NYC Pizza!

A couple of bonuses here are:
-the house salad always has beautiful, fresh and crispy lettuce (I've experienced much of the opposite from multiple pizzarias out here) as well as the best variety of fresh veggies to go along with it
-the portions of the Tiramisu are for one, delicious but also Generous. Especially for $5!

Occasionally, they may be understaffed and there may be a wait. Stay patient and kind - it's worth the wait!

reviews.author: Gigi A
reviews.text:
Out of town Customer Review:
We recently came here for breakfast and overall had a good experience, with a few areas that could improve.
When we arrived, the place was full, which wasn’t an issue at all. We waited about 20-30 minutes. The wait itself was fine; however, as tables started to open up, they weren’t being cleaned promptly, which delayed us being seated. That first impression was a bit frustrating.
Once seated, we were not given a menu right away however we placed our drink order. Just a heads up—there is no hot chocolate, and it’s not on the menu. That said, the juices and other drink options were great and very refreshing.
Our server truly stood out. She was kind, friendly, super polite, and very attentive. She gave thoughtful recommendations and made us feel welcome.
One thing that was pointed out at the table was the eggs. They appeared to be organic, which was a nice touch. The feedback was mixed though—one person felt the eggs were delicious, while another didn’t enjoy them as much. I personally didn’t order eggs, so I can’t speak to them myself.
I had to step out before eating, so I got my order to go (blueberry pancakes). The two people I was dining with said their food was very, very good. When I later tried my pancakes, they did not disappoint at all—great flavor, and I can only imagine how amazing they would’ve been fresh and warm.
I also used the restroom and noticed how warm and cozy it was, which really highlighted the comfortable atmosphere they’re creating.
The only reason for the 3-star rating is the initial seating experience. A couple arrived about 10 minutes after us, and the same staff member (owner) immediately offered them multiple table options—even a dirty one, saying it could be cleaned right away. We’re hoping this wasn’t intentional and just an off moment.
Overall, great food, wonderful service from our waitress only. We’d like to come back and hope to be seated in a more timely and organized manner next time. Blessings to the business and continued success to the team.

reviews.author: Kristi
reviews.text:
Excellent visit and will definitely be back. The space is welcoming and the owners have done a very nice job with renovating from the previous business. It is light colored and a rustic vibe which is cozy and airy. The breakfast menu felt very diner like with a high quality flair for those we are looking for something a little more upscale. Food was fantastic, great local items included and advertised as well as local beers on tap. We loved everything we ate. Service was friendly and quick and the prices were excellent.
We were a group of 3 adults who each had a meal, plus one side of delicious Wide Awake Bakery Bread and jam, 3 coffees total, 2 local craft beers total, and a mimosa and the bill came out to $56 before tip!

The food is clearly homemade and done with care. Highly reccomend stopping in and getting a meal. Side note: they use very lightly processed, unbleached flour to make their biscuits and pancakes which is healthier and easier to digest for people that deal with the issues of American Gluten products. They also had oat milk available for a non-dairy option if people need it.

All in all, 5 star, can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Debbie Kemberling
reviews.text: Found this to be a great place to eat. Lots of locals there. Food was amazing! Owner was very friendly and kept checking in on us, and not when our mouths were full of the delicious food, bonus!!!

reviews.author: Grace Yusko
reviews.text: Lisa and her team did an absolutely amazing job on my wedding hair! We did a last-minute booking, and she and her team stepped up to the plate. My hair looked absolutely perfect, and all of my bridesmaids' hair looked amazing as well. Her makeup skills are impeccable. I can't recommend her enough!

reviews.author: Lauryn VanOrden
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing!! She always does great work and my daughter has a happy experience every hair cut, wouldn’t go anywhere else other than home for a cut other than Lisa!!!!

reviews.author: Lauren Ryan Hamacher
reviews.text: I loved working with Lisa and her staff for my wedding! I first met her in June 2018 for my trial and we instantly clicked, I booked her on the spot that day.
