I was with her several times over my wedding weekend -- she did nails for my mom and I and my hair for my rehearsal dinner and then came to our venue (the John Joseph Inn) the day of to do hair and makeup for me, my 6 bridesmaids, my mom and my mother in law. Everyone looked beautiful and was so happy with the end result!

reviews.author: Maureen Carroll
reviews.text: The service is local, friendly, and efficient. I've been using this post office branch for over 35 years and was very happy when it survived the cuts to other small branches that occurred several years ago. The hours are what the hours are, and I appreciate not having to drive over to the main branch on Warren Road every time I need anything.

reviews.author: Dave sit
reviews.text: Friendly dependable service. I've mailed out dozens of packages from this post office and have never had a problem. Sure, the hours are not ideal, open for only a few hours a day. But it's not this post office's fault, so why give it a bad review. The main post office is only a few miles away on Warren Rd. I'm glad this one is just 2 miles from my house.

reviews.author: Stephen Perrine
reviews.text: Great little post office, hours of operation Monday- Friday 12pm-4pm And Saturday 10am-12pm

reviews.author: Mita Stojanovic
reviews.text: Good thing is they are open 24/7. Bad things. I spent 10 min trying to put money in machine. 10 $ i quarter machine return me 7$ , then again and again, then paper money. 10 min in total. Owner should change machine from ‘80 and put something new. And on the end car was dirty like before. Washer cleaned 20%. Never come back again

reviews.author: David Thompson
reviews.text: Really like this car wash. Does not accept credit cards but you can download an app that makes it very easy. Bays were clean, elevated position so car can be easily wiped down after washing

reviews.author: Tyr Wiesner-Hanks
reviews.text:
The good - The app they started using here is pretty convenient IMO. Way easier than feeding 28 quarters into a machine or getting halfway done and realizing you don't have enough cash to finish rinsing off your car. There's a $5 credit for first time users and it was easy enough to sign up.

The bad - The pre-rinse hose setting on my bay didn't have any pressure. It was like trying to squeeze juice out of a Capri Sun. The soap used for the main scrub brush has kind of a bubblegum scent that I find pretty nasty. I wish they'd switch to citrus or a more generic soap scent or something.

reviews.author: Fly, You Fools
reviews.text: Super kind, friendly, thoughtful staff. My dog had some mats I was ashamed about but they were so nice about it and didn't make me feel bad. And they made her look wonderful. She was very happy too and loves her groomers.

reviews.author: Brian Toy
reviews.text: No Barks About It is amazing! Our Bichon Frise Hans has been coming for over a year. He always comes out happy and looking amazing. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: megan nettleton
reviews.text:
I  love no barks about it! The staff is amazing. They take excellent care of my one dog Bart, who loves to go to daycare once or twice a week:)

They are also incredibly great with my other dog, who can have an attitude with grooming. I trust them 100%!

reviews.author: Joshua Chase
reviews.text: Car died at the Lansing Market. I walked down and Pat took great care of me. Drove me up to my car to check personally on it. Towed it down to shop and gave me a couple estimates of problems.  Very upfront and honest and easy to work with. Diagnosed the problem when he got it on the lift and completed the work for a very reasonable price. Great spot. Busy place.

reviews.author: Kwan Rausch Moran
reviews.text:
I went here awhile ago and was happy with their work.
I just called today and ask about some estimates for a couple of my cars and I was told “I’m not really interested in doing all that” in a rather rude tone.  Neither of the jobs were very labor intensive and I felt rather let down, and swatted aside by the person who answered the phone. I guess I will not be going back there :(

reviews.author: Dmitri Novgorodsky
reviews.text: A truly harrowing experience. My car's alternator broke down last night. I called AAA, and the person who came to tow my car recommended Phoenix Auto. Dropped the car off and called them this morning. Got immediately screamed at, "Why are you calling me when I just came in?!!!” I explained that I dropped off the car last night and needed to have it fixed soon. - “Just stop!!! Stop right there!!! I need to go to the yard and look at your car! If say ONE MORE WORD, I am done with you!”. I called the towing service that recommended Phoenix Auto last night. They concurred that I probably should not be screamed at... and recommended another place in downtown Ithaca. I called the other car service and explained the situation. They replied (politely and professionally) that they could take the car in and get the alternator fixed by the end of today. Got my car re-towed to another place. At additional expense, but I had a bizarre feeling that people who didn't start their business relationship with me by yelling would end up doing a better job. Sure enough, the car was ready to go by 12:15 pm. My first "experience" with Phoenix Auto and, needless to say, the last one. I have never encountered such rudeness and unprovoked insolence towards a potential customer before .

reviews.author: Shay Teoli
reviews.text:
This was our first stop on our trip to Ithaca and it was the perfect start to our trip. From the atmosphere, to the friendly staff and the amazing food...5 stars across the board.
The atmosphere is a combination of 70s diner but with an add of updated sophisticated vibe with the rose gold lighting fixtures and the ceiling details. The food was absolutely amazing. The menu has a variety of options to choose from for anyone. The hostess was charming and quick to greet us at the door. And our server, she was an absolute delight. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Ithaca.

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: Lovely place, perfect for brunch. I ordered a dish from lunch menu (turkey club sandwiches). They were tasty, turkey meat was fresh and bacon was cooked well. Loved the vegetables inside too. Moreover, they serve french fries with sandwiches, pretty big portion. They have sauces for different dishes, used ketchup for my french fries. Also loved a little pickle. My wife ordered a breakfast item: Brie French Brioche, and it was massive and tasty too. Moreover, they also gave a cup of syrup, which was nice. I didn't have a drink, but she had a coffee and liked it. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Coty Lunn
reviews.text: Milkstand in Ithaca, NY was absolutely wonderful. The service was excellent and friendly, making the experience feel welcoming from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm, cozy, and aesthetically pleasing, with thoughtful details that made the space really enjoyable to be in. The food was fantastic, fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Overall a very good experience and a place I would happily return to and recommend to others!

reviews.author: Angelo Garcia
reviews.text: I have visited Ithaca several times and every time I am in town I eat here!!! Prices are modest and the food is delicious!!! Service is friendly and courteous!! Facilities are kept clean and orderly! Plenty parking and plenty to choose from!!! Bring your friends, family and colleagues you will love it!!!

reviews.author: TheRed Hill
reviews.text: We have only done takeout… Lobster ravioli was great… enough that I am torn between repeating that each time , but guessing the other options would have to also be that good. We have ordered their baked wings a few times. They are not buffalo wings-they’re an Italian restaurant, but they are a very tangy caramelized onion sauce. They taste great and are VERY moist and plenty meaty! (It’d be nice if there were an option to add Calabrian peppers for heat, but they are really good as is!) They were super busy with takeout orders, a lot because people were not ready with their payment, but the staff remained pleasant, helpful and all hands on deck.

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text: Palento fries were lacking flavor and I was expecting way more from them. The sacchetti pasta and ravioli were good but the lobster ravioli was on the sweeter side wheras the sacchetti was very rich with cheese. Portion sizes for both were on the smaller side.

reviews.author: Dave Nutter
reviews.text: Friendly honest service. I showed up with a damaged tire. They were very busy with people who had appointments, which Shannon honored. I left my car knowing it could be several days, but Shannon found time to fix it the next morning. Glad to have them in the neighborhood!

reviews.author: Douglas Milton
reviews.text: The auto personnel is always professional, courteous, friendly, and knowledgeable. I had to have a tire fixed and it took only 15 minutes! I appreciate the excellent service and have referred the service practices to many Friends & Family. Thank you, Dan, Rob, and your wonderful mechanics!*

reviews.author: Anup Ved
reviews.text: Needed a pre-purchase inspection for a car and Dan from Steve Shannon was incredible. The whole process was so smooth and reasonable. No up selling, no pressure tactics. One upfront cost and that too the lowest I could find. Very very happy with the service.

reviews.author: Nicholas Bower
reviews.text: The guys behind the counter and helpful and understanding. Never see this place understaffed, and there is always someone here to help you load up lumber or whatever else into your truck.

reviews.author: Michael Whitmarsh
reviews.text: Great hometown building supply/home improvement center. Very helpful and friendly staff that gives you excellent customer service that a mom and pop store does.

reviews.author: Michael Ezzo
reviews.text:
I came in to buy less than a dollar worth of hardware to fix a broken shower handle in a pinch. Despite knowing i was not going to be spending much money, and without asking them, the staff helped me for over an hour to extract the broken set screw out of the handle. Everyone there went way above and beyond to help me! The selection of tools is not as large as the big stores, but so well thought out, theyll carry the quality tools that work! Id rate them higher if possible!
-A customer for life!

reviews.author: Telephone
reviews.text:
I had a great shopping experience at Best Buy in Ithaca recently and wanted to share how impressed I was. This store offers a wide selection of electronics, home appliances, and tech products, all in a convenient, well-organized location.
The layout of the store is easy to navigate, making it simple to find exactly what you're looking for. Whether it's the latest laptops, smartphones, gaming consoles, or home theater systems, Best Buy has it all. I was particularly impressed with their selection of high-end electronics—everything is neatly displayed, and you can actually get a hands-on feel for the products before buying.
The staff were incredibly helpful and knowledgeable, which made my shopping experience even better. I had some questions about a laptop I was considering, and an associate took the time to walk me through the options and features, helping me make an informed decision without any pressure.
Their customer service is top-notch as well. When I had an issue with a previous purchase, the team was quick to assist me and made the return process smooth and hassle-free. I was pleasantly surprised at how accommodating they were.
They also have great deals and offers throughout the year, and if you’re into tech or gadgets, you’ll definitely want to keep an eye out for their promotions. Plus, their price match guarantee ensures you’re getting the best deal, so it’s hard to go wrong shopping here.
Overall, Best Buy Ithaca is a fantastic place for anyone looking for tech products, appliances, or even just some good advice from the friendly staff. It’s my go-to destination for electronics, and I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Chris Williams
reviews.text:
I’m back for the second week in a row writing another well earned 1 star review. Had to use my other email, but at this point they absolutely deserved another 1 star review. I bought a 75’ Hisense LEMON October 22nd.

The LEMON was delivered November 5th. Long story short (you can go back to the 1 star review from Chris W if you want the details) the LEMON did not work. BEST BUY scheduled to pick it up 11/13. They did not come. I re-scheduled for the 19th. They did not come again.

So being the brainiac (sarcasm) I am, I thought “hmmm I’ll just order the new TV and have them pick up the LEMON when they drop off the new TV that is hopefully not a LEMON too.”

Well, that plan was about as productive and useful as a toothache. They get here to deliver the new TV and I ask if they were taking the old one. They said no, and that another team was doing pick ups. I call to confirm and they say they have nothing scheduled for me. This is a LIE. Right in my app the date, time and TV is confirmed.

So at this point I’ve taken off 4 days of work 11/5, 11/13, 11/19 and today 11/26 to deal with this. Who would be happy with this customer service?

Best Buy does not deserve my business or yours! After almost 10 years of being a card holder I am absolutely positively closing out my account with them once this is all settled. Closing out is worth the couple point hit to my credit score at this point.

This big 75’ LEMON has been sitting in the family room since 11/13 waiting to be picked up. No one is allowed in there because I’m sure if something happens to the LEMON Best Buy will act funny about the return.

I know this is one of the only places to purchase electronics in the area, but I think everyone should look elsewhere whenever they can!

I don’t care what the owners response is to this review! This is absolutely ridiculous and you guys need to be ashamed of how you do business. I only say that because not a single one of them is too concerned with the fact that I had to use 4 going on 5 of my days off on this issue.

Thank you! I appreciate y'all wasting my time!

reviews.author: Chris Williams
reviews.text:
Bought a 75’ Hisense TV October 22nd. The day before the delivery November 5th I noticed that I put in the address up the street instead of mine, so I changed it. They pushed the date out another 8 days which seemed absolutely ridiculous, but I guess I did change the address by 500 feet and god forbid they do a little problem solving. I would totally understand if I changed the delivery to Binghamton, but they said there was nothing they could do. Yeah okay. So, there’s one day I had to take off from work that didn’t amount to anything.

I finally get the TV November 13th (another day I had to take off). I didn’t get a chance to “watch” it until the 16th. I turn it on and it turns off. The duration varies from 5 minutes to an hour, but it always cuts off at some point. I rinse and repeat this cycle for another 2 days until I’m finally fed up with it and request a return.

They schedule my return pick up for today 11/19 (another day I took off from work). They don’t show up and when I call customer service they said it was because I didn’t answer a phone earlier in the day. Mind you the same delivery driver (it says in the app who is delivering) did not call me last week when he dropped the LEMON off so why was that a make it or break it factor today?

Also, no where on the prep list BEST BUY gives you does it say to answer the phone when they are 15 minutes away or they will cancel the order. It says to make sure someone 18+ is here upon arrival!

So, now I’ve taken off 3 days (November 5th/13th/19th) of work for 1 LEMON of a TV. Now it looks like I’ll have to take off a 4th and maybe even a 5th day so they can maybe possibly manage to come pick up this LEMON and then drop me off the new TV I ordered (Hopefully not a LEMON).

It has been a serious debacle on BEST BUYS part and once this situation is resolved I will be closing my account with them after almost 10 years and thousands of dollars in unnecessary purchases.

This was my first credit card after graduating college and up until now I have been pretty happy with the customer service department. With that said the last couple of weeks have made it clear to me that closing out my account is worth the hit on my credit score. I’ve spent over 5hrs on the phone with them for them to tell me there is nothing they can do about their mess up’s. I see no way in which this gets better so I’ll just cut ties now.

No one should be happy after taking off 3 days to deal with 1 TV that DOES NOT WORK PROPERLY.

They do not deserve my business and they do not deserve yours. DO BETTER BEST BUY!

Oh yeah, I don’t want to forget!
I also ordered a Samsung tablet 2 weeks ago that had to be returned last week because the screen was broken as soon as I turned it on. 2 LEMONS in 2 weeks + 5/6hrs on the phone is crazy work.

reviews.author: Tonilynn Egbowon
reviews.text: The lady, I did my puppy. I explained to her that she had a horrible, first experience that she was very afraid because the other lady that did her first ever haircut, traumatized her she was afraid of the water. She was afraid of the dryer everything and she took her time and did a beautiful haircut on her. I can’t believe how beautiful she is. She came out with her hair looking so even her face cut out and trimmed so nicely. Everything was beautiful.

reviews.author: Sophie Alemany
reviews.text: I love this place. It’s always clean, their prices are reasonable, they care about their clients, and they always take a photo of every dog after their groom with seasonal backdrops and props! My dog is reactive and benefits from a one-at-a-time type deal. BBB is one of the few that offer this type of scheduling and I am forever grateful! The owner is very hands-on and was willing to help me with the process of setting my dog up for her first grooming session. Ally has been my dog’s groomer since I have been coming to BBB and my dog absolutely loves her! Ally listened to my dog’s needs and was flexible with my hectic schedule. She explained each step to me and what she used and why, she spoke kindly to my dog, lets me know if there’s other dogs in the building, and was super patient with my dog for her photo. I cannot imagine going anywhere else!

reviews.author: Nicole Dann
reviews.text: What an amazing experience from booking the appointment to walking out the door! Our pups look great! They took the time to explain and educate us on our dogs grooming needs. They are passionate about what they do! Wonderful staff.

reviews.author: George Fine
reviews.text:
Dollar Tree Ithaca:
Very clean, organized and well stocked.
Many of the Dollar Trees we frequent in NYC, is barren, disorganized and messy.
This one is fantastic, including the staff.

reviews.author: Joseph Clink
reviews.text: I was shopping at this location in ithaca ny and over heard one of the managers Tell a pregnant woman that he will call the cops on her because he smelled alcohol on her breath and that he said it is affecting his health. I looked up the law and that is illegal disinformation and that a employee cannot make threats like that. Hope it gets taken care of. Plus threatening to ban the person because of of a personal matter of one's self is illegal.

reviews.author: Adati Tarfa
reviews.text: Very lovely and nice dollar tree with helpful staff! Well stocked as well. You’ll find what you are looking for.

reviews.author: Gerard Farmer
reviews.text: I came here on a business trip and the people and staff are so nice. I liked they had Canadian beer on tap but they can use an arcade machine besides the dart board. I wanna go as soon as the leaves fall again.

reviews.author: Kaylee Oliver
reviews.text: New ownership has this place making food as good as… actually, even better than before. The wings are the ones you’d expect from UJ and then some, plus the best bleu cheese in Ithaca. Burgers cooked to your temperature can’t be beat, and the quick service is great! It’s not a party spot, but a place to catch a game or have a solid dinner and be surrounded by great locals, great beer, and great vibes.

reviews.author: Kellie M
reviews.text: We ate here back in November. Was hesitant to stop. It wasn't busy when we got there. The food was really good. Best burger I'd had in a long time. We would go back.

reviews.author: Joshua Roenfeldt
reviews.text: Excellent lunch and our go-to spot for pizza and wings in Ithaca. The thin-crust pizza has a perfectly crunchy texture and holds up well under the toppings. We ordered pepperoni, chicken bacon ranch, plain cheese, and buffalo—each one was flavorful and well balanced. The pepperoni was classic and savory, the chicken bacon ranch was rich and satisfying, and the buffalo pizza had just the right amount of heat. The wings were equally solid and paired perfectly with the pizza. Consistently great quality and taste—highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kimberly StetsonGelinas
reviews.text: Haven't been impressed with the portions on the pizza for quite some time. I usually go for the Buffalo Chicken with a cup of ranch on the side but there's hardly any chicken on it. Today they didn't have Buffalo Chicken available for slices so I got the Tomato & Feta and I dont think they could have possibly sliced the tomatoes any thinner.. tomatoes cost what $0.30/ tomato?

reviews.author: Pam Gueldner
reviews.text: The new owner Philip is great, same level of service as Ned. I ordered 5 large pizzas through their AI order taker and wanted delivery but it was very confusing to understand what was going on with the order. I told AI I wanted delivery, it said okay and it would get delivery details later after I placed my order, I placed the order, gave my credit card but never got a prompt to enter a delivery location, and the AI said thank you and goodbye. I am not sure what happened, but I don't recommend using the AI order system. They don't have their own delivery drivers, so you have to use one of the apps for delivery I believe. Phillip made sure my order was delivered on time and hot, and spent a lot of time with me making sure I was satisfied. Same great pizza, same great service.

reviews.author: Adlantic (Timelost)
reviews.text: One of my favorite restaurants in the Ithaca area. Whether it is by delivery or in person, I have thoroughly enjoyed the food here over the years. The restaurant is well furnished and gives off a relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.text:
Better have called your order in or YOU'RE the problem! 👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽

I went in to order in person since they were having phone issues. When I walked in and was asked what I ordered, I explained I couldn't due to the phone line being busy, which shouldn't be a problem either way. I was given attitude for not placing my order beforehand, and the young man who was at the counter, proceeded to roll his eyes and throw his head back like I ruined his entire evening.

I told him that I didn't have to order if it was an inconvenience and then I asked him what his problem was. He gave me an emotionless apology in front of other families and asked me what I wanted like it wasn't a big deal? I've been coming here for years and I've ordered at the counter many times without it being a problem before.

Capital Corner has once again lost another loyal customer and I'll never set foot in there again.

reviews.author: Sage Lee
reviews.text: We decided to visit on a whim and were pleasantly surprised! The other reviews about slow service are pretty accurate; there were like 2 other tables other than ours (and some takeout orders) and it still took a bit. But the food was actually really good and very economical. The dinner combo platter gets you fried rice, an entree, soup, and an eggroll. Portions were really big; both my partner and I had to get boxes. We ordered the mooshu pork (w/ hot & sour soup, pork eggroll, pork fried rice) and mapo tofu (w/ egg drop soup, pork eggroll, pork fried rice). This place stands up to Apollo in terms of quality and price. We also ordered the shrimp spring roll appetizer, expecting a summer roll, but it was just another deep fried egg roll. Also, the chili sauce they offer on the table is quite hot, be warned. Will definitely be coming back sometime soon!

reviews.author: Galyna Shulimova
reviews.text: It was just one option for Thanksgiving dinner, but I was pleasantly surprised by the cozy atmosphere - we sat next to a real wood fireplace. The staff were very helpful and nice, and the food was fresh and delicious. The prices were also very reasonable. I definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: Amazing place! Good prices, especially for sandwiches. The food was excellent, I had a Deli Rose sandwich (it's pretty big, definitely bigger than burgers in fast food for the same price) served with chips and pickle and lemon lime cooler, and all was great. The staff is very polite and friendly, they like to talk to you about different things while you waiting for your order. Maybe wait-time was a little bit long, but I think it was because there were many people at lunch. But again, it was worth it, and I was satisfied with my lunch

reviews.author: Marcia Perry
reviews.text:
I always only dined at Moosewood when  visiting Ithaca. My dogs 🐕 vet suggested I try  The Yellow Deli. I was so surprised with the warm greeting upon entering. The menu is extensive to accommodate all dining needs. I received outstanding service and food suggestions. The food is delicious, well prepared and nicely presented. The amount of food is huge. Bring a large appetite or you will be leaving with a big take home 🏡 bag like me.
I WILL  be back!

reviews.author: Jordan Mathews
reviews.text: Great used book store. Everything was in great condition and reasonably priced, in my opinion. There were records and DVDs upstairs. They had sheet music, too. There's something for everyone.

reviews.author: Stephanie Holbrook
reviews.text: Good size used book store with helpful staff. The store is a bit overwhelming though we asked the cashier for help and he guided us over to what we were looking for immediately. The upstairs is filled with records, cds, dvds, comics, be sure to check it out. There is also a basement level though we didn’t explore it as the genres down there weren’t what we were looking for.

reviews.author: Aeryn
reviews.text: Largest used bookstore I’ve ever seen! A real treasure trove. They have books of every kind, vinyls, CDs, sheet music, stickers, poetry, you name it. There are even bargain books for a dollar. Just a fantastic place, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Grace Mary
reviews.text: Used to come here with friends to sell and buy, but will not be coming here anymore. If you want to thrift for quality, I recommend Evergreen. The hours are not accurately represented, so it’s a waste of a drive. They’re always “closed,” even when there are people in the store and lights on. Tonight the girls working there were giggling behind the counter at 5 pm when the sign says they close at 8pm on Saturdays. They said “sorry, we’re closed.”  The girls that work there are very rude and unhelpful. They are definitely y teenagers running the store that just close up whenever they feel like it.

reviews.author: Kailey O'Donnell
reviews.text: Drove an hour into Ithaca to drop off clothes to sell, only to be greeted by a sharpie sign taped to the door that says they are not selling today. At least post something on social media so people don’t waste their time.

reviews.author: Mathilde Longchamps
reviews.text: Staff is rude and frankly sort of bitchy I’m not sure why I was super nice towards them any question I had was met with annoyance and dismissal. All the clothes were fast fashion worth nothing sold for 30$ plus dollars very expensive for what it is. overall not a great store.

reviews.author: Sundeep Venkatesan
reviews.text: We ordered chicken Noodles and chicken katsu. Both tasted pretty good and we all enjoyed it. The chicken noodles initially came with beef and when we pointed out the waiter just removed the beef pieces and brought it back which still had some pieces in it. Did not make a big deal about it as the service was good and everyone was having a good time. The Sangria orange soda was surprisingly delicious and my kids enjoyed popping and tasting it.

reviews.author: Ted Rejman
reviews.text: I have lived in the area all my life. Never knew about Sumo until one of our daughters invited us to eat together there. What an experience. Totally enjoyed the chef KIKI, as he prepared our meal in front of us. I interacted with him and it made tge experience even more enjoyable. We had enough leftovers to take home for another meal. Everything we had was delicious. Definitely will be going back.

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text: The lunch special made this place worthwhile and we were very pleased. The portion sizes were really nice. Not too crowded and nice ambiance.

reviews.author: Jezandladybug
reviews.text: In short: If you like Moe's, go to any location but here, because the staff might just call the cops on you for respectfully pointing out a simple mistake. I wish I was joking. Longer: I've been coming to this location for years, and it was generally fine. Some food items changed over the years in ways I believe lowered the overall taste and quality, but not so much that I couldn't eat there. But now, I'm never eating here again due to a horrible staff interaction. I know there are a lot of Karens out there, and I know customer service jobs can be stressful, but I cannot defend how staff chose to handle what should've been a simple resolution. Generally, if you're polite about a mistake, folks are understanding back and things get resolved without stress. But here, staff were extremely rude and aggressive when a small order error was brought up. They blamed me, forced me to pay for the staff's mistake, and then called the cops when I asked for a partial refund after being overcharged for less food. This was several staff members backing up combative behavior from one member in particular, so I don't have faith management will do anything to address the problem. Also, the cops who showed up said they'd received complaints about this staff before, and they let me and my friend go after just a few questions. So, I suggest avoiding this location at all costs.

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text:
(Placed on online order)
Pros:
- Food is usually good/decent
- Free chips and salsa is nice
- Price is okay

Cons:
- Consistency.
I almost never get the same results with the same order I place, sometimes my bowl is packed with all of my ingredients and it’s very solid but sometimes (like today) I get half of my ingredients missing and the ones I do get are incredibly small and for the price I paid I was very disappointed.

Overall this place would be pretty good if the consistency was better

reviews.author: Abdul Azeez
reviews.text: I was at this location for a vacation. I ordered two bowls and a value meal. I asked the server if guacamole is extra and he said its not extra on the bowls. So I added. At the end he billed me as two home wrecker bowls when I had clearly indicated I needed the regular meal and had asked if guacamole was extra. He said something about him adding some extra portions on the toppings and I would not get them if he threw the meal away and made new ones. I did not want to argue or waste food. So I paid the extra and left. However tbe location is not transparent about pricing. Why would he assume i was asking for the homewrecker when I only said I needed tbe bowl? I would not recommend this location.

reviews.author: Aimee Dars Ellis
reviews.text: Mockingbird Paperie has wonderful cards that can't be found many other places. They also offer stationery-related gifts and fine wrapping paper. The selections are strongest for birthdays and blank cards. I went in for graduation cards and found few to choose from which surprised me given the time of year and that Ithaca is a college town. Usually, though, I can find the perfect cards for my needs.

reviews.author: Filip Galiza
reviews.text:
Love this store, love this staff, love the products as well as the art here.  When you want to buy something that is more meaningful, that doesn’t come from Amazon, that will have some meaningful usage then this is the place to visit.

Staff was SUUUUPER cool to chat with about the art and other things.  People like them is what makes Ithaca a very cool place!

reviews.author: Jeremy Boody, PMP
reviews.text: Sasha provided incredible customer service from when we first spoke on the phone to the in-store experience. This was my first time in a specialty store like this and their help made all the difference. The products had a great selection to choose from with even greater quality. I purchased a great card & envelope, a red fountain pen, wax, and a stamp for a nicer envelope seal.

reviews.author: Aakash Kapoor
reviews.text: Probably the best wine store in the entirety of Ithaca. The owner is extremely friendly, has amazing recommendations, and always manages to cater to not only what flavors I am craving but also what vibes I am feeling. 15/10 would go again.

reviews.author: Margaux Channell
reviews.text: they have amazing range from affordable and casual wines to specialty. the selection of local wines is great too and they are open during blizzards and all!

reviews.author: steve selin
reviews.text: Great service.  And great liquids.  And being in the Finger Lakes of course they have great ciders.

reviews.author: Jayde Newton
reviews.text: The quality of the food they put out has gone so wildly downhill. I used to order CTB weekly. This is an “open face, scooped, tuna salad bagel + onion & tomato”. Absolute waste of money.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Fabulous experience! Delicious, nutritious food at reasonable prices. Convenient location right near the Cornell campus. Fast, friendly service. A wide variety of both food items and beverages.  A clean, neat store. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Steve Pacenka
reviews.text: Excellent bagels. Great sandwiches and soups. Large menu (except soups) with cryptic names.  Been a regular in this local chain since 1977.

reviews.author: Office of Dr. James Lentini, DPM PLLC
reviews.text: I called this morning as a business owner to inquire about the status of a check that one of this credit union’s members wrote to my business, which was returned for NSF. I spoke with Kiersten at 8:49 AM, who initially mistook me for the member. She did not ask any questions to verify my identity, but stated that the person who transferred me had already told her who I was and where I was calling from — major red flag! Kiersten then told me she could not verify anything about the member’s account or the returned check. When I explained that passing bad checks is illegal, she consulted with her supervisor and returned to the line to repeat that she was unable to provide any information, and that they would need to speak directly with the member. I suggested a three-way call with the member, to which she agreed  but then admitted she had no way to initiate one. Another red flag. I ended the call, realizing there was no chance of getting a straightforward or professional response. To be clear, I wasn’t asking for confidential account details — only to confirm whether the check cleared, since their member insists it did, even though our bank returned it for NSF. Any reputable financial institution would be able to verify this basic information between businesses, but not this one. Absolutely unacceptable experience. Poor communication, unhelpful staff, and no regard for professionalism. I would never recommend doing business with this credit union, and based upon the number of negative reviews someone from this credit union may want to get on the ball.

reviews.author: Don C
reviews.text:
I only use this credit union for a savings account for my emergency fund and tax refunds. Checking is at alternative.
The interest rate is better here. 2x the interest than afcu where I have far more in savings
Had to leave a review after seeing 2.3 avg...
Beginnings is better than 2.3.

reviews.author: E C
reviews.text: 5 phone calls, 5 times I was told my lien release would be sent soon. Still have not received the lien release. Have done all my buisness with them for 10 years.

reviews.author: Rachel Cunningham
reviews.text: Wink’s was great. The staff gave progress updates regularly via text and the vehicle was done on time (one day early, in fact). The repair work was great and it looked like they even detailed the inside a bit. The front office staff was pleasant and thorough, reviewing all aspects of the service when the vehicle was returned.

reviews.author: Morgan Oline Wiig
reviews.text: Have been here for both my Mercedes 300D 1985 and my shitbox Dodge Journey 2014. Have had my master cylinder replaced on the Mercedes, and rear brakes and other things on the Dodge. Joe is great, attentive, and is willing to walk you through what’s going on with your car. Business is super organized and everyone is friendly. Close to Cornell, great for college kids. Go to Winks!

reviews.author: Ezechukwu Nwemeh
reviews.text: Someone hit the door of my 2026 Kona, and Progressive asked me to take the car to Wink’s Body Shop. They performed magic! The staff were kind and professional, and the technicians did an amazing job ensuring I got my car back in less than a week.

reviews.author: Walt Mann
reviews.text: Great food, great atmosphere. the kitchen is so clean, and everyone that works there cares about the quality of the food and the NY style pizza is great and it won't hurt your wallet, I cannot praise this place enough.

reviews.author: Bone & Bottle Reviews
reviews.text:
Found this place while in town on work. First of all, love the name...can't imagine why. Plenty of options for sauces for your wings, and could do regular or charred.

Unfortunately they were out of a couple sauces at the time, but went with a Sweet Chili charred. Was around 18$ for 10 wings which is pretty high these days even with inflation, but, everything in Ithaca seems overpriced, so for their market, this is about right.

Service was good & prompt. Was a couple seats available to eat inside. Wings were pretty good, hit the spot certainly, but no world beaters. Need to explore the Ithaca wing scene more, but these were a good find overall.

reviews.author: Julia Drayton
reviews.text: A hidden gem for sure. One pizza didn't just feed four of us, but had us completely full! The pizza was absolutely delicious, and the staff was very nice. The dining room was quiet and we had a great time. Also, they serve Pepsi products :)

reviews.author: Elisabeth Szafarz
reviews.text: Love this! I miss my Asian Market and had to stock up! Also got an amazing recommendation for cabbage Kimchi 💙 thank you.

reviews.author: Zian Zach
reviews.text: Can’t believe that my top two favorite Korean side dishes can be found here or else the nearest you could go to is Hmart in NYC or NJ. Just bought these today and let me tell you, the quality is amazing! The one on the left is called Korean Wild Pickled Garlic Leaves and the one on the right is Ginseng Kimchi although it’s made out of lettuce, the taste is like eating an actual ginseng with a little bit of bitterness but sweet and salty at the same time. I wish it’s always in stock!

reviews.author: Irham T
reviews.text: I love this place very much! It has a lot of varieties of asian foods, snacks, drinks, and everything! If you are into asian delicacy then this is a recommended place for you to get all your ingredients. It even has indomie! The legendary instant noodle from Indonesia.

reviews.author: Melisa Medina
reviews.text:
Came to this place to wash a comforter that doesn’t fit in my washer. This is the second laundromat I visit in the area with the same purpose. A bit messy, no descriptions on how much to pay or load the washers (every place is different). Many washers were also broken.
On the good side, it was fairly empty on a Sunday morning and their front loader did a good job in cleaning my comforter. I also liked that I can use coins instead of laundry-cards.
Will I come back ? Maybe, is not a well kept laundromat but has a good location after all.

reviews.author: Rebecca Trump
reviews.text: I was in Ithaca as part of a long vacation where I didn't have access to a washer or dryer. Instead of dragging my kids along for a day at the laundromat during the pandemic, I dropped my clothes off here for wash and fold service. A week's worth of clothes for three people and a couple beach towels cost $20. Best 20 bucks I ever spent. I had to leave my clothes for 48 hours, so I had to plan in advance, but they were ready and in very good shape when I picked them up. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Barbara Nussbaum
reviews.text: I was scared. They are not wearing masks even so it is the law for all businesses in New York right now. There is no plastic or other separation between the employee and the costumers. There is no way to maintain a 6 feet distance when bringing in your cry clean stuff or paying. I was told some lame excuse when mentioning the masks. I should have left right away. I will certainly not go there again ever again as I'm an older person.  Who knows in which other ways they violate the law and treat clothes. This business needs to be shut down.

reviews.author: Dennis Logan
reviews.text:
My wife and I stopped here while in a motorcycle tour of the Finger Lakes Region.
What an awesome place to relax and have a one of kind pizza and of course a pint of Peanut Butter Beer.
Yep that’s right.. Peanut Butter Beer!! Was a little reluctant to try it , but are we ever glad we did.
We are already planning to return to the area  from Newcastle Ontario and I am certainly going to make sure I have a little extra room in my saddlebags for some of your Peanutbutter beer.

reviews.author: M Johns
reviews.text: We stopped here during a weekend trip and I am glad we did.  I ordered the meatball tunnel and split a small Nashville Chicken Pizza with my friend.  The meatball tunnel was HUGE.  It's essentially a meatball stromboli but loved the name so I ordered it.  It was very tasty and even tasted good after being reheated at home then eaten cold the next day.  The pizza was also very very good.  The crust was flavorful and chewy.  Can't wait to try their other pizza flavors.  I also had 2 beers, both were very good as well.   Come hungry and leave full(for 2 days).

reviews.author: Naomi Hintenach
reviews.text: The food and service was fantastic. It was fairly busy when we were there and our food still came out in a decent time. The server was so kind and we didn't feel like we were stuck waiting for anything at all. Highly recommend trying The Ouchy, which is their hot honey pizza. At a lot of places I've gone to for a hot honey pizza they put so little you can't tell it's on there. Here had the perfect balance. The pizzas are well made, and are topped sufficiently with higher quality ingredients.

reviews.author: Reed Mizener
reviews.text: I had spent nearly $1000 dollars on new tires and scheduled an appointment a week out to have them installed at 9:30 am I had to move things around in my life to make this happen and as I show up the tire center has a paper sign saying it is closed and the door is locked. I go to a customer service for them to tell me they have no staff. I can understand that but what I couldn't understand is why I had multiple confirmation emails reminding me of my appointment but no one has the wherewithal to contact me even before the appointment to notify me I would have to reschedule. The soonest they could reschedule me after all of this is another week away and I've been riding on a spare tire for the last week. Completely inconsiderate and poor business practice. I am taking a refund and will never use their tire center again and may just cancel my membership altogether.

reviews.author: Dan Forquell
reviews.text:
••••••Update•••••
After several emails and phone calls I finally got a response from management. The tires had a 45 day satisfaction guarantee and I was able to return the original set and have a different brand installed. I changed my rating from 1 to 3 stars because they finally did something to address the issues I was experiencing.

The tire center at this location is nothing short of a joke. Shop is way understaffed and under tooled- they couldn't properly air up my tires after installation. Now I am having issue with tire balance and vibration. I have left several voice mails in an attempt to contact someone which remain unanswered. I cannot endorse using this location for any of your tire needs. (Ithaca, NY)

reviews.author: Buff Orpington
reviews.text: BJs just isn’t a deal anymore.  A few years back, buying bulk often meant lower price overall.  I’ve done the math - for most items, BJs just doesn’t offer discounts vs Aldi and Walmart.  And even if there is a slight discount for some items, you end up spending money on produce or meats that go bad wayyy before the expiration or sell-by date.  Meat section has especially gone downhill, I opened a corned beef roast a week before the sell-by date and it was rancid, not the first time either.  Staff and service in this location had always been good. But if you’re looking to actually save money, BJs just doesn’t serve this function anymore

reviews.author: Robbie
reviews.text:
Amazing store with a great selection of clothing, hardware, household supplies.

Things are here for pets, arts, cooking and crafts.

Friendly staff and knowledgeable too.

reviews.author: Brian Horan
reviews.text: I needed shear pins for my snowblower.  I live in Cortland and the only place that had them was Lowes.  I went, and it turns out they didn't actually have any.  I drove to Ace in hopes their website was correct and they were still in stock.  Not only were they in stock but a very helpful clerk showed me the regular shear pins, and directed me to the ones for a snowblower. I was also able to grab 2 new covered litter boxes for my cats without having to go to another store.

reviews.author: M Miller
reviews.text: So glad there is still a locally-based hardware store where you can get experienced and skillful advice, as I always do when I go there! Most recent experience with the paint department; I didn't have any leftover paint to identify what was last used on the area I needed to cover, so I made my own --faulty - best guess as to the color and when I got my two gallons home it was WAY off. Breanna was extremely helpful and knowledgeable, and was able to fix the color  and match the sample I should have brought in the first place, so well that I can't tell any difference. A big relief, and her patience and expertise are much appreciated.

reviews.author: Lauryn Burdine
reviews.text:
One of the worst thrift stores I’ve ever been to- as someone who travels often and visits thrift stores across states. Actual garbage had $1-$2 price tags (empty candles with burnt out wicks, empty Harney & Sons tea packages, etc.)

I’m willing to pay boutique thrift prices for gently used items from quality brands, but these were low-quality items for inflated prices.

reviews.author: Kayla Cervantes
reviews.text:
Over the past three years I’ve seen prices slowly go up and with the quality of clothes and shoes is ok. Lamps, Art work, and furniture are over a hundreds dollars sometimes. Making the discount days not even worth coming back for. I heard the smaller one in downtown Ithaca is still holding prices fair and have decent items but I can’t say I haven’t been there this year.
It just keeps the treasures away from thrifters like us who would usually come and spend a lot of money, happy to find great items at a great price. While also helping the ones who are financially struggling.
I love their mission statements, what they say they do for the community, I love that they are local, I personally love the fixers collective and workshops they give. So I really hope they see these comments and take it to heart so I can change my rating back to a 5 star.

reviews.author: Tricia Lyn
reviews.text: The cashiers were super helpful. I wanted to get some things off a mannequin in a window display and they were happy to assist. Prices vary - some items I decided were unpassable deals, other items were extremely attractive but the prices were more than I was willing to pay. Everyone has a different definition of whats good and what a good bargain is.

reviews.author: Lacey J. Osborne
reviews.text: When I walked in, the guy greeted me, and I showed him exactly what I needed, He went over and grabbed it off the wall. The prices were great and Farley cheap. Just 100% satisfied. Great customer service skills, 100%. I was in and out of the store in less than 5 minutes.  He also answered my question on an electrical tester.

reviews.author: Jim Bonacci
reviews.text: These guys are the pros's that you just don't get at the box stores.  They know what they're talking about; have been in the biz for years.  You'll find the prices are in line with the box stores and can often beat them.  You don't have to stand in the isle looking through bins and bins that others have rummaged through and put stuff back in the wrong places, just looking for the right item you want.  At HD and Lowe's you'll waste so much of your time looking for something that they just don't have and then you'll come to Finger Lakes Electric to get your stuff anyway.  Seriously, this is the place for your electrical stuff.  I do not work for FLE, nor am I affiliated with them in the slightest; just a loyal happy customer who has shopped there for years.

reviews.author: Joe A
reviews.text: Overpriced.  A breaker was more than twice the price compared to a big box store, $34 vs $16.  I support local businesses but the pricing needs to be reasonable.

reviews.author: Lisa Carrier-Titti
reviews.text: The Team at Signarama were fast, friendly and very experienced in helping me sort out what type of signage would work best for my new business. They crafted everything from the wording to the graphic design. Why work with some faceless online company when you have the experts right in downtown Ithaca?

reviews.author: Herbert F. Johnson Museum
reviews.text: The team at Sign A Rama Ithaca is second to none, with a commitment to quality and a determination to get it right. From large image and text vinyls for our exhibitions to special sign projects that require unique solutions, we have relied on Diane and her team for many years and have always had excellent results. We're lucky to have such a great local resource!

reviews.author: Aaron Thomson
reviews.text: Did beautiful work making signs for my work trucks! Diane has great customer service. Got the work done ahead of scheduled date!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Welshans
reviews.text: We had been driving all day and needed somewhere to get takeout and we saw the great reviews for ETA Pie. We were shocked about all the creative options. We got two small pies to split and a Caesar salad. The dressing was really good on the Caesar salad. But the pies were amazing. I loved the eggplant on the pie. Also, the Philly cheesesteak was so good. If I came back to the area, I would definitely come here again and try new flavors.

reviews.author: Giveita Shank
reviews.text:
Norfe the owner really cares about making a good quality product.  The ingredients are very fresh and the toppings are generous.  The 18" pizza is huge and easily feeds a family of 4. ( or 2 hungry teenage boys lol)
I recommend the bbq chicken, the marinated mushrooms, the caramelized onions,  and if ur feeling adventurous the Masala sauce;) the pictures dont do it justice because it was after an hour drive home but it was delicious!!!

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.text:
Crust is good, ingredients seem quality but I wouldn't know, but the pizzas as a whole are mediocre. Some are bland, some are way too rich. There are at least half a dozen pizza places in town I would choose over Eta Pie.

The fried food is why I'm leaving a review at all. Fried chicken, fried mozzarella, fried ravioli; it all tastes horrible, like wet dog and the promise of acid reflux. It's been the same every time I've ordered over the past couple months. One of the most consistently bad experiences I've had with any restaurant.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: The coffee is quite good and they have several tasty food items on offer as well. The staff are friendly and the store has a nice vibe. Prices are fair.

reviews.author: Lauryn Burdine
reviews.text: The coffee and service were good. However, I would be likely to return if there wasn’t a $1.50 upcharge for alternative milk, which is steep relative to other businesses. I’m aware non-dairy milk is more expensive, but not $1.50 per serving more expensive. It feels exploitative for a business to profit off food allergies.

reviews.author: Courtney Collins
reviews.text: The coffee here is really good, there is good hot food as well as pastries. They also sell a lot of interesting little treats like cookies and marzipan. The parking lot has plenty of spaces and is really nice since most other coffee shops in town only have street parking.

reviews.author: Mary Naughton
reviews.text:
An absolutely adorable spot to grab a bite and a snack. This is a nice cafe spot with some really good food options. We had the harvest salad and “The Diva” breakfast bagel open-faces sandwich. The harvest salad has spinach, apple slices, dried cranberries, walnuts, and cheddar cheese in it, nice and fresh. The diva is decadence. It had cream cheese, avocado, melted provolone, bacon, and it was topped with pico de gallo. It was everything! We also grabbed a couple little truffles because one kind sounded interesting, the other looked like little footballs.

They also have pies and items available for holidays, like Thanksgiving that can be ordered.

reviews.author: Sydney Bigelow
reviews.text: We haven't even had our breakfast sandwiches yet but I already want to give this place 5 stars. I have celiac disease and we can in to see if they had gluten free options, which they did! They offer gluten free bagels and bread for all their sandwiches, and they toast them in a separate toaster. Plus, they always keep one or two gluten free bakes goods available as well. When we came it was gluten free coffee cake and it was absolutely delicious. The food staff were very friendly as were the coffee staff, who brought our coffees to our table. Will definitely come back! Oh and the food came out very fast!

reviews.author: Rachel McElroy
reviews.text: Absolutely loved our trip to Dolce Delight! I ordered a Dolce Special but substituted bacon for ham. Everything about the sandwich was phenomenal. The biscuit had crispy caramelized cheese on the outside and was fluffy on the inside, the egg and bacon were perfectly cooked, cheese melty and the pepper jam rounded out one of the best breakfast sandwiches I've had. My husband had the Joey on an everything bagel and he said it was really good as well. We also got an iced mocha and iced coffee. The mocha was so well balanced: not too sweet with great chocolate flavor. The iced coffee had a great flavor and was not too acidic. So impressed with everything! Also, loved the vibes. You can tell that this is a spot the locals enjoy and frequent and everyone seemed to know each other.

reviews.author: Thomas Cashman
reviews.text: Black Mold in the Fabric Softener reservoir. Wash Machines and Dryers that steal your money. Snack machine and overpriced laundry detergent/dryer sheet machine that also selectively steals your money. Quarter machines only, no debit cards.

reviews.author: Jeremiah Clark
reviews.text: Always very clean. The machines work great.

reviews.author: Blair SZ
reviews.text:
First time coming in tonight. I was a bit late for the last wash warning and had trouble with one of the double loaders eating one of my quarters.
I only planned to wash my clothes and throw my coat in the dryer for a few minutes. 20 minutes before the place closes for cleaning, a cleaner comes up to me and asks me how many minutes on my washes repeatedly. I say they'll be done before close.
I saw I only need a wash but he reminds me 5 times that the last load is at 8:30 not 9.
I mean yeah that's what it says but I don't need to dry them, just my coat. Anyway. I move my stuff to my luggage bag but before I can throw my coat in the dryer while the rest of my stuff finishes a lady cleaner is cleaning all the dryers while loudly complaining about people that "don't follow rules" or something of that nature.
So I grab my army pack and my luggage and head out before 10 o clock hits.
Such a bizarre experience. I walked 4 blocks back home with no coat. Not my worst experience since being back in the states but I won't be back here. Very odd.

reviews.author: Paul Cody
reviews.text: Amazing store, top to bottom. Great staff, great owner, wide selection, good prices, and if you have any problem with your furniture, call them. I did, and the problem was fixed, re-delivered without a charge, within 24 hours. I'll never buy furniture anywhere else. Thanks, Mark. You guys are the best!

reviews.author: Erica Hopper
reviews.text: My mother gifted us a recliner from the store and the staff were incredibly helpful and kind. They delivered the chair to our home and when the recliner mechanism broke (the metal snapped) they ordered replacement parts and fixed it at our place without it costing us anything (it happened within the first year warranty). They’re always a pleasure to work with and I’ll be sure to visit their store in the future if we are looking for additional furniture.

reviews.author: C
reviews.text: We've purchased several pieces here. Always friendly and very helpful. Great quality; fair pricing. Delivery guys are wonderful too!

reviews.author: Jison Zabala
reviews.text: Solid food offerings, good beer selection. Can't ask for much more than that.

reviews.author: Dean Benjamin
reviews.text: Love this place.  The pizza is the best in the area.   Great live music and the staff are super friendly and eager to serve.

reviews.author: Riley Smith
reviews.text: The lady on the phone was just lovely! I asked for a pickle (weird request lol) on the side of my wings and she gave me two(happily as well! Very good attitude over the phone)🥹

reviews.author: Iqbal Nathani
reviews.text: Franny’s Pizzeria in Highland is a hidden gem! The pizza is absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked with a crispy crust. Their specialty pies and classic options are all made with high-quality ingredients. The staff is friendly and welcoming, and the service is quick whether you’re dining in or taking out. Cozy, clean, and always consistent—Franny’s has become our go-to pizza spot in the area. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: PJ K
reviews.text: What a great find, I had never been here saw their advertisement in the LCD addition of the WFMU program the pizza half pepperoni, half sausage well-done was amazing. The server was also very super nice and the young man assisting her was equally as pleasant and hospitablesitting in the garden on a nice Sunday afternoon was great and relaxing. I will be back to try the rest of the menu before the summer’s out have a great season and good luck.

reviews.author: Alicja
reviews.text: I came here because Food IQ author Matt Rodbard posted on his story that this is the ”best grandma pie in NJ.” The next day, I had to try it and got the same thing he did: a grandma pie, half tipsy (vodka sauce). It’s a well-done, thin-crust pizza with light sauce, 5 stars if that’s your thing. The vodka sauce was amazing. $26 price was tough, losing a star for that.

reviews.author: Ricky bachner
reviews.text: I’ve never done business with them but their truck driver stopped on the side of the road in 20 degree weather to help me and my grandpa change his tire today. He couldn’t have been nicer and didn’t ask for anything in return. Again I’ve never done business with them but I know they have great people working for them and I’ll call them first next time I need lumber

reviews.author: Shawn Waterman
reviews.text: I’ve had a great experience working with Sean, the manager, and his team at 84 Lumber Ithaca. Their pricing is very competitive, and they’ve been flexible with my order changes and delivery requests. Response time is always prompt, and they’ve consistently made the process smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sarah Jean
reviews.text: I have gone through 84 Lumber in Ithaca a few times and have had a great experience every single time. Service and pricing is always the best in the area by a long shot. My husband and I worked with Sean, who is great, and Anthony for a bit, who is also great! Wish nothing but success for the store, Sean, and Anthony.

reviews.author: Ornwara Tritrakarn
reviews.text: Beautiful library with modern look. (Totally different from other big libraries in Cornell such as Uris, Olin, and Law school.) It's bright and nice here. The seatings are quite limited but it's pleasant to be here! Also, very quiet (based on my 1 time experience).

reviews.author: Lin WC
reviews.text: I saw it in the Architectural Record magazine from November 2019. The architect intended to make the heavy bookshelf look light and appear to float. If I have the opportunity, I will visit one day.

reviews.author: Alex Forman
reviews.text: It’s pretty and has many pretty books :3

reviews.author: Erica Hopper
reviews.text:
I adore this bookstore. It's one of the first places I visited when considering moving to the area and immediately felt at home. With progressive selections in nonfiction and an assortment of fiction books for all ages, there's something for everyone. I also buy more than I am willing to admit in trinkets from the store because there's always something fun for my little crow brain to desire.

There's always a lot of great events going on at the store, and having had my own events there, I can say that the process is seamless. The staff is amazing and have my heart. Whenever I have friends and family visiting, I take them to BSB as if to say "here is the heart of Ithaca and why I love it here."

reviews.author: Ace Dufresne
reviews.text: Great selection and atmosphere. Friendly, helpful, considerate staff. Beautiful reading room with murals and  places to sit. Regularly bring in community for cool events. I love Ithaca's non profit bookstore!

reviews.author: Chip Eats
reviews.text:
One of my new favorite book stores. Went in with my family for a wonderful signing by  author Signe Pike. She was simply fantastic and it was one of the best book signings I've been to!

It is an enjoyable and comfortable store. The children's selection was great and both kids loaded up on books. I also found a special treat on their shelves which was a signed book by my favorite author.

What a great experience!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Shelby Chubb
reviews.text:
I love this amazing resource for our community! Due to the excessive waste in the fiber industry I’ve gravitated to purchasing second hand, dead stock etc for better sustainability in my craft.

SewGreen is also a generous community business. I recently received some lovely donations for a fiber arts club I’m running at a local elementary and I’ve learned that they also donate to the schools after school programming.

I’ve had incredible customer service and genuine conversations with staff any time I’ve stopped in.

For a host of reasons I will always be an enthusiastic supporter of SewGreen.

reviews.author: Lauren Kessler
reviews.text: Took a wonderful basics sewing class with Darya! Very beginner friendly and I learned a lot! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Shannon Kauderer
reviews.text: I found some absolute treasures here at fantastic prices. There's a huge variety of fabrics and accessories here, all of which have been saved from another fate. You'll never find super large quantities here, but plenty to do a cosplay project or two. I happily visit here and feel good about the money I spend!

reviews.author: Kurt Weber
reviews.text: Quaint restaurant good for brunch breakfast and lunch. Interesting artifacts showing the history of coal being that this is an old coal weighing station. Order at the counter and they bring the food out to you right away. Park is a little tough as a lot of small and can only hold about six cars but we were lucky this time and parked in the small lot. Super friendly staff and very good food.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Fedele
reviews.text: We were pleasantly surprised by how upscale this cafe was - the food was delicious and the atmosphere was perfect! We got the Ranch Eggs meal, crepes, and a vanilla latte. Everything really hit the spot and I'd say the pricing makes sense for the quality you get there. We also sat outside, there were a lot of seating options to choose from. Will be back again!

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: A super cute cafe in a converted coal office building. They really lean into that heritage and have a lot of cool decorations and furniture that hail back to that era. The coffee and food are both very delicious and the staff are very friendly!

reviews.author: Emilia Ginzburg
reviews.text: I stumbled upon this store, saw some bags next to the entrance and decided to go inside. It is not very cheap indeed but the selection, atmosphere and the lady working there were lovely. She was very open to chat in case of any questions. Got a backpack and a pair of pants. I'll be back once visiting DC again!

reviews.author: Chana Feagans
reviews.text: Checked out this gift shop while looking for a last-minute present and ended up spending more time than planned. The place has a nice mix of items, from small local souvenirs to more thoughtful gifts you’d actually give someone. Nothing felt super overpriced, which was a relief. The layout was easy to walk through and not cluttered, so you could browse without feeling rushed.

reviews.author: Zoe Diaz
reviews.text: The owner is amazing! The shop is so beautiful and well put together 10/10! Definitely visiting again for more singing bowls!

reviews.author: Hugo
reviews.text: While most Staples stores will be and feel the same, I want to give a shoutout to the staff at the Ithaca, NY location. Every I went there, I was met by helpful associates who were ready to help without hesitation. Really nice folks. I think they all deserve a raise!

reviews.author: Frank Baldwin
reviews.text:
It's seem hit or miss depending on staff. But today's experience was horrible. There was some other customers getting some shipping done were it the sign says something about shipping. There was a sign clearly saying check over 2 registers. Since I was the only 1 in line at the time, I walked up to the register.  2 other people got in line for checking out.

Waited a bit and had to wave down a staff member and interupt her social chat with the guy from printing. Instead of coning over and checking me out, she went into some stupid explaination that the shipping area was in fact a  check out and seemed annoyed to be doing her job. So, instead of helping me, I returned my itwms and left. Talk about poor custoner service. Some girl in braids. Had she bee  doung her job, she would have realized that there were people waiting and that I had indeed been in front of the line.

Discouraged and another reasob why people shop online instead.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Fabulous store! A wonderful selection of quality products at low prices. Friendly, kind, hospitable employees. A clean, neat store. Plenty of free parking. Conveniently located on Meadow Street in downtown Ithaca. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jennifer Streeter
reviews.text: Took my pup to be groomed by Joni today, and she did an amazing job! Super friendly, would definitely recommend and we will be back.

reviews.author: Breanna Wilson
reviews.text:
Usually staff if pretty friendly, recently had a bad interaction with an older lady helping the fish side of things...she wouldn't sell us a baby cicihild because I devulged the information that it has a temporary tank of ten gallons at home already and would be getting a much bigger tank in the near future. After already doing our due diligence of confirming that our water was 100% safe because the last thing I wanted to do was put the fish into a bad situation. I was clear in the fact I intended on giving the fish a good life prior to the denial. She continued to be condicending and pointing at the tags saying how many gallons... I again confirmed with her even as a temporary tank that it would not be suitable, even for three months. She said correct. As the fish was living with multiple other fish, which this specific fish is aggressive by nature...so it was overcrowded and in a 5 gallon tank currently!!! Wild, anyways I will add that there were so many dead fish floating about, tanks were overcrowded in general. One of the lone baby cicihilds looked like it was activley passing away. But a temporary tank for a BABY, that was absurd lol. That's all, rant over.

I did end up following up with a manager that apologized for the situation, I made sure to mention I wasn't trying to get anyone in trouble because I'm not, we ended up getting a baby cicihild from another store anyways. I guess it would have just been nice to have someone take a more educative stance and attempt to educate us on why it wasn't okay or to let us know that it would need a bigger tank soon. That being said we had done prior research, not that I would claim to know everything about them .... but I did know enough, which is also why it was frustrating. It really is disappointing that negative intentions or thoughts of us were immediately formed thus leading to us being talked to like we were children that stole coins out of a mall fountain.

reviews.author: Ray Mae
reviews.text: Amazing experience at the grooming facility. Star did an awesome job with my long fur, big cat Peaches. She had a couple mats and Star was able to get them off and make peaches feel way better and comfortable. She did such a good job and gave my cat so much love and support. It was also very affordable for what we got. Definitely recommend going here, especially for cats.

reviews.author: Cameron Ashby
reviews.text: Five below is amazing! As soon as you walk inside the employees greet you, the service is nice if you need anything. Very broad selection of everything you can think of. Usually ranging from $2-$8 got some good finds.

reviews.author: melissa pierce
reviews.text: My daughter and I had a great visit here and found things we have been looking for. We found 3D printed toys and really great squishies. Found nails  and make up to try out .

reviews.author: Azure
reviews.text: I love this place because they have such cool stuff and cheap scenecore shirts, accessories, etc overall 10/10 I love this store :3 I LOVEEE THE INVADER ZIM STUFF TOOOOOOOO X3

reviews.author: Thirst TEA
reviews.text: I went in February 3rd around 4:30 pm and was checked out by the rudest employee I have ever spoken with. She rudely told me to put all my items down like I was stealing them when in actuality I was seeing how much the price was cause me and my gf were splitting it. Her overall demeanor is judgy and unkind. Wont be stopping in anymore.

reviews.author: Kam Samrat
reviews.text:
Very nice store and reasonably fare price no doubt.
I come here pretty much every week or so with my 2 little kids. Past 6 months or so their restroom is broken so my wife has to go take my 2 little kids (3 and 6) to next door (old navy) to use restroom. How inconvenient is it. They want you to spend money here at tj max and use someone’s else restroom.
I simply asked one of the store employee if they all go to old navy to use restroom. She said they use restroom  here at tj max So I am assuming they have restrooms for them but not for customers or even a little kid age of 3.

reviews.author: Florencia Ulloa
reviews.text: Gorgeous store! Everything beautifully but for Jackie in the fitting rooms. If I want to get treated like a criminal I go to Walmart.

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.text:
Kyle was consistently responsive and easy to work with, returning calls and messages promptly and keeping communication clear throughout the process. He proactively flagged potential scheduling issues and helped ensure everything stayed on track.
He was patient, thorough, and thoughtful in addressing questions, including situations that required extra care or flexibility. When unexpected weather required a change in plans, he assisted with communication and made sure the site remained accessible.
Overall, a reliable and professional experience. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sarah CM
reviews.text:
We are so grateful for our experience working with Kyle & Lansing Funeral Home. Even before my older sister & mom met in person with Kyle to go over their questions & plan for my dad's funeral, my mom had been communicating over email with Kyle about the many logistics questions we had. He took the time to do research on everything & reassured us by giving us all the details & info we needed.

For the funeral itself, he did an amazing job coordinating all the elements and helping to organize our burial. He also incorporated all the clothes we wanted in the casket. It was extremely comforting for all of us to know that Kyle was so communicative and on top of everything.

reviews.author: Victoria Laux
reviews.text: Kyle at the Lansing Funeral Home was incredibly helpful, kind, and thoughtful when our family suffered a sudden loss.  He did a great job helping our family navigate all of the planning and paperwork, and helped us have a very nice service.

reviews.author: J van der L
reviews.text: Super friendly service. Nice sandwiches as well! Old style ordering via a paper form but the result is good. The place looks a bit old and had no toilet for customers.

reviews.author: Rosy
reviews.text: Had a quick stop for lunch here and the ordering process was smooth and fast. You circle what you want on a ticket. The sandwiches are decent, a little saltier and tougher than expected. Their chicken noodle soup was delicious. The inside is decorated with neon signs and old-fashioned menu, making the atmosphere retro and enjoyable.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: Shortstop Deli has been a local institution since 1978. They operate a deli counter and convenience store with a large selection of sandwiches and snacks. They use a ticket system for ordering, which can be a little confusing if it’s your first time here. What you want to do is go up to the counter and grab a ticket. If you want a regular sandwich, you’ll want the one labeled “Ithaca style sub.” They also have tickets for breakfast sandwiches (which are really delicious) and pizza subs. Once you have your ticket, mark down what you want and give the white copy to the person making sandwiches and the yellow carbon copy to the cashier to pay. They’ll call your name when your sandwich is done. I usually take mine to go and eat it in the park, but they have tables there if you want to eat inside. I really can’t recommend this place enough! The sandwiches are always delicious and you absolutely have to try their giant cookies! I’d go so far as to say that they’re the best sandwich shop in town.

reviews.author: Steph Jacobson
reviews.text: My little one had just endured a very unpleasant doctor’s appointment with a Covid test and much poking and prodding. All she wanted after was a pink lemonade. It’s not on the menu, but the girls at this Dunkin made it happen. They also provided her sad little face with a delightful pink donut and this lovely note! Thank you so much, you girls made our day! 🤍🤍

reviews.author: Kyra Kennedy
reviews.text: I ordered off the app. I used my points to get some free food. I only got the food I paid for and they never gave me my food paid for with points. This dunkin wasted my points. I also ordered an iced coffee with butter pecan and vanilla flavor shots and they never put that in my coffee. Just espresso, cream, and sugar. They got my order all wrong. Im not happy at all. Do better dunkin. And learn how to read online orders smh.

reviews.author: Donal Fitterer
reviews.text: This is my favorite Dunkin. The staff is always friendly and will smile at my dumb jokes.

reviews.author: Aaron Schantz
reviews.text: This place has a great menu and accommodates vegetarian and gluten free customers.  We had a large party of 12 and everyone was more than satisfied.  We had margaritas, apps, entrees and dessert.  My son had the chocolate cake and says it was awesome.  My niece, Rubyz,,  took the pics for this review.  I highly reccomend if you are in the mood for good food and a light hearted atmosphere.

reviews.author: Martin Feehan
reviews.text: Good selection of healthy food and indulgences.  Best for a casual night out.  Unfortunately, highly inconsistent. Sometimes it's great. I have also had my worse restaurant experience every there. 2 hrs waiting for food. Bugs on vegetables. Baconless bacon bloody Mary.  A raw burger.  I have been a regular be for years but the last couple visits have been so horrendous, I can't imagine going back.  They need to turn this around, because the concept is great.

reviews.author: Abby Davis
reviews.text: the environment is pleasant and comfortable. the food was great. I had the carnitas tacos and I LOVED THEM. it was the exact amount of food I wanted, but I think most people will need to get something else as well as the tacos since you only get two and they aren't huge. the service was attentive, and helpful! I told them when I came in that I only had twenty minutes to eat and they got me my food and still ensured I had a great experience! so happy.

reviews.author: Meaghan Austin
reviews.text: I love visiting Eddydale!  It has such a charm to it each season!  We love the pumpkin and apples, mums, corn cob, cookies, sweet treats and more!  If you are driving by, plan to stop and check it out!

reviews.author: Mary Naughton
reviews.text: I had a lovely stop here. They had a cabbage that was as big as my head or bigger! I had to buy it. I made a bunch of Gołąbki, or Polish stuffed cabbage. I also got a lovely Blue Hubbard squash which I’m looking forward to roasting.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Braymen
reviews.text: We picked up some day old corn for 25 cents an ear and it was so sweet and flavorful. Nice place, nice people, yummy produce.

reviews.author: 1123JGilbert
reviews.text: Recently remodeled to a "no cashier" layout.  Of course you can just ring the bell for someone to take your order if you wish.  Service is a little on the slow side, but not unacceptable. The food taste like burger king.  Overall atmosphere gives the impression of a generic waiting room, as most "modern" remodels of any business.

reviews.author: Mahir Hakic
reviews.text: I’ve been to this Burger King twice recently, and both times multiple items were missing from my order. On top of that, the wait time for food was extremely long.
