What made it more frustrating was seeing about four people standing in the back instead of working. If everyone had been helping, it would have been much quicker. Very disappointing experience overall. I like the remodel but they need to remodel the employees

reviews.author: Chris C.
reviews.text: Took them 5 minutes to give me 3 “shakes” with a full crew and no line, or other customers. $12 for 3 undrinkable shakes at that. Should be paid less than minimum wage for that bare minimum work ethic and service. So thick they didn’t even bother to give us straws. Pathetic at best.

reviews.author: Alessandro Pigati
reviews.text: Probably the worst coffee I had in my life... And expensive as well! Bakery part is not as bad, though

reviews.author: Derek Rowe
reviews.text: Mattin's Cafe is convenient but not cheap.  They have a decent selection of wraps and other refrigerated fast food.  Their chocolate muffins are addicting, and for this reason I would recommend staying away from them!  Their prepared foods can be pretty decent, but their calzones are from the freezer and cost almost as much as freshly made calzones from DP Dough.

reviews.author: VJ Sat
reviews.text: Had the pleasure of ordering from Jackie a few days ago. She went above and beyond in my order during a very stressful time. The food was great and the customer service was even greater. Will definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Shannon Willitts
reviews.text: Loveliest outdoor seating and they respect the ADA laws

reviews.author: Artisan Tony
reviews.text: Will not go back.  They told us over the phone no reservations then after getting there and waiting an hour they told us tables were reserved.  It’s just a red neck bar for locals.  Don’t waste your time.

reviews.author: Jess Hollenbeck
reviews.text: Great little off the beaten path eatery

reviews.author: George Poulos
reviews.text: Stopped here on a quiet snowy night. Loved sitting at the booth by the window. Has a cozy, familial, almost diner-like feeling to it. I could hang here for a long time! Delicious food and great service.

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.text: I've had delicious Indian Cuisine from the menu twice now that I visited Ithaca from Albany. It has always been superb! My favorite dish is chicken tikka masala. I've tried this in several different locations but theirs is the best! Really tasty! Highly recommend if you're in Ithaca and looking for really good Indian food!

reviews.author: P E A C E !
reviews.text: I did the lunch buffet. Decent selection. Loved the naan. The rice pudding was simple but refreshing after plates of savory.

reviews.author: Karynn (Karynn Altmann)
reviews.text: Colleen is absolutely amazing! I have been a loyal patient for over 2 years now. I book usually twice a month. Her technique and professionalism are outstanding. I highly recommend New Leaf Massage to anyone who is looking for relaxation and to support a small business

reviews.author: Kristin DiPronio
reviews.text: My husband and I have been treated by Colleen for several years, every 4-5 weeks, she is lovely, knowledgeable and so kind… she has done so much to keep our backs and bodies well and pain free… I recommend her so highly!!

reviews.author: Becky Carvill
reviews.text: Colleen is an amazing massage therapist!  Very professional and personable.

reviews.author: Tom Knipe
reviews.text: We bought our Lopi stove insert from Ithaca Stoveworks in 2023 and love it. Recently, we needed our chimney cleaned. The crew that did the job initially was a bit inexperienced and the insert still wasn't working properly after the service. So I called to explain the issue and they scheduled a follow up visit from Matt, who was extremely thorough and knowledgeable. He got it working like a charm and gave me some helpful pointers as well. No charge for the follow up visit. Just in time too. Nothing better than a warm fire heating the house on a frigid weekend like the one we just had.

reviews.author: Scott Schmutzler
reviews.text: First time using Ithaca Stove works for our chimney cleaning. Our service tech Matt did an outstanding job cleaning our chimney. He showed up exactly on time, explained what he was doing and why, and answered every question with real expertise. When he finished, the fireplace and surrounding area were spotless—no ash trails, no mess, just clean and safe. Professional, courteous, and efficient from start to finish. Five stars without hesitation.

reviews.author: Richard Schafer
reviews.text:
Needed new cap and cleaning. Matt came in and did an excellent cleaning. He found that the previous cleaners never cleaned one part of my interior pipe and it was caked up pretty bad. My outside pipe is three stories so it was a pretty big climb. Old cap was caked with soot from years of never being cleaned. New cap is awesome. Matt used proper floor covers to protect the floor area around my stove. I give the job an A+.
Not taking any points away for price. I know everything has gone up. Price was pretty steep. Will be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Elizabeth R
reviews.text:
We visited early for dinner on a weekday after a day of hiking and were made to feel right at home by our wonderful server as soon as we walked in, and had a lovely time seated outside by the water. The owner of 50 years cooked for us—the Cajun blackened catfish was to die for, and we got to try salt potatoes for the first time. The Rachel sandwich and the grilled Cajun chicken sandwich were also delicious. We really liked the seasoned potato wedges and a refreshing cocktail. The pictures may look simple, but the flavors are amazing. The decor, while a little dated, only adds to the charm.

We were on the fence about going and are so glad we did. A must stop!

reviews.author: Brittany Brennan
reviews.text: My daughter and I went camping and exploring all the waterfalls, we decided to stop here for dinner one night and it was great! Very reasonable prices and a great view sitting by the water, the service was excellent and the food came out extremely quick and was delicious! Definitely coming back again.

reviews.author: Chris Jose
reviews.text: I’ve always ordered the chicken sandwich and eggs Benedict. I can say the chicken sandwich is reliable. Eggs Benedict is good. My friends were disappointed with their sandwiches and French toasts. Bummer

reviews.author: Stacy Rodd
reviews.text: Always fresh organic vegetables.

reviews.author: Dave Mason
reviews.text: I have an elderly cat with pain issues. I went to this store without any knowledge of CBD. The ladies there are extremely friendly and knowledgeable in CBD. The effects, dosage and the right kind. They listened to the points about my cat's pain issues. She picked up a specific bottle and told me it would work. I was skeptical but I gave it a try. My boy is so happy compared to before. I have sent others to this store and they love it. Great service and knowledge but most of all they genuinely care. Thanks ladies for your help!!!

reviews.author: Craig MacDonald
reviews.text: Been buying edibles here for about a year.  Excellent products, knowledgeable service - we're very happy customers ... occasional users of CBD/THC gummies as a sleep aid.  Grateful for their business.

reviews.author: Tyler Jordan
reviews.text: I heard this was a great place to pick up good cbd products. Stopped in and got cbd dog treats. My dog is 14. He has hip and joint pain. He has a hard time getting up. Those treats had him feeling better in just a few weeks.

reviews.author: Sheri Kelly R
reviews.text:
First of all, this is a review about the horrible customer service I received when I called Emmys Organics, not about the cookies.  The cookies are 5 star cookies. On Nov 29, I placed an order on this company's website.  The order shipped shortly later, but I was never emailed. I noticed the tracking in my USPS Informed Delivery Account. The tracking indicated I'd receive it Dec. 6 but nothing came.  I noticed the package stuck in Memphis with USPS so after it didn't move after 5 days I called Emmys.  I called 9 x before a human answered.  No one replied to my email or called me back when I left a voicemail. Then I spoke with a foreign woman named Hannah.  She didn't have answers and was unwilling to help.  I asked what happens if the cookies don't arrive?  She said they would not give a refund, nor would they reship. She told me I would have to contest the charge with my credit card company.  Meanwhile I still have a second order outstanding with them that's not fulfilled yet.  My credit card payments went thru but their customer service refuses to do anything if the cookies don't arrive. Then this woman hung up on me after telling me they would do nothing! I'm not happy!  I love the cookies but after what I went thru,  I'll only buy them on Amazon where I can get my money back if they don't arrive.

Ok, in all fairness, I pursued and got my problem resolved. Here's an update.  When I was left without a resolution I pursued further.  I sent a message in FB messenger to the company. They gave me an email and I wrote to them. Then I got a call from Gabriel in Customer Relations. He said he would personally take care of things.  Then later that day I got an email from the coordinator of shipping.  I forget their actual title but they assured me they'd reship my package and use UPS this time because USPS lost my original package.  They even offered to send an extra bag. Today the cookies arrived.  It was all a huge hassle but I'm glad it got resolved.  Their cookies are amazing!

reviews.author: Peggy B
reviews.text: I love these cookies, coconut cookies vanilla bean. I placed an order with Amazon. I recommend them! Yummy!😋😋😋👌👍

reviews.author: Samantha Letourneau
reviews.text: I am in love with Emmy's Blueberry Cashew Super Cereal!!  I put a handful in my vanilla yogurt and wow! There are so many yummy blueberries it will make your yogurt turn purple. Ever since i have made this a staple of my diet I have felt a million times better. This is a miracle food in my book. Thank you Emmy's!

reviews.author: Jenny Sue Heisler
reviews.text: We recently moved here and it's a beautiful place. A little hard navigating the hills however the views are well worth the effort

reviews.author: Richie Frank
reviews.text: You might as  well move at astera it's ran the same way I personally I know of one unit we're the tenent got out of rehab moved there in 3 months she going into long term rehab thanks to the way the manager allows the activity buy letting another person stay in the girls  unit with out being on the lease so they can collect the sec 8 payment and the place smells very bad so you never know who will be living next to you day to day

reviews.author: Lavonne Willumson
reviews.text: It's very hard to reach anyone on the phone. I was supposed to move in last October(2023) and am still waiting. Thankfully I never gave my 30 days to the landlord or I'd be on the street. I've talked to 3 different managers and it's always "you need this paper, oh by the way we need this paper too," etc...  The head boss is very nice but I can't remember her name. Otherwise I'm still waiting to move in.🥴😠

reviews.author: Tom&Linnea Sunti
reviews.text: 5/5 star farm & community. They have been our CSA farm in the summers and winters for years now, and their variety of food, quality, intentionality of supporting local farmers collaboratively (beans, egg, cheese, etc), and csa communication are excellent. Not to mention the food access programs they run in our community are incredible. Huge thanks for all that you guys do!

reviews.author: Don McNerney
reviews.text: Probably the best overall vegetable farm at the Ithaca Farmers Market. Great variety of seasonal vegetables, great quality. Everything's organic, and Stick and Stone participates in programs to make produce accessible and affordable to everyone. This business deserves massive public support.

reviews.author: Christy Bianconi
reviews.text: We love this farm, which is right up the road from us. They're part of the Full Plate Collective, a wonderful CSA that combines products from several local farms. I really appreciate the u-pick options and delicious herbs and veggies.

reviews.author: Fred S
reviews.text: Nice and clean good space but no lights for nighttime

reviews.author: Robyn Forkey
reviews.text: Prescriptions never ready on time. They accidently filled a prescription of mine 2x in 24 hrs and handed it to my boyfriend who had no clue they had made a mistake and wasn't even leaving with the correct meds. I never got an apology and was without my daily nerve pain medicine I've been on for years for almost a week because of their mistake. Pharmacist thinks he needs to police your medicine more than dispense medicine safely to customers. Despite all these problems I was still willing to be a customer until I called in for another medication refill and he asks about another medication and begins to scream at me when I suggest he should focus on the question at hand instead of attempting to police what medicine has been prescribed to me.. he told me I was not allowed to speak with him that way and hung up on me. I immediately had my entire family's prescriptions transferred and was able to talk 4 other families into changing pharmacies for their families safety as well. No one deserves the outrught disrespect and possible sickness or death due to their incompetent and unprofessional staff in the their 100% staff owned business. Shameless, and dangerous business that would only be able to operate in rural communities of upstate NY and VT bacuse they would be run out of business anywhere else

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Great place! Conveniently located right next to the Shops at Ithaca mall. Plenty of parking. A clean, neat store. Friendly, kind employees and I found what I was looking for very well. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cecily Cox
reviews.text:
I’m new to the area and often visit drugstores, so I was hoping Kinney Drugs would become a regular stop. Unfortunately, after my experience yesterday, I won’t be returning.

The cashier, Melissa, made me feel extremely unwelcome. I was dressed in sweats and noticed right away she was giving me unfriendly looks. I greeted her with a “hi” and got no response, which I initially brushed off, thinking maybe she was just shy or having a bad day. But then I saw her being warm and cheerful to other customers.

Throughout my visit, she stared at me with a look that made me feel completely out of place. When I checked out and wished her a good day, she rolled her eyes and looked visibly annoyed. It was incredibly uncomfortable and disappointing.

Customer service like this shouldn't be tolerated. I’ll be taking my business to CVS or Walgreens instead.

reviews.author: eru—n
reviews.text:
Absolutely stunning place w a lovely lady and a sculptural building.
Didn’t have a reservation but the staff offered us some tastings and they were really flavorful.

Definitely the #1 place to stop by when visiting finger lakes or niagara falls from down state.

reviews.author: Scottish Pride
reviews.text: Thank you to The Honeybee Embassy for always providing a delightful experience. Every item in the shop is incredible and hand picked with care. The honeys and candles are very special, and I buy many to give as gifts to loved ones. Thank you also to the staff who are always knowledgeable and friendly!

reviews.author: Sarah Miles
reviews.text:
This place is beautiful. We visited in the dead of winter at 3°, and still appreciated it. Ceiling-high honeycombed mesh doors lead to the semi open-air main area, where there's little tables to sit with dried flower arrangements on each. Through an identical set of doors out the back is a patio with more seating that overlooks what in summer would be a grassy lawn.

Besides a wide variety of honeys, the shop inside sold hot tea and sweets, as well as looseleaf teas, beeswax candles, tinctures, art prints, and other small sundries. Each hot tea came with honey on the side. Honeys were available in a few sizes, the littlest being 3 for $10, and there were gift sets available as well.

Despite the bitter cold, someone from the kitchen opposite the shop greeted us soon after walking in and waited patiently as we looked over everything. The tea was delicious and we got a few snacks to go. I imagine it would be lovely to sit and enjoy it (or an iced version) in the warmer seasons. Would absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Alexisweird
reviews.text: Ordered sweet and sour chicken and got just plain breaded chicken, what is this, how do you forget the sweet and sour when it’s in the name?!?! Added duck sauce to it that I had in my fridge for at least some flavor (and no there was not a cup of the sauce in the bag either)

reviews.author: London Kelly
reviews.text:
Went there having not been there in a while and didn't kno  they stopped doing HotPot... BIG bummer... so I got a little Chinese Fare.... meh. That chicken on the stick is sinful.. Szechuan shrimp had no flava. I even asked for it to be EXXTRA spicy.. I even heard my girl tell the cook in the back. It was not. I wasn't pleased.
However I did go and get a boil for my  birthday.. snowcrab/shrimp/mussels mixed sauce... it was pretty tasty!
Although my sauce is better😉

reviews.author: Haythi myint
reviews.text: Although this place has been my favorite place to get seafood boil, it has become very stingy with their food. I got a a boil combo B bag with sausage add-on for 5.99 extra and only got 3 freaking pieces of sausage. And it was so thin. It was so off putting for the rest of the boil.

reviews.author: Deb Lawrence
reviews.text: I had a great experience working with Advantage to set up my studio gym in Albany, NY. John was very helpful in setting up my order, and the delivery and installation team were great. I would definitely choose to work with them again for future equipment needs.

reviews.author: Hawthorne Oleander
reviews.text: Teresa, Clay, and the rest of the team at Advantage are amazing!  Our fitness center at our apartment community it state of the art thanks to these guys.  We have the latest and greatest equipment, and their preventative maintenance has kept everything running smoothly.  We have worked with other fitness center preventative maintenance companies and these folks are hands down the most thorough and detailed.  Highly recommend these folks!!!

reviews.author: Kristen Koehler
reviews.text: I have nothing but good things to say about Advantage Sport & Fitness.  I got their contact information directly from Precor as a place where I could find a trained/authorized person who could do technical work on my Precor elliptical in my home.  Their communication was excellent, their staff was very helpful (Jim & Josh), their prices were very fair, and I was grateful to have someone who I could trust coming into my home for help with my elliptical.  I was especially grateful when I ran into an issue in the lead up to my appointment and we they are able to work around my problem.  Thanks!  A+

reviews.author: Dalton Robinson
reviews.text: Came at about 3pm, staff was great and welcoming on my first visit, ordered the chicken spiedie wrap and it was phenomenal, juicy and flavorful with good portions. Decent prices, walked out after a filling meal and two draughts for ~$23. Comfortable sports bar atmosphere, will 100% be back

reviews.author: Margery Lipenski
reviews.text: Food was good as was the service. Language at the bar by the customer left a lot to be desired. I felt like the bartender could of asked them to be a little quieter and stop using the "f bomb" so loudly and so often. Just my opinion.

reviews.author: Minji Lee
reviews.text: I love this place! Foods are great and people are kind :) My favorites are jalapeño poppers, burgers, and fries 🍔🍟

reviews.author: Ionic Tech
reviews.text: Ithaca Bakery (Triphammer Rd) is my go-to spot on this side of Ithaca. It’s really the only solid sit-down coffee shop around here. They’ve got a great selection of sandwiches, cakes, and even fun merchandise. My favorite order is the steak & eggs paired with a mochaccino. The internet is reliable, and there’s plenty of space to sit and work or relax. I also love that one side of the shop features rotating displays of photography and artwork — always inspiring as a photographer myself. Service is quick, friendly, and you can even order ahead for pickup if you’re in a rush. A gem for both food and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Eva Spak
reviews.text: I come here often because there is a lot that I can do here. I can always find a space to eat brunch with a friend. I can always get a table to do some work. The food is decent, but it is consistently decent. It's not going to be the best bagel you've ever had, but it will never ne a bad bagel. The atmosphere is always pleasant, and the staff are always nice.

reviews.author: Carrie Pitcher
reviews.text: Our first time visiting and didn't really know how it worked. The girl who took our order at the counter was patient and friendly. The food was great.

reviews.author: Nick D
reviews.text: I have been with Dr Watto for nearly 20 years now. Very thorough, knowledgeable, and genuine. You are not part of the machine like many other offices with thier fast in and out type visits. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: John DeAngelo
reviews.text: Excellent doctor! Very thorough and he takes his time with you and listens to your concerns. Most doctors will only spend 5 or 10 minutes with you but Dr. Wattoo will take as much time as he needs with you. He’s very much in tune with whatever medical conditions you may have. I highly recommend him. When you go to his office you see him and not a PA. He doesn’t believe in them. He keeps his practice small.

reviews.author: Anne Sine
reviews.text: We have been so impressed and grateful to Dr. Watto’s excellent medical care. He is thorough, incredibly knowledgeable, careful and considerate. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Roberto Delgado
reviews.text:
In a city known for its eclectic and collegiate dining scene, Le Café Cent-Dix stands out as a sophisticated, unwavering anchor of French culinary tradition. Stepping into the bistro, you are immediately met with an atmosphere that balances rustic brick charm with the polished, high-energy hum of a Parisian brasserie. It is intimate, dimly lit, and undeniably "Ithaca-chic."
​The Main Event: Classic Execution
​The Steak Frites at Cent-Dix is a masterclass in why simplicity, when done correctly, is unbeatable. The steak—typically a hanger or bistro cut—was seared to a perfect medium-rare, boasting a deeply caramelized crust that gave way to a tender, flavorful interior. The accompanying maître d'hôtel butter added a rich, herbed decadence as it melted across the meat. The "frites" were exactly what you’d hope for: thin, golden, salty, and dangerously addictive, served in a portion size that respects the French appetite for indulgence.
​The Seasonal Highlight: Scallops
​Opting for the Menu of the Day Scallops proved to be the highlight of the evening. The kitchen clearly respects its ingredients; the scallops were pan-seared to a stunning golden brown while maintaining a buttery, translucent center. They were served over a seasonal bed that highlighted the chef's ability to pull from local Finger Lakes produce. The dish felt lighter and more nuanced than the steak, providing a bright, oceanic counterpoint to the heavier bistro fare.
​The Verdict
​Le Café Cent-Dix doesn't try to reinvent the wheel; instead, it polishes it until it shines. With an impressive French-focused wine list and a service staff that is knowledgeable without being pretentious, it remains one of the best spots in town for a celebratory dinner or a high-end date night.

reviews.author: Mario Alex Gonzalez
reviews.text: An absolutely incredible dining experience in every aspect. The food, atmosphere, and service all complimented each other beautifully and made for a stunning night. The meal is ordered all at once and coursed out, allowing to be continuously one upped by the last item and be continuously impressed by the dishes. The appetizer dishes blew me away and somehow the food maintained or surpassed the quality at every turn.  Service was impeccable and very well informed on all the dishes, exactly what you would expect from a restaurant of this caliber. No weak points in this dinner at all. Highly highly recommend coming here if you are looking for an elegant and delicious meal that will blow you away, as long as you’re prepared to pay accordingly, but it will be worth it.

reviews.author: Lisa J
reviews.text:
Because of the comments in the reviews, we started the line in front of the door at 5:20 pm on a Sat.  By opening time, there were10 people behind us.  By 6 pm, the restaurant was full, including seating at the bar.  There are only 6 two-tops, 6 seats at the bar and ?5 booths that can seat 6.  They do take names and numbers to contact later arrivals when a table opens.  Tonight, it was after 7 pm before one did.
We absolutely enjoyed our meal with an excellent 2006 Pomerol.  There was a large lag before our main arrived, and I forgot to take a picture until we had already dug in.  Service was friendly and efficient.  The Beef Tartare was prepared classically and was delicious.  The côte de boeuf was somewhat tough inn places, but the demi-glace was heavenly and made up for it.  It was served on the rare side of med.-rare.  I splurged on chocolate cake, and it was worth every calorie! (light and fluffy with excellent cocoa flavor).  My husband loves Pedro Ximenez sherry, and deigned to eat it over vanilla ice cream. ;)

reviews.author: Jody Sobel
reviews.text: We got married at New Park about 4 months ago, and it was absolutely magical! The scenery was breathtaking—exactly what I envisioned for my “backyard, but not a backyard” wedding. Multiple guests even said it was the favorite wedding they’d ever attended! There was plenty of space to dance, but guests also had so many other fun options like cornhole, ping pong, and relaxing by the fire. The venue is truly unique, and if I could do it all over again, I wouldn’t choose anywhere else. Huge thanks to Sara and the entire New Park team for making our day unforgettable! 😊

reviews.author: Danielle Lagrua
reviews.text: My husband and I got married at New Park at the end of September and it was so beautiful. The venue is naturally stunning, and the rooms are wonderful. We rented it out for the whole weekend and had our wedding party and family stay on site. We were able to have all of our events around the wedding there as well. In addition, Sara (the owner) is so helpful with planning and coordinating the day of. I couldn't recommend this place enough!!

reviews.author: Hannah Townsand
reviews.text: I got stuck in Ithaca when my flight was cancelled and was able to easily book a night here at New Park Event Venue. It was a great experience, clean and cozy spot right along the lake. Staff responded quickly and went above and beyond when my flight was delayed again the next day. Highly recommend checking this place out any time of year!

reviews.author: Jacki Garlock
reviews.text: Terry and Kyle were very helpful in finding the right mattress setup for my elderly mother. There was a time deadline involved so they worked tirelessly to put together the mattress and frame that would work for us and have it delivered by that deadline. Thank you Terry for treating my mother with kindness and respect.

reviews.author: Cheri Lunas
reviews.text: Kyle was so knowledgeable and very patient with all of my questions.  He guided me through the difference in the memory foam vs coil.  He didn’t upsell me on any thing I didn’t need.  Ended up with a great mattress within my price range. 10/10 shopping experience.

reviews.author: Rich Rogers
reviews.text: Kyle and Terry were a pleasure to do business with. They are very knowledgeable at what they do and spent as much time as we required to make an informed decision on our purchase. I would recommend to anyone. Thanks Guys!

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.text: Small corner store but the food was delicious. Very friendly staff

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.text: Very yummy crawfish pie and kind service! My name is Nikki so my husband and I were inspired to stop by. Glad we did! Our toddler enjoyed the food too!

reviews.author: Teresha Williams
reviews.text: The lady that took my order was friendly, she gave my baby a candy. The menu was easily seen and there is a good variety on it. My food was done fast and it was more/bigger than I expected. I will definitely be back, and will recommend this store to anyone who is looking for a new food spot.

reviews.author: Ashley Stunkard
reviews.text: I finally found a go-to boutique that is perfect for all of my fashion needs. When I go there I literally want EVERYTHING and with the great prices I am able to continuously refresh my wardrobe with all of the latest styles. The staff has excellent taste and will even be your personal stylists for any event. I highly recommend The Trend Co, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Samantha Graczyk
reviews.text:
A surprising, hidden commodity in a lovely part of New Fairfield! The shop is trendy, carries a wide array of sizes, and has a variety of styles and fits for all aesthetics. I particularly loved their assortment of dresses, jackets, and pant options. And prices are fairly comparable to what you would pay at any major retailer, if not lower for certain items—beats having to take a trip to the mall!

Currently, I have a mental image of several items that I would love to go back for and I’m definitely excited to stop back in again and see what else they have to offer!

reviews.author: Julie Anne
reviews.text: This boutique has a HUGE selection of super cute clothes & accessories at excellent prices. It is so hard not to buy every single item you see because it is all so adorable! Nicole and her staff go above and beyond to help you find looks you'll love. I am so excited to have the The Trend Co. in New Fairfield!

reviews.author: Michelle Harty
reviews.text:
I was a patient of this dental office, and had no problems until I asked them to refund a credit left on my account from an insurance payment that I had apparently paid too much for.  They did not want to refund the credit, but finally did.  I just called to schedule a cleaning and was told there's a note on my account saying I can't come see this dentist again.

When I did have fillings done here several years ago, the dentist told me I needed more fillings however the gentleman working in the billing office assured me that the "fillings" I needed weren't for actual cavities. That was concerning, and during this conversation the billing manager let me know I had a credit of somewhere around $50.  They shouldn't be overbilling their clients.  Or trying to give them fillings for non issues.

reviews.author: Skye-Anna Lynn Nye-Smith
reviews.text: Dental hygienist does a great job. Didn’t love how little communication there was about the cavity fillings- everything seems rushed. When I went in for my filling appointment I had to ask how many-they told me 3 fillings but then only did 2 and had me schedule another appointment in a few weeks for the last one. I, like many others, have to take time off of work to go so it was super inconvenient. Most disappointing though was the filling that I did get on 1 (technically 2) front teeth horrible and over all sloppy. Later that evening the part of the filling that was smeared across my tooth (not where the cavity was) started lifting and in 3 days after getting the filling, it was out. They had said I could continue flossing but the filling connected my teeth and I couldn’t even get floss between. Seemed fine for cleanings, but nothing beyond that.

reviews.author: Della Hendrickson
reviews.text: Not only they don’t do sedation but they don’t even do extractions which was a terrible disappointment. Other then that they were very nice and gentle with X-rays and cleaning and advice. There was no wait time and they did offer to refer me for extractions. However to me it is not a dental office without that service which I will need a lot of in the near future beeing an older adult. I do plan to visit again for cleanings. They accept essential plan insurance but not medicaid.

reviews.author: JiaJia Ye
reviews.text:
The only problem with their homemade kimchi is that it disappears too fast into my stomach.

Great place to get groceries and ingredients for Chinese cuisine (and Korean cuisine, obviously)—they even have more niche stuff like preserved eggs and a significant variety of tofu, along with fresh vegetables like Napa cabbage. The prices are generally competitive for the location. The kimchi is an especially good deal and better than the offerings at the larger grocery stores in Ithaca.

reviews.author: Maya Watts
reviews.text: Great little store, has everything you would need including some fresh produce for great prices. Also has very kind and helpful staff!

reviews.author: Isabel Espinoza
reviews.text: me and my boyfriend came the other day and went a little crazy with our purchases lol but the prices are really good for what you get!! i really recommend the freezer rice cakes :) they have a lot of good quality veggies which seem to be fresh! HUGE instant noodle section and got to pick up some of my favorites i haven’t had in a long time , good selection of ice cream too! flavors i’ve never heard of before but in general was pleasantly surprised of how much they have for a small place , would definitely recommend and will 100% be coming to visit again soon!

reviews.author: Amanda (TheEyesofSyn)
reviews.text:
This place is lovely! I was like a kid in a candy store with the variety of seeds they had to offer, from chili peppers to tomatoes, to legal greenery, they have everything you might need.
The gentleman at the counter was friendly, calm and pleasant, the store is clean and well maintained, and I plan to return here for my future gardening needs.
The gentleman I spoke to really knew his stuff, and was more than willing to chat with us. He was generous with his time and information and I appreciate that immensely.

reviews.author: Todd Davenport
reviews.text: I drive 40 miles approximately to get to Planted Earth because I wanted to buy local but I don’t think they realize how dependent we become on a place then you can’t keep product in stock.  But then when you come back to pick it up, they’ll tell you it’s gone already. We need another week. I’m sorry I have really liked this store, but this is the third time since the beginning of the year. I’m done with you.

reviews.author: Corbin Owens
reviews.text: They have some amazing plants their its been growing like crazy want to get more soon great customer service and they helped me out quite a bit as well

reviews.author: Michael Brown
reviews.text: Smaller sized laundromat but there are enough machines in there to choose from. The washers start as low as 2.75 a load in the smaller washers up to 6.75 for the larger washers. No restrooms there. You can get an app to pay for the machines, or use the change machine and pay with quarters. Machines and premises looked mostly clean. Free WiFi to help you kill the time there

reviews.author: Angela /Tenchi K
reviews.text:
24/hrs is awesome & got me through a first month of a grand opening I worked seemingly non stop.
Fans & TV. Outlet to press bYO iron for shirts & pants quick.
Just wish there would be a natural allergy free laundry detergent offered at the machine.

reviews.author: Nostri
reviews.text: Cheap and clean with free WiFi. I wish the TV in there could be turned off or the channel changed but I bring headphones so it's not that big of a deal. You can control the ceiling fans too which is nice when it's hot out.

reviews.author: Jessica Tomlinson
reviews.text:
*** I have updated this review to 4 stars as the receptionist tried to rectify the earlier issue and has been pleasant. The doctor was quick and efficient and friendly with his services.

The 1 star is for the receptionist who NEVER answers a phone call... the whole point of being a receptionist is to answer calls (or at least put on hold) & help patients. She has a very passive aggressive approach in person as well when talking to patients. We called when we were in traffic saying we would be a few minutes late (10min total) we left a message seeing how she does not answer but refused to check us in saying everyone else will be on time

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text: Highly recommend. Was able to get a same day appointment and follow up appointments were easy with no crazy wait times like most places around here

reviews.author: Meredith A Palmer
reviews.text: The doctor is fine, but check your billing carefully. Because of late billing and misinformation I'm left with a collections agency on me for a tiny $20 bill. They claim they called me but this is untrue.

reviews.author: Susie Perry Pedersen
reviews.text: As a rule I LOVE this store; the clothes are lovely, they buy product made in the USA, they're always extremely helpful.  However, I am a plus size woman, and they've never really carried a hearty stock of clothes for us gals.  But to make matters worse, now they have gone and mixed the plus size clothes in with the regular sizes.  Which means we, (the plusies) have to go through EVERYTHING, only to be disappointed over and over again, until we finally find a plus size piece, only to find they don't have the 2X, just the 1X and 3X.  You can see where I'm going here.  There's a reason stores give the Plus size women there own section, it's to avoid all the disappointment.  I really hope they go back to that soon.  Still love the store

reviews.author: Wan Zhen Chua
reviews.text: A lovely women’s clothing store offering a wide range of selections, with a friendly and helpful shop owner who makes shopping a pleasure.

reviews.author: Tamarra Truman
reviews.text: Great selection of beautiful clothes. Love the friendly folks at the Homer store.

reviews.author: Arielle Johnson
reviews.text: Don’t give them lace!! I dropped off a vintage 70’s dress from my grandma and specifically noted that it was fragile lace and asked them to be careful. I picked up the dress and there are little puffy clouds at the corners of all of the lace motifs where it’s unraveled due to whatever the dry cleaner did. I wish they had just told me they couldn’t clean it if they didn’t have the ability to. Really bummed out!!

reviews.author: Hannah van Bergen
reviews.text: My money was stolen. The woman working the counter let me pre-pay cash up front, and when I went to pick up my item they had no record of my payment and I had to pay again. The woman even claimed that she was not working the day I dropped off my item, when I clearly remember that she handled my transaction. Not only did she lie to my face, but it is most likely that she pocketed the money for herself. I would be willing to speak about my experience, please provide a number or email that I can best reach someone at. Thank you.

reviews.author: Zachary Kaan
reviews.text: After reading the reviews I was really worried, but I was pleasantly surprised. The service is actually friendly (at the least adequate), my shirts were quickly done within a day, and the results were very good quality.

reviews.author: Francie Henson
reviews.text: Very polite, but not knowledgeable in helping out with downloading their app on my phone so I could get the DG rewards.  I felt obligated to bypass the discount because there were people in line behind me.  When I picked up the discount item I thought it was an in-store discount (not an application).  I had to purchase two of the item in order to get the discount.  I didn't know I would be holding other's up.  If I had known, I would have gotten help before going to the register.

reviews.author: Michael Brown
reviews.text: Great selection and variety. Store is usually/mostly well stocked and clutter free. Plenty of parking

reviews.author: Lorri Shipe
reviews.text: Shannon  was great to deal with . I have been going to Dr Zwrart for years and he is the best ! My pets love him and feel comfortable  with him and and his staff has always  been  great to to me me .

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text: The most reasonably priced small storage spaces in the area. They had just the right priced storage space conveniently located right where I needed it! Located just off of route 34 near Lansing Ny. Well maintained storage facility with 24/7 camera security. I give this facility my highest score 5 Stars.

reviews.author: Louise Marie
reviews.text: The best for storage locally, prices are very reasonable, facility is clean, and owner is accommodating and delivers great customer service. After over 17 moves, use of 5 storage facilities, and countless middlemen... based on my experience this place is doing it right.

reviews.author: Jack Allport
reviews.text:
Always tastes great for a great deal on Tuesday. But id definitely deal with the call center and call ahead because the wait will be incredible, there's way too many people for the small restruant to feed quickly. Not really the staffs fault
Most of them are polite despite the business, especially the man who I presume is the owner.
One guy will treat you like cattle though, and it seems he treats his Co workers like that too.

reviews.author: Aydin B
reviews.text: Very nice staff and awesome pizza to match it! Everyone was very friendly and a great pizza place to stop by at 😁

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text:
TL;DR: Came for $1 slices on Tuesday, everything went wrong. They lost my first order, then forgot to put two slices in my second order, then I ended up paying $23 for 8 slices of pizza.

Suddenly it became very bad. I've ordered here a few times and all was good, but today I made an order, the cashier wrote it down and put the paper right near the desk with my name on it and every position of my order! He asked me to wait for 7 minutes because pepperoni wasn't ready. I patiently waited for 30 minutes and many people after me made their orders. After half an hour I kindly asked another cashier (the first guy disappeared) where my order was. He told me that he knows nothing about my order, and we tried to find this piece of paper near the desk. Unfortunately, our struggle wasn't successful, I guess this paper disappeared with the cashier. I ordered again, but different flavours, because their board was full and they weren't making any new pizzas and were selling only already prepared. Almost immediately I got my new order because all pizza was already cooked. And that was the worst part because it cost me $23 for 8 pieces during $1 slices Tuesday. My bad that I didn't get the receipt because I trusted them. At home I found out that they gave me only 8 slices when I ordered 10 slices. I'm not sure if they forgot slices or just screwed me over on purpose but it was definitely not the $1 slices Tuesday. The pizza was great though, loved its taste. Will not be returning. Also keep in mind that the place is small, crowded and noisy, almost no seats available

reviews.author: Alexis Abramo
reviews.text: When Dr. Duthie was there, our experience was always fantastic. We met him as part of the cleft palate team when our child was just a toddler and checked in with him periodically through the years. He was so knowledgeable and supportive. The techs were great. The office staff was great. When Dr. Duthie left things started to deteriorate and have gone from bad to downright appalling. They don't even answer the phone or respond to messages anymore. We are going to have to change practices in order to manage our child's cleft care with a responsive and knowledgeable provider.

reviews.author: Sara Couchman
reviews.text: My sons have been patients there for years. It was great in the beginning when my oldest started and Dr Duthie was working. Over the last two years, the customer service as been very poor. Good luck getting someone to answer the phone and/or return your phone call. The office in Auburn has declined tremendously with wait times up to an hour after your scheduled appt. I have given them the benefit of the doubt for months but I am at a point that I would no longer recommend either office for their lack of patient care and turn over rate of Doctors (which I feel has prolonged my sons treatment)

reviews.author: Rachel Nilsson
reviews.text: It's a shame to see the practice Dr. Duthie built deteriorate so spectacularly under new ownership. If you are reading this as a prospective patient, it's not too late for you. Turn back. Find a practice with caring, competent doctors and staff who regard you as a human being with thoughts and feelings. The professionalism, skilled care, and operational efficiency that characterized Dr. Duthie's practice have been erased. What remains for me is a bitter self-loathing at having committed a second kid, not to mention thousands more of my hard-earned dollars, to the tattered remnants of this practice. This place is like an AI version of an orthodontist. If you don't look too closely, it's a reasonable approximation, but upon closer inspection, it is actually quite bonkers. Give your money to someone else.

reviews.author: nilka joaquin
reviews.text: The ambiance is dimly lit and intimate, creating the perfect setting for a romantic evening. It feels tucked away and special, like a hidden gem. The pasta tastes house-made and perfectly cooked, with rich, well-balanced sauces that feel authentic and thoughtfully prepared.

reviews.author: yoyo
reviews.text:
Celebrated a birthday here and left disappointed. While the food was very good, the service undermined the entire experience. Our waiter was repeatedly condescending, made pointed remarks toward members of our table, and created an atmosphere that felt uncomfortable rather than celebratory.

For a restaurant with a reputation like Gola, I feel like attentive and respectful service should be the bare minimum. Spending roughly $300 on a meal where guests feel talked down to is simply not acceptable. The food alone isn’t enough to justify the price if the hospitality falls this short.

reviews.author: Matt Cotto
reviews.text:
I had taken my partner to Gola Astoria for their birthday celebration. The ambiance and wait staff had been on point. We were pleasantly impressed how they had brought our food out very quickly. My partner had mentioned to me that the Tortelloni dish they ordered was not fully cooked. It was hard not Al Dente. We brought it to the wait staffs attention and requested to have the plate replaced. The waiter said they could cook it alittle more for us. I requested it be replaced due to Tortelloni not being a dish that can be reconstituted by cooking it more. He responded ," Are you a food critic " very smugly. 10 plus minutes passed and he had brought back the Tortelloni to our table and it was completely flat and mushy. It looked as if it was microwaved. My partner mentioned it looked well overcooked but said they were hungry and it was ok. On my end i didnt see the need to actually request they taste the food that they had plated for us because I'm wanting to preserve the best experience for my partner on their special day. That was my top priority in regards to my needed attention.  I smiled lots and was trying to be as gracious as my partner. I was so disappointed. That was not my 1st time , "Dining" here. I had treated family and friends to dinner at Golla Astoria a few times over the past few years. Overall, with good experiences.  But have not returned since.
Sadly, in addition to my partners food being sub par. I ordered one of my favorites there, "Grill Octopus". It didnt tasted "Grilled".  It was what I would call Charred Octopus. Money not wasted due to being there for my partner. We smiled and continued our celebration that evening.  But I will say it was money wasted for sub par food and the disappointment in the waitstaff experience.
What i found interesting about the waiter was he had given us Eye Smiles through the initial interactions then after he made the remark," Are you a food critic " he smiled with a full mouth and he had some serious dental issues in the front. They list them selves as the ," Fine Dining Experience " . Hmm, He should have continued with the eye smiles after his mocking me. Eye Smiles worked. The condescending full grill smile not so pleasant for my appetite with having to look at his dental issues.
I thought I should bring my experience to the attention of management and followed through with a phone call. They were not available so left a message with staff that I was wanting to bring my experience to the managers attention and asked if they would contact me. I did not receive a return call.

reviews.author: Judy Raether
reviews.text: Fantastic ice cream! Best I have ever had, and I've had a lot in my 64 years of ice cream-loving life! The entire experience at Cornell was remarkable. I recommend taking time to do the self-guided tour of the Dairy building, which would include the Viticulture science display. Don't miss the Botanical Gardens and Arboretum while on campus!

reviews.author: Telephone
reviews.text:
I recently visited Cornell Dairy Bar and had an amazing experience! The ice cream here is hands down some of the best I’ve ever had. Made with fresh milk from the Cornell Dairy, it’s incredibly creamy and rich in flavor. They offer a wide variety of flavors, and every one I’ve tried has been delicious. The portions are generous, and you can really taste the quality in every bite.
The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it a great place to relax and enjoy your treat. It’s a popular spot for students and locals, and for good reason! Whether you’re in the mood for a classic scoop or a fun sundae, you’ll find something to satisfy your sweet tooth.
The staff is friendly and efficient, and the prices are fair for the high quality you’re getting. I love that it’s located right on Cornell’s campus, making it the perfect stop after a walk around the beautiful grounds.
Overall, Cornell Dairy Bar is a must-visit in Ithaca, and I can’t recommend it enough. If you love ice cream, this place is an absolute 10/10!

reviews.author: PRT Cool Service Inc
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Cornell Dairy Bar – Cornell University, Ithaca, NY

A must-visit spot inside Cornell University’s campus. This place beautifully combines quality, tradition, and flavor in every detail. It’s perfect for enjoying a handcrafted ice cream or a fresh sandwich in a spotless, cheerful setting with truly outstanding service.

Visiting Ithaca without stopping by the Cornell Dairy Bar would feel like leaving something unfinished. This is our second visit to the university, and once again we were impressed by the excellence of their products. Every ice cream flavor is authentic, creamy, and perfectly balanced, each with its own unique touch that reflects the passion and expertise behind it.

You can taste the quality in every bite — fresh ingredients, original combinations, and a level of care that speaks for itself. Knowing that behind these creations stands Cornell’s renowned Department of Food Science, which educates and advises major companies in the dairy industry, makes every scoop even more meaningful.

A place where passion for good food meets academic excellence. Without a doubt, if you’re looking to try something truly different and of the highest quality, this is the perfect place. 🍦🎓

reviews.author: Ian A
reviews.text: Really pretty view for free. Recommend stopping here and then doing the gorge trail 1 mile away or going to the lake to relax. During the winter the frozen falls looks incredible. Best falls in Ithaca. Absolutely worth the trip.

reviews.author: FriedChicken
reviews.text:
Overlook is half way point of North Rim Trail. Since half of the trail was close during winter. People just drove and park here (free parking).
There is a visitor center and bathroom but it wasn't open when I was there. View is not bad. It is a 2-minute stop. Take some picture and then go back to the car.
Gorge trail has better view because you can get close and feel the energy of the waterfall.

reviews.author: Sarah Snyder
reviews.text: Awesome view from this Overlook.  There is car parking on one side of the road and larger vehicle spots on the other. Multiple viewpoints down several levels of stone steps. You can see from the top or walk down closer but the view is great from either.  There is a small store and bathrooms.

reviews.author: Liz Phillips
reviews.text: If I could give this place 0 stars I would based solely on how the man who was working there treated me. I held up a bottle of wine in the doorway to my husband who was standing outside with our dog and was screamed at. We are both well over 21 years old and I was yelled at multiple times that I talked to someone on the street and he demanded to see both our IDs. We were more than happy to comply but he continued to harp on me. He then "apologized" by saying it wasn't his intention to be hostile only after he saw how rattled I was. I have never been spoken to this way in my entire life, and I left the store shaking and in tears. I will never go back to this business and I will be sharing with my friends not to go either because no customer should ever be treated that way. This could have been asked in a calm way and the hostility and tone was beyond inappropriate and entirely unnecessary.

reviews.author: Gustavo Porpino
reviews.text: Clerk at the register is rude and he doesn't care at all about customers. I have bought wines in this place for the convenience, but I'm not willing to return anymore. They think we are doing a favor to them when we enter there to buy wines, but they forget that there are plenty of wine stores in Ithaca treating well its customers.

reviews.author: Kim Edwards
reviews.text:
The owner at this store well the manager during the day has said very inappropriate things to more than one customer.
he will tell you that he’s married but complain about his relationship  and perhaps even shed some tears I’m not the only one who has been manipulated by this man I suggest you only go in during the night shift when the woman is working she is very polite.

reviews.author: Anthony King
reviews.text: Sunny is a super cool Down to earth guy, manages the customers well, place is always clean and our interactions are very funny. He makes THE BEST PIZZAS, give him a raise👌

reviews.author: Silochanie Miller
reviews.text: I have a bit of a love hate relationship with this place, the love being while I'm shopping and the hate being while I'm paying. These people have some of the best selection of any convenience store in Ithaca, particularly when it comes to beer and cider, and as someone who grew up in a South Asian neighborhood, being able to stop by for some Indian snacks is very nostaglic. Their location is also very convenient - however, I'd imagine their rent is through the roof, which would explain why everything is a bit pricey.

reviews.author: Allison
reviews.text: Very chill vibe with great selection of a variety of foods. Also has a pizza kitchen inside, I had chicken nuggets and they were very good yay thank you

reviews.author: Quin Fowler
reviews.text: I have about 1 million nice things I could say about this shop, from the second you walk in the door every staff member is kind and attentive. I went for the first time on Friday the 13th to get my nose pierced and left with 2 piercings from Rob and a flash tattoo from Vini. And since then I can’t stop going back, Vini never fails to disappoint me with his art or with his attitude. The whole shop is comfortable and safe and vinis tattoo work is some of my favorite, could not recommend this shop enough

reviews.author: Cayley Jane
reviews.text: Rob helped me find the piercing that was perfect for me when i came in unsure. I was very anxious and he was incredibly accommodating, helped distract me and cracked some jokes. He was patient and made sure the piercing and placement was perfect. I could not be happier and i HIGHLY recommend coming here & seeing rob!!

reviews.author: Bridget Berkley
reviews.text: After doing much research I came across Vini at Ithaca Piercing and Tattoo. I was drawn to his fine line and black style of tattoo. He did not disappoint. Not only is he a true artist, but he's warm and friendly. The 3-hour session flew by. It was fun and professional. The piece is in memory of my dad and I'm so happy with the results and the experience.  100% recommend.

reviews.author: Margot Hughes
reviews.text: I hired Ahrayna as the tinsel fairy for a bachelorette party, and it was a blast!! Even the girls who didn't originally think they wanted tinsel in their hair decided to do it. It looks great and was so much fun — I'd highly recommend her!

reviews.author: Sophia
reviews.text:
Jessie is the best! I’ve been getting my hair cut from her for a couple years on and off, but recently, I purchased a wig that needed some customization. I knew she would get the job done, and she exceeded my expectations! My wig is more personalized now and it just feels like me.
She will listen to you and fully consider what it is you’d like. She is also very friendly and sweet and down to earth. I enjoy our conversations when I go!

reviews.author: Barbara Rauschenbach
reviews.text: Jessie is the best!  Turning 70 and looking in the mirror at all my grey hair I decided it was time to dye my hair.  But I didn't want to use harmful products.  Also, I have curly hair and after years of having my husband cut my hair I decided to get a nice cut before my daughter's wedding.  I was so lucky to discover Jessie's place.  I feel years younger!    She made the whole process enjoyable and my hair looks and feels fantastic. I feel years younger.

reviews.author: Uno Roro
reviews.text:
Coffee is excellent, service is great (especially Serena),  nice decor/atmosphere, but food was extremely disappointing and overpriced.

Brie stuffed French toast -- it was dry
Fries -- portion is small and they charge $3
Homemade ketchup -- tasted like tomato paste
Ham and egg breakfast -- barely any ham

To top it off they add a "service fee" to your bill without even telling you.

Honestly, just come here for the coffee and service.

reviews.author: Urmilla Banerjee
reviews.text: Really nice for coffee and scones! Lots of interesting flavors of scones - we got chocolate earl grey and chocolate ginger. Both were delicious. There’s normally a wait for the brunch, but you can order the coffee and scones from the counter without waiting.

reviews.author: Aydan Scott
reviews.text: Mark has been here all three times we've visited over the last few months, and has always taken great care of us. This is the only place we've found in Ithaca so far that makes cappuccinos the same way we had them in Italy on our honeymoon and is a staple of me and my wife's dining experience in the area. The food is stellar every time we come here and we're certain to return time and time again.

reviews.author: Cindy Collado
reviews.text: I don’t usually do this but food and atmosphere was amazing. From the Sunrise Selections I had Seasoned Country Style Potatoes, Scrambled Eggs with Hardwood Smoked Bacon and a Fresh Tropical Fruit Cup. My Husband had the Hawaiian Style Loco Moco. As Breakfast Accents we had Ham Steak Bon-in along with Butter Biscuits with Sausage Cream Gravy. Can’t wait to go again definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Izabela Zamboni
reviews.text:
Sooo good! We tried the ahi tuna taco- amazing
Kaluha pork sandwich- very good (I miss a little kick of a salad like the taco had it)
Kaluha pork taco- perfect!! 💯
My husband ordered the mussels and was his favorite and he loved the passion fruit creme brulee
The coconut pie was fenomenal
We will be back 😊

reviews.author: Melissa Silenzio (RedApple93)
reviews.text:
Modern Ohana, formally MIX, was a delightful surprise. As a big fan of Mix, I was worried about this change, but I must say that Modern Ohana is official in my "favorite restaurant" list of Ithaca.
The uplifting atmosphere created with the renovations were beautifully on theme with the new tropical direction of the restaurant.
We ordered a Blacked ahi tuna benedict and a Hawaiian loco moco and both were amazing quality, balanced in flavors and made with attention to detail. An amazing introduction into what was our first hawaiian meal, and it will not be our last at Modern Ohana!

reviews.author: Eva Spak
reviews.text: Picking my own produce was such a fun activity! I left with a bag of delicious apple varieties that I picked myself. Frolicking through the fields was a lot of fun, and I got some great photos. Make sure to get some apple cider donuts (and an apple cider slushy for a refreshing and festive treat) at the end.

reviews.author: lindsta
reviews.text: We got to pick apples for such a good price! 🍎 coffee and cider donuts are amazing

reviews.author: Rita L
reviews.text: Adding some more reviews for this year! Loved this farm on my road trip a few months ago and never got to writing a review. The donuts were so yummy! Super friendly staff and it's really fun picking out your own fruits! Check it out if you're in the area and looking for something to do, they have peaches, apple, pears, grapes when I went! Pay for what you pick and check what's in season before you go!

reviews.author: Deb Myers
reviews.text: Karl is a top notch mechanic .he did some work on my husbands Ram very fair prices quick turn around .

reviews.author: phoebe nolder
reviews.text: This guy has gotten me out of a jam more than once! He's quick and fair.

reviews.author: Robert Rieger
reviews.text: Honest, organized, knowledgeable, reasonable and local.

reviews.author: Mr.T
reviews.text: I have to say that these guys are masters of their trade. Chase is not only an artist but engineer master in his knowledge and skills in fabrication and design along with his skilled hand hat tinting, can’t be beat. And Lee and his experience in home audio is a testament to his passion and dedication to that field . His knowledge in home audio with his hard working team is on another level. They were with me every step of the way in my audio journey in chasing perfect sound reproduction. Now I’m not adding any gas to this, they are hands down the greatest and they authentically care for their customers and clients.

reviews.author: Rob Bandler
reviews.text: Lee, Chase and crew are awesome!  I got my first system from Lee in 1979 and have had many, many since.  They have provided excellent service on multiple home theater setups as well as too many mobile systems to count.  The latest was a full dash replacement on a very low mile but sun damaged Chevy Tahoe.  Fast, neat, complete and they even gave the interior a minor detail before giving the truck back.  Better than new!  These guys rock!  Wish I could give them more than 5 stars!   They are masters of their trade.

reviews.author: Alexis Randall
reviews.text:
I have used this shop a numerous times over the years for issues with my car batteries. The service is stellar. They are very communicative and don't make you feel rushed or vulnerable for not knowing what the issue is yourself. They are great about selling batteries with good warranties and make sure the battery you get is the proper capacity.

I recently had to replace the battery on my Tacoma for the third time in 3 years, previously installed by AutoZone. The tech I worked with, Robert, was awesome and very quick to point out that the battery I had was nowhere near the right size to support the snow plow I have hooked up (AutoZone even replaced the battery once with the plow on the truck and never suggested a larger capacity battery despite me asking multiple times). Robert sold me a properly sized battery and installed a fixed battery tender hookup as well so I can keep the battery charged even if it's going to be sitting a while.

They also seem to have a very good selection of hi-end stereo and AV products in the store including headphones and turntables. Next time I'm in need of any of those items/services this will definitely be the first place I go to. This place will hands down outperform AutoZone/AAP or BestBuy any day.

reviews.author: Ross Borden
reviews.text: Because this was my first visit to a shop that buys and sells rare coins and jewelry, I expected the shop-owner would drive a hard bargain. Instead the sale was thoroughly transparent, perfectly easy and agreeable. Patrick Klee represents the third generation of his family’s business, and he is a gem.

reviews.author: Jacob Jadwin
reviews.text: We went in to drop off our watches, but patrick was able to help us right away. He fixed one of our bands and ordered two batteries for our watches. Great service. I highly recommend! And it's family owned!

reviews.author: Leeanne Rose White
reviews.text: Gentle man that assisted me was very friendly, very straight-forward & very helpful. Best experience i have ever had in a pawn shop. Great variety of items!!

reviews.author: Rachel Ng
reviews.text: super cool, lots of good vendors. food and music too.

reviews.author: Skye Hamilton
reviews.text: This is cool

reviews.author: John Davis
reviews.text: The guys that work there are always friendly and very helpful.

reviews.author: Carl VanOrder
reviews.text:
HEP Sales, is a very nice place to shop. The counter
help are knobl1nqwledgeable and friendly.

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.text: They have a good amount of plumbing and heating parts. Cheaper than the big box stores and staff is friendlier and willing to assist customers.

reviews.author: Brett H
reviews.text:
Added to my original review below

We stopped in tonight to give it another chance. Service was better than before but it wasn’t busy. Hopefully the other night was just a fluke. Everyone does deserve a pass for one bad night. Food was good until we hit dessert which was burned and only about half of it was even edible. I don’t know why it was even served. Hopefully you do better for others but two tries is enough for us. We won’t be back.

Original review

We’ve been to Reds in the past and loved it. I never write reviews but this was the worst service we have ever had. In an hour and a half of sitting at our table the only thing we were able to get was water and not even a refill on that once we drank it. No drinks, no appetizers, no food. Waiter came to the table twice. Once to drop off water then to take our order that never came. We gave up after an hour and a half and let the hostess know that our waiter never came back and we never received anything but water. She was nice but didn’t know what to do about it so we left.

reviews.author: hamza mounhamir
reviews.text: My pregnant wife sent me out for macaroni and cheese, and I arrived very late, just as they were closing the kitchen. But they didn't disappoint me; they reopened the kitchen just for me. That made me very happy. Thanks a lot.

reviews.author: Nicole Sawade
reviews.text: Stopped into Reds for a late lunch and it didn't disappoint! Eric was incredible. Super personable and fun! Food was delicious too. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Jacy
reviews.text: Cool brewery and the cider was really good 🍻. Food was okay overall. My favorites were the whipped feta and Caesar salad. Unfortunately, service was horrible for my table personally. Our server never checked on us (even while checking on tables around us), and we had to flag him down just to get the check which led to quite a frustrating experience. I don't see myself visiting here again as the lac of service was off putting.

reviews.author: Amit Hayile
reviews.text:
We had a early dinner at Revelry which was okish.

A nice flight of beers with a good selection.

Asparagus parmesan was really nice, a bit smokey with a tasty aioli.

The burger was good with nice onions rings.

Fish and chips was quite nice, a big portion of the fish with a nice crisp tempura.

Pasta with tomato sauce was nice with a lot of fresh basil but like a homey dish.

The short rib poutine wasn't that tasty the cheese covered the meat flavours and the fries got wet from the big amount of sauce on the bottom.

Service was friendly but not attentive enough. The table was small and they didn't clear the empty plates or prepared the table for the next dishes which was very inconvenient as they were busy and it was a bit challenging to their attention.

reviews.author: Isabel Mendez
reviews.text:
We did not enjoy our meal for 4, and will not be coming back. We came here based on previous reviews and it was a mistake, and not a good experience. We had reservations for dinner. Sat down at 5pm, received our food at 5:30pm, and were told at 6:10pm that we had to leave before 6:30pm because "there is a 22 top coming at that time". We had barely finished our entrees, and could not even order desert. This was not a cheap meal, and I did not appreciate being kicked out with a 20 min. notice. Had we been informed at the time we arrived for our reservation that this was the case we would have done something different. Afterwards, we were able to find another restaurant to sit down, order some cake, and finish our evening. It was an embarrassing situation.

I understand this place must have been good at some point in the past, because the food gets raving reviews, but our truffle fries were soggy, and my chicken sandwich was all crust. I will not review the rest of the food because I do not want to seem petty and I want to focus on the way we were treated, but do not expect anything other that standard cafeteria fare.

I keep going back to the current reviews, and I do not understand how they are so good. Perhaps we were unlucky, but I cannot recommend the place to anyone looking for a nice dinner. I chose this place for a special evening and we were only able to salvage it because we end it up somewhere else.

reviews.author: Cmoon
reviews.text:
Ordered eggs benedict and it came out overly cooked and just like hard boiled egg.
The service was slow in morning. To make it worse, the waitress was lack of interpersonal skills and basically said we are short of staff and you need to wait longer.

reviews.author: Robin ML
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for valentine's day. The food was amazing and the service was beyond exemplary. Especially our server Kylie, she was amazing and made sure everything was perfect for us. All of the staff was friendly and accommodating, even on a very busy night!
We will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Steve Mulloy
reviews.text:
Enjoyed breakfast on Thanksgiving morning at Monks.   There was only one server, Brianna, who was incredible as she was alone and at one point I counted 10+ tables being served.

The kitchen staff was assisting and the food was amazing.

I can’t compliment Brianna enough for staying calm and hustling to ensure everyone had the best dining experience possible.  I hope the management appreciates this professional team member.

reviews.author: R Dangler
reviews.text: A few years ago, I stopped in to the orchard store on a whim. I was greeted with a wide variety of apples, some familiar and some totally new to me. Each variety had a sign which described it's lineage and I was surprised to learn just how many of my favorite apple varieties held ties to the Cortland/Ithaca area via Cornell. Now I try to stop back every fall for a bag of my new favorites - the Snapdragon apple. Give it a shot!

reviews.author: crasher1339
reviews.text: Love, love, love Cornell Orchards. Best apples I've had anywhere, nice spot, easy location, and plenty of other items of very high quality, cheeses, Cornell Dairy ice cream, other fruits and veggies in season. Definitely worth a stop.

reviews.author: David Levine
reviews.text: A MUST visit if you are in the Ithaca area.  In addition to the amazing selection of apples, the store features Cornell honey, maple syrup, ice cream, yogurt, cheese, seasonal fruits/vegetables and occasional surprises.  A select group of local crafts and Cornell swag is also included.  Something else to appreciate is that the building is smack dab in the middle of a teaching and research orchard: one of the best-run and maintained sets of apple trees you will ever see.

reviews.author: Joshua Streets
reviews.text:
We bought a vehicle from Elliot and have to say it was an awesome experience.   He was very friendly and accommodating to our children.   The deal was pressure free.  He took care of some of the small things for us including insurance update and plate swap with the dmv.   We got to test drive the vehicle.   Best of all though, the whole deal got done relatively quickly compared with previous buying experiences from larger dealerships.   We excited to pick up our new vehicle which was extremely clean.
I strongly recommend him and Ridge Road Imports.

reviews.author: Max Wood
reviews.text: I just had my vehicle inspected there today. The appointment was made yesterday. When I showed up to pick up my vehicle, the gentleman was saying how busy they have been, and I told him that I was grateful he was able to get me in so quickly. They have also taken very good care of my mom and her automobile as well. The folks there are friendly, knowledgeable, and their shop is neat and well organized.

reviews.author: Lenny Rosenfield
reviews.text: The most you can hope for when buying a used vehicle is that your dealer is honest. This is very true of Elliot. This is the 3rd or 4th car we have bought from him.  Lenny R

reviews.author: C J
reviews.text:
This place is a hidden gem that you can’t wait to tell everyone about..but also secretly want to keep to yourself. But I have to share a review because this restaurant is truly THE spot everyone needs to visit.

The owners and staff at Ole Ole Ithaca are really what make them stand out. You can just feel how much they care about their customers and food. I can guarantee they will always provide you with top-tier service. Honestly, I was (and continue to be) pleasantly surprised at how personable and attentive the service is, considering its counter-service. If anything, I love how quick and convenient it is, without lacking in excellent service or quality.

The interior has an open farmhouse aesthetic that is inviting and full of character.

Ole Ole Ithaca serves Korean street food, but what makes this spot different is the fusion blend that you won’t find everywhere. The food is always delicious, the portions are generous, and it feels homemade. With rising costs these days, I find the prices are unbeatable for the portion sizes. I frequently order online for delivery or takeout, and the website is super easy to use. The food is just as fresh and tasty as eating in, so I use their website a lot.

Ithaca has many Korean restaurants, but Ole Ole Ithaca is one of those places that truly offer the best of all worlds: delicious Korean food with a unique twist, consistently great quality, and stellar service in a welcoming atmosphere.

Like I said, I can’t gatekeep this gem forever, because I know that once you try the food, it will instantly become one of your favorite restaurants too.

reviews.author: Sean R Cole
reviews.text:
My first time to the Han Family’s Ithaca location. Love the atmosphere classic adornments all over the walls. The menu has so many delicious choices. Mrs. Hahn greeted me with a smile and I placed my eat in order - GF chicken rice bowl. Absolutely delicious with yum yum sauce and an excellent tasting broth. I forgot to add until I already started in with just yum yum sauce. This just made it even better! I also ordered the GF chicken K roll. Wow this was great and tasty with the yum yum sauce and full of vegetables!
Thank you for a great lunch. Loved my visit!

reviews.author: Kris F
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place!  The kimchi beef tacos, beef gimbap, and beef bibimbap and tteokbokki were SO GOOD!  I wish I was local so I could come here all the time.  I will definitely be back to try more of the menu items the next time I am home to visit.  Highly recommend giving this place a try!

reviews.author: niboR Swartwood-Lomax
reviews.text: Clean, Professional, Polite & VERY Courteous customer service reps! They offer a variety of options at fairly reasonable rates.

reviews.author: Steve Nedrow
reviews.text:
They get your stuff, where it needs to GO!
GREAT staff , very friendly, very helpful
Nuff said

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text: This place is absolutely abysmal. They call me telling me that they have a package for me and they they cannot deliver to my PO Box and that I need to come pick it up. At no time did they tell me I needed to pick it up by a certain day. I drive all the way here and wait behind this lady in line with dozens of boxes who took her sweet time and I stood in line forever. The incredibly rude employee then told me that my package was already shipped back to the sender. Maybe you could’ve told me I have a deadline to pick it up by since I have a busy schedule during your business hours? What a complete and total joke. Stop calling people and wasting their time if all you’re doing to do is return it to the sender.

reviews.author: Steve Manley
reviews.text:
Shout our to Zach! Had a kiddo's scooter wheel get jammed at the skate park- the only place in town for quick bearing. And he even plugged them in for me. Skate park day saved!
Excellent customer service, excellent member of the our community.

reviews.author: Josh Ocampo
reviews.text: I seen this skateshop getting posted on @nikesbornothing and that they had the SB "Deep Fir" and boy my heart dropped 🤩 so i clicked the link went to their page and i knew they were going to have some heat 😉 and what do you know dude allll sizes were gone but mine size 9 ‼️🔥 i was so stoked to scoop em. Ordering process was super fast and easy and i got a cool discount on my next order 😉 Definitely will be back to shop more

reviews.author: Bravo Belly
reviews.text: This 5 Star review is coming ALL the way from Texas! Whoever runs this store tends to post what is "left over" on the website in regard to any in-store releases and I just so happen to find a saucy pair! The SHIPPING was the fastest shipping I have ever experienced.... I ordered on a Thursday afternoon, they were at my front door by Saturday morning. I look forward to making my next purchase with y'all! Thank y'all SO much!

reviews.author: Samantha Baker
reviews.text: Camden in the shoe department was extremely helpful. We came in to get my daughter shoes for track and he was very knowledgeable about what type of shoe is good for certain types of running. He also didn’t get upset at all when we didn’t get her size correct and he had to run back and forth to get us the right one. Thank you Camden!

reviews.author: The Throttles and Life of Dolly
reviews.text: I went in there for hunting and fishing supplies but there was none. What a disappointment. I suppose I'll go to a really outdoor store. They are more overpriced now that they have moved and some of the employees are rude and don't want to help or answer questions

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text: Poor quality products. Bought a pair of sunglasses from here that broke in 4 days. Went back for a replacement which broke in 8. They then had the nerve to tell me that since I didn’t buy the “protection plan” I didn’t qualify for a refund or exchange.
