Maybe have products that don’t fall apart in a handful of days and it won’t be an issue. The lady was nice enough to make an exception and refund it “this time only” but I shouldn’t be in a position to begin with that I need to be coming back and forth to get what’s rightfully mine.

reviews.author: Olivia Sadati
reviews.text:
Mercato serves up excellent food in a cozy, intimate space. I had the fish baked in parchment paper—the special of the night—and it was absolutely delicious: light, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. My daughter had the skirt steak and fries, which were also excellent—tender, juicy, and well-seasoned.

The restaurant is on the smaller side, so seating can feel a bit tight, but the quality of the food makes it well worth it. A great spot to dine if you're in Ithaca and looking for something special.

reviews.author: Sierra Mitchell
reviews.text: This place is absolutely to die for. If you don’t like anything on the menu that you think you’ll like… GET THE BREAD!!! The bread is amazing and I could eat it all just for dinner. The service was also incredible, got a taste test of wine, as a family we felt very cared for and respected. I would come here again and again if I could. Definitely a recommendation!!

reviews.author: Deborah Bennett
reviews.text: The food was absolutely phenomenal. I had the ravioli which was possibly the best Italian food I have ever eaten. Paired with a lovely Italian red wine, the pasta was perfectly prepared and the tomato sauce was divine.

reviews.author: Greg Mazzeo
reviews.text: This was a very easy walk to see the falls. It is crazy that it is right in Ithica! Loved these falls. We went to the upper and lower falls in Treman Park, which was an awesome hike to get to Lucifer falls... Lots of beautiful sights, but Ithica falls was the best falls by far, at least this time of the year in the fall.

reviews.author: Mel Go
reviews.text: The location offers breathtaking views, with lush greenery and vibrant flowers that create a picturesque backdrop. The well-maintained walking paths provide an easy stroll, making it accessible for everyone. It’s the perfect setting for capturing stunning nature photographs, especially for weddings or special occasions, where the beauty of the surroundings enhances every moment.

reviews.author: Roberto Delgado
reviews.text:
amid a crisp winter chill, I made a beeline for Ithaca Falls Natural Area—drawn by the promise of frozen waterfalls in the Finger Lakes' gorges. Located off Lake Street in the Fall Creek neighborhood, this 1.5-acre spot is an effortless add-on for visitors, mere minutes from downtown or Cornell. With temps hovering around 28°F and light snow flurries, the park transformed into a winter wonderland, the 150-foot Ithaca Falls partially encased in ice, forming glittering blue columns and frosty overhangs that sparkled under the overcast sky.
The short trail from the parking lot was manageable, though I bundled up against the wind—cleats or boots are a must on the icy path, as slips are real (I nearly took one near the viewpoint). Getting close to the base revealed the falls' muted roar, muffled by ice, with steam rising from unfrozen pockets in the creek. It's mesmerizing for photography; my phone captured ethereal shots of the frozen cascade against bare trees. Wildlife was sparse, but a few hardy birds added life to the serene scene. No crowds midweek, just peaceful solitude—perfect for a quick 30-minute visit before the sun sets early around 5:30 PM.
Free parking was plentiful, but watch for snow-covered spots. No facilities, so layer up and use downtown spots beforehand. Recent city enhancements, like reinforced trails from 2025, held up well in the slush. Compared to summer hikes, winter offers a stark, dramatic beauty without the bugs or heat.
A slight downside: wind off Cayuga Lake made it biting cold, and road salt from Route 13 tracked in some grit. Still, as a first-time visitor, it's a 5-star winter gem—raw, accessible, and quintessentially "Ithaca is Gorges." Bundle up and go; it's worth braving the elements for that icy spectacle.

reviews.author: Cat
reviews.text:
Ashely is my favorite. I have never had a nail tech more enthusiastic, talented, and professional than her! I regularly went to her for acrylic/gel full set manicures with designs and they ALWAYS rocked.

She is the best and I would never go anywhere else had I not moved from the area. I would go back to have her do my wedding nails, she's that great.

reviews.author: Julia Arriaran
reviews.text: Literally amazing! Ashley was so accommodating fitting me on last minute and then on top of that SLAYED with the inspo pic I gave her. She was always checking in to make sure things looked good before it was too late. Go here :)

reviews.author: CANDI COLLINS
reviews.text: If have been going to Ashley Nails since it opened in Pyramid Mall - now Shops at Ithaca Mall. They are very professional, kind and courteous and very reasonably priced. There is no better place for nail services. I would recommend Ashley Nails to everyone. Ashley and Danny are fabulous.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Braymen
reviews.text: I see Maddie and I always leave very satisfied with my cut. All the ladies working at Satori are very warm and friendly. A beautiful place, but not the least bit "stuffy".

reviews.author: Eva Spak
reviews.text: Cassidy is amazing! She listened and gave me the exact cut I was envisioning. My hair looks almost exactly like my inspiration photos. She also asked specific clarifications during the haircut to make sure she was giving me the cut I wanted. I am very pleased with my experience here. I will come back the next time I need a haircut in Ithaca.

reviews.author: Deb Harrison
reviews.text: Ivy is the best!  When visiting family, needed a haircut and was lucky to be scheduled wirh Ivy.  She is so sweet, very attentive and takes time to talk through want your want in a cut or color.  Been so happy with the results!

reviews.author: Gam Prangrarin
reviews.text:
If you want to have newly made, quick Asian Food (especially Thai & Japanese), Oishii Bowl is the place I always regularly visit.

The taste is really delicious! The price & the portion is reasonable. The quality is good. The atmosphere is clean.

We can order via Kiosk/ Tablet and that’s convenient. They have 2 options: dine-in and take-away. The only thing I would critic is that we cannot add on some proteins in dish, unless you directly contact with staffs (which normally are not there at the counter).

In summary, every thing is good here. Looking forward to coming back for sure.

reviews.author: joanne chen
reviews.text: amazing bang for ur buck. every time i order noodles from here i quadruple the amount of soup i have by watering it down because it’s too salty. ordering is quick and service is also quick. the thai tea here is also goated for just $3.5

reviews.author: Liu Tom
reviews.text: The quality is declining. Used to like this restaurant. Ordered a tongatsu don today, and the pork stinks and was undercooked. It’s actually very dangerous. Never eat at here

reviews.author: Alec Barden
reviews.text: Delicious. Very clean dining room. Got the Hand ripped noodles and the thin spicy sesame noodles. Both were good but the sesame noodles had way more flavor. Also order spicier than you think, I got a level 5 spice and it was barely spicy. Braised beef was incredible, cucumber salad in chili oil incredible, egg and tomatoes incredible, dumplings incredible. Can't say enough good things about the food.

reviews.author: Joshua Dirga
reviews.text: I got the Spicy Cumin Lamb Hand Ripped Noodles. The noodle was firm and springy, featured a good portion of lamb, and the sauce was savory and spicy. I got the medium spice and it was perfect, though a bit oily. I was also impressed by the length of the noodles because they were really long. The triple dumplings were also so delicious, the inside was juicy and flavorful, topped with more chilli oil. The automatic ordering was cool as well, and food came relatively fast. The pricing was also surprisingly affordable. Would definitely recommend to noodle lovers and spicy food enthusiasts.

reviews.author: Yunong Shi
reviews.text:
Authentic and satisfying! It’s such a treat to find a place that serves real Xi’an food—hand-pulled noodles and lamb jiamo that are bold, spicy, and deeply seasoned. You can taste the freshness of the dough, and the chili oil has real flavor, not just heat. The lamb sandwich was juicy and fragrant, packed with green pepper and cumin.

The interior is simple and functional, but even during the quiet summer break, the place was buzzing with students and regulars. That says a lot. Highly recommend if you’re craving Northwestern Chinese comfort food done right.

reviews.author: anangrykoala
reviews.text: Staff is very nice. The quality and variety of food they sell is great! Sometimes pricey but they often run some amazing deals. It's my Happy Place in Ithaca because of its impeccable vibes.

reviews.author: Adam Morgan
reviews.text: Came here with a couple friends to grab some groceries after visiting Ithaca before heading back to Syracuse. It was a cozy spot with plenty of options available. Staff were very friendly as well, so 5 stars from me!

reviews.author: Jon Ion
reviews.text: Well stocked inventory and nice layout, however the cashiers seem rather bothered by your presence, as if they did not expect customers to come during their shift.

reviews.author: D W
reviews.text:
I absolutely love Insomnia Cookies! The cookies are always warm, fresh, and perfectly soft in the center with just the right amount of crisp on the edges. The variety is amazing—whether I’m craving a classic chocolate chip, something rich like the double chocolate chunk, or a fun seasonal flavor, they never disappoint.

What makes them even better is the convenience. Being able to get warm cookies delivered late at night is such a treat, especially after a long day. The delivery is always quick, and the packaging keeps everything intact and fresh.

The staff is friendly and helpful, and the stores have a fun, cozy vibe. Overall, Insomnia Cookies is my go-to when I want something sweet and comforting. Highly recommend to anyone with a late-night sweet tooth!

reviews.author: Anna Miller
reviews.text: Cookies were warm when delivered. They arrived on time and the driver called. Being a campus can be stressful especially knowing they don’t have access to all the buildings. I was worried due to the past reviews but I had no issues.

reviews.author: Wassim Ayass
reviews.text: A lovely place for a delicious dessert! The cookie wiches were super delicious. The service was great friendly and fun! Highly recommended for a great ice cream cookie dessert!

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.text: We decided to try this restaurant while visiting Ithaca. When we arrived we were the only people in the store & it took a long time for the food to come out (we were told 10 minutes but were sitting waiting for a good 25 minutes). The crepes themselves are ginormous and can definitely be split between multiple people.

reviews.author: Jill Aylesworth
reviews.text: One of the best places to get crepes, very nice selection of toppings and made fresh in minutes. The person who works is also are very kind and exceptionally generous, would recommend and support this local business 🙏🏻

reviews.author: Noga Yangzom Tenzin
reviews.text:
phenomenal vibes. came out with a stunning & delicious hits-the-spot milkshake, not to mention, a great convo.

prices are great too, owner very sweet. will be back!!

reviews.author: Katie Moring
reviews.text: Bubble tea was good. The place is pretty small and the business seems to still be unpacking - still boxes on the floor. Some of the seats were ripped and looked pretty old. Large menu selection and if you're not hoping to sit there and hang out, then definitely try it out for the tea. Atmosphere/seating isn't great if you are looking for a place to hang out for a while or work on laptop or something.

reviews.author: William Henderson
reviews.text: Delicious Tea and Slush drinks, but the service is a little on the lacking side. Other's drinks were sitting on the counter before the order taker took charge in finding them.

reviews.author: Lino Le Van
reviews.text: Pretty good milk tea and boba. Got a Thai milk tea with mango jelly and didn’t regret it.

reviews.author: Abbas Naqvi
reviews.text: Excellent customer service.  Good to see a desi store packed with all the good stuff in a small college town. Love it!

reviews.author: GSA
reviews.text: You can get basically all the indian essentials. Staff is amazing.

reviews.author: Christy Atiles
reviews.text: I work at a hotel, and we had guests from India who were asking for Masala Chai, which we don't have.  I went to this store and explained to the cashier what I needed. He showed me the teas they carried and also gave me suggestions for snacks to go with the tea.  Our hotel guests were very happy when I brought them the tea and snacks.

reviews.author: Tyler Parseghian
reviews.text:
Very professional and efficient business. I have used them for on-site repairs and had several keys made in their shop. The keys are high quality and far better than those from big box stores like Lowe’s or Walmart. And the off-street parking is very convenient.
-Tyler Parseghian (Realtor).

reviews.author: Bree Barton
reviews.text: Ohn is a master. I lost my spare key for my 2010 Toyota Yaris; a replacement from the dealer would’ve practically cost more than my car. I went to another hardware store first—nice guys, but the key they gave me bent like butter on a hot summer day. Imagine my surprise when I found Ace Security Locksmith and Ohn cut me a perfect spare in under two minutes. What would’ve cost me $200+ at Toyota, Ohn did for less than $10. Worked like a charm. Plus, HE’S charming—clever, funny, one-of-a-kind. Truly one of the best customer service experiences I’ve had. Suffice it to say, ACE holds the key to my heart!

reviews.author: Amanda Patelunas
reviews.text:
While they fixed a broken lock, the woman working the phone was extremely argumentative and refused to believe that an employee misplaced a separate key ring that he was handed. When asked if the employee could check because she stated he said he “was not handed a key on a key ring that had a smaller key on it”, not that he attempted to look to ensure he didn’t take the key ring off the key he needed, she refused and said “he already did” but ma’am you did not say he checked, you just said he knew he wasn’t handed multiple keys on a key ring. She then said “I do not agree with the customer is always right” and hung up on me. congratulations, neither do I, but I am now missing property that was last in your employees hands. I don’t care if he’s been doing this for 30 years, I didn’t receive back all of my keys. Extremely unprofessional.

EDITING TO ADD: the next day he returned as he didn’t correctly do our lock (used someone else’s key entirely), and he in fact returned the missing key & keyring because as it turns out, the customer was right in this instance. He owned up to his mistake which I appreciate, but the woman working the phones makes me never want to utilize their services again.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.text: cool spot for thrifting! they get a lot of stuff from ithaca reuse so it's cool to see what ends up on the shelves

reviews.author: Joan Lazar
reviews.text: The store is really quite wonderful, filled with items ranging from the 19th century to pretty much today. Staff was friendly, ample parking. Great selection of mid century, modern pieces, in excellent condition. As a reseller, though, I walked away, empty-handed, as everything is a little pricier than what I expect. I couldn’t find anything to add to my collection either but regardless, great spot. Took me about an hour to go through the whole store.

reviews.author: Leah
reviews.text: It was hard to leave this place, and I spent the next 24 hours trying to figure out how to get a truck so that I could buy more! Such a good selection of homegoods, clothing, furniture, and jewelry. And so much more. Prices were super fair and reasonable and the staff was friendly and very helpful. I will certainly be back!!

reviews.author: David Kreitler
reviews.text: This was one of the best evenings/nights we have had in a long time. Not only was the place beautiful, the food was fantastic, the drinks excellent, the band was straight groovy, AND they let us camp on site in our RV!! They are dog friendly and offer other drinks besides cider. This really was one of the best nights out of our week long road trip. Would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Ellie Price
reviews.text: Breathtaking views; exquisite cider, and incredibly warm and friendly service from the people! In my spare time I have been studying Finger Lakes region wine for 6 years; after tasting South Hill Cider’s String Theory, Prelude and Full Blossom, I’m going to do the same with cider. Not only was the set up visually gorgeous from the landscape down to the details of the string lights and the fire pits and the local art inside, the cider was outstanding. South Hill exposed me to the craft of cider, and much like wine we can learn much about place through tasting cider and appreciating the thoughtfulness and myriad decisions that go into their production. I brought a bottle home to NYC to share with my friends. And pro tip: check out Stay on Orchard Hill on HipCamp to camp on a platform raised canvas tent right on the gorgeous property with unbelievable views. We’ll be back here!

reviews.author: Jackie Carlson
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome afternoon and evening. Fresh air, green grass, apple trees and flowers! Extraordinary local and Specialty Ciders, fine food items and all set to really good music! T-rrific! So pleased. Beautiful place. Lovely People ❤️ PS And I brought my favorite home! ❤️

reviews.author: Olivia Parham
reviews.text: We stayed here last year and had no problems HOWEVER THIS YEAR WAS AWFUL. If you are staying here with a team I wouldn't ever recommend this hotel. We had a meeting room and in our contract they said they would take out the trash if we cleaned it up and put it in a central location. which we did. They then told us to clean and but locked the door so we couldn't get in and then proceeded to kick us out of that room after consulting multiple people at the font desk. However they said the manger made the decision, but they wouldn't let us speak with them and wouldn't return calls. And we had two rooms for late check out and they cancelled them an 1 hour before we were supposed to come back to the hotel form our event. Regular check out is at 12pm. We had kids stay behind since they were competing at 12 they were to leave the hotel at 10. 2 hours before check out. The hotel went into their rooms without knocking at 8am kicking them out of their rooms! One was in the shower! That is not okay to kick us out of our rooms based on one things we followed in the contract about trash. And the rooms were not clean when we got their. The contract also said they pick up trash every 3rd day but they never did. They never came to pick up trash from any of our 15 rooms. There was no communication with the manager and they did honor the contract we both signed. I wouldn't stay here ever again.

reviews.author: A Hart
reviews.text: Stayed here twice and am about to check in for the third. This place is wonderful. It’s clean! The beds are comfortable. The front desk clerks are friendly and helpful. The prices are super affordable- AND it includes a hot and cold breakfast. The first time I stayed, we stayed in the suite because our son was with us. And the second and third times a king room. I cannot understand why this hotel has a 3.8. I give it a 5. It is exactly what it should be (which would earn it a 4) but exceeded my expectations which is why I give it a 5. I will rate the location as a 4 only because it is a tad outside the Ithaca center but that’s why the prices are so affordable. Location is very convenient but not in the walkable downtown of Ithaca.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: This place could not have been better! Conveniently located near Ithaca College. A brand new facility with clean, neat rooms. Friendly, hospitable employees. Fast check-in and check-out. A delicious, nutritious breakfast with a fantastic selection. Good prices. Safe and quiet. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Bill R.
reviews.text:
I was in a hurry so I grabbed two pizzas. I asked " are they fresh? I'm starving!" The lady behind the counter was like yes they are fresh, have not been out long. I drove home and went to eat but it was so bad my wife, and kids didn't even touch It I ate a piece I could even finish.
I want a refund!!!!

reviews.author: AmarisSang Yoon
reviews.text:
I had a very upsetting experience at this Little Caesars location. When I went in to order, one of the employees made racist and inappropriate comments toward me. He asked if I was from Shanghai or Hong Kong, and when I told him I’m from Korea, he followed up by asking if I was from South or North Korea. That kind of question is extremely rude and disrespectful.

No customer should ever be treated this way. I came in just to order pizza, not to be subjected to racist remarks about my background. I hope the management takes this seriously and provides proper training so no one else has to experience something like this.

reviews.author: Erik Marvin
reviews.text: Lazy workers. Pizza was cut horribly (not centered at all, had tiny random pieces in the middle of the pizza), one of the specialty pizzas was so bad that the toppings and sauce covered maybe half the pizza surface that it normally covers. The workers there weren't even personable, they just acted like they didn't want to be there and that the customers were a problem by coming in just to pick up an order. Never again, not worth even considering as an option when a person wants "convenience".

reviews.author: Piper Capreedy
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I have gone here a couple times before and it was always delicious, however they have now rebranded to ‘Maru Korea’ and have an entirely new menu! I was a bit worried at first because i was a big fan of their Tonkotsu, but the meal i got was SO good! The service was super fast and friendly, the restaurant was clean (although it always is!) and the server even brought us two complimentary courses while we were waiting on our food. 10/10 highly recommend!!

reviews.author: inggrit ifani
reviews.text: We love this Ramen PLACE!!!!! Its always a to go place for us when we visit the area. The food is perfect, quality and tasty! With affordable price, we feel like we got tons of the protein (the beef or the seafood). We are never disappointed! The servers were great, either the new girl or the older lady. The Korean Ice Coffee is soo delicious too. Love love love.

reviews.author: Michael Cheung
reviews.text:
Maru Ramen is a fusion Asian spot that blends Japanese and Vietnamese flavors. The vibe is nice, but for the price, I expected a bit more in terms of quality — though to be fair, the portions are solid.

I tried the Tonkotsu Ramen, Shrimp Tempura Ramen, and the Shrimp Tempura Crab Roll. The flavors were okay, but the chashu was overcooked, which definitely took away from the experience. Service was fine — nothing bad, but nothing memorable either.

Overall, not a bad place if you’re in the area and craving ramen.

reviews.author: Lisa Carrier-Titti
reviews.text: The Team at Signarama were fast, friendly and very experienced in helping me sort out what type of signage would work best for my new business. They crafted everything from the wording to the graphic design. Why work with some faceless online company when you have the experts right in downtown Ithaca?

reviews.author: Herbert F. Johnson Museum
reviews.text: The team at Sign A Rama Ithaca is second to none, with a commitment to quality and a determination to get it right. From large image and text vinyls for our exhibitions to special sign projects that require unique solutions, we have relied on Diane and her team for many years and have always had excellent results. We're lucky to have such a great local resource!

reviews.author: Aaron Thomson
reviews.text: Did beautiful work making signs for my work trucks! Diane has great customer service. Got the work done ahead of scheduled date!

reviews.author: Aszuaria Jones
reviews.text:
Nice laid back spot if you’re looking for a chill vibe.
Have been a patron here for a few years and it’s
Always been a chill vibe the hookah is amazing ( ask for the Anubis ) and the drinks are just right. This is a great date night spot also the Zeus fries chef Kiss . See you there .

reviews.author: Devon Strom
reviews.text:
Was recently introduced to this place by my buddy and I cannot suggest the Butter chicken enough. While it is not exactly the cheapest option for food. The quantity and Quality of it makes it easily an amazing deal especially for anyone who preps meals for work.

While I haven't participated in much of the other services provided here. I whole heatedly can endorse their food.

reviews.author: S A
reviews.text: This place is really awesome! I've been to a couple of hookah spots in Indiana, and this is definitely one I recommend. I hope y'all have a great time there, just like I always do.

reviews.author: Andrzej
reviews.text:
Very unique place with many beautiful water falls. Some of them are big and other little smaller but gorgeous. Hiking this trail is pretty intense,  specially coming up.
Good hiking shoes and some water is recommended. Please look rally good when is a lots of water going true.

reviews.author: Stephen Weakley
reviews.text:
What a beautiful hike.  Nature has outdone itself at the gorge.  The actual trail is a feat of engineering and an amazing example of tradesman skills.

I recommend doing the lower gorge trail and starting from the upper entrance all the wsy to the lower entrance.  The route is almost all downhill, and you can catch the shuttle from the bottom back to the upper parking area.  One caveat, the shuttles only run on weekends, so plan your route accordingly.

reviews.author: Shruti Sinha
reviews.text: Gorge trail is closed starting mid Oct this season except weekends. $10 parking fee. It was quiet wet and muddy trail so ensure to have hiking shoes and poles.

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text: Tried Fusia Bento Bar for the first time through DoorDash and loved it. We ordered the Mongolian Beef Bento and Crab Rangoon. Everything arrived warm, well packaged, and really tasty. Definitely great value for money.

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text:
Quick, Tasty, and Affordable in Collegetown, Ithaca! 🍱

If you’re in Cornell’s Collegetown and looking for a quick yet satisfying meal, Fusia Bento Bar is the spot! This casual eatery serves up hearty portions at affordable prices, making it a go-to for students and food lovers alike.

I grabbed a three selection lunch box featuring fish, pork, and a side of sweet and sour soup, and let me tell you—every bite was packed with flavor! The fish was tender and well-seasoned, the pork had just the right balance of crispiness and juiciness, and the sweet and sour soup tied it all together with a comforting, tangy kick.

Beyond the food, the service was fast and friendly, making it a great choice if you’re in a rush but still want a solid meal. The space itself is clean and welcoming, perfect for a quick lunch or a casual hangout.

If you’re in Ithaca and craving a filling, tasty meal without breaking the bank, Fusia Bento Bar is a must-visit. Who else loves a big portion for a great price? Let me know your go-to bento box order! 🍱✨

reviews.author: Zoe Meng
reviews.text: Have been having food here since before covid. One of my go-to place at Cornell. Ingredients are always fresh and people are really nice! Highly recommend their VIP card! Price is so reasonable:) They also actually listen to your feedbacks and make changes accordingly. They deserve 5 star!

reviews.author: Gray Kelly
reviews.text: Usually get delivery here. I haven't had many issues until recently. I cancelled an order, then 3 hours later a delivery man showed up and called me. I told him that I canceled the order hours ago, that I was very sorry for the inconvenience, and then I proceeded to get yelled at by the delivery driver over the phone, then he hung up. I've worked in the food service many years, but nothing would ever constitute being t h a t unprofessional and mean to a confused customer. Just get Papa John's.

reviews.author: piyush shirode
reviews.text: They refused to close the door in crazy cold weather and their response was “some maintenance” letting customers eat in this cold weather is just atrocious! Now I know why no one goes there and goes to papa johns instead ! Worst pizza experience ever ! Pizza was also not tasty, crust was too soggy for some reason. Me and my friends had the worst experience ever

reviews.author: Milo Duran
reviews.text: Nathan and Josiah are the best hard workers here. We love them so much and they are nice and they always make us the best pizzas around. If you want a good pizza call dominoes and make sure nathan and Josiah are working. They will make you the best pizza in the world.

reviews.author: Erik Z
reviews.text: I got subs for dinner here recently and they were amazing. The large subs are 12 inches long and they are huge. I couldn't finish the whole thing. I also got fried pickles. It was some of the best I've ever had. Definitely try it out if you are looking for some affordable food.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: Super delicious sandwiches with a very friendly staff and a cool vibe. The bread was especially good. It was nice and soft with a very good texture. They also have their own drinks which are super good. I had the mango and coconut one and it blew me away. I’m not even a coconut person! If you’re in town, then you have to check this place out.

reviews.author: Nolan Palmer-Smith
reviews.text:
OMG! Best sandwich I’ve had in a very long time. The bread was fresh baked and the ingredients were fresh and bursting with flavor.
I ordered the banh mi and it was one of the best ever! On par with with sandwiches I scored in Vietnam. The outdoor seating was great and the person who served us was great.

reviews.author: Jenn Roedel
reviews.text:
Our take out during the snow storm was excellent!!!  We got wonton soup which was excellent with the freshest veggies in it!  A beautiful soup with bright orange julien carrots, bright green bok choy, 3 large wontons!
We tried the thai dumplings, delicious and beautiful! 4 dumplings, with scallions lettuce to make it extra appetizing and visually gorgeous.
Red curry with shrimp (5 shrimp cooked perfectly) regular spice was awesome,  excellent flavors and beautiful fresh veggies within the dish. (I would probably get mild next time, regular was a little much for me).
Drunken noodles with shrimp were excellent too and the portion was very normal sized and had 5 shrimp.

I was hesitant ordering because the reviews were mixed...ours was delicious and big round of applause for the amazing staff working in a major snow storm! I asked for extra container and utensils and very happy to help me.
The decor was very special inside and I would definitely eat in.
Thank you Thai Basil!

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text:
Stopped by Thai Basil in Ithaca for an early lunch on a chilly 20°F day. I ordered the Som Tum (Papaya Salad), Jungle Curry, and later switched to Green Curry. Here’s the breakdown:

✅ Papaya Salad: Fresh, vibrant, and flavorful—just the right balance of tanginess and spice. A great start to the meal!

❌ Jungle Curry: Unfortunately, this dish was far too salty for my taste. I sent it back, and the staff kindly replaced it with Green Curry.

✅ Green Curry: Creamy and aromatic with tender vegetables and chicken. It definitely redeemed the meal!

However, the dining experience overall was a bit underwhelming. The restaurant atmosphere was uncomfortably cold, making it difficult to fully enjoy the meal. Additionally, the staff were not attentive, which left me feeling overlooked during my visit.

Would I return? Perhaps for the papaya salad and green curry, but I’d hope for a warmer environment and better service next time.

reviews.author: Drew V
reviews.text:
Food was great, atmosphere is nice, server was very friendly and polite. However, my wife and I had to initiate every communication. I had to ask for a beer, we had to let him know when we were ready to order because he was at a back table on his phone.

Expensive.

I understand January is a slow time of year but when there are customers present any server should be attentive and alert.

A little training by management in this regard would help.

Overall the experience was good, no issues with the food quality or atmosphere.

reviews.author: Prof. Margaret Readdy
reviews.text: We had a very nice mother/son Valentine's Day dinner this evening.  The food was wonderful as usual and Fanny and her staff are so kind.  I even received a flower and Mitsuba vase with 2 chocolate kisses.  Looking forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: Rico H
reviews.text:
A so-so Chinese-style restaurant. We arrived close to 5 PM on a Friday, and we were the only customers there for the next hour.

The service was okay, but the moment we walked in, there was a strong cooking smell that filled the entire room — as if the kitchen hood had never been turned on.

The food wasn’t impressive either; very ordinary, like something you can find in a food court.

Only highlight was “grilled fish sushi “ , kind of “decent” dish.

reviews.author: Sonia Taa
reviews.text:
No frills spot for Japanese and Chinese food. The sushi is acceptable. The Chinese and Japanese entrees shine, but I would suggest avoiding the appetizers (the agadashi tofu was bland but crispy) and dumplings (they are frozen). They were very kind and offered free pieces of a roll to start.

The chicken katsu is a great deal - at $15 you get a 2x juicy chicken breast with light and crispy panko breading + salad + miso soup + rice.

Overall, not too bad if you are hungry and looking for a filling meal that does the job.

$15-25 per person. Parking is abundant

reviews.author: Matin M.
reviews.text: This ice cream place is what you hope and expect. The nostalgia factor and memories of me going here with my family growing up were all refreshed. Their ice cream is so good and creamy! The staff radiated warmth and hospitality, adding to the vibrant atmosphere filled with lively music and a bustling crowd. Hope this business succeeds!

reviews.author: Sana Abuhandara
reviews.text: Amazing Ice Cream. 10/10 experience. Ice cream is really flavorful, and creamy. Shop and tables are extremely clean as well. Will definitely come back!

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text: First visit and it was excellent! The store smelt sweet, the employees were kind and knowledgeable. I did the you create and got the blueberry muffin batter with graham crackers, it was delicious and well worth the price! The ice cream tasted creamy, soft not hard. I returned another day and got the cake batter milkshake. It was very delicious, tasted like drinking a liquid cake, it was spot on and well worth the $8.

reviews.author: Jen Pearcy-Edwards
reviews.text: Friendly, helpful staff. Medical team is very supportive and proactive.

reviews.author: shane Witt
reviews.text: Great care and staff.

reviews.author: Rob Dex
reviews.text: Super!  AAA++++

reviews.author: Jennifer Daniels
reviews.text: I know this is not a 4 or 5 star place but it really was perfect after being tired cold and hungry travelers. The place was very clean, the room was well situated with microwave and mini fridge, the king bed which was comfortable and stocked with pillows and blankets, and the shower pressure was great and the water hot. It was quiet, and staff were the right amount of attentive not intrusive. Free breakfast in the morning ran until 10am and included make your own Belgian waffles. The breakfast area was kept clean and well stocked throughout. Checkout was simply returning your key to a key drop, and while it said 11am and we weren't much later than that, it probably was ten or fifteen minutes after 11 and no one has called or come by to hound us or rush us out in a frazzled state. So no it isn't the Ritz but it is a warm dry place to rest and then recharge with good enough food and quiet enough rooms to start your day visiting Ithaca falls or the college or wine country with a smile and at the reasonable rate you feel like you made a good decision when you pull away.

reviews.author: Chris Hupf
reviews.text: Two adults stayed for 4 nights here in mid-August in a King room and were very satisfied with the hotel located a few miles southwest of Ithaca in a quiet area. Gas, restaurants and stores are located a few minutes away towards Ithaca. The entire staff is super nice. Smallish breakfast area with 6 tables. Food was good with a hot breakfast of fried eggs and sausage links plus the normal fruit, bagels, bread, cereal, waffles, yogurt, etc. Hotel was quiet and furnishings were nice. Room was in good shape except the bath area was somewhat showing its age. A bonus for anyone with an electric car is that they have four chargers available. Would not hesitate to stay here again whenever we come back to the area.

reviews.author: Thomas Cashman
reviews.text: Best place I've stayed at in the area so far. Security on site are friendly, staff is friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Kevin Ebert
reviews.text:
Despite being insured, they marked my prescription as uninsured, charged me full price ($100+ more than expected), and did not listen to me when I said I was insured (Through CVS Caremark mind you!) Now, nearly 2 months later, I am still jumping through hoops to try and get reimbursed. Very nice people working here but the level of inconvenience I've had to go through due to this incompetence has been absolutely ridiculous.

Edit: Since CVS responded, I had tried. I called your team 4+ times and they were absolutely useless. No, I'm not wasting any more of my time.

reviews.author: Matt N
reviews.text:
Rude, unprofessional, employees.
Then I read all the reviews and realized this is a problem target corporate supports. This is a small town to have so many bad reviews. It’s obvious Target supports treating people this way or the problem would be resolved.
Is this even a real pharmacy?

reviews.author: Dan Robertson
reviews.text: I finally transferred my Rx's to another pharmacy after years of constant employer turnover and difficulty getting prescriptions filled. Many of the staff have been very helpful, and I don't think it takes away from their efforts to note that the rest don't seem to enjoy working there very much.

reviews.author: Adam DelGrosso
reviews.text:
First saw this restaurant on Facebook, they were doing steak flights, which got my attention. Made a mental note, when it came time to make Valentine’s Day plans, we decided to head up.

We were welcomed by a live guitar player, a roaring fire, and a cozy atmosphere. Our server, Dayna, and the manager Scott were VERY accommodating.

I ordered the 22oz Porterhouse with a Gorgonzola, mushroom, and balsamic glaze topping. My wife ordered the steak flight, which came with four 4 oz pieces of steak (filet mignon, NY strip, elk, and Delmonico). Her flight came with 4 sauces (bacon compound butter, Gorgonzola compound butter, bourbon cream sauce, and a Demi glaze). She ordered a half pound of snow crab clusters to go with her meal.

The steaks were all cooked beautifully. A perfect medium rare. The toppers/sauces were delicious.

We ordered 2 desserts. The peanut butter cake and the carrot cake. FANTASTIC. Both came with homemade whipped cream and the carrot cake came with ice cream.

Legitimately one of the best meals I have had in my life. We will DEFINITELY be back!

reviews.author: Larry Mitchell
reviews.text: The food is absolutely amazing!( The duck)The service is absolutely amazing! Rachel is attentive, friendly, and joy to talk to. Casey is a master mixologist. The old fashioneds he makes for me are on another level!!! Such a friendly guy! The owner is very personable and takes the time to talk with everyone. Our favorite place! Love it there!!

reviews.author: Channyra Than
reviews.text: I gave it 2 stars and that is being nice. Such a disappointment. It was our first time here. My husband picked out this restaurant to celebrate his birthday. I made a reservation with a special note for “birthday dessert.” Upon arrival the hostess sweetly greeted us and wished my husband a happy birthday. Although the server and the individual she was training were super nice, the service fell short. They were not attentive. We ordered our drinks, the bread basket and our dinner. The drinks were good, but we proceeded to wait 48 minutes and the bread never came. I tried to make eye contact with our server, but she was too busy rushing around. When our dinner came, there was no bread…they forgot it. Sadly the highlight of our dinner was the French fries! The best part was the company! To top it off, the espresso machine was broken and when the dessert we ordered was dropped off, no candle and not even a happy birthday.

reviews.author: Ildi Noe
reviews.text: the coolest 7-Eleven I ever came across fantastic selection all is packed with merchandise.  The folks are working here(sat there during a storm) on their toes never stop working organizing helping customes.kudos

reviews.author: John Zhang
reviews.text: I shop hear almost every day. Very convenient, with some of my favorite Pocky. They also have mochi and many instant ramen.

reviews.author: Wilson Carter
reviews.text: The card reader is often dysfunctional, and one of the cashiers handed me another small card reader, which couldn’t even print a paper receipt. He then asked me to enter my phone number, but the interface inexplicably disappeared. Instead of resolving the issue, he kept me waiting while prioritizing customers behind the line and displayed zero teamwork and problem-solving ability. I was just gonna buy a couple of snacks, yet the entire checkout process turned into an unnecessarily frustrating and inefficient experience.

reviews.author: 송명후
reviews.text:
Collegetown Bagels is a popular spot right in front of Cornell University. Despite the name, which might suggest they only sell bagels, this place offers much more! They have a wide variety of drinks, including beer, alongside their bagel selections.

While I only had coffee during my visit, I'm definitely curious to try their beer next time I'm in the area. It's a convenient and versatile place for students and visitors alike, whether you're grabbing a quick bite or looking to unwind with a drink.

reviews.author: Woo Young Kim
reviews.text: A lot of options and the ingredients seem pretty good. The taste of sandwiches were pretty average though. The guy at the counter seemed grumpy as well, which isn't the best interaction to start off your day in the morning.  The delivery of our food was extremely slow even though we did not have people in front of us. Good location vibe and outdoor sitting.

reviews.author: Canh Vo
reviews.text: After a full morning of exploring Ithaca, wandering through Cornell University and chasing waters, we found ourselves a bit hungry. Collegetown Bagels and surrounding were the perfect stops. The area was quiet with school out of session, that only added to the charm. We enjoyed sitting outside and soaking in the calm summer vibes - just what we needed. CTB offers a great variety - bagels, creative sandwiches and assortment of drinks and tempting desserts. There’s definitely something for everyone here.

reviews.author: Chlorine Gear
reviews.text: Feel compelled to offer a 5 star review just to counter the campaign of Karen’s upset over then staying open 8 months ago over a flare up in COVID cases shown to only impact .001% of college age students. Stop the nonsense and pay attention to the statistics.

reviews.author: My Place at Cornell
reviews.text: The fact that they require proof of vaccination to get into the bar for months and then go and advertise the red alert at Cornell as a time to get together at a bar is hypocritical and disgusting. They are flouting public health and safety to make a quick buck.

reviews.author: Jared Barnhart
reviews.text: Really trashy place. Currently planning a "Red Alert" party to "celebrate" Cornell closing because of the surge in COVID cases. Tacky things like this are a detriment to our community.

reviews.author: JiaJia Ye
reviews.text:
The only problem with their homemade kimchi is that it disappears too fast into my stomach.

Great place to get groceries and ingredients for Chinese cuisine (and Korean cuisine, obviously)—they even have more niche stuff like preserved eggs and a significant variety of tofu, along with fresh vegetables like Napa cabbage. The prices are generally competitive for the location. The kimchi is an especially good deal and better than the offerings at the larger grocery stores in Ithaca.

reviews.author: Maya Watts
reviews.text: Great little store, has everything you would need including some fresh produce for great prices. Also has very kind and helpful staff!

reviews.author: Isabel Espinoza
reviews.text: me and my boyfriend came the other day and went a little crazy with our purchases lol but the prices are really good for what you get!! i really recommend the freezer rice cakes :) they have a lot of good quality veggies which seem to be fresh! HUGE instant noodle section and got to pick up some of my favorites i haven’t had in a long time , good selection of ice cream too! flavors i’ve never heard of before but in general was pleasantly surprised of how much they have for a small place , would definitely recommend and will 100% be coming to visit again soon!

reviews.author: Lorelli Cervantes
reviews.text:
These guys know how to do tacos!!! The torta is a great sandwhich for breakfast, and they have all the meats for $5 so you can enjoy your steak tacos without having to pay 2x as much. Super sweet guys always loving seeing them, and food is clearly made with love. Very delicious please make it a spot you hit on your way into ithaca

My go to order is lengua with everything on it and the spicy sauce. And a strawberry banana jumex

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text:
Al Pastor with a Kick! 🌮🔥

If you’re in Ithaca and craving authentic, no-frills Mexican flavors, this hidden gem is a must-visit. Stepping inside, you’re greeted with the sizzling sound of fresh tacos being made, the rich aroma of grilled meats, and a cozy, vibrant space that oozes personality.

I had the Taco Al Pastor, a perfect balance of smoky, juicy pork, charred just right, topped with sweet pineapple chunks that added a refreshing contrast to the meat’s depth. But the game-changer? Their house-made hot sauce—a fiery, bold kick that tied everything together. One bite in, and it was an explosion of flavors, the spice lingering just enough to make you crave another bite. 🌶️🔥

Beyond the food, the spot itself is a vibe—colorful walls adorned with traditional artwork, a massive mural watching over your meal, and little details that make the space feel both homey and full of culture. It’s the kind of place where food is made with love, and you can taste it in every bite.

Whether you’re a taco purist or just on the hunt for a standout meal in Ithaca, this is one spot you don’t want to miss. Authentic, flavorful, and unforgettable. Would you try this Al Pastor taco? Tag your taco-loving crew! 🌮✨

reviews.author: HMT
reviews.text: You must try CDMX in Ithaca! It was recommended to by a local. We pretty much had everything here from steak to chorizo to chicken and different combinations with salsas - Loved everything. More than the food, it was an experience watching the tacos cooked in front of you and enjoying the food served on colorful plates and tables sitting outdoor on the commons.

reviews.author: Nathan McLyman
reviews.text: I’ve been a patient for years and have always been more than satisfied with them. But yesterday’s appointment seemed different. It was very fast. A little too fast for me. I had very little time to interact with the doctor about different issues. Hopefully things will slow down next time.

reviews.author: Girish Bhat
reviews.text: It was my first appointment there, and everyone was friendly, helpful, and efficient. My doctor (Kathryn) was excellent, and gave my problem a careful, patient examination, and recommended a good plan going forward. I'll definitely be making a follow-up visit.

reviews.author: Karen Cushman
reviews.text: The doctor is thorough and very kind.She receives a high rating from me. However, the rushed atmosphere and extreme efficiency of the visit were off-putting. The staff member who initially prepared me for the checkup spoke SO rapidly & failed to make eye contact. Being a routine checkup made it OK, but if I had a skin issue, the  impersonal treatment would have been hard to receive . I felt rushed and like I was on an assembly line from the checkup call when I was in the parking lot through the medical check… thankfully the scheduling staff member was delightful and took time to be personable.She gets a 5+ rating!

reviews.author: JL T
reviews.text: We met the friendliest, most helpful folks here; excellent selection, a variety of local wines, and a surprising amount of cheese knowledge to share. Shop Local.

reviews.author: Jordan Vargo
reviews.text: We stopped here thinking it was like a Fine Wine and Good Spirits - we were surprised to find a nicely curated selection. We are not that knowledgeable about wine and asked an employee for guidance on selecting a bottle. It was nice looking around - we have yet to try the bottle we bought but we look forward to it! Also - the vibes inside were immaculate and we got a discount on our bottle :)

reviews.author: EL.
reviews.text: If you're going to go to any wine/liquor store in the area, go here! The employees are all nice and welcoming. You will not get profiled like their competitors in the area who will treat you like a criminal if you look young. I like that they keep your age information on file with your credit card, and keep a history of all the wines you've purchased, just in case you want to get it again. It makes the check-out seamless!

reviews.author: Mel Bee
reviews.text:
The Chanty is a staple and landmark for historical downtown Ithaca.
Every visit here is chill and cheap.

The 🐓 sign is your signal to stop in and hang in an intimate place offering: darts, pool, and good ol juke player.

Feels more local folk than college kids. A plus for us OG ithaca workers.
It's been almost ~20 years since I started going . It was always the place to go after work drink and an '5 o'clock somewhere' place on a day off.

The Chanty is an easygoing classic place to just have a drink with your friends.

reviews.author: Sahid Martin Robles Bello
reviews.text: From what I gather this place used to be the go-to dive in Ithaca. Right now it occupies a very awkward middle spot where it's too divey for college kids and too modernized for the old guard. Dim the lights a little bit!

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.text:
Ithaca's official dive bar.  (yes there are other 'dives' in town, but the Chanti (as it's called locally) is special.

Almost its own caricature of a dive bar.  It's actually a pretty well kept place and a very big step above the true dive.  Pretty large liquor selection and several taps.  The crowds can range in every direction.  A couple locals will be at the quiet bar earlier and college kids tend to fill it in after 11.  Really is a must-stop-tour-stop to get a taste of Ithaca.

Yes, the same Chanticleer in the song by X-Ambassadors, yes that place with the giant glowing rooster outside, yes to that weird Walking Dead pinball machine, yes to the downloadable jukebox playing some odd songs, yes to that blood red billiards table and yes to some of the cheapest drinks in Ithaca.  Just no food and if you've been there enough, you would be good with that.

reviews.author: Loung Thammavongsa
reviews.text:
This place is such a cozy little gem ☕✨ I ordered a breakfast sandwich and an iced matcha, and everything was SO good. The sandwich was perfectly toasted with melty cheddar, fluffy eggs, and crispy potatoes packed inside every bite was warm, savory, and comforting. And the matcha? Smooth, creamy, and just the right amount of sweetness 💚

What really made it special though was the adorable private seating by the window. It felt like my own little morning nook perfect for slow sips, people-watching, or just enjoying a quiet moment. The sunlight coming through made the whole experience feel extra dreamy.

Such a cute spot for a cozy breakfast date or solo self-care morning. I’ll definitely be back

reviews.author: John Guzman
reviews.text: Don’t miss this little gem of a spot when visiting Ithaca. The service is gentle and kind and the food is delicious; prepared with care and creativity. Pick a window seat and watch the world go by while sipping coffee. As you leave with a full, happy belly, look up and smile…

reviews.author: Melissa Fergusson
reviews.text:
Hound and Mare is a coffee shop with a nice ambiance and a rustic/urban warehouse feel off the downtown commons in Ithaca. I’ve been looking for a coffee shop with great breakfast food in Ithaca, and this place definitely fits the bill. If you’re looking for something a bit more gourmet, but still in a relaxed environment this is the place to go. There are plenty of food and drink options to choose from which are creative. It was also nice to hear Adele playing in the shop, one of my favorite artists!

I got a lavender latte (which was flavored just right - not pictured but delicious) and the breakfast burrito. It comes with homemade salsa that has the right balance of acidity and kick. It was also a very generous portion size. My husband got the Maple Latte, iced, and the Melrose sandwich which is a bagel sandwich with bacon, fried egg, cheese crisp (which is really good), and he added roasted tomatoes. Definitely a tasty bagel sandwich! We also tried a couple of the pastries which were also well done - the scallion cheddar scone and the pumpkin cream cheese muffin which wasn’t too sweet. Would definitely come again!

reviews.author: lemonde_
reviews.text: We got the special combo platter with the Keysir and the Kilt. it’s plenty of food for two people. We liked the raw beef and the chicken, and we thought the stewed beef was okay. Food came out a little bit slower but overall not too bad.

reviews.author: Dongyun Ho
reviews.text:
The food is great, the Mushroom Tibs was especially delicious, it's full of flavor with well-balanced seasoning.

However, the service kind of ruined the dining experience. I guess it depends on the waiter, and unfortunately, ours seemed upset from the moment we arrived. He didn’t bother to mention the names of the dishes, and at one point he even tossed the wet wipes onto our table when we were nearly finished.

We still left a 20% tip as it seems to be the culture here, but I couldn’t help wondering what we had done wrong to deserve such poor attitude.

reviews.author: Paige Stitzel
reviews.text: If there is one place to hit up when you are staying in or near downtown Ithaca, this is definitely the place! I discovered this quaint Ethiopian restaurant while living in downtown Ithaca as a Cornell student, and it’s now the first and only restaurant I go to when I’m back in town. The food is absolutely delicious and made me fall in love with Ethiopian cuisine! My go to is always the individual entree with Doro tibs as the meat of choice and gomen and kilt as my sides. Not only is the food incredible, the portion you get for the price is unbeatable. For context, my ‘go to’ dish (pictured) is less than $25 (excluding tip)! The service here is always a big plus. I had gone at 7PM on a weeknight during the dinner rush, and I seriously think I waited 10 minutes or less for my food. The staff is also super friendly, attentive, and the overall atmosphere is a whole vibe. Would DEFINITELY recommend to check this place out!

reviews.author: astrid
reviews.text: Customer service was terrible. I’ve spent around $1,300 on clothes and the cashier Noah was very rude. He won’t even made eye contact either me,  he threw the clothes that I bought and never help me to fold it up. He never provided me with a bag and never removed the security tag on some of the clothes I bought . I spoke with the manager about it and it looks like he didn’t care about, so I will never spend any dollar in this store never again. I came from vacation to Ithaka but the customer service and management in this store is very poor.

reviews.author: Emil
reviews.text: What a great experience! Every single employee i talked to was very nice and helpful. Thank you Mark for help finding the REI Zephyr sleeping bag.

reviews.author: JM
reviews.text: Traveled two hours to this REI to get a new bike and it was worth the trip! I was afraid it was going to be an intimidating process but Mark was super friendly and made it a breeze. He helped me out and had me test ride two bikes and was very knowledgeable. This experience made me even more excited to start my biking journey!

reviews.author: Joanne Dorazio-Thier
reviews.text: We were staying in Ithaca overnight and looking for a restaurant to have dinner at. We took a walk around the main town and came across Creola Southern Steakhouse. Our server Christopher was great. He was very attentive and professional. We ordered the Brisket burnt ends nacho skillet and the chicken and waffles. The food was absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was beautiful. We would definitely come back if we were in town again.

reviews.author: Carrie Natale
reviews.text: We stopped into Creola for drinks and dessert at the bar and had a fantastic experience. The banana pudding and pecan bread pudding were absolutely amazing. Both were rich, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. Jay, our bartender, was excellent! We found him to be attentive, helpful, and genuinely friendly. He made us feel welcome right away. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with a fun theme that ties everything together beautifully. I highly recommend giving this place a chance for anyone looking for a sweet treat and great service!

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: A very pleasant dining experience at Creola. Superior cuisine, terrific service in a comfortable setting made for a great evening. Every dish from appetizer to desert exceeded expectations

reviews.author: Jackie Dresser
reviews.text:
Cayuga Family Medicine is the reason that I have dipped my toe back into western medicine after easily a decade of not having a primary care provider.
I saw Dr. Karnow for a reproductive health issue and she made me feel safe and comfortable while working through that. I saw Ben Kornblum to get some labs run and he needed to take a blood sample. I have had a very difficult time with blood draws and was really nervous about it. Ben was an absolute pro and talked me through everything in a calm and confident manner. It was the first time I have ever gotten blood drawn and not passed out. Huge win. When the labs came back, Ben followed up and put the results in plain English and helped me consider all of my options for optimal health.
I would not feel comfortable going anywhere else and I am so grateful we have such knowledgeable, talented and dedicated providers in our community.

reviews.author: Lainey Papageorge
reviews.text: Ben Kornblum, my primary care provider is exceptional. My medical situation is complex, and at every turn Ben has provided astute guidance, support and referral when necessary. The office staff are amazingly responsive, courteous, and efficient. It’s a small practice, a busy place, but I always receive personal attention. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mobius Strip
reviews.text: Ben Kornblum, my PA is great.  Always bending over backwards to make himself available.  Extremely knowledgeable and willing to admit when he needs to do more research on my conditions, which he always does and gets back to me.   The office staff is courteous and efficient.  Can’t recommend this practice more highly.

reviews.author: Marina M Romanova
reviews.text: Dr. Schwartz is superb. He is very knowledgeable, attentive, and kind. I had cataract surgery in both eyes, and soon, I had a clear vision. Dr. Schwartz is a skilled surgeon and a kind person as well. The staff in his office are friendly and very efficient. It was a very positive experience overall.

reviews.author: Andrew Tocheny
reviews.text: We have seen Doctor Schwartz for roughly 9 years due to the lack of pediatric ophthalmologists in our area.   We have driven over two hours for each appointment round trip. We have had decent experiences in the past with the nurses.  The scheduling staff can be rude and condescending.  No real appointment follow-ups are conducted.  There is more of a sense of entitlement over customer service.  If you need to have your child seen… prepare to wait approximately 7 months… and maybe be laughed at on the phone if you request a call from the doctor.   Look elsewhere.

reviews.author: HN
reviews.text: Dr. Schwartz is an outstanding ophthalmologist. He has followed us for years, and we are very grateful to him for his professional care. He is a highly competent & a caring physician; we are glad he is in town. The office has wonderful staff as well (e.,g., Kelly, Karen)

reviews.author: Vale Lyon
reviews.text: I seen a NP there after Amelia left. iv head thyroid issues for years but when I tried to get them to address other concerns it still was blamed only on my thyroid and no other test were done. Never once had been offered a ultrasound on my thyroid either to rule out cancer. I told them about my son's recent diagnosis of type 1 and they didn't offer any testing for me. I switched to Guthrie and they did test and ultrasound is scheduled of my thyroid to rule of cancer. This place only treats the symptoms and has NO real doctors. Do NOT Go here if you want real answers this is not the place. FYI to that Np my test for type 1 diabetes came back positive so thanks for letting me suffer the last 2 years.

reviews.author: Jordan Ferrari
reviews.text: Amelia Poplawski was the best thing about this place, she was absolutely fantastic and has full stars online everywhere. Now that she is gone, a terrible nurse called to let me know they’re revoking my prescription from her and then continued to bad mouth and disrespect Amelia on the phone saying she “did what she wanted with patients” - sounds like Amelia was the best and left

reviews.author: Jessika Buckley
reviews.text: PA-C Amelia P was by far the most kind and sweetest doctor I have ever been seen by. I would gladly recommend her to anyone, I left the office feeling like I was finally in good hands!

reviews.author: M 10
reviews.text: Dr. Hage has been  amazing with my daughter - he's a great orthodontist and I will be sending my son to him as well. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dalton Robinson
reviews.text: Simply stellar, came in with party of 4 with no reservation, they were full but accommodated our party at a bar table. Service was very attentive and friendly. Ordered the birria quesadillas and dulce de leche bread pudding for dessert and they were just phenomenal. Others were very pleased with the al pastor and lengua tacos as well as the flan. Mezcal house margaritas excellent. Will 1000% be back enthusiastically very soon

reviews.author: Amy Jensen
reviews.text: We passed this restaurant every night during our vacation in Ithaca and it always had people sitting outside. We decided to sit inside and it was cozy and inviting. The server was friendly and attentive. The food and drinks were great! We got to try the ceviche and had chips and salsa but still had room for our dinners. Everything was hot and fresh.

reviews.author: Christina Altieri
reviews.text: What a vibe! Excellent food, every time. The atmosphere is sharp and comfy, tough combo to pull off.  Service is impeccable. I love going here for an intimate dinner or with several friends. Truly, it works! I know the bar stuff is important to them, lots of tequilas and beers, but that's not my thing so I cannot judge.

reviews.author: Sean Newton
reviews.text:
My therapy has been ongoing for almost 10 years. I've had different Drs and counselors through TCMH. There was only two things about them I have an issue with, the location doesn't have the best drop off for disabled patients, and one specific Dr I had as a teen that I made them switch me away from. That Dr never once listened to me about my situation and only referred to my abusive father. I snapped one day at him and demanded from the office to be called by a Dr who takes it seriously. I won't say his name here but I don't think he works there now. I have a minor issue with how they handle my seizures from time to time. I respect that the company policy is to let the paramedics come in to move me. But they are afraid down there to help me up in case the person helping me got injured helping me. But that's not so much a issue, it's more just a policy disagreement.
Overall thought the counselors have been amazing, Dr Lippert has helped me emensly. I have a lot of respect for them down there and wish them the best.

reviews.author: Blair SZ
reviews.text:
My therapist is awesome. My psychriatist listens to all my suggestions that i bring up based on Scholarly articles I read. I really appreciate it. Calling in my meds is kinda annoying but yk it is what it is. I call in a couple days in advance.
I wish that there were more black therapists or therapists that are BIPOC. Like i love love my therapist and the way they have grown with me to help me better.
I do feel that there are a lack of resources for homeless people/poc. Spaced out appointments can be hard.

Love them, i hope they get more funding, more staff, and more diversity (but with equity for those therapists) and as always i want my care team to be paid more.

reviews.author: Felicia Downing
reviews.text: My daughter’s therapist is amazing but to get her meds refilled is a nightmare. I have called multiple times and had to leave a message each time requesting her meds be refilled. No meds at the pharmacy….no callback as to why. I spoke with the front desk which was completely useless. She told me just to leave another message. My daughter has been without her meds and they don’t seem to care.

reviews.author: John O'Reilly
reviews.text:
Guy told me it would be a week. Came back two weeks later, he hadn't touched my bag...

Came back later that day as instructed, and found he'd done the work of a beginner rushing through his job. This was my grandfathers bag and I thought he'd do a decent job. Instead he hacked it open, stitched it up with twine, and charged men $80 for the pleasure.

The price wouldn't bother me if he'd done a good job. Instead he did poor work, and he did it late. 1/5, to say the least.

reviews.author: RedRyderHD
reviews.text: I love this place! The owner is extremely knowledgeable and wonderful to work with! I needed a quick leather job done and he did it while I stood there. He is very experienced across the range of leather work and is very, very helpful! I would highly recommend his shop to anyone in need of any leather work!! I definitely will be returning to have him dye a set of boots for me

reviews.author: David Syracuse
reviews.text: The owner is incredibly knowledgeable and helpful.  He was able to repair the zipper and snap on a set of leather motorcycle gear quickly and professionally.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nyufly81
reviews.text: The food was okay. Wasn't bad. I'd be willing to try some other dishes here, but the service was kind of bad. There's two young girls working in here and it look like they just wanted to be left alone to be on their phones all day. It's the one girl. She was not smiling when she was making my tacos adding ingredients. She was like missing tacos cuz she was just kind of pouring them all over the tacos instead of making one individually each one individually. The price was good. 17 bucks for three tacos and a drink. Not bad for today's market. I might try a quesadilla here but overall wasn't the best experience.

reviews.author: Phil McNeil
reviews.text: I just don’t get it, the good reviews make no sense to me. The reviews pointing out not hot, soggy food, with dried out protein are dead on. I saw 4.2 stars and thought I should give it a try, I won’t be back.

reviews.author: Victoria Pirulli
reviews.text: I asked for the veggie taco and they had no idea what I was talking about? And the Al pastor taco was not good. The tortilla fell apart immediately, seemed stale. Bummer.

reviews.author: Amy Kelly
reviews.text: I was really nervous about the vein procedure I had done, but I can't express enough how kind, supportive, and professional everyone in this office was, especially Stacy, Sally, Jessica, Brenda, and Dr. Ferrer. I would highly recommend getting any vein procedure done here. They are truly kind and classy professionals.

reviews.author: Audrey Baker
reviews.text: I love this place so much. The staff is so kind, friendly and professional. It is a very clean and pleasant facility and the staff really know how to treat their patients. I started laser hair removal a couple months ago, and the results are already amazing!! Multiple friends of mine recommended it and I am blown away by the results; I'm so excited to be hair free in places that have been such a pain to shave, tweeze, and have constant ingrown hairs - until now!! Surprisingly affordable considering the lifelong results, especially if you get the 6-treatment package (which can carry forward for maintenance treatments)

reviews.author: Mary OConnor
reviews.text: If I could give this office a rating higher than 5 star, I absolutely would.  You can stop reading reviews right now and schedule your appointment with this office!  I have visited many differently Doctors and Nurse Practitioners over the last decade from the East Coast to the San Diego area, and never have I received better results than with this office.  Dr. Monaghan is highly trained, educated and skilled in every service she provides. The office is so incredibly comfortable, you'll feel like you're with friends in clean and sterile surroundings where all involved with your appointment are anticipating and delivering your needs.  Your experience will be amazing, and you're results, perfect!  Thank you, Dr. Monaghan allowing me to go forward with more confidence and joy.

reviews.author: Pauline C
reviews.text:
I have had similar experience since Dasco
Took over. Our insurance changed so we couldn’t use them anymore, I called and let them know that but they mailed us supplies anyway without me asking for them. Sent me a bill for over $380. I called to say I wasn’t paying and I wanted to mail back. They sent me a return label and I mailed them back Feb 2. Just yesterday, I received an invoice and a phone call to pay the bill. I had tried to call customer service and explain this multiple times. Beware, the calls go to India. Just awful. I hope local office can do something.

reviews.author: Moataz Emam
reviews.text: Lauren at the Cortland office is amazing. She is nice, respectful, and extremely helpful. Don’t call the 800 number, they are useless, rather stop by and ask her. Ps: the company was much better before Dasco took over. I am only giving five stars because of Lauren.

reviews.author: Alex Langdon
reviews.text: Lauren helped me get my Nebulizer machine for my son, she was an absolute pleasure and so easy to talk to. Will recommend everyone i know for their medical supplies! Thank you for the help!

reviews.author: Jacki Garlock
reviews.text: Terry and Kyle were very helpful in finding the right mattress setup for my elderly mother. There was a time deadline involved so they worked tirelessly to put together the mattress and frame that would work for us and have it delivered by that deadline. Thank you Terry for treating my mother with kindness and respect.

reviews.author: Cheri Lunas
reviews.text: Kyle was so knowledgeable and very patient with all of my questions.  He guided me through the difference in the memory foam vs coil.  He didn’t upsell me on any thing I didn’t need.  Ended up with a great mattress within my price range. 10/10 shopping experience.

reviews.author: Rich Rogers
reviews.text: Kyle and Terry were a pleasure to do business with. They are very knowledgeable at what they do and spent as much time as we required to make an informed decision on our purchase. I would recommend to anyone. Thanks Guys!

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text: Shi Miao Dao holds a special place for me—it was my very first restaurant visit after moving to Ithaca. My husband took me to Collegetown on a weekend, and we walked in without any plan at all, which made it feel even more special. We tried the Spicy Beef Brisket Rice Noodles, and as a spice lover, I absolutely loved it—rich, comforting, and perfectly bold. The service was attentive and welcoming, and overall we had a really great time. A spontaneous visit that turned into a memorable first food experience in Ithaca.

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text:
Craving some comfort food this chilly late autumn / winter? Look no further! I stopped by for an early lunch at 11:45 AM, and their spicy noodle broth was an absolute game-changer—so flavorful, so warming, and exactly what my tummy needed. This spot is perfect for gathering with friends (trust me, the more, the merrier). Plus, the friendly staff and super clean atmosphere make it a dining experience worth coming back for.
Highly recommend giving it a try!

reviews.author: Jing Zhao
reviews.text: A bit disappointed, came here to try new thing, actual meal is totally different than the stock photos. Quail egg, corn, tasted like the canned one and everything is premixed in the bowl.  Taste is acceptable but pricy for the meal! The stone bowl kept the noodle really hot and good for the winter when it is cold.

reviews.author: Paul Martin
reviews.text: Excellent experience at this barber shop! She really took her time and it didn't feel rushed despite being busy!

reviews.author: Jason S
reviews.text: Jenn is so sweet and she did an amazing cut! Highly recommend this place as a college student in the area

reviews.author: Kevin Paxton
reviews.text: This is a real gem. It is a little barber shop with great potential. Jen is a fantastic barber  with an awesome memory. She always knows what I want and always delivers a great cut. If you need an outstanding haircut, take a few minutes and stop by. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: michis57
reviews.text: I love shopping at Mama Goose for my three granddaughters. Always find lovely clothes, so much so that I basically don't buy them new clothes. I leave that to their other grandparents! The vast majority of my finds have been appreciated by my kids and grandkids. Some they absolutely love. I also have found some nice toys.

reviews.author: Melissa V
reviews.text: I've been coming here since my kids were babies and it's such a sweet shop! So many options and variety. Love that we have a place where we can get store credit for our gently used kids items and in exchange get amazing new-to-us stuff!

reviews.author: Susan McCouch
reviews.text: I love stopping in to Mama Goose to look for things for my grandchildren and I always find something they need. The store is well organized and the gently-used clothing is of good quality and priced reasonably. I also appreciate how knowledgeable and helpful the staff is in helping me find things or recommending where else to look. It’s a great store with a warm and human feel.

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text:
I ordered the vegetable Ramen and there was no flavor in the broth. The tofu, mushrooms and other toppings didnt really add much to the dish either. There was a stark contrast between that and the Bacon Ramen which was very rich in flavor. When I got to the bottom of the vegetable Ramen all the flavor "sediment" was there but it still didnt taste like enough.

We also got an order of the Brussel sprouts. They were good but needed something like a dipping sauce to cut through the fried taste.

reviews.author: Aeowyn Kendall
reviews.text: Beautiful ambience and delicious ramen!!! This is vegetarian ramen done right. The noodles were perfectly slippery and soft, but not overdone. The tofu is truly unique, and the broth combined with the garlic is just absolutely perfect. Savery and satisfying, as ramen should be!

reviews.author: Julia H
reviews.text:
It’s a fusion-style restaurant with interesting menu. You got everything here and there. Pasta selections are specifically unique. Dey not traditional tastes.

Salmon squid ink pasta came with a cream sauce. Salmon was huge, pasta portion is big too. Tasted good but pretty straightforward.

Fried chicken was good but slightly dry.

Fried brussel sprouts was flavorful but something might overcooked so it got a little bit bitterness.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Splendid place! Delicious, nutritious food at reasonable prices. Friendly, hospitable employees. A clean, neat store. A good selection of menu items. Convenient location. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jordan Anderson
reviews.text: Never been to Jimmy John's before, and this wasn't a very thrilling first experience. Very small hole in the wall that doesn't offer much of anything. The prices are through the roof considering what you get.

reviews.author: Erin Hudak
reviews.text: Order through the Jimmy John App for delivery and it took 2 hours to get my food! I would have picked it up had I known!

reviews.author: Priya Sarma
reviews.text: Bean and cheese pupusa was great, I liked it better than the jalepeno and cheese. In the future I’ll ask for less cheese and more beans. And the curtido and salsa were really good too

reviews.author: Phillip Chorba
reviews.text: After a very bad experience at nearby Franco's Pizza with my daughter we decided to come here instead and we're very glad we did. The people are very nice here, the horchata was delicious.  PIzza is definitely solid and the pupusas are top-notch. I highly recommend them over Franco's especially given their quality of hospitality here at pizza aroma.

reviews.author: Milany Papachryssanthou
reviews.text: I’ve been living in Ithaca for 10 years and have always told myself to give this place a try. I have always enjoyed Pupusas in NYC and Miami. These are hands down the best I’ve ever had. I truly could kick myself for not indulging in these delicious Pupusas sooner. Today I tried the pork and cheese and chicken and cheese. Both were amazing! They are made to order so plan to wait at least 15 minutes for them. It is well worth the wait! They were extremely fresh and so satisfying. Will be a frequent customer! Great job.

reviews.author: lynne conway
reviews.text: Dr. Karpinski and ALL her staff are pure fabulosity. Brooke is so nice at the front desk.  Dr. Karpinski is an amazing endodontist who is clearly quite skilled, an excellent listener, and understands teeth problems inside and out.
