I have pretty pronounced dental phobia and I did fine in her care. Sadly, I'm blanking on the name of her assistant during the procedure but she is incredibly kind and reassuring. Really kind. I didn't feel a thing during my root canal procedure. What a gift that was. Thank you!

reviews.author: Claudia Brenner
reviews.text: Dr Karpinski inspired 100 % confidence and she delivered. Office staff super helpful and friendly. Excellent office!

reviews.author: Jenn Asher
reviews.text: They’re very kind and care a lot if you’re in pain. I’ve had 3 root canals there and fell asleep during 1 because they’re that good. They also make submission to insurance very easy.

reviews.author: Hayley Owens
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience. The staff was professional and personal at the same time. I went with my husband for support, and we both left feeling relief that we were in good hands.
I recommend coming here if you are looking for thoughtful and thorough care.

reviews.author: Carrie Pitcher
reviews.text: The variety always amazes me. I never leave empty handed. They have sneakers, shoes, boots, slippers, sleepwear, outerwear... you name it. I don't believe there is a brand I haven't stumbled upon. They carry the same products as Marshall's but usually for cheaper.

reviews.author: Jasmin Amelia
reviews.text: Great all around great first time I've been there n they are awesome n I'ma go again

reviews.author: trekervt
reviews.text:
Very cool store for some hidden gems /pet friendly 🫶🏻
Employees are very nice and helpful
Will go back again

reviews.author: Charles Mollenhauer
reviews.text: Jasamine is helping me recover from hip replacement surgery.  She gently pushes me to work on exercises to keep me improving.  Excellent advice and great atmosphere!

reviews.author: Greg DuBois
reviews.text: Injured my neck 6 months prior to meeting with Valerie at Cayuga Medical Center Physical Therapy. Having explained my issues at the beginning of our first appointment, Valerie reviewed the x-rays and pinpointed the muscles that needed attention. With this information she selected easy exercises for my first week. Each session thereafter time was taken to discuss any issues with the previous week and additional exercises were introduced and I was instructed the correct way to do them. After 6 weeks my injury has improved more than I expected and definitely recommend and thank this facility for Valerie's knowledge and professionalism.

reviews.author: Susan Sibley
reviews.text: Josh was my mom’s therapist. He was absolutely fantastic! As an older adult who is also very hard of hearing, he was very patient and kind, supportive, and knowledgeable in regards to what we were there for. Included me in his explanation and made me feel very comfortable and welcome in the session. He was very understanding and knowledgeable as well. Would definitely recommend him to anyone who needed help if it was in his field of expertise.

reviews.author: Val A
reviews.text:
Rigid policies over children’s health

WellBeing Pediatrics enforces strict rules without applying the same respect or flexibility to their own patients. I was made to wait at least 40 minutes past appointment times, yet they refused to see my one-year-old over being exactly 15 minutes late. This was the first time I was late, and their response shows a lack of coherence and priority for patient care.

Because of their decision, my child—already delayed on vaccines due to limited provider availability—missed her 12-month immunizations and we were forced to scramble for another provider. A pediatric practice that truly cares should place children’s health above inflexible policies. WellBeing Pediatrics chose bureaucracy over common sense.

reviews.author: Dr. Maureen Alexander
reviews.text: Well being peds is so thorough and always gets my daughter in immediately when she is sick and needs to be seen ASAP. I highly recommend their services in Ithaca.

reviews.author: somer white
reviews.text: My children have been with Carolyn Koppel NP and Dr. Jessica Casey since 2013, when they were with a different practice, and we valued their care so much we followed them to their new practice on Third Street. I am so impressed with the new facility! It’s such a fun place for my children to play while waiting for their exam, and the colors are more inviting than your average sterile office. Occasionally we need to see a different practitioner, and have had continued excellence of care with Dr. Dan, NP Andrea, and other staff members. The practitioners are kind, take their time evaluating my children, and aren’t afraid to refer out if they think my child would benefit from it. Finally, the staff is responsive to emails in their patient portal, and usually answer clinical questions within an hour. I highly recommend this practice!

reviews.author: J. Reviews
reviews.text: Sebastian was of great help to me when I needed my seat post cut down. He helped me figure out the ideal fit and went through multiple rounds of cutting/fitting to get things just right! And the price was very reasonable. Very happy to have a great bike shop right on the Commons!

reviews.author: DavesYouTuba
reviews.text:
Hickey's Music Center is my go-to for top-quality professional music equipment and expert advice. My first experience with them was in 2002... I actually spoke on the phone with a Hickey's Music Center expert regarding a decision about a new trombone mouthpiece. I took the advice, and I am happy to be using this mouthpiece on professional gigs to this day !

In addition to their professional expertise, Hickey's Music Center offers outstanding customer service. They offer excellent discounts between Christmas and New Year's Day, and I found a really great deal on a trombone gig bag that I wanted. Sadly, the cheapest shipping cost was 150 percent of the gig bag. But, the gig bag price was so attractive that I bought it anyway. THEN, I got an e-mail from Hickey's, and they worked their magic to get me a HUGE reduction in the shipping cost !

I highly recommend Hickey's Music Center !

reviews.author: Marc Presler
reviews.text: Experience with the online shop has been fabulous. Prompt shipping, organized documentation, excellent inventory.

reviews.author: Allison Kannus
reviews.text: My family did not have a very good experience with Hickey's. My daughter started flute this year, and when we initially signed up for a rental, we indicated we would like to pick it up. We were strongly advised against this and were told it's better to have it sent to the school. We agreed to this suggestion and asked that it be sent to the school. Hickey's responded with an affirmative "Will do!" That should have been the end of it. Instead, when my daughter arrived to her first lesson at school, there was no flute, and when Hickey's was emailed asking why this happened, a very rudely worded email was given in reply telling us to check our invoice. Why would we check the invoice when Hickey's directly agreed to delivering it to the school? And even if we did rely on the invoice, we received a weird invoice email about how we would retrieve a tracking email for a shipment. We knew there was no tracking, so we just disregarded it; sometimes weird things are autogenerated by small businesses. Our fault was that we simply trusted Hickey's to do what they urged us, and we agreed, to do. If at any point Hickey's had acknowledged that they made a mistake by agreeing to deliver it to the school and then not doing so, or if they had just arranged to make the delivery happen after the fact, then there would have been no issues. Instead, Hickey's never once apologized or made any acknowledgement of the role they had in this situation. We decided to figure out how to get the flute elsewhere. When asked for a refund, we were given it, which is about the only good thing I can say about this company's customer service. When my younger daughter eventually signs up for an instrument, we will make sure to avoid Hickey's.

reviews.author: Amrita Preetam
reviews.text:
Such an experienced and sweet therapist!
I had my frequent post-natal massages here for consequetive four months, every time it was a great experience with Wendy!
Highly recommend place!

reviews.author: Michelle Mazza
reviews.text: Nicole is amazing! She has a warm and friendly personality and is a professional and skilled massage therapist. I've been going to her over the years for different services and every service I've tried I was very happy with and felt relaxed and renewed. I've gotten the signature massage, hot stone massage, mom 2 be massage, reflexology and facial cupping. I highly recommend Nicole and any of her services is a must try!

reviews.author: Julia Wolinski
reviews.text: Fantastic massage and amazing atmosphere. Wendy and Nicole are knowledgeable and considerate in their sessions. They have an amazing gift for healing and a beautiful space to allow it. I left feeling completely rejuvenated after weeks of pain. Would highly, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kevin Lucas Art
reviews.text: Love this place. My wife and I hit it up everytime we're in Ithaca. I wish they offered more original artwork.

reviews.author: Craig Rimmerman
reviews.text: I have bought multiple items from Contemporary Trends over the years and what a wonderful business it is!  The owners and employees will go out of their way to make sure that their customers are satisfied and they offer excellent delivery services as well (all of the people who work at Contemporary Trends are knowledgeable about the products that they sell and patient in answering customer questions).    Highly recommended especially if you enjoy supporting a family run local Ithaca business and enjoy spending your money on quality furniture.

reviews.author: Ben EastwaterVlogs
reviews.text: Me and my boyfriend went into this store yesterday. We were followed by one of the workers.Worst feeling ever. My mom is a professor at Cornell University and I’ve been going to this place since I was a kid. I’m disgusted by this behavior. If you check the security cameras it would look like stalking.

reviews.author: Inko C
reviews.text:
Good food, but not fantastic. Desserts are really good, mussels too salty but the fries on the steak frites was very good but the steak was mid. Gnocchi also mid.

Service very slow but servers very nice.

We were seated next to the kitchen and it was very stuffy and difficult to breathe.

reviews.author: Carrie Natale
reviews.text: My husband and I tried this place for our first time today for brunch. The brunch menu was great with fantastic choices. It was honestly hard to pick. Mary was our server. She was friendly, attentive, and accommodating. The food did not disappoint. Everything was timely, unique, and delicious. We will definitely return. This is a wonderful place to visit. I highly recommend trying this restaurant!

reviews.author: Stephanie Caulford
reviews.text: Went here for a quick Easter brunch with my boyfriend, the staff and owner were so lovely, and the place has such a beautiful atmosphere! We started with the Belgian Hot Chocolate, which tasted like melted dark chocolate - so rich! For entrees, I ordered the Lemon Soufflé Pancakes and my boyfriend got the Eggs Benedict Fiesole. The pancakes were incredibly light and airy, subtley-sweet (which is exactly what I was looking for!) with the perfect amount of lemon - practically melted in my mouth! The benedict was delicious as well (he ate most of it aha) but from the bits I had, everything was very fresh and thoughtfully put together. I've been looking to eat here for a few months now, and it absolutely exceeded my expectations. I hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: Mel Foote
reviews.text: Coffee is always usually good however I ordered 3 loaded hashbrown bowls recently and the bacon was burnt to a crisp in all three bowls. Not cool...

reviews.author: Dorothy Perez
reviews.text: I usually come here and workers are always respectful and polite but today morning was the worst, I usually don’t have time to drink my chai latte through out the day at work which I asked today for light ice so it wont be watered down, I understand it will be given a bit less than usual but NOT close to half the cup. At first they filled the whole cup with ice which I reminded the lady I asked for light ice, The lady was being very disrespectful and nasty and was talking to me like I was her child, then she took the ice out and left my drink like this. My boyfriend got a regular iced latte which is the last picture and as you can see the ice is half the cup and I got more ice than him at first. I understand workers have a bad day too but that doesn’t give them the right for them to treat us like garbage. This is disappointing and hopefully it doesn’t happen again.

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text: Worst Dunkin in the area. They have no idea how to handle online orders and will give yours away to random people then act as if it’s not their fault when you get there. They will then take their sweet time remaking it and acting as if you asked them to do some massive favor for you. The whole point of placing online orders is to skip the line and wait, not the other way around.

reviews.author: David Bickford
reviews.text: Went here to grab a cup while waiting to see Kathleen Madigan at State theater.  Also, a cat rescue nearby.  Love the little guys!  Coffee was great, too! Around the corner from state theatre.  A place to stop by, and enjoy a cup of delicious coffee or tea.

reviews.author: Christine G
reviews.text: Please visit this adorable Cafe and adopt a cat if you are dedicated to loving cats. We had a great time here and if my sister and I didn't already have 12 cats between the 2 of us, we would have taken hone 2 or 3 of these lovey babies.

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text: First time coming here and I was immediately greeted by Queen Marigold who led to me to the room full of kittens! She was a sweetheart, all of them were! Most of them were sleeping so I didn't disturb them but when I got some toys out to play with the adults, that's when some of the kittens started to wake up. The little tiger I love so much, I'd adopt him if I could! He just wanted me to keep petting him, he was just purring and softly meowing, and I played with him too but he then snagged the toy right off of the pole! Such a playful kitten he is, I'll have to make another visit! All of the cats were friendly, of course some did get a little hostile towards others but not really in a fighting way due to the catnip toys so be mindful that they are cats and will do what cats do. I did get one of the espressos as well before I left and it tastes amazing, only about $6, and it's $5 for 30 minutes to visit the cats so that's not really bad and the money goes towards the cats too! I highly recommend stopping in, especially if you're looking to adopt then take a visit here first because there's plenty of kittens looking for a home.

reviews.author: danielle nobriga
reviews.text: My daughter went to Safari Smiles for years but for insurance purposes, we recently switched to another office. She needed an extraction but the new office was not patient or kid friendly, her anxiety heightened and the tooth was never extracted. I immediately brought her back to Safari Smiles, and Dr. Choi made her feel at ease and was able to extract her tooth without an issue. I must also mention that we were able to be scheduled the same day I inquired about an appointment. Safari Smiles is worth every penny!

reviews.author: Lindsay Mott
reviews.text:
Colorful and bright walls. Visually, looks like it’s kid friendly, but unfortunately, I did not receive a kid friendly experience. Staff needs to be trained better with young children, and they need more toys and tools to use as a distraction. Choose to go here even though it was outside of insurance coverage specifically because I thought it would be a better experience for him. Any other adult dental office in the area would have been the same experience. I was yelled at because my newly 2 year old was playing with the door (because there was nothing else to play with) while I was doing my best to read and fill out paperwork. The assistant was not versed in talking to a 2 year old, “too bad, you have to.” Whhhat!?Not to mention, after filling out their automative text message and specifically indicated I was only available for the Ithaca office, they booked me through Corning and then did not tell me, so I wasted an hour of my time driving to Ithaca office just for it to be closed. I made it very clear I was uncomfortable with X-rays because of my own medical history, but instead of being accommodating, I felt bullied into it, with no other options. My son had a minor tooth chip that was a bit sharp, I was hoping to have shaved down a bit so that he didn’t cut his lip, made that clear from the beginning, and it never happened without booking an entirely new appointment and more 💸

Update: I just received a letter via certified mail* that I’m “discontinued” as a patient, not that I would have gone back, but it was a great way for them to handle my bad experience……..

reviews.author: Nicole Zuver-White
reviews.text: I’m so beyond happy with the staff from the front desk to the dr. Ten years ago I had a bad experience with the previous owner and never would have recommended this place. However the NEW staff in the last 7 years has renewed that. My daughter at a previous dentist was told to remove her front teeth, fill some others but due to previous fillings at this dentist she would not sit still as the previous experience she wasn’t given the chance to allow Novocain to actually start working so she wouldn’t sit still and they wanted her to go to the OR. Took her to safari smiles knowing it was under new management and much closer to home to have the Dr recommend leave the front teeth as they’re not bothering her and when they do we will address. Fill the cavities needed and place a crown under sedation which they also no longer give versed! My daughter was given a mix of Demerol and other medications sat in a private area with a couch, tv and blanket while given 45minutes for the meds to work. She was then taken via wheelchair chair to the procedure room where she remembers NOTHING! She got to pick out several resin animals made by the lovely Tracy, given one large one and an animal balloon.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Excellent place! Rarely is it ever crowded and it is always stocked well. Friendly, welcoming employees. An efficient, speedy checkout process. A clean, neat store. The only problem is that it does not contain any restrooms. But on the whole, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lohit Malik
reviews.text: Went for a passport photo thing at 8 AM in the morning. They were NOT understaffed and helped me with everything instantly. Specifically, Megan was the best, going out of her way throughout the process. After getting my passport photos and paying for the same, I realized that I did not fully like those photos (it was not the camera, it was my face in the morning). I had other photos that I had clicked myself on my phone. Megan kindly guided me how I could use those photos for my passport making sure they fit the requirements, printed them and did NOT charge for the same and simply asked me to return the previous photos. I had to also drop off a FedEx shipment there (this Walgreens has a FedEx dropoff spot) but needed to use a pair of scissors and some tape. Cassie, another employee and Megan were kind enough to let me borrow these items and take all my time to prepare my package for shipment. I'd lastly say that do not go on the overall Google rating but instead try it out for yourself, the whole team is great.

reviews.author: P Lynn
reviews.text: New management has made doing routine coupon deals feel like I’m doing criminal type activity in the store. Plain out disrespectful to myself and others in this store. I am part of a coupon community and they are targeting us.

reviews.author: Hannane Yaghoubizade
reviews.text:
I loved the fro yo! All the flavors are very interesting. It is soft, flavorful and not too sweet.

I am not sure about the service tho, I didn’t really interact with them.

reviews.author: Peter Peter
reviews.text: The frozen yogurt is excellent here. Many great flavors to indulge in, and always super-fresh and delicious! Jason is good people and treats his employee's and customers well.

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.text: Terrible customer service experience. First off, clerk who I’m assuming is the owner, “Jason”, was the most obnoxious grump who needs to relax and take a business course. Looking at these reviews, not surprised that I’m not the first with a bad experience. To paint the picture, I’m just a guy coming in to get a small midnight snack of froyo for myself and a friend and at checkout, creates a whole scene “because I’m too stupid to understand”. Sorry I was WILLINGLY ready to pay the $10 (since I didn’t meet the minimum $5 a cup which is already silly), guess the trash tonight has more to eat than your desire to make a profit off of less froyo sold. Not really sure why you’d cut out a customer base who doesn’t want more than $5 of froyo at a given time, maybe forgetting that you’re in a college town? That’s just my 2 cents on it, genuinely all the best despite

reviews.author: Sara Jackson
reviews.text: We have had a great experience with Dr. Zobel and his team so far. Our three year old just had his first teeth cleaning. The technician that worked with him was excellent.her approach was age-appropriate and made him feel very comfortable. We are so grateful he had a great experience his first time at the dentist.

reviews.author: Scott H
reviews.text:
I was very pleased with my initial appointment at Dr. Zobel's practice after my previous long-term dentist had retired. The office staff were all very helpful and efficient, especially with processing insurance paperwork on my behalf, and the waiting room and treatment/exam rooms were all very modern, spacious and comfortable.

Dr. Zobel was warm and welcoming, and also very thorough in his exam and review of my past x-rays. Even though this is a busy practice (which is definitely a good sign!) and they didn't anticipate being able to schedule me for a cleaning until a month or two later, Margie at the front desk was able to squeeze me in on the spot due to a last-minute cancellation. Lorrie, the hygienist, was both gentle and thorough, and her cleaning was done in no time.

reviews.author: Genna Knight
reviews.text: The entire staff at Dr. Zobel's office is friendly, professional, efficient and amazing with children. Our children look forward to dentist visits. I would highly recommend them! I am thoroughly impressed every time we visit. It is such a pleasant experience every time we go. Do you know any other dentists who make balloon animals for their patients?

reviews.author: Ana R
reviews.text: Was a little skeptical at first but my bowl was bursting with flavor! I got the beef bulgogi bowl w purple rice zucchini corn red onion pineapple kimchi lettuce and teriyaki sauce and spicy mayo. Perfect combination of flavors, sweet savory and tangy. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: JitkaKac
reviews.text: Clean and welcoming restaurant. Our bowls were prepared swiftly from fresh ingredients. Great place for a quick and healthy meal.

reviews.author: Dinesh Ghimire
reviews.text: Recently dined at this asian restaurant that offers a wide variety of bowls and the option to build your own. Whether you're in the mood for a classic combinations from the menu or something customized to your taste, this place has got you covered. The portions were generous, ensuring you leave feeling satisfied. Very healthy and tasty food options. Check it out for a delicious and fulfilling meal!

reviews.author: Sundeep Venkatesan
reviews.text: We ordered chicken Noodles and chicken katsu. Both tasted pretty good and we all enjoyed it. The chicken noodles initially came with beef and when we pointed out the waiter just removed the beef pieces and brought it back which still had some pieces in it. Did not make a big deal about it as the service was good and everyone was having a good time. The Sangria orange soda was surprisingly delicious and my kids enjoyed popping and tasting it.

reviews.author: Ted Rejman
reviews.text: I have lived in the area all my life. Never knew about Sumo until one of our daughters invited us to eat together there. What an experience. Totally enjoyed the chef KIKI, as he prepared our meal in front of us. I interacted with him and it made tge experience even more enjoyable. We had enough leftovers to take home for another meal. Everything we had was delicious. Definitely will be going back.

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text: The lunch special made this place worthwhile and we were very pleased. The portion sizes were really nice. Not too crowded and nice ambiance.

reviews.author: Joeliesha Ferguson
reviews.text:
$85

I went to the place expecting to get acrylic full set. I haven’t gotten my nails done in 5 years so I wasn’t sure what changed about them when she started applying Gel.

I wasn’t asked and/or warned about Gel nails.
I was just told

“We don’t do acrylics, gel is better for your nails. “

Yet they cut my natural nail down to nothing before starting which was weird, I’ve been able to keep my length before but I said whatever.

The gel burned. As if I was putting my fingertips in open flame. For 10 seconds at the least. I wasn’t warned about the burning feeling.  She rushed through my nails so fast that she cut me 3 separate times.

I had my daughter with me at the time so I didn’t want to make a scene. I have social anxiety so I just watched and when she missed painting a lot of my nails I was told I have big nails and she doesn’t usually have to paint so much nail. She left a space of my natural nail around the whole nail. Which makes it look like it’s been grown out for a week already.

3 nails are crooked but I couldn’t tell because of how rushed the whole thing was.
One nail is filed so far down you can see the tissue under the nail.

I felt rushed. Uncomfortable. They were not busy at all and the appointment was less than 30 minutes. My nails are still slightly burning.

This will be the last time I pay for my nails to get done.

I was charged $85

reviews.author: Miranda Steen
reviews.text: My favorite nail salon in Ithaca! Beautiful nail designs, always done well, clean place, friendly staff, calm atmosphere, reasonable prices. Highly recommend!! 💖🤩💗 I love the Halloween and cloud designs. The third design was for my wedding and they turned out perfect! Always happy with my nails leaving the E Nail Spa 😍

reviews.author: Aubrianna Jenesse
reviews.text: The best mani/pedi I've ever gotten. Alec and Michelle pampered me and chatted with me the entire time. They both are very talented and the finished set is fire 🔥! I can't stop looking at them. It feels like I have gemstones on my fingers. Michelle's attention to detail and thorough work left me feeling blissful. Alec made me feel relaxed and laugh a lot. Well worth the price. Thank you to Michelle and Alec for a lovely experience. 💗✨️ I'll be back.

reviews.author: Noor Rahman Armani
reviews.text:
Outstanding Pediatrician!
Dr. Wali M Ahmadzai is an exceptional children’s doctor who truly cares about their patients. From the very first visit, they made my child feel comfortable and safe with their warm, gentle, and friendly approach. They take the time to listen carefully, explain everything clearly, and answer all questions with patience and kindness. The diagnosis and treatment are always thorough and reassuring. The staff is also courteous and well-organized, making every visit smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend Dr. Wali M Ahmadzai to any parent looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and trustworthy pediatrician

reviews.author: Zarifa Ghafari
reviews.text:
I cannot speak highly enough of Dr. Wali Ahmadzai and the exceptional care he has provided for my daughter at Buttermilk Falls Pediatrics. From the very first visit, Dr. Ahmadzai has shown an extraordinary level of professionalism, compassion, and dedication. He takes the time to listen carefully, explains everything thoroughly, and ensures that I feel confident and informed about every aspect of my daughter’s care.
What stands out most is his ability to combine deep medical expertise with genuine kindness. My daughter feels comfortable and at ease during every appointment, and I can see how much he truly cares for the well-being of his young patients.
Dr. Ahmadzai is exactly the kind of pediatrician every parent hopes to find: knowledgeable, attentive, patient, and committed to providing the highest quality of care. I am grateful for his service and would wholeheartedly recommend him and Buttermilk Falls Pediatrics to any parent seeking the very best care for their children.

reviews.author: Jayasri Srinivasan
reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of getting to know Dr. Wali Ahmadzai when he treated our older son on several occasions for a couple of infections. Thanks to his expert diagnosis, treatment and follow up care, our son  got better quickly. Dr. Ahmadzai is an exceptional health care professional! We are grateful for the fact that he has always been unfailingly kind and responsive to the health needs of our family!
We also appreciate Dr. Shrivastava's advice on vaccination and nutrition when our kids were younger. His medical perspective combined with a cultural familiarity with our background was very helpful!
Thank you!

reviews.author: m muncy
reviews.text:
Everytime I drive in from Syracuse for a hike, Franco's Pizza is my non-negotiable pit stop! Their Roman style pizza is unlike anything else in the area- crispy, flavorful, generously loaded toppings. The quality is top notch.
The staff, friendly, fast & welcoming.
If your passing through Ithaca or just looking for a pizza spot that delivers every front- taste, service & atmosphere - Franco's is the place to be. Highly recommend! 💯💯🍕🍕

reviews.author: Alex Zepka
reviews.text: Great pizza. Just as good as in NYC. Thin and crunchy bottom. Nice large space. Just don't take it to the brewery next door (they won't let you in with the pizza). Selection of drinks could be more extensive, but it is adequate. Just don't come too close to closing time or you will won't have much of a choice in toppings for pizza-by-the-slice.

reviews.author: Angela Tripuzzi
reviews.text: The sicilian pizza is truly one of the best ever. My husband and I have traveled all over the world, and all over the country. Both from very pizza heavy places - NY CT NJ etc. this is truly one of my favorite slices of alll time. Second time here and it’s consistently delicious. Soft dough with a crispy outside- sauce is 10/10 - ready to go slices have interesting toppings not just basics. They are also heated to absolute perfection every time. No notes. Service is always prompt and friendly. Atmosphere is exactly what it should be. Chill and casual.

reviews.author: Janet West
reviews.text: So unset just payed lots of money for a couch and love seat was super excited about getting it. So they said. They did not deliver so my husband payed someone to. Help him. Get the new one and. Throw out our semi old one. Once he did all that the couch was not what we ordered it was a part of a sectional we did not want a sectional we paid for a couch and a love seat we got the love seat and also we got a half of a couch that belongs to a sectional not what we ordered so they said that we have to bring the couch back of course they can't give us a discount what does unbelievable we had to pay someone to help us remove our old couch bring in the new one it's not even what the hell we ordered so we are putting out money over n over again and already threw our old couch out but. That's crazy to me

reviews.author: randy pfautz
reviews.text: Great selection and customer service,  friendly staff.

reviews.author: Todd Sheffer
reviews.text: The store has a little bit of everything. Good selection.

reviews.author: E Dan
reviews.text: Ordered an Eggplant parm. One slice of eggplant. All pasta. Over $20 bucks. Never again! Waste of my money! I would love to request a refund but their restaurant is named something different than what’s in door dash. Better business bureau?

reviews.author: James Martin
reviews.text: The staff at the Ithaca Ghost Kitchen never fail to deliver on a wide variety of concept restaurants all balled into one. If you want great pasta, pizza, burgers, or subs until 1am you honestly can't do better than them here in Ithaca.

reviews.author: Antoinette Marie Torres
reviews.text: been obsessed with their pasta since freshman year. have ordered the same thing 10 times this semester so far under my sister’s Ubereats acc (half pasta, fresh fettucine w alfredo, broccoli, red peppers, parmesan, crushed red pepper and black pepper) and it hits every single time. the only thing is I’ve never gotten the breadstick which I know it’s supposed to come with 💀 regardless still my fav place and I’ll remain a loyal customer 🫡

reviews.author: Jae Rae
reviews.text: It doesn't matter where we go, we always look for a Home Goods. It's always a fun shopping trip, and you can't leave without buying a treasure to take home. The holidays are always the best, with so much to choose from for your holiday decor.

reviews.author: Lynne Coleman
reviews.text:
We have never been in HomeGoods before. We were impressed!! Nice, clean place and staff was friendly and helpful.
It can be dangerous!! We went in looking for a small end table and even though we didn't find what we were looking for we did not leave empty handed. Very nice store, we will be back
Thank you

reviews.author: ItsaMe Mario
reviews.text: Good place to find kitchen and home stuff. Usually around Amazon prices or a little higher. Customer service has always been pleasant here.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Pleasant dining experience, the Octopus and Cauliflower appetizers were excellent.  The entrees were fine but were not on the same level as the apps. The lava cake served its purpose. The dining room was very comfortable and service was on point

reviews.author: Sofia Miquilena
reviews.text: I wish I could leave a 6 star review for this place! 10/10. The food was immaculate, the service was absolutely unreal and the vibe was perfect! From the owner to my server Kirk, everyone treated us like celebrities literally. The food was out of the world and I thought the prices were very fair for the quality of the food. I recommend this place with my eyes closed and I’ll be coming back!! I’ll attach a couple photos but keep in mind my husband and I shared everything and they served us the Duck shared in two different plates so we didn’t have to make a mess doing sharing! I took videos a of the food so it won’t let me share them

reviews.author: Mario Alex Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Possibly my favorite restaurant in Ithaca, the Heights always manages to impress me with its innovation, quality, and consistency every time I have had the joy of eating here. The service is always fantastic, and the food choices are always delicious and interesting. Easily my favorite part of the dining experience here is the appetizer selection. There are times when I go with people and we just order only appetizers because they are so outstanding. My favorite is the Portuguese Octopus, and it is among my favorite appetizers anywhere. Other extremely notable mentions are the Short Rib board and the pork cheeks, but honestly, you cannot go wrong with anything they have to offer in my experience. The entrees are outstanding as well, and I love seeing what the specials have to offer, but everything from the steaks to the burger are superb. The desserts maintain the strength of quality, with one of my creme brûlée conessieur friends saying the creme brûlée is among the best he has ever had. The lava cake soufle is also well worth a try, and it always has a fun twist.

Overall, the Heights is a fine dining establishment that is not scared to try new things and innovate with its dishes, and it is always a pleasure to experience their exceptional food.

reviews.author: Mary Russ
reviews.text:
Dr. Max Dubin is truly an outstanding oral surgeon.  His professionalism and calm reassuring personality made me feel comfortable from the start.  He clearly explained the procedure and after care, patiently answering every question I asked.
The Gorges Dental team is equally as impressive - friendly, efficient and caring.  This entire practice is polished.  I highly recommend Dr. Max Dubin to anyone needing an exceptional oral surgeon.

reviews.author: Kate NY
reviews.text:
If you're looking for dental services in Ithaca that are the best in every way, then you'll want to make an appointment at Gorges Dental. From calling to make an appointment to leaving the office after a visit, you can't go wrong. Staff are friendly, caring, accommodating and professional. I can tell staff communicate with each other while I'm there because my care is seamless. And Dr Raggi is the best. Aside from his excellent skills as a dentist, and he is top notch, kindness is the first word that comes to mind. He really really listens and when possible gives clear options. I've had several visits here and they are always the same.
And another thing, I recommended Gorges Dental to my daughter and when Dr Raggi first looked at my grandsons teeth he could tell this three year old was on a healthy, whole food, plant based diet. I don't know how but it shows to me anyway that he keeps up on all things Dental and is a well rounded professional.
I appreciate you Dr Raggi and your team. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jose Hernandez
reviews.text:
I had to wait few minutes for my cleaning but it was worth it. They should definitely warm up the place an hour before opening to the public.
All the front desk employees were great. The doctor was very friendly and knowledgeable. I love my cleaning experience from Katie. No pain, mouth rinse often. Very straightforward. She gets a 5 of 5

reviews.author: KEVIN RADADIA
reviews.text: Liquid State Brewing Company is a fantastic spot! The beers are creative, well-crafted, and there’s a great variety to choose from — something for every taste. The atmosphere is fun and relaxed, perfect for hanging out with friends or just enjoying a casual drink. The staff is friendly and welcoming, and it’s clear they take pride in what they do. Definitely one of the best places to grab a beer in the area — I’ll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Arl P
reviews.text: Liquid State and Franco’s pizza what a great combination! Had the flight with 4 IPAs and a small pizza from Franco’s with 1/2 pepperoni. Delish! Definitely going back.

reviews.author: Steve Breen
reviews.text: My family visited Liquid State Brewing Company yesterday. We had a wonderful time. There was a wonderful selection of beverages ranging from beers to NA cocktails. Be sampled most of the IPAs. All were good! Food was from the food truck. Chicken, fries and mac & cheese was delicious. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Roman Rabinovich
reviews.text: Decent neighborhood gas station with air machine and very good convenience store.

reviews.author: William Henderson
reviews.text: Best fried chicken ever in Ithaca! Excellent service too

reviews.author: Mel P
reviews.text: Everyone says they have the best chicken, not today. It was cold and the juice inside when I took a bite was cold. The staff seemed annoyed I interrupted them texting on the phone to get service. Wouldn't give me a 10piece of tenders, said they only did 8piece. I asked for honey for my biscuit, no honey. Before I left I asked for butter for my biscuit, they said it was in the bag, it wasn't. Won't be back.

reviews.author: Diane M
reviews.text: I called from NYC last week with a very specific request- my mom wanted a signed copy of “This Dog Will Change Your Life” and this location was one of the last ones that had it in stock (not available online). Danielle and I believe another person were both assisting me. They listened and were solution oriented and patient. They went above and beyond to help me secure the gift. Appreciate their help and service.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: A book nerd like me is in heaven every time he walks in! Friendly, hospitable employees. Plenty of parking and a clean, neat store. I love the membership club as well. A fantastic selection and low prices. Conveniently located on Meadow Street in downtown Ithaca. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Hello Brave Girl
reviews.text:
Sorry B&N, your Starbucks employees are horrible. We were there tonight 12/21/25 @ 5:10 and they felt their conversation was more important than taking our order. Its unfortunate because I always get a coffee in  the Vestal store and sip while I shop. I had lots of people on my list and I left. Went and bought Amazon cards for all of my friends.
Won't be back!!

reviews.author: Pamela Morris-Parish
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to an Aspen Dental office. It was for a new patient evaluation and treatment plan set-up.

Extremely nice employees on every level, from the man at the front desk, X-ray tech, hygienist, dentist and operations manager. I felt listened to, valued, and most of all respected as person. My questions were answered and my opinions and concerns taken into consideration. My treatment options were explained clearly and I was pleased they offer payment plans with several options to choose from.

This is a small office with only two treatment rooms, which could mean a longer wait time, but the staff seemed to be handling patient flow well and as quickly as possible during my visit.

reviews.author: Shana Chaffee
reviews.text: Casey was amazing. She is such a great and friendly hygienist. She went above and beyond to help me and make me feel comfortable. She also squeezed me in for some additional X-rays and had me speak with the dentist concerning some upcoming appointments. She really helped expedite the process.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.text: My experience with aspen has been amazing. I personally cannot handle the ex ray process but the dental assistant Regan was absolutely incredible with getting it done quickly and comfortably. She has been incredible

reviews.author: sheila mettler
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Dr. Monacelli. From start to finish, the level of professionalism was outstanding. Dr. Monacelli is incredibly thorough, taking the time to ensure every detail is addressed. What truly sets this doctor apart is the way everything is explained so clearly and patiently. I never felt rushed—every question was answered, and I left feeling informed and confident about my care. Highly recommend Dr. Monacelli for anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate professional.

reviews.author: Pat Teeter
reviews.text: I am very pleased with Dr. Monacelli,  very caring and explains things so well.  His office workers are so nice and pleasant.  I would recommend him to anyone. All the nurses etc. that worked with me before, during and in recovery were all so nice and caring. Thank you all

reviews.author: Chris Cross Applesauce
reviews.text: Dr. Monacelli and his staff are top notch. They all took the time to listen to my issues. They were very knowledgeable and patient and sincere. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Slava Paperno
reviews.text: My wife and I have been treated by Dr. Husseini and Dr. Vohra for years, and have always been given warm, respectful, and timely attention. The treatments worked, and on a few occasions, when we found ourselves in a difficult situation, they were extraordinarily helpful and kind. On one occason, one of us was personally driven by one of the doctors directly to the hospital to ensure immediate and correct treatment there. The staff at the clinic is also exceptionally helpful and experienced.

reviews.author: Michelle P.
reviews.text:
Dr. Vohra does not care about his patients and only cares about money. My husband has been seeing him for almost a year now but his state has not improved. The prescribed medication has not aided him at all and whenever we asked for a different prescription, Dr. Vorah would decline and call my husband back for more tests. As a result, my husband has wasted almost a years worth of time with multiple visits, useless prescriptions, and high medical bills that show no proof of assistance with my husband’s health.

Tow days ago(3/8/22), I called his office and pleaded for a new prescription for my husband, who still is not feeling better. We were yet again asked to come back for more testing by Dr. Vorah and his assistant, Bobby Jo. We requested to first get a new prescription and come back for more testing to see how my husband’s health improved. Bobby Jo seemed to understand our qualms and promised to call me back after consulting with Dr. Vorah. However, she didn't call me back and required me to reach out again, only to be informed that Dr. Vorah would not provide a new prescription until we paid our remaining balance.

While my husband and I would be more than happy to pay the remaining balance, we had already been in contact with the billing department in regards to the bills for testing that had not proved beneficial. We had been advised that the amounts would be adjusted by Doug in billing, but were pending follow up internally with his superior, Jackie. This was several months ago. I have followed up with the Billing team in regards to the matter on several occasions and was assured that the issue would be resolved but have not heard any follow up unless I sought it out first. The issue still remains unresolved, so finally  I paid in full this morning.  One thing  ridiculous happened yesterday(3/9/2022) was that Jackie told me Dr. Vorah suggested that give us 30% discount of the remaining balance, then offered another follow up testing right away without  additional cost(except  insurance coverage)before he give my husband a new prescription, however  he reversed  back that suggestion of this discount  offer and the favorable  test very next day(3/10/2022). I felt so funny  to see that Dr. Vorah was  doing  like this to his patient in suffering discomfortess, with his assistants Jackie, Bobby Jo, Andrea and his nurse Tammy.  This morning,  all the assistants declined  my phone  calls more than 10 times, and they just hung up. Once I asked for the prescription after  I paid my balance in full, Dr. Vorah refused it again,  even he said he would  give it if I  clear the balance on the day before  yesterday(3/8/2022).  I can't  believe  why he keeps changing  his words and treats like this to his patient? I was begging  him for the new prescription  medication  for my husband because I  worried  about my husband's  condition. I don't  think  Dr. Vorah  is a real doctor, he doesn't care about  his patient 's condition at all. He declined my husband 's request of the new prescription  since my husband's  second visit! It was July 2021!

To be informed that the remaining balance that was supposed to be resolved so long ago(last October, 2021)is restricting my husband from proper treatment is horrible. My husband and I have been patient and invested so much time and energy to seek out a resolution as it was not provided. We just want to see my husband’s health improved but this has still yet to be provided.
We do not want to see him anymore.

reviews.author: Jake Cornelius
reviews.text: Dr. Vohra has given me excellent care whenever needed. One example: Seeing I was in discomfort, he ordered a nurse to give me more pain killer in the hospital when waiting for a kidney stone removal.

reviews.author: Alison
reviews.text: Just had the best experience one could ask for. The salesman was super helpful recommending what he felt were better wipers than the once’s I chose myself. Appreciated his experience + offering something still in my price range but a better quality product. He was kind enough to come out in the cold to show me how to install them. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ruben Carbajal
reviews.text: The shop has a decent selection, but the staff there are extremely helpful. Really appreciated their advice and service. Great people!

reviews.author: Tyr Wiesner-Hanks
reviews.text: This location is great, especially compared to the Advance Auto down on 13. Clean, organized, and everyone I've talked to there is friendly and knowledgeable. I usually go out of my way to stop here for parts etc.

reviews.author: Susan Carvel
reviews.text: We stopped here for breakfast while we were visiting Ithaca. The diner is very small and we ended up sitting at the counter. I really enjoyed watching the cook and the waitress. I could never keep up with the orders as quickly and efficiently as they did! I had the corned beef hash, eggs, and a biscuit, which was very good. My husband also enjoyed the blueberry pancakes. Both our meals were plentiful! Prices were average. If ever we were back in the area, we would return!

reviews.author: LL C
reviews.text: Homey, no-nonsense place half a block away from Ithaca Falls. My partner wanted to fuel before a long bike ride so we got the pancakes and eggs with hash. The pancakes were wonderful! Thanks so much for the satisfying meal.

reviews.author: Arl P
reviews.text: What a great little place! My new favorite breakfast place! My husband had the meat and cheese omelet with sourdough toast and I had scrambled eggs and bacon with a side of french toast. Everything came out hot and delicious! The French toast even had the powdered sugar sprinkled on top - just like how my mother made it! The staff were friendly and personable too! We will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Lorelli Cervantes
reviews.text: Love this place. They have the best rice krispies. So large and yummy. My go to order is a rice krispie and an iced chai latte with sweetner. Everyone is so kind and plays chill music. Def a stop you need to make at least once :)

reviews.author: Madison Clapp
reviews.text: Best coffee I’ve ever had in my life. There lattes are amazing. I have celiac disease and love there trail mix bars! They are so so good, and I know they are safe for me to eat. 10/10 by far my favorite place, worth trying!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Woodford
reviews.text: I visited twice. Didn't care for the turmeric latte. Ordered a large size to enjoy in the lobby but they only have small sized cups... would be nice to have larger cups for guests to enjoy coffee in the beautiful lobby. Tried a scone and it was delish. Also, offering more syrup flavors would be amenable too

reviews.author: Bianca Rose
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I are learning to ski and snowboard this year. Ron was incredibly personable and helpful. He set us up with all the gear we needed. And he didn’t make any question feel silly at all. Great establishment!

reviews.author: antonio steinhauer
reviews.text: Ron was a big help for me and my girlfriend getting stuff for skiing and snowboarding we got all new stuff to get started and was a great help and the price was lower than we thought it was going to be

reviews.author: Brendan b
reviews.text: JJ was an absolute fantastic help with my new snowboard bindings!

reviews.author: Irwin Glenn
reviews.text:
Very knowledgeable staff to assist you on finding the perfect pairings of wine, spirits and cocktail ingredients.

Their Friday afternoon wine tasting should be part of your weekend wind down process.

reviews.author: Angnes
reviews.text:
Quality products. Rude male staff.
Recently in past two days, witnessed bearded man treating the ladies cashing out customers with such rudeness, I was taken aback.
While they are cashing out customers. Where is he? Leaning against the counter.
One of the ladies, asked him if he needed anything and he response was to tell her, he was good and continue to lean. You are hiring? Is he getting his pink slip?
The ladies who work here are a treasure. Always making sure I have a pleasant experience.  Hire more like them. They are a pure delight.

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.text:
I was in with my children this past Thursday. The staff was delightful, however the music being played was a disgraceful. Rap with profanity and the "N" word being played. When I asked who chose the music the response was the "store manager."
I was mortified to have my children hear such filth. For such a nice wine store to play such music, they should should be ashamed.

reviews.author: Bridget Wellen
reviews.text: Great service and delicious food. It was fun to see everyone talking and they even have a dart board. The fried haddock was perfectly done and the French dip was good. Horseradish aioli is not to be skipped! Nicely done apple crisp, creamy rich cheesecake, and great flavor to the carrot cake. You can even buy a bottle of wine to go which is perfect if you are staying in the hotel.

reviews.author: Nicole Gabriel
reviews.text: Plenty of parking. We sat outside it was such a a nice day. I ordered wings, they were delicious. Had pickle chips as a appetizer. My company had the pulled pork sandwich. That was tasty aswell. Will be back.

reviews.author: charles lawhun
reviews.text: A gem of a place away from the congestion of Ithaca and Cornell.  Food is pub style think Sysco but served by friendly and entertaining people.  Locals are friendly no assigned seats and you feel comfortable.  200 year old building and its atmosphere reflects it.  Highly recommended good food, great cocktails and 5+ on ambiance.

reviews.author: Charlie “Charmander” Lin
reviews.text: Soft serve and hard ice creams. We had the chocolate vanilla swirl and berry swirl. Many toppings to choose from! Great service.

reviews.author: Jason Bloomberg
reviews.text:
Sweet Melissa's Ice Cream Ithaca, NY

We tried their Vegan ice cream based on the recommendation of someone we trusted.

We got 2 scoops vegan toasted coconut and vegan gluten-free blonde cookies & cream ice cream.

At this time they are "cash only."

Both of their Vegan ice creams are coconut milk based and didn’t have much flavor.  The toasted coconut had more than the blonde cookies and  cream.  They also had a somewhat rubbery texture, more like melted mozzarella cheese than what one would anticipate from ice cream.

It's outdoor seating only.  There's no street visible signage to indicate this business, yet despite that there is a constant line of customers, most likely for their dairy based ice creams and other threats. For us as Vegans, I would not go back except to sometime in the future to give them a second chance. It just wasn't that good.

reviews.author: Jason B
reviews.text:
This was the best soft serve ice cream I’ve ever had — I really mean this.  I have never had anything quite like it. It was a silk-like creaminess and that was the perfect amount of sweet. I had their version of the Blizzard with Heath bar and it was divine. I will gladly plan future trips to this part of the country around a stop at this place.

There was no place to sit inside or a bathroom so that was the only negative.  Locals said that they all pee around back by the dumpster.

reviews.author: Christopher Parzyck
reviews.text: Nice climate controlled units, reasonable rate.  Clean and well kept building with good access.  Had the occasional billing issue with autopay not working but when I talked with staff on the phone they were quick to get things taken care of.

reviews.author: The Barksville Inn
reviews.text: Super friendly and helpful staff - 24/7 access to storage unit - very happy.

reviews.author: T
reviews.text: Pretty easy to get in and out of with box truck, looks well maintained on outside, pristine inside.  Not sure if office on site

reviews.author: Ethan Bodnaruk
reviews.text: New owner and just re-opened after being closed for a year or so I think.  Great selection of beers, also carries gluten free beer, NA beer, and NA wine. Didn't notice if they have normal wine. They will have taps going in the near future for tastings and growler fills.

reviews.author: Arl P
reviews.text: Great tasting! Chris, the owner is super friendly! Brewery Ardennes had some very tasty beers available at the tasting.  Deneal did a great job explaining each tasting and he was super nice. We had a great experience down at FLX Beverage Company!

reviews.author: Bone & Bottle Reviews
reviews.text: Good location just off downtown with accessable parking. An absolute massive inventory of beer, ciders, seltzers and more. Their cider section is varied with stuff from all over NY & beyond. Their prices are fair, it's overall a great place to stock up on your favorite drinks and maybe discover a new favorite.

reviews.author: jayce green
reviews.text:
Disappointing Experience

I recently visited with high hopes of enjoying an authentic Jamaican patty, but unfortunately, my experience was a letdown. The moment I walked in, I noticed a swarm of flies buzzing around the food, which was a major red flag.

I ordered the patty, but it failed to impress. The dough was excessively thick and overpowered the filling, making it difficult to enjoy. To make matters worse, the flavor and texture were far from the authentic Jamaican patty I'm familiar with.

The price was also steep, considering the subpar quality. Overall, I was disappointed and wouldn't recommend to anyone seeking a genuine Jamaican patty experience.

*Rating:* 1/5 stars

*Recommendation:* Improve food handling and preparation to ensure a clean and authentic dining experience. Revise the recipe to achieve a more traditional Jamaican patty taste and texture.

reviews.author: susan alloway
reviews.text: Late night - 10:30pm. Worst. Don't do it. Employees arguing with each other. Pizza over done. No cheese in overcooked mozz sticks. Ithaca needs good late night food.

reviews.author: BullionTooth
reviews.text:
For those confused, the pizzeria and the restaurant that is right on top of the pizzeria on google is the exact same - you can get pizza but there are other options too.

I got the lamb and chicken over rice and it also comes with some vegetables (pictured below). Overall, it was a good amount of food and it filled my hungry self up. Cost was around $15-16, which is alright. Something that I'm not a fan of is that drinks are $2.25 each and that there are not water cups.

Service was solid - the guy behind counter seemed to be pretty chill.

Overall, you get some very solid food for a solid price but you can find better. One good thing is that this place is halal (at least according to my Muslim friends) which I know is important for some people.

reviews.author: Anastasja Moynihan
reviews.text: Ithaca’s premier breakfast and lunch location! They have a rotating menu of specials Friday-Monday that feature fresh seasonal local produce. They procure everything they can locally and make most items in house. The owners and staff really care about the community and food they serve. Everyone is friendly, accommodating and professional. They have great sandwiches - the witchwich, the Shannon, the Kara - fresh salads - omelettes - like the glorious or the Kai. Definitely check it out whether you’re just visiting the area or a local who just hasn’t made it in yet. You won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Sue Gould
reviews.text: Everything was great. The Kai omelet with kimchi and chipotle aioli was one of the best omelets I’ve ever had.  We also really liked the French toast and the cafe latte.

reviews.author: James Shealy
reviews.text:
Update:

Tried it again - spent $20 on cold gumbo (no faults with the chef - his cooking is good, just the service). I do not recommend this place; its only redeeming quality is the nice atmosphere.
______________________________________________

I've been here a few times and truly wish I could offer a better review. The food and atmosphere make this place one of the best spots to grab brunch in Ithaca. They have an ever-changing and very unique menu and the in the vibe is great.

However, I can't recommend this place purely on account of the very disorganized service. The last time I went with a group they lied to me about being able to seat us as opposed to just telling me that it would not be possible to accommodate my party (and this was not a large group where it would have made sense to call ahead). I don't mind if a place is full and can't seat any more people for the day, but I would prefer a measure of honesty about this. My group and I eventually left without ordering anything. To be very clear, the service is exemplary if you are actually able to get seated.

I don't believe that anybody individually was trying to be malicious, but it seems like there were multiple factors at work that caused this and that they seriously need to get a little better organized.

reviews.author: HOPE and Kind
reviews.text: The food was very delicious. The place is small but it had tables outside so it was not problem for us to sit and eat. Most of our meals were taken to go because we couldn't eat it all. One negative thing about this place was under staffed service. When we got there  they had only one person staff in there. She had to take phone orders, in person orders and cook all the orders-not too good business readiness. She was able to call some one and get some help. When they were two people cooking everything moved a lot faster. She had one big order before ours. Then she got our order done-- for 9 people.Halal food is always the best. I really enjoyed the food. If you like spicy food let them know so they know hot to prepare it for you, and if you are not a spicy food fan - maku sure you tell them because many sauces and side trays have spices in it. It seems like a lot of students eat or buy food from there as well. We saw a lot of young people walking around. The food prices are reasonable considering it's Halal place and it can cost more to buy the stuff. The restroom was huge but little neglected. It will be nice to keep it more cleaner - maybe they do just we ended up being there at the wrong time (under staffed) She mentioned that the other person was stuck in traffic or not feeling good- I don't remember. If I have a chance I will eat there again.

reviews.author: Shawna
reviews.text:
Wonderful food! I grabbed some take out from gateway Mediterranean. Service was great and the staff was so nice. I have a lot of ridiculous allergies and rice is one of them. It did not say in the menu that my Mediterranean shrimp came with rice. But my husband received extra rice and i will know next time to let them know of that allergy.
I definitely recommend and will be back. It was so good!

reviews.author: Mohammad Arsalanuddin
reviews.text:
My overall experience was good. I called ahead and was given a 40 min pick up time but I waited another 10 mins at the restaurant. It was only one lady taking orders and cooking so expect a long wait time.

The food itself was great. The Lebanese mix Grill was tasty. The hummus with veggies was yummy. The pita was toasted. Falafel was too dry for me and would not recommend.

reviews.author: Bald-kugo
reviews.text: Amazing burritos, but a little small for the price. I unfortunately didn't get to stay in shop to eat, but the setup was quite nice. The burritos we ordered both came in quick time , and the chef did an amazing job wrapping and packing them too. They didn't have much vegetables, other than onion which was VERY overpowering yet still quite good. It mostly consisted of beans rice and chicken. There were two sauces and the creamier one was very VERY good. This place is really nice for anyone who has a craving for Mexican food since there's not many other places like it in Ithaca, but just be prepared to spend a bit of money. The food is VERY filling and super tasty so it's definitely worth it for those who really like a good burrito.

reviews.author: Chris Petrillose
reviews.text: Dos Amigos is one of my favorite spots in Ithaca. The food is always fresh and full of flavor, the portions are great, and the staff is super friendly. It’s a perfect place for a quick bite or a casual meal with friends. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Patrick Dorsey
reviews.text: Good tacos. The fries in the burrito weren’t strained enough so it was really, really greasy. I’d recommend no fries in the burrito

reviews.author: Alexander B
reviews.text: I’ve never walked into a place and felt more at home than I did at this establishment.  What drew me in were the windows decked out in houseplants, soft lighting from the globe lights hanging amongst the ceiling, and of course the great sounding menu. The drinks were amazing and customer service could not have been better. I walked in and was immediately helped. The staff was personable, super friendly and always went out of their way to make sure I was good. If you’re looking for a lounge with great drinks, music, soft lighting and overall great vibes, you gotta check this place out. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Danielle K
reviews.text: We only had drinks but the drinks were great and all 3 bartenders on Saturday evening during apple fest were wonderful! Very pleasant and custom made a shot from a loose recipie we had, and they were so fun! The plants hanging all over made the environment sooo relaxing and chill, such a cute place. We appreciated the vibe, the banter and delicious drinks, cant wait to come back!

reviews.author: SJ
reviews.text: Used to come here a lot. I was here yesterday and enjoying my matcha latte - until I have felt something in my mouth as I take my last sip. There was this white-pinkish, hard bead thing in the drink, still no idea what that is but that thing broke between my teeth as I chewed. The lady on the counter said she has no idea and mumbled that she is sorry, and didn’t offer me any refund or redoing the drink (it was other male staff member who made my drink fyi). Didn’t ask me if I was okay at all or anything - it was a very awkward moment. Having an unidentifiable object in your drink is a food hazard? Think it will be my last visit.

reviews.author: Chris Jose
reviews.text: Chicken cutlets sandwiches were great. The flatbreads are okay and would advise if you’re studying for an exam and want to eat something quick. Great place to get smoothies as well.

reviews.author: Ray Zhou
reviews.text: Great variety but overall, the food is not that great compared to terrace, trillium, etc

reviews.author: Ben Wells
reviews.text: I come here at least 3 times per week and it’s always delicious with great vibes. Flatbreads and deli station are my personal favorites; smoothies and Starbucks are also great. Probably my favorite spot on central.

reviews.author: Blair SZ
reviews.text:
I've been eating at Ooy's for a year now.
I often order the John on gluten free bread and I usually get a Match Madness smoothie. The gluten free bread has always been soft and never had gaping holes like everywhere else. They also haven't charged me for gluten free bread ever, which I wish was a dining standard but oh well.
The food is always spot on for me. The service is always good too! Everyone is soo nice when I come in. They also always recognize me even when I drastically change my appearance.

So here's so problems people have pointed out.
The wait, I personally always go during times that aren't very busy and I don't worry about time often. HOWEVER, many people place their orders on the phone ahead of time so they can do pick up and eat outside.
The newer staff probably feel worse about the wait than you do.

Improper sandwichs: whenever something is lacking, I always go up immediately to alert someone when I'm in a restaurant. I always phrase it like, "this was probably a mistake but the egg on my sandwich is smaller than I'm used to when I get it here" 10/10 times I'm offered a remake or a discount.

Prices: if I could eat at Ooy's everyday I would but I am broke most of the time. However, I understand that the cost is due to the rising cost of living. I would much rather my local barista and cook have a livable wage than anything else. So... if I ever win the lottery, there would be signs and one of them would be eating there constantly.

reviews.author: Taylor Young
reviews.text:
Was in town looking for a good lunch spot. Most of the options in the area were restaurants. Saw this deli and it stuck out right away. I pulled up Google Maps to check the reviews and it had a pretty low rating. Most of the bad reviews were about coffee and slow service, neither of which were important to me at the time because all I wanted was a good sandwich.  So I gave them a try.

BOY DID THEY DELIVER! They had some interesting sandwiches on the menu, but I played it safe and went with the Classic Club. When it came out it I saw how big the portions were. The bread was nice and crispy and the sandwich was overall delicious. If I ever make it back I would try some of the other more exotic sandwiches.
This place is wayyyy underrated!

In response to the bad reviews: I didn’t try the coffee, but as far as service goes everyone was very nice. Slowness wasn’t an issue either, then again I was the only customer at the time.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: The sandwiches here are super tasty. I had the Rueben and it was one of the best I’ve ever had. Absolutely loaded with meat the and sauerkraut was tangy but not overpowering. The staff were really friendly and the service was top notch. This place it totally worth checking out.

reviews.author: Shruti Sinha
reviews.text: We visited here multiple times over last weekend. Food, coffee, the Mexican bagel, and ended up buying 10 different marmalade flavors to gift to friends. This 100 year old bakery has something to offer to everyone. You can spend a quality time here growing the menu, their merchandise too.

reviews.author: Sam Brannon
reviews.text: There are so many options from bagels to beverages, hot sandwiches to a cold case full of goodies. So many baked goods, and a great selection of oils and hot sauces that would make great gifts. Our food was great, everyone was friendly, and we’ll definitely stop in again when we visit the lakes.

reviews.author: Sara Catrow
reviews.text: Ithaca Bakery is a treat every once in awhile, and it has never disappointed! The food is always fresh whether it's soups or a prepared sandwich, and the breakfast sandwiches are the best in town. I love the salt rosemary bagels, and always save room for whatever vegetarian friendly soup they've got on the menu.

reviews.author: J. S.
reviews.text: Loved this place! I had the super smothered burrito and my wife ordered the taco salad. Everything was incredibly fresh and delicious. I was especially excited about the pickled carrots, they were amazing and clearly homemade. As a Mexican, my expectations were high, and this spot absolutely delivered.

reviews.author: Steve Lanys-Morris
reviews.text: Great place. Super warm and friendly, delicious homemade sauces of varying spice levels, great margaritas, enchiladas, tacos!

reviews.author: Andy Noyes
reviews.text: It's fine! My kid loves it. The food is good. Basic southwestern fair. The Cheatin Vegan Nachos are the best, no I'm not vegan in neither is the dish. The bar is fun. Lotsa tequila great margaritas, the Smokey Joint is my favorite. The old place across the street had this vibe to it that didn't quite follow them to the new spot but it's still a good spot.

reviews.author: Bill Merrill
reviews.text: Delicious food always tastes good friendly kind and helpful staff being disabled I take extra time to order the lady working behind the counter was patient and caring even offered to help me get to the table. They say you cant have Delicious food Great prices and Good staff but this place has all 3. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a bite to eat while traveling through.

reviews.author: Ken
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience Staff was really friendly and nice. Food was really good in fact 1 of the best subs I had in a while. Prices were not too bad either. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cass Fox
reviews.text: Becca at this location is the epitome of excellent customer service. She understands the difference of hospitality over service and that alone sets this establishment above all others in Ithaca because finding that type of service is very difficult. I came in with my son after spending the afternoon at UR and spending 4.5 hours in a car to order a chicken salad sub only to find out it was discontinued. Not knowing how exhausting our day was both physically and mentally instead of just telling us the item was no longer available she offered to make it by hand for my son. She not only made my son's entire day exponentially better but her kindness and compassion for the people she comes in contact with as a mother brought tears to my eyes and warmed my heart.

reviews.author: Tanya Rae Jacobs
reviews.text: I love this place so much!! Been going here every time I'm in Ithaca for 12 years now. Always delicious food, and not "American" Chinese food, but REAL Chinese food. The staff are all very friendly & accommodating, no matter your spice palette. Hands down the best Chinese restaurant in the entire southern tier & finger lakes region!

reviews.author: Dinesh Ghimire
reviews.text: Spicy Asian Kitchen was okay overall. The portion size was pretty small for the price, but the service was quick and convenient with a drive-through option. The food taste was okay.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.text: Just dropped off our daughter at college and we were hungry from all the lifting! We wanted something relatively healthy that wasn’t too heavy. Spicy Asian was great! We got fried dumplings (ok, maybe not the healthiest 😝) and were so delicious - it didn’t taste oily and they might be homemade? My husband and I shared the chicken, beef and shrimp with broccoli in garlic sauce and it was amazing. I overheard the waitress tell another table that they make their own egg rolls, so had to try that! It was very tasty (I would have preferred some meat in it but it tasted very light-perfect amount of wrapper where some places have it too thick. Excited to take my daughter here when we come visit!

reviews.author: Peggy McCrank
reviews.text: The sizes of wings provided are downright pathetic. They have a soggy texture, and a good enough sauce. For just six of them, the cost listed on the menu was an already high $6.99. When I actually ordered, it turned out that the menu I was provided with, and the actual cost was an outrageously shameless $8.45. The service was great despite this mixup, and the guy working there was real nice, throwing another two wings in. Even with this increased value the order was an utter ripoff, with the smallest wings I’ve seen in my life. I understand that not every place has great wings, but few have such high prices for so lacking wings. It’s enough to put me off D.P. Dough altogether, even if the calzones are passable.

reviews.author: David Lin
reviews.text: Ordered Big Red Zone (chicken bacon ranch) takeout in person. Still tastes pretty good after 15 min walk back to my apartment even though it's lukewarm at this point. Marinara is just the right amount for a calzone although I'd prefer a warm sauce. Menu price $10.75 already includes tax, which is nice for diverse students at Cornell.

reviews.author: Brebnan Rebb
reviews.text: they took a little nibble of my wing, I deserve it i ordered too late...

reviews.author: Sorenmy Valdez
reviews.text: Awesome shop great staff with interesting personality the coffee shop interior is smaller feels bigger on pictures but it worth checking out we got the Salted NYS Maple Latte on ice and a hot latte butterfly pea. we felt in love with the Salted Maple amazing drink!!

reviews.author: Ellie B.
reviews.text: Press makes consistently wonderful lattes. I typically order oat milk and the texture is lovely--like drinking a cloud. Best place in town for a latte, hot or iced. They also have a cute little study space and outdoor seating.

reviews.author: Andrea Erb
reviews.text: Ordered a mocha it tasted good however I was not notified when it was done. I finally went up to the counter after seeing people who came in after me get their drinks. Just to make sure I had the right drink I asked and the lady was like yeah as if I was dumb for asking. Wish I was notified as I was getting situated with my work and there were only 3 customers total.

reviews.author: Joseph Castelli
reviews.text: They have a little of everything at VERY competitive prices.  I took my Ukelele in to have a pickup installed and it was ready later the same day!  Great service and everyone is super helpful.  My go to music store from now on!

reviews.author: K C
reviews.text: I recently bought a locally made ithicaster from these guys and its one of the best playing guitars ive ever had. All the instruments where set up professionally and ready to rock right out the door and i was confident in the purchase with the 90 days of free setups. They both had all the answers to the questions I had and was able to give me a fair deal on the guitar. Overall this store is exceptional and need not change a thing.

reviews.author: Rick Waterman
reviews.text: Yesterday was my first experience with Ithaca Guitar Works and I couldn’t be happier. I went in to look at a particular guitar and the staff was friendly, helpful and very knowledgeable. All my questions were answered there was no pressure to buy. I left with my new Eastman and was given a very fair trade. I will be back for sure!

reviews.author: Joshua Dirga
reviews.text: Pho was good and the fried spring rolls were fresh and hot! Perfect for a cold day in Ithaca

reviews.author: Liana
reviews.text:
We enjoyed the food we ordered from here: Pho with rare beef and meatballs, grilled pork chop with rice, meatball soup, imperial meat rolls.

The pork chop was flavorful, however I wished it was not so greasy. It tasted like it was pan fried with a lot of oil.

Service was fast. Staffs were friendly and attentive to customers.

reviews.author: Carpio Cyprinus
reviews.text: I would say our experience was borderline decent but not great.  We got the noodle bowl with shredded pork and shredded chicken.  The chicken was entirely tasteless and seemed undercooked so we left it uneaten to be safe.  The pork was just ok.  Overall we found it dissatisfying and left looking for another place to eat.

reviews.author: Rosy
reviews.text: We ordered the West Lake beef soup and double meat with rice (roast pork and roast duck). They were both delicious and great portions for two. The restaurant is nice and clean with aesthetic decor. I would recommend this restaurant for anyone who enjoys cozy chinese food for dinner.

reviews.author: F S
reviews.text: Food is decent. Service is good but didn’t appreciate that they automatically added tip (we have less than six people) and didn’t tell us.

reviews.author: Sarah Bogdan
reviews.text:
Looking forward to trying more dishes! Love the size of the chicken pieces in the pepper chili chicken dish— perfect amount of meat with a little crunch, and the cilantro is tasty. I think more flavor from added garlic would add depth and be great; it’s sized and cooked well but the flavor is just chili and cilantro. 辣子鸡很好吃但需要加大蒜来增加味道。
Overall impressed by their menu.

reviews.author: Thomas Robinson
reviews.text:
