Are you ready to sit down on a cold day and drink some hot sake with a little fresh sushi?
Osaka is a great place to check out.
Conveniently located on the mall in downtown Ithaca. There are parking garages near by if you can't get a street spot. Parking is free on the weekends and holidays.
A warm and welcoming little shop. The attentive staff had our drinks and appetizers within moments.
The gyoza was crispy and savory. I enjoyed the edamame as well. Their beef bulgogi was an interesting take. The shaved steak and copious onions in a light sauce, not too thickened with sugar.
I enjoyed their sushi sashimi dinner combo. The miso soup was hot and well balanced. Instead of house salad I opted for some seaweed. The bowl was huge! Lightly seasoned and crunchy, so tasty.
The sushi cuts were appropriate sized, quite cold and trimmed well. The sashimi rice was the correct texture and just the right amount of vinegar.
Apparently the soy sauce is all slow sodium, but you could ask for regular. They have a decent selection of desserts too.
I was happy that I popped in on a whim. Check out Osaka today. For a rural town in the middle of upstate New York, the sushi ain't bad and the service is great. Thank you Osaka for a lovely little lunch on a snowy day.

reviews.author: Ella Armstrong
reviews.text: I haven’t been able to find a great sushi place in Ithaca… until now! The service was lovely and the food was SO delicious. The salmon, unagi, yellowtail, and tuna we tried tasted so fresh. The prices weren’t too bad either. Will definitely be returning here soon and recommending to all my friends!

reviews.author: Ethan Roche
reviews.text:
Water took 20 minutes to get
Sushi was unedible.  So bland and blah yucky in my tummy yum seriously
House salad lettuce was rancid
Never had trouble finishing a plate but here we are people
It’s good if you are on a diet because you won’t want to eat food again

reviews.author: Amanda Gorges
reviews.text:
Food was great and the portions were large. I was also surprised with how much sauce accompanied the Greek fries. The two paired up really well together especially with the seasoning on the fries and they sauce.

The staff was also really kind. They were very attentive. Only small thing is that I wished all of our meals would come out together instead of each dish coming out one by one.

reviews.author: LL C
reviews.text: My Cornell alum boyfriend came here to see if this place had stood the test of time. Happy to say that it was great! Got the steak pizzaiola and a gyro. We were very pleased. Thanks for the lovely time!

reviews.author: Nancy Lauten
reviews.text: The Chicken Souvlaki platter was perfectly chargrilled to order and had a big soft pita wrap. The salad was chopped up well and the vinaigrette dressing was light and lemony. It’s a huge amount of food for one so I have some leftover for tomorrow. And I absolutely Love the Tzatziki sauce and got a generous side portion of that. Satiated.

reviews.author: Rain W
reviews.text: It was delicious food and it came out quick! We didn't get anyone coming by to refill waters during the meal and we were there for about an hour, but there was a big party going on so it was understandable. Very much reccomend, it was a good night out! Its definitely a bit expensive but for the quality and amount you get I would certainly say it's worth it.

reviews.author: Angelina Estevane
reviews.text: Went there to eat as a family. The place was not too crowded and our table got us comfortably. We were near the sushi station which was nice as we did order some rolls. We got appetizers including the fried chicken and potatoes and some ramen and udon bowls too.

reviews.author: Marion NYC
reviews.text: The service was very friendly.  The location needs a makeover.  The food was a bit overpriced for the quality.  Food was just okay but not bad.  I think this place might be better when the students are back and it’s busier.  If you’re really craving Japanese food and in the area then stop over for a quick bite!  Might be better for their lunch special!

reviews.author: Daniel Filler
reviews.text: Just across a gorgeous from the Cornell campus, Utea has a shockingly diverse selection of sweet Asian beverages. Although I've had Boba before, Utea was the first place I encountered many of their more foreign menu items. If you're in the mood for a sweet drink, exotic (by American standards) flavors, and a relaxing vibe, then Utea is for you. If you happen to be a Boba connoisseur, you may be a tad bit disappointed.

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.text:
I love this place! I always get their brûlée bubble milk tea and it is always delicious! I think they use condense milk? Anyways it tastes so sweet and I love it. I have also not been able to find replica elsewhere that is as tasty, so it’s something I look forward to getting when I’m here.

The service was prompt. We went when it was not busy so we ordered and got our drinks immediately.

The interior is also quite nice. It’s clean and minimalistic with friendly blue walls. There’s also board games in the back so it’s a great place to hang with friends.

reviews.author: Ivanna Kaleniuk
reviews.text:
It’s okay bubble tea. I’ve tried better but there is not that many options of boba in Ithaca and this one is decent one that we’ve tried

Place was empty when we visited in July but I guess that it’s focused on students so it makes sense that it’s empty during summer

reviews.author: Ariana
reviews.text: Really good, fresh and thick açaí bowls. I will say the cafe is rather small with only two tables but everything else is great! I recommend if ur in the mood for a quick grab of coffee or bowls.

reviews.author: kk_ds
reviews.text: Been coming here for a while now, the acai bowls have gotten me through some of my worst college days! I recommend the Par-yay bowl, it’s sooososo good

reviews.author: Seahorse Sally
reviews.text: Really cute coffee/acai/juice shop!! They make their acai base fresh each day and also make their own clean granola! The staff was very nice as well. I got a detox juice and the breakfast at tiffanys acai bowl! It was really good and hit the soot on a warm day.

reviews.author: Mi Murakami
reviews.text:
Been here several times! They used to add 15% tips automatically but they don’t do that anymore.

Food is awesome! I like the Wok chicken&chillies, Yellow Bovine something, Shredded potatoes, and Sautéed eggs &tomatoes

It’s underground so I didn’t expect it to be fancy or anything in the first place.

Service is okay. They serve complimentary fruits before checking out. 🍊

reviews.author: L C
reviews.text:
First off, I will say for authenticity, the food is pretty good. I ordered the fish dry hot pot, my wife ordered a spicy beef stew. Both dishes were excellent. The food was also served fast, which was also nice. But that was about the only good thing.

Food is not enough to make me want to come back. The service was non-existent. Aside from bringing us the menus and the food, they did literally nothing. When we asked for the drink menu, they pointed to a cooler near us, and said help yourself.

Mind you, there are two ladies doing the ordering and bringing the food, a chef cooking ..and several grown men sitting around talking to each other or playing on their phones. Not cleaning, not organizing, not bringing the food or asking about the service. That is why the place had zero customers aside from us.

When we were there, only two take out orders, and no dine-in customers.

Also, rice should be a given. I should not have to order it separately or find someone and ask for it. Also, when my wife says not to make very spicy, that doesn't mean "throw as much pepper as you can on top, and dose it with a whole bottle of chili sauce".

The worst service I have ever had in a restaurant, worldwide.

If they can fix that, and add more lights, and add more traditional Chinese decor, they can make money. The food is excellent, just need to touch up the environment and actually have people working there. Very lazy people working there, and you can thank the four guys sitting and playing on their phones who should be working. Get off your butts and clean the place and add new lights.

If you want to force a 15% tip on the bill, at least provide an actual service.

reviews.author: Monica
reviews.text:
Wow I was really impressed by this place! All the dishes we ordered were delicious. I especially love the lamb dish and the pork belly dish was also good. The string beans were also really flavorful.

We went during a weekday for an early dinner in the summer so there wasn’t a lot of people and the service was prompt and the food came out fast.

The restaurant itself is at the bottom of some stairs so you might miss it if you’re not looking for it. The inside has lots of seating and it feels like your typical Chinese restaurant with a somewhat of a dark interior.

reviews.author: Willie Will
reviews.text: I enjoy coming to the firehouse sub shop great food, great company good people and affordable pricing. Everybody should come here at least once a month or more enjoy.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.text: First time trying this spot out. Was in a time scrunch for something quick last week and figured I try it out. Went with a French Dip sandwich and it was spectacular. Will be back

reviews.author: Realtor Kippen
reviews.text:
This place has since come under new ownership and you can tell the difference! You’re greeted with a smiling face & a ‘welcome to firehouse subs’ upon entering. I ordered the Steak & Cheese sub which was incredible! Cooked perfectly & had the perfect meat/cheese/veggie ratio. And let’s not forget to mention, it was enormous! The atmosphere is casual & sit down friendly although I got my order to go which came out super quick! Will definitely be back! 10/10

PS-did not get a chance to take a picture before digging in, it looked and smelt too good!

reviews.author: Thomas Chia
reviews.text: This restaurant does not honor their promises. They have a game where if you hit the timer at 10 seconds they remove one item off the bill. I won it and they refused to honor it. Instead they offered to give me a soda. 😂

reviews.author: P E A C E !
reviews.text: The jjajangmyeon was good, but I was full from the naengmyeon, so I only had three bites. I took it home and my mom finished the rest, so I hope to actually have a whole bowl of jjajangmyeon next time.

reviews.author: Merrill Shen
reviews.text: Worth it! Love that they use authentic noodles that have the right amount of bounciness, with their flavourful soup that’s packed with ingredients. With the large portions, it definitely makes the meal worth while for hungry days. Will definitely be back for more of their jjampong!

reviews.author: Alison Manchester
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our dinner at Four Seasons. I was a bit hesitant since I'm gluten free. The staff were very friendly & informed, leading me to 2 of the stews that don't have soy sauce or gluten. I got the spicy fish stew which was flavorful & filling. The staff were considerate to warn me about other things I should not eat but brought me extra veggies. Not a ton of choices for GF but authentic & flavorful, we will go back!

reviews.author: 友人B
reviews.text: Terrible experience. Never try their chicken and bibimbab, awful and always dry. Their customer service is awful and Id never come again. The carrots and vegetables are not fresh and tteokbokki is not standard.

reviews.author: Joshua Dirga
reviews.text: Four seasons is good college town spot with huge portions. Can be a bit crowded sometimes but the staff is always friendly and quick. The dolost bimbimbap was food, though a tiny bit salty. I enjoyed the spicy tofu side dish as well as the kimchi side dish. The seafood pajun (pancakes) was also delicious. Got the kalbi box for dinner and it was great, perfect seasoning and marinate. Can be a bit pricy depending on what you order. Would recommend the soups here!

reviews.author: Jeff Burnett
reviews.text:
After having a disasterous experience with another Ithaca florist, who pushed our phone call to one of the international services. We called Michaleen’s to save the day.  They did!

When the phone rang, it was answered by someone who was actually in the florist shop. A rare occurrence these days….

The employee who took our order was polite, professional and spoke clearly.  She understood what we wanted and what our delivery requirements were.  The arrangement was beautiful and arrived when promised.

We recommend Michaleen’s highly for anyone who values top notch personal service.

reviews.author: Lizzy TenWolde
reviews.text: Michaleen’s always goes above and beyond with everything they do. I love knowing that even though I now live across the globe, I can still count on this incredible shop to deliver the most beautiful, fresh, and unique floral arrangements with thoughtful touches down to the very last detail to local family and friends. I will always choose Michaleen’s over larger, commercial floral delivery services! Thank you again for yet another beautiful birthday bouquet delivered with care.

reviews.author: Garrett Taylor
reviews.text:
This place is amazing. First, their selection of plants, pots, and other stuff is great. A wide range of plants with plenty of size variety for whatever it is you are looking for. The store is also gorgeous and is enjoyable to just wander.

But the analyzing just the store undersells it. When you buy a plant from here, you are also getting remarkable service. Any time that I have a concern or question about my plants they are eager to help, give advice, and lend a hand. Their costs for repotting or other services like fixing damaged roots are almost zero. I cannot recommend enough.

reviews.author: Alexis Abramo
reviews.text: When Dr. Duthie was there, our experience was always fantastic. We met him as part of the cleft palate team when our child was just a toddler and checked in with him periodically through the years. He was so knowledgeable and supportive. The techs were great. The office staff was great. When Dr. Duthie left things started to deteriorate and have gone from bad to downright appalling. They don't even answer the phone or respond to messages anymore. We are going to have to change practices in order to manage our child's cleft care with a responsive and knowledgeable provider.

reviews.author: Sara Couchman
reviews.text: My sons have been patients there for years. It was great in the beginning when my oldest started and Dr Duthie was working. Over the last two years, the customer service as been very poor. Good luck getting someone to answer the phone and/or return your phone call. The office in Auburn has declined tremendously with wait times up to an hour after your scheduled appt. I have given them the benefit of the doubt for months but I am at a point that I would no longer recommend either office for their lack of patient care and turn over rate of Doctors (which I feel has prolonged my sons treatment)

reviews.author: Rachel Nilsson
reviews.text: It's a shame to see the practice Dr. Duthie built deteriorate so spectacularly under new ownership. If you are reading this as a prospective patient, it's not too late for you. Turn back. Find a practice with caring, competent doctors and staff who regard you as a human being with thoughts and feelings. The professionalism, skilled care, and operational efficiency that characterized Dr. Duthie's practice have been erased. What remains for me is a bitter self-loathing at having committed a second kid, not to mention thousands more of my hard-earned dollars, to the tattered remnants of this practice. This place is like an AI version of an orthodontist. If you don't look too closely, it's a reasonable approximation, but upon closer inspection, it is actually quite bonkers. Give your money to someone else.

reviews.author: Madeeha Ahmed
reviews.text: Beautiful views. Lots of benches for you to sit and enjoy.

reviews.author: Tomáš Gregor
reviews.text: Very nice spot with a cool manual bell.

reviews.author: Jennifer Browning
reviews.text: Very beautiful overlook of the campus botanical gardens

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.text: Parking with the best view in Tompkins county.

reviews.author: Jesse Bush
reviews.text: So very beautiful.

reviews.author: Marianne Couch
reviews.text: Its a rest stop to pull over and if you look real hard over the buildings and foliage you can see Cayuga lake.

reviews.author: Mandy Painter
reviews.text: The food here is always good. They have the best sauces (including ranch and blue cheese). The staff is wonderful too. Perfect business for a college town, yet still a great place for your family to grab food from as well!! Always a must stop when we are going through Ithaca!!

reviews.author: Ali Jumabhoy
reviews.text: The wings here are good and there are a lot of flavour options. The staff are friendly and helpful. Very decent for its price.

reviews.author: Vladimir Packard
reviews.text: Absolutely wicked chicken, yo. Went on a frolicking adventure when I got wings ordered from this spot. The delivery person from the restaurant rightfully had no idea where the entrance for this apartment building I was staying at was since there were like 5-6 entrances. I don't blame them!! I barely knew where it was! I went on an adventure hunting down my wings, going across the apartment building, built on a steep hill, and I ended up watching the sunset next to an old fence on a wooded hill with a guy ripping a bong. Then I ended up slipping in oil (!!!!) and getting a bit lost. It sounds stressful but I had so much fun. I called and talked to the delivery person a few times and they would give me little clues since they didn't know the apartment building that well, either, and it was such an unorthodox fun time. This is more of a review of that apartment building's very poor structure, but the delivery person who brought the food was so nice and fun and made what would otherwise be a stressful situation into a silly story to tell, many of the details omitted for the sake of your sanity and mine. When I finally found the delivered food, at one of the five or six entrances, I sat down then and there and had some of the best chicken I ever had. Absolutely recommend. You may not have an adventure, but the chicken will make you feel like you did regardless cuz it's just that good.

reviews.author: Lilly Lou
reviews.text: Always happy to shop here, great variety. Recently found this amazing pickle mustard. Perfect for pickle lovers like me.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Braymen
reviews.text: Locally: The people working there are great. On a national chain level:  Who doesn't love the products! BUT they get only four stars because they need to cut back on all the plastic. I shop there less and less due to over-packaging.

reviews.author: Jae Rae
reviews.text: We were shopping in Ithaca,  NY and remembered that they have a Trader Joe's. Of course, we had to stop in. I bought fabulous Linzer cookies and the spreadable cheese they were sampling that day and my favorite frozen Quiche Lorraine. All so yummy I will make a special trip there just for them. Everyone is helpful and cheerful, making it a very pleasant experience. We thought the pricing was good for the quality of their food items, too. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sheíla R.D.
reviews.text:
My son and I enjoyed a nice dinner here recently 12/24/2025. Myhoa was very accommodating with both my son and our meals. Assured me everything could be altered basically too for our vegan lifestyle. Ordered vegetable tempura - wouldn't again. Greasy, deep fried. But I did love the variety of vegetables. Carrots, sweet potatoe, broccoli, cauliflower, eggplant from what I could recall. My son had the Thai fried rice - no egg, but tofu instead. I had the "cashew chicken," meal - no dead animal / flesh for me. Tofu complimented that really well. Menh was the first person we met upon arrival, somewhat reserved but no issues.  Cha assisted in bringing out meals from the kitchen & checked in once. Friendly staff. The portion size for the food and the amount of money as others have mentioned here doesn't equate. Please work on this.  But it doesn't hurt to ask for more either. Thank you for accommodating us Myhoa. Very outgoing and sweet loving motherly soul. We had a pleasant trip. Thanks everyone bts as well especially the chef/chefs, cleaning crew. You all matter. Accepts Apple Pay, in addition to traditional methods of payments.

God Bless
We'll see you again if The Lord permits.

reviews.author: Fernando Graham
reviews.text: I visited Ithaca, and was recommended this place. First of all, I really liked the food. It can feel unhealthy, but the amount of spiciness and savory really was close to my likings. Who eats Thai to be healthy anyway. However, the portions were pretty small for the price. Thinking it as a restaurant in a "collegetown" I think it needs to be considering the value, as students need to eat.

reviews.author: Srividhya Murali
reviews.text: One of the Thai restaurant that is open 365 days a year was something very different when the waiter told us so. We waited for some time to get seated as the restaurant was quite busy and eventually service was little late. We ordered few curries and rice - everything we tasted was good except the massaman curry which was very unusual in taste than the ones we have had. We have had much much better massaman curry in other restaurants. The pineapple fried rice was also a little let down as it was too sweet and soggy more like Indian Kashmiri Pulao. The Spring rolls, Fried Tofu , green curry, yellow curry , spicy fried rice we’re all really good.

reviews.author: Eric Fenchel
reviews.text:
Under “new management “ ( Triphammer Mall Cleaners)
Recently purchased and are an excellent place to have alterations with fabulously affordable prices.
I needed my heavy-duty winter coat repaired (zipper was not functional) and it was addressed
And at a cost less than a BLT sandwich!
Thanks a bunch and now I’m as “warm as toast”

reviews.author: LunaY_Yuki ;P
reviews.text: I was originally unsure because of some of the negative reviews (e.g., about prices). However, my first visit with them was quite smooth and positive! The staff were kind and helpful. I got my clothes back after 3 days, costing $10 for dry cleaning a suit jacket and $30 for a long down jacket. Personally, I think the price is quite reasonable!

reviews.author: Daniel Carroll
reviews.text: This place is great but it is pretty much only open while everyone is working. Would be nice to have even just 1 hour after work to get dry cleaning done. The place closes right at 5pm.

reviews.author: Ash B
reviews.text:
GREAT WITH CELIAC DISEASE!!!!

Don’t let the “beer co” fool you - this is a fried food dream for celiacs! All of their breading use corn flour so all of the fryers are always GF. I went with two celiac, two non- and they could not taste the difference. As someone who grew up loving buffalo chicken fingers, it’s a loss not to have them.

They also have ciders to drink!

Would absolutely recommend! Delicious and safe!

reviews.author: Melissa S.
reviews.text: PLEASE BEING THE CHEDDAR ALE SOUP BACK!!!  I love this place, and I always take guests here, especially the beer lovers! I don't drink beer, but I LOVE their fresh root beer on tap. Sometimes, I order a shot of vodka and add it to my root beer. The food is so delicious and locally derived. You can sit outside and enjoy the gorgeous view, or sit in the air conditioning inside. It's a fun atmosphere. Update: We had Meredith as our server, and she was so sweet and helpful. We ate the burger, grilled cheese, fry flight, cheddar ale soup, and chicken sandwich. All food was delicious! Update: the seasonal beet salad with chicken is amazing!

reviews.author: Tom L
reviews.text:
Nestled in the rolling hills of the Finger Lakes, Ithaca Beer Company stands as both a local treasure and a destination worth the trip for anyone who appreciates good beer, good food, and a welcoming atmosphere.
On approach to you see some facility buildings, turn right and the actual brewery stands. On my recent visit, I found that this brewery blends the best of small-town charm with a level of quality and professionalism you might expect from a nationally known craft brand.
Just outside of downtown Ithaca, the brewery feels tucked away in the countryside. Surrounded by greenery and open skies, it offers an inviting mix of rustic comfort and modern design. The building itself is spacious and airy, with a farmhouse-inspired aesthetic that reflects the region’s agricultural roots. A large outdoor beer garden with picnic tables, string lights, and plenty of room to spread out immediately set the tone for a relaxing afternoon.
Inside, the atmosphere was equally welcoming. The taproom is bright, lively, and buzzing with conversation. Staff were attentive and genuinely friendly, creating an easygoing environment where both locals and visitors felt equally at home.
Of course, the star of the show is the beer. Ithaca Beer Company has been around since the late 1990s and is best known for its flagship Flower Power IPA; which was excellent. I made sure to try it fresh on draft, and it did not disappoint—bright, citrusy hops balanced by a malty backbone that made it as approachable as it was flavorful. Beyond Flower Power, the tap list offered an impressive variety: crisp lagers, hazy IPAs, sours, and seasonal drafts.
Ithaca Beer Company offers a little bit of everything: expertly brewed beer, delicious food, friendly service, and a setting that encourages you to slow down and savor the moment. Whether you’re a craft beer enthusiast making a pilgrimage or simply someone looking for a great spot to relax with friends, this place delivers.
A must-visit locale!

reviews.author: Inés Pérez Osorio
reviews.text: It was a surprise to visit this amazing store!! You can find even the unexpected artist and albums. Truly recommend it

reviews.author: Brandon Gates
reviews.text: A great record store. I am lucky to have about 5 or 6 really good record stores within a hour of where I live. This is the place for some more obscure stuff and jazz.

reviews.author: Dakota
reviews.text: I always find something that I’m looking for here. Whenever I stop here, I am not disappointed. Great prices, wonderful selection, and beautiful quality of records. This was my first visit to the upstairs rather than the basement. There is lots of room with space for more records with a wider variety to display. I am always very appreciative that they are spinning records behind the counter while I browse, most notably one of my favorites Bob Dylan. Thank you Angry Mom! It’s always a pleasure stopping in and I’m sure it won’t be long until I walk back through the doors again.

reviews.author: tavers
reviews.text:
A convenient location on campus for a coffee fix. Generally has long wait lines, especially after the lectures finish. The coffee isn't the best. The drip coffee tasted burnt 2/3 times, latte didn't taste that good for 6 dollars. Matcha was decent. Croissant lacked the layered pastry texture, being more dense and chewy rather than light and flaky.
They have a wide range of gimme coffee beans, brewers, merch, and a selection of grab an go refrigerated drinks, yogurt cups, energy bars and chocolates.
Unfortunately I feel the place is understaffed, and they need larger area to keep up with the demand. Most times I found the barista taking orders to be tired and overwhelmed. I hope they can improve the workspace and staff to deliver consistent and better quality.

reviews.author: S W
reviews.text: It is kind of super over priced (especially the pastries) but the employees are awesome! They get swamped and there’s a little bit of a wait at peak students-in-Gates hours but they do an awesome job regardless.

reviews.author: Steve Pacenka
reviews.text: Gimme always makes a great cappuccino uning their own perfectly roasted "leftist" beans blend.  I walk a mile to one of their sites a couple of days per week to break up my workdays.

reviews.author: Rarara
reviews.text: I’ve attended Cornell and frequented this store for over two years. On my last visit I was stopped by a middle aged white employee (i am brown) accused of taking merchandise into the restroom. After I clarified I had already purchased the T shirt I was taking in, the employee asked “What about the bag?” Referring to my school bag in an aggressive tone. My Nike school bag was bright orange, has been used for over 2 years, and most importantly, wasn’t even sold at the store. It had multiple pins and a keychain identifying it as a personal item. This bag has never been sold at this store, I’m just a non white student going to the restroom. It is disappointing to face such racial based micro aggressions. I have otherwise only had good experiences at this store and most of the staff are extremely nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Kurt Althoff
reviews.text: Three cheers for Linda! I couldn't find a particular item on their website so I called and luckily got a hold of a very helpful human. She was extremely familiar with the inventory and thought it may be on the clearance rack and no longer on the website. She contacted the storefront, found the item and took my order over the phone. You cannot ask for better customer service! Please give her a raise and a promotion. Go Bears!

reviews.author: Venice L.
reviews.text:
I haven’t been here in three years. I remember back then, the store wasn’t as big as it is now. They’ve done a great job renovating and expanding. There are more clothing options, though some are still of poor quality.

What I really like is how they’ve designed the space to connect the store with the post office and the coffee study area. I think it’s a brilliant idea.

reviews.author: Laura K
reviews.text: The Falls Wine Room is my absolute favorite boutique wine shop in Ithaca, NY -- and the entire central state region. Every single selection is special, and there's something for everyone whether you're looking for a lesser-known bottle of Champagne to celebrate a special occasion or a solid box of cheap and tasty wine. The Falls Wine Room has got you covered . I can't recommend Falls Wine Room enough. Browsing the collection is a magical experience. Cheers!

reviews.author: Garrett Venuto
reviews.text: Best wine store in Ithaca! Chip is very knowledgeable as well as a great person. They have the best curated wine selection, which includes many wines from around the world that you can’t find at many wine stores.

reviews.author: camilo nascimento
reviews.text: Best wine and spirits store in Ithaca. They care about their customers and are very knowledgeable about their product. Chip consistently recommends the best wine for any occasion, always on point!

reviews.author: Stephanie Holbrook
reviews.text:
Hidden gem basement level feels like starting your own odyssey. Beautifully lit and great structure. Very helpful cashier gave us information on other local bookstores as they didn’t have the one we were looking for. I ended up getting a recommended book though and am happy with the find. Loved the free stickers and quality bookmarks.
Difficult to access for those with walking disabilities.

reviews.author: Tayna Labissiere
reviews.text: As you walk down the walkway and into the store, you already know you are going to have a serene experience. The workers are amiable and are ready to help you find the book, or rather your next adventure. From poetry to nonfiction, children’s books to the classics, you’ll find what you’re looking for, and maybe some thing you didn’t know you needed. There are even sitting areas for you to begin to explore whatever book you desire. Enjoy 💕

reviews.author: Savvy
reviews.text:
One of my absolute favorite spots in Ithaca! Odyssey Bookstore is cute, cozy, and perfectly cramped in the best way a true bookstore should be. The shelves are overflowing with incredible reads, many of which I haven’t been able to find anywhere else, yet Odyssey always has them.

The staff are wonderfully thoughtful and helpful, and ordering books through them has always been quick and easy. I’ve received every special order within a week. It’s the perfect place for a quiet afternoon of browsing and soaking in that warm, bookish charm. Truly my favorite store in Ithaca!

reviews.author: Matt Thornton
reviews.text: Great owners and amazing hand made pies. We ordered 2 sausage rolls and 2 irish mutton the night before (to ensure they had them) and collected just after noon today. They were freshly baked and oh so full of amazing flavors, awesome pastry and fillings. Please support this amazing little start up bakery.

reviews.author: Seraphina
reviews.text:
A friend suggested this place for good hand pies. She was not kidding.  They are absolutely delicious. I only had the sweet pies,  but there was a nice variety of savory ones as well.

There is a handicap parking spot close to the building off the street.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.text: What a gem! These pies were fantastic. Everything was freshly prepared and hot! Service was quick and friendly. Potato and cheddar was a favorite. I really enjoyed the blueberry pie as well. I will certainly be back! One of the best stops in Ithaca.

reviews.text: All the delivery guys are outstanding but a big shoutout for Mike he helped me in so many ways I didn’t know also just so pleasant

reviews.text: Always feel very safe, heard, and respected here. Have helped me multiple times where other OBGYNs have failed. Appointments can be long on a busy day, but everyone is so nice and transparent about it. I drive an hour to go here rather than any local Binghamton/Vestal OBGYNs because they are that good!

reviews.author: Sarah Alta
reviews.text: I've never waited long to be seen here, and their staff is always friendly and knowledgeable. They work on a sliding fee scale of need be, and work with many insurances.

reviews.author: CJ
reviews.text: I can’t even describe how good of an experience I had here. I drove over an hour to come to this specific Planned Parenthood, and I am so glad that I did. I came here for gender-affirming care and everyone was excellent, respectful, and kind, from the desk staff to the doctors and nurses. They treated me like a human being and listened to me and spent time explaining everything to me. I would 100% recommend this office to everyone.

reviews.author: Tami Barrows
reviews.text: This place is clean and all the machines work and are fast. Quarter machine works. There's a vending machine which is nice. There is ample parking. It's not usually too busy. I paid 3.25 per regular washer load and the dryer was 1.00 and only ran for 30 minutes and dried my clothes. I was surprised they dried that fast. I was a bit disappointed by the fact that if you are stuck there washing your clothes you should be able to plug your laptop in. There is a table and chair to sit in but no where to plug in your laptop or even your phone. I did finally find one plug in and they had it covered and LOCKED!  Definitely no wifi which I would have been ok with using my hotspot with my laptop but my laptop doesn't last very long without being plugged in. Also there is no bathroom so you are sol if you need to go while you wait. However I'm going to give 4 stars out of five because it has plenty of washers and dryers and they all were in good working condition and the place was clean.

reviews.author: Aspen Ouellet
reviews.text: washers and dryers are overpriced while still leaving clothes dirty. owner is incredibly rude -- she will yell at you if you're doing anything. Plus, there are always passive-aggressive notes around the laundromat from her on the door, the bulletin board, and on machines. take your business elsewhere! The laundromat on Lincoln St is priced fairly, spacious, and you won't get barked at.

reviews.author: London Kelly
reviews.text: They usually have just wat you're looking for.. items in every price range and the staff.. a1

reviews.author: Christopher Smoker
reviews.text: What an absolute gem! Went for my first time, got immediate and respectful assistance when asked for. Definitely going again! Very helpful for those with visual impairments.

reviews.author: D H
reviews.text: Large variety, affordable prices, great customer service…

reviews.author: Nick Polisi

reviews.author: Steve Mulloy
reviews.text: Very comprehensive selection of wines and liquors.   Super helpful staff.  Lots of free parking and convenient to central Ithaca.

reviews.author: Heath Robinson
reviews.text:
The most extensive wine and liquor selection in the Ithaca area.

Lovely French wine selection and great scotch options.

Seriously, if you are trying to become cultured(🤚) and learn wines (🤚) and started.with wines from France (🤚) then you can walk your way through the major wine regions of France here. One of the best Chinon's I have ever found, as well as this Corbières below (those last two words are fun to say, huh? Anyway).

True story- my friends from the city ( humble brag) always buy liquor and bring back to the big apple because of the selection and price. If you are in Ithaca and need libations- here is a food start.

reviews.author: Selina
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite places to grab a quick lunch in Ithaca. I get off at 3 and there is always practically no line or wait when I go through the drive through. The supreme luxe box is a great deal and you know you gotta get the Baja blast with it. I have yet to have a bad experience ordering here although on my most recent visit there was no napkins given with my order which was a bit disappointing. Overall I’d say this is a great place to get a quick yummy meal.

reviews.author: Taz Foreman
reviews.text: If I could write a zero I honestly would. The quesadilla on the right is the first one I was given, cold to the touch and cheese not even melted. I pull up to the drive thru window very nicely, and the server said they’d make me another one so I pulled around to let people behind me get their food. On my THIRD TIME AROUND, I was given the quesadilla on the left. Absolutely disgusting, go to the triphammer location, this is wildly disappointing after a 12hr school day.

reviews.author: Sarah Jorgensen
reviews.text: This is the worst Taco Bell I’ve ever been to. There’s poor management which is one of the reason they’re short-staffed. I ordered ahead online to skip the line, but ended up waiting 35 minutes for my order to even be acknowledged. Mind you, there were plenty of employees to be managing the lobby and the drive thru. After 20 minutes of waiting for my food at my seat, I decided to see what the hold up was. I waited at the counter for 5 minutes before I was being acknowledged, even though the manager made eye contact with me, and the other employees were swearing out the window without a care in the world. And when my order was ready, after 35 minutes, they slapped on the mobile order pickup table without apologizing for the wait or even sealing my order off with a sticker to ensure safe eating. I warned other customers to not even bother with their time. This Taco Bell does not respect their customers and I am deeply disappointed with their service. Don’t go here if you’re willing to wait 30minutes to an hour for “fast food.” You could enjoy a nice sit down meal with the amount of time it took for us to even be acknowledged. Go spend your money and time elsewhere!

reviews.author: Colleen Lyerla
reviews.text: Kimi has been doing my family’s hair for well over a year and is wonderful. The color always looks great, cuts are beautiful, and she’s taught me how to manage my curly hair as well. We’re so grateful to have found her!

reviews.author: Kerry Anne Buckman
reviews.text: Kimi did my hair and makeup for this Halloween look and did such an amazing job!!! It held great for the whole night (and the next day too. I may have slept in it because I had more Halloween events the next day😭 lol). She was so nice and professional and happy to work with me to make sure things turned out exactly how I wanted. The appointment was so chill and fun and I definitely recommend Kimi/Ulta in the future!

reviews.author: abby glick
reviews.text: Caren absolutely botched my hair so terribly bad. Like BAD BAD BAD. Picture attached. The staff at Ulta was so kind and held my hands and told me that it was a hot mess but they would fix it! Nick fixed my hair as best he could (not much he could do) even while doing his own clients hair. The whole thing was free and the managerial staff was awesome but don't get your hair cut here. Well except Nicks probably good if your hair doesn't start out as botched!

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Stellar place! A clean, neat restaurant. Conveniently located in downtown Ithaca in a strip mall with plenty of free parking. The food tasted wonderfully and was served quickly. Good prices. The staff was fantastic--Dom, Taliq, Tyhga, and Zachryan all did a fabulous job taking care of me. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Evan Ogata
reviews.text: Five Guys consistently delivers a quality experience that feels both familiar and special. The all‑beef burgers are juicy and cooked just right, topped with perfectly grilled onions and fresh ingredients that speak for themselves. Even the fries stand out—cut from Idaho potatoes, bringing a taste of the Rocky Mountain West to every tray. It’s straightforward, honest food done well, the kind of coast‑to‑coast comfort that reminds you why classics endure from sea to shining sea.

reviews.author: Doug Hatch
reviews.text: Little cheeseburger and small fry.  Fries tasted good as usual but had the bottom of the bin crispies mixed in what was 60%good fries. Burger was well made and satisfying.  Staff there was lively and efficient.  Seems every time I go there it gets more expensive though.

reviews.author: Jonathon Edwards
reviews.text: Superior customer service and the quality of work is second to none. Topped with incredible lead times. Highly recommend Incodema for all your sheet metal prototyping needs.

reviews.author: carey tucker
reviews.text: Supporting a local artist. Thanks guys! Also it looks like they do some high quality machining here.

reviews.author: Jorge Vila
reviews.text: Excellent place to study and work! The personal is very skilled and friendly. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: CalleJorgeAntonio101
reviews.text:
Olin Library is a solid university library. It's home to many books, study rooms, and is an overall great spot for studying!

An interesting fact about Olin Library is that it was built in 1959 to accommodate the university' growing collections. Consequently, the university demolished Boardman Hall in the process, which was the university's ornate Law Library before the construction of the Law Quad.

While it's sad that Cornell lost one of its prettiest buildings, Olin Library nevertheless is a solid study spot.

reviews.author: Nicholas Foster
reviews.text: Paper is the BEST form of communication ISI STAXX

reviews.author: Tiana DeVille
reviews.text: I'm sorry I know the store has a lot of positive reviews but personally I'm not impressed. Because my dad went in there to buy hand towels and he ended up grabbing washcloths instead because they were in the hand towel pile.

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text:
I always find what I'm looking for. The aisles have been more neater than usual as well. Workers are kind and friendly.
I can easily find what I'm looking for.

I mostly come here to get my arts and crafts supplies, great selection of canvases and acrylic paints. I recommend stopping in for that sort of thing, and there's a great selection for kids as well. And I have bought a pair of socks before because I needed them and wanted to see how bad it would be due to the cheap price but the socks are great, they haven't ripped yet either.

reviews.author: Adam Schotz
reviews.text: Most Dollar Tree stores in this area are kept reasonably clean, well-stacked and organized.  This one (in Ithaca, at the Cayuga Shopping Center) is certainly no exception!  AND, the staff is very friendly and polite.  We also like the one in Cortland.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.text: I had an unpleasant first time experience with the receptionist and the provider. I arrived 1 minute past the grace period for my appointment, which I know would justify the appointment being cancelled, but that wasn’t my issue. Basically, I had to wait a couple minutes until the receptionist was off the phone with a client to even check in and when she was about to assist me, the receptionist said we needed to reschedule because the doctor already wrote the appointment down as a no show before I arrived? And I’m thinking well perhaps if the receptionist had told the doctor I was here when I arrived, I could have been seen, however I know it is not her fault if the doctor canceled it. So anyways she rescheduled me, and as I was waiting outside the main office for a car to pick me up I heard through the door that the receptionist was talking to another staff member and she said something like “a client just came in 1 minute past the grace period so I had to reschedule her. And I said it’s not my problem.” I opened the door and said “I’m sorry I’m still here” and the receptionist and other staff member just stared at me and didn’t say anything at all. That was really disrespectful and unprofessional of them. I wasted my time coming here.

reviews.author: Bob Gabriel
reviews.text: If I could rate them with 6 or more stars I would! Dr. Rierdon and associates are top notch. They listen, they evaluate, and treat accordingly, all with professionalism and a level of thoroughness that rivals other doctors, even those of other specialties!

reviews.author: Anita Life
reviews.text: I heard that you have to wait a bit longer for an appointment with this group.  I am glad I did there care was excellent.  I saw Dr Riordan and he was very helpful in explaining my Crohn's disease to me.  I have seen doctors back home and Dr Riordan reviewed those records and kept my treatment plan going without a hitch.  Great Dr!  I would recommend this group to anyone seeking care with digestive problems.

reviews.author: Jack Young
reviews.text: My wife posted a very negative review after her recent colonoscopy detailing the fact that she was fully sedated without permission when the doctor fell behind schedule. (She wanted to have the procedure done with no or limited sedation as is a normal provide in Europe and Asia.) Of course the practice responded to her review by saying “give us a call” and let us know what happened. The reality is that she did that the day of the procedure and has been ignored completely since then. Their reply was as incompetent and dishonest as the original work they did, although unlike their full sedation against her wishes it wasn’t an assault under New York law. I would not recommend having anything to do with this doctor or his employer. I’m amazed this guy is still allowed to practice. Being a doctor doesn’t give you the right to ignore clear instructions from a patient just because you want to get some lunch.

reviews.author: Caryl
reviews.text: I had to wait a very long time for my procedure to begin. While waiting and waiting I heard the nurses station abuzz with how are they going to get the nurses to lunch if the Dr  is so far behind.  I wanted to get my procedure without any sedation. Clearly Dr Brennan was against this from the start.  I  was given fentanyl against my specific requests to not be knocked out.  The two nurses in the room listened to Dr.  Brennan and not to me despite my telling them at least twice that I did not want fentanyl.  I only wanted a tiny amount of versed and a peds scope.  Some patience and kindness and listening to my wishes would go a long way. And, sedating me when I specifically said I did not want fentanyl and to be knocked out, is an assault under NYS law. I would not recommend this practice or Dr Brennan. Ever.

reviews.author: John Bryan
reviews.text: Very friendly and efficient, from intake to discharge.  No pain but lots of gain!  Ty to Intake person/nurse, Julie, Anita, Kat, Holly, Carl and of course Doc Brennan.

reviews.author: L Li
reviews.text: I have been going to PMA Audibel for many years.  Phil is knowledgeable and personable, and does regular tune-ups, cleanings, and adjustments, without charge!

reviews.author: T StClair
reviews.text: Phil provides nice, friendly, helpful, and patient service. He invites questions and seeks help from technical experts when needed for highly technical questions. Phil strongly encourages regular follow up appointments to clean, inspect, and adjust settings based on my actual hearing aid usage. I do not have to pay anything for these follow up appointments and I find they are super helpful in helping me use my hearing aids as efficiently as possible.

reviews.author: Thomas Smith
reviews.text: I have to say that the post-purchase experience has been extraordinary.  Beyond expectations.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Wonderful place! I always have no problems making appointments and I always get seen in a speedy amount of time. A clean, neat facility. Friendly, welcoming staff. Conveniently located near the Shops at Ithaca Mall. I used to get earwax cleanings there and they were always fantastic, but unfortunately the woman who used to do them for me has left the practice. Still, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Stephen Fontana
reviews.text: My first visit to Cayuga ENT was excellent. Check-in person was patient when I didn't have all my info. (She put 4 phone callers on hold while I was finishing up my intake!). Dr. Cryer was patient and a good listener. Highly recommend this office.

reviews.author: Ellen Reynolds
reviews.text: I was a patient of this practice several years ago and they helped me with my earwax issues. I called them today because my ear has been plugged for four days and I asked if I could get an appointment. Because I have not been a patient in a few years they tell me I have to be a new patient which I understand but they do not do what I am asking them to do so they would rather me have an issue and try to help me at all to me. That is not the oath that doctors take. I am so disappointed in what I thought was a good practice

reviews.author: Eleanor Willard
reviews.text: I think your experience here highly depends on which practitioner you're seeing. Emily Dvorak is amazing, she's the best medical provider I've ever seen. If you have GI issues related to hypermobility, go here. She's the first person who I felt really understood what was going on with my GI system and cares about finding a solution. I've seen reviews saying the wait time is too long but at my last appointment I got there very early and was seen by Emily 10-15 minutes before my scheduled time. She is scheduling several months out but once you have an initial visit she is decent at responding to messages in the portal or via the nurses' phone line.

reviews.author: Kurt Becker
reviews.text:
My colonoscopy at Cayuga Medical Center on November 18, 2025, performed by Dr. Tandy Agostini under MAC sedation (Dr. Hans Salamanca-Granados), was dangerous. I’m sharing this so other patients — especially those on GLP-1 medications like Ozempic or Mounjaro — don’t experience what I did.
What Happened:
I aspirated stomach acid under sedation. I woke up coughing violently, unable to speak or swallow, with burning pain so severe it felt like my throat had been cut open. My voice was completely gone. I was drooling because I couldn’t swallow. I was terrified.
What shocked me most was how little anyone seemed to care.
Staff continued their routines while I lay there coughing, drooling, unable to make a sound. I tried desperately to communicate using finger spelling, but no one understood. No one assessed my airway. No one showed urgency. I have never felt so invisible in a medical setting.
Staff casually mentioned I had been “coughing a lot” under sedation — a critical warning sign of aspiration, especially since my chart documented tirzepatide use (delays gastric emptying) and reflux history. Both are major aspiration risk factors. Instead, I was told my symptoms were from “dry air from the mask.”
The Documentation Problem:
My discharge paperwork states: “Anesthetic complications: no” and “Patient discharged per protocol without apparent complications.”
But when Elizabeth, RN, called me two days later for routine follow-up and I explained I’d gone to the ER and said I “probably shouldn’t even be talking,” she documented this — but timestamped it as 10:15 AM on the day of the procedure, before I’d even gone to the ER.
The documentation makes it appear they followed up same-day when they actually didn’t.
Multiple System Failures:
Within hours, I needed emergency evaluation at Cortland Hospital, where the doctor ordered a CT scan for possible perforation and suggested steroids.
I then went to Cayuga Urgent Care — the same health system. Despite complete voice loss hours after their facility’s procedure, they checked me for strep throat and missed the obvious complication. No care coordination occurred.
When Elizabeth called two days later and I explained ongoing severe symptoms, she became defensive rather than concerned. Despite notifying the Chief of Anesthesia, no one called back to help.
Medical Confirmation:
My ENT found visible laryngeal injury from aspiration — red, raw tissue on scope. Chemical burns from stomach acid. Ten days later, I still have significantly impaired voice.
What I Cannot Accept:
• Risk factors documented but ignored
• Obvious injury dismissed as “dry air”
• Discharged unable to communicate
• False documentation of “no complications”
• Incorrect timestamping concealing lack of follow-up
• Three departments failing to provide appropriate care
• Defensive responses instead of concern
I will be filing complaints with NY State Department of Health and Medical Board. Not from vindictiveness, but because this pattern suggests systemic problems putting other patients at risk.
For GLP-1 Patients:
Ask specifically about aspiration risk before sedated procedures. Ask if MAC sedation is appropriate. Ensure you’re heard. If problems arise at Cayuga, consider care at a different system.

If Cayuga acknowledges what happened, reviews their protocols, and provides fair resolution, I’ll update this review.

No one should wake up injured and terrified, only to be told nothing happened.

reviews.author: Jeff Marshall
reviews.text: Well was prescribed a medication that my insurance would not pay for Dr said they probably would so in the meantime I've run out of the medicine that I had been taking so have tried 4 attempts to get it refilled with apoltly no luck at all if I'm not talking to someone answer machine I speak to someone who's going to get right on it and call me back so going on just about 4 weeks after my appointment and 3 weeks of being out

reviews.author: Joe Watson (Joe Cool)
reviews.text: Amazing!!! We watched a CBS Morning piece on this place and decided to go and check it out. We emailed the owner and told her what we wanted to make and when. We made night lights and globe lights. She makes fresh cookies for everyone because it was “Art Trail Weekend”.she was patient and knowledgeable. She and her husband clearly love what they are doing, and they pass the joy to others. It was busy, but she was great and we made our products. A wonderful visit for anyone.

reviews.author: Stacey Lechevet
reviews.text: It was on my bucket list! Funky gourd shop in Ithaca. Would be cool to see garden in summer. Graham was very friendly and showed us so many things she's learned. Her creations are beautiful.  You can make some gourd art when you visit!

reviews.author: Aleta Jane N. Sullivan
reviews.text: I loved going here! The gourd crafts are so cool and very unique. I even made my own gourd light, and it’s still up on my wall to this day. One of the coolest local experiences ever!

reviews.author: TheRed Hill
reviews.text:
A bright and cheery stop on a dreary winter day! Seven of the eight items we tried were off the charts… The other was somewhere between good and very good…

Charmingly located on Ithaca’s Euro-esque high street… Bright commercial lighting in a franchise that purports to value being neighborhood-based.

reviews.author: Raechel Zielinski
reviews.text: Super cute cafe! My friends and I were in town for a night, stumbled upon this place on a late night walk, and knew we wanted to try it in the morning!! Sooo many good options for a sweet treat and their pizzetta was delicious! We loved the vibe in here and would definitely come back!

reviews.author: RAHUL KEJRIWAL
reviews.text:
The food and ambience is just soo good.

All the stuffs we had was 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
The girls working there was super sweet, they made me a new cold matcha drink Bcz the hot drink was too bitter.
Make sure u try the pastries there it’s heavenly 💫💫🤩🌺🌸❤️❤️
The mango coconut was fireeee🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥😋😋😋😋

reviews.author: Anne Brooks
reviews.text:
We had a great experience working with Mansour to design my custom engagement ring. I came to them with a pretty clear idea of what I wanted, and the team took the time to understand my vision and walk us through every detail until the CAD model was just right. They also pay close attention to the durability and comfort of the ring design, which we greatly appreciated. We had a lot of fun throughout the whole process.
The final ring is exactly what I had pictured, and I love it!

reviews.author: Devon Carroll
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at Mansour Jewelers working with Michael and Jordan to design our engagement rings. From the very beginning, they were incredibly welcoming, patient, and knowledgeable. They took the time to really understand what we were looking for and guided us through every step of the design process without ever making us feel rushed or pressured.

What stood out the most was their attention to detail and genuine care in helping us create rings that felt truly personal and meaningful. They offered thoughtful suggestions, explained all the options clearly, and made the entire process enjoyable and stress-free.

When we saw the finished rings, we were absolutely blown away. The craftsmanship is stunning, and they turned our ideas into something even more beautiful than we imagined.

We’re so grateful to Michael and Jordan for making this such a special experience. If you’re looking for a jeweler who is talented, trustworthy, and truly invested in their clients, we can’t recommend Mansour Jewelers enough!!!

reviews.author: ryan swanson
reviews.text: Mansour Jewelers did a fantastic job designing a custom engagement ring for me and my fiancée. They were very patient and accommodated every little adjustment I wanted. They were very informative and made the whole process as stress free as possible. Excellent service and a very personable experience from everyone in the store. We love our engagement ring and look forward to working with them in the future.

reviews.author: Devon V
reviews.text: We had a great time here for dinner. So much so that we came back the night after. The lotus root fritters were our favorite and are a must try. It was appreciated how many items were vegan or could be made vegan. The selection made it exciting to come back a second time with friends to try new items and have them share our favorites. The cocktails and dishes were truly unique and absolutely delicious!

reviews.author: Mario Alex Gonzalez
reviews.text: Tapas places hold a special place in my heart, and this place takes an interesting twist on the concept with asian tapas. It does an awesome job of having a variety of small dishes and larger ones for a traditional experience, but I only tried a lot of small ones. However, every single tapa i tried was delicious and used great quality ingredients. The service was good and the staff were super attentive and helpful in choosing what I should get. Great spot.

reviews.author: Jeff Faber
reviews.text: Wow what a great place. We had a bunch of the small plates and they were all delicious. The chicken satay skewers and the paneer were standouts.  The vibe was great and all the staff were super friendly and attentive and kind. Our server Jake was awesome he felt like a friend by the time we left.

reviews.author: Nat Fine
reviews.text: Petrune has a great selection of cute new clothing and a nice vintage section in the back. Good mix of trendy and timeless styles. Prices are definitely not low but I often come in to window shop.

reviews.author: J T
reviews.text: Really neat selection of stuff within the display (medium format cameras!). Not within my budget, but the staff was super super kind and patient with me. Thanks for being so welcoming, blonde woman at the store.

reviews.author: Kathryn Porcell
reviews.text: Great mix. You can find some actual vintage clothing mixed in with vintage inspired pieces. Accessories galore and quirky gifts are spread all over and give the shop a really welcoming vibe. The owner is always happy to help pick out clothes. It's always got quirky things I dont see anywhere else.

reviews.author: david Scott
reviews.text:
If you love sheepskin… this place is HEAVEN.

Carefully and ethically sourced natural fibers curated in a creative, loving community atmosphere.
This family business is a blessing to Ithaca and beyond!
I purchased rugs, boas and the Duchess as gifts but will have trouble parting with them.
As I repeat customer I LIVE and sleep with these pieces.
So naturally WARM and breathable.

reviews.author: Ese Moynihan-Ejaife
reviews.text: *Update- I was contacted by the company that did accept the return and replaced the slippers with ones that fit and were quality and enjoyed by the recipient.* While the quality of slippers is great, the makers were impossible to get ahold of when I emailed 4 times and left a voice message to replace a pair of slippers that were too small with a larger size, just as their website says you can. Their return policy says you have 30 days to contact them, and to email them first if you want to make an exchange. We have sent multiple emails and phoned leaving a voice message and the 30 days went by with zero response. I am now out $190 with a pair of slippers sitting in a box in my closet. I do not recommend buying from a place that is impossible to contact and therefore does not keep their word with their return policy.

reviews.author: Chris Rowland
reviews.text:
After having received my second pair of slippers from this company, I started developing an issue with the stitching along the bottom of one slipper at the toe. After having worn them for 10 months.

Being mindful of their return / repair policy, I contacted the company through e-mail. I was dealing with co-owner Jessica Leonard. She was nothing less than professional and helpful. I sent the slippers back as instructed. They received my slippers on a Monday. Repaired and returned on that Thursday. Good as new.

Though I was disappointed to have a problem after several months, I was blown away by the speed, service, and customer support from this small company.

They have definitely earned a repeat customer.

Chris Rowland

reviews.author: christian bachman
reviews.text: In NY you eat a lot of pizza..this is one of the best slices I've Ever had..I got a slice of white and a slice of chicken fajita..WOW .It is fire!!. Highly recommend!! Nice crisp great flavor..I found my new spot any time I'm around.

reviews.author: Maria Z
reviews.text:
Fresh halal pizza and gyro.
I think I’m doing injustice by just typing that out but their pizza was outclass. Definitely the best NY style pizza I’ve had in NY state.
If you’re in Ithaca and looking for a halal meal this is your go to place. don’t even think about visiting any other.
Generous portions and decent prices.
Definitely worth trying.

reviews.author: B H
reviews.text: Local to the area but have never checked this place out until now, and I’m really glad I did! We got the Greek Tzatziki burgers and fries, and the burger was the best restaurant burger I’ve had in a long time! The food was fresh and you can tell the staff puts a lot of time and care into their business! There are lots of good menu options that I will definitely be coming back to try! There is downstairs and upstairs seating, which is spacious and comfortable. Prices were surprisingly affordable for local fare (have you seen some of the food prices in this town?!). Overall everything was 10/10 and I recommend going here!! ❤️

reviews.author: John O'Reilly
reviews.text:
What a lovely surprise this store was today. Went to Mansour to get a watch and ring resized and have a chain repaired, but they were closed. Stopped into Schooley's for the first time today and was blown away by how well we were treated and how fast they work! They re-sized my wedding ring, repaired the chain, and took the links out of my wife's watch in 30 minutes.

To the people complaining about the price of resizing or repairs, I don't know what to say except that skilled labor costs money and these folks have skill.

Dave was lovely to talk to, well informed, and showed us some pieces of jewelry without making us feel any pressure to purchase it while we discussed our repairs.

We sometimes struggle to get good repair work done in Ithaca, glad that wasn't the case today.

reviews.author: Cee Cee
reviews.text:
This place stole from me! In late 2023 early 2024, I brought in a Raymond Weill watch from the late 1980’s. The screws to the watch are the smaller version. When I brought my watch in I only needed two screws to be fixed. Just the year before I went to an upright jeweler who helped me fix it. It only needed two screws. They lied and said they needed to keep the watch for a few days. They then call me back and told me that they can’t find the screws because “they no longer make them” and my watch is in 5-6 pieces. They then told me that I needed to call Raymond Weill to get the watch fixed and don’t tell them that I brought it to their jewelry store. Once again, I am shocked because they’re literally telling me to lie. At the time, I was so shocked I walked out of the store and realized that they had stolen my screws. I should have asked for them at the time. These people are dishonest and thieves.

They claim to even be believers in Christ Jesus, which was a reason why I had given them the benefit. However, I found out they’re ravenous wolves in sheep’s clothing. The entire family is dishonest from the son to the parents. No wonder their reviews are in the toilet. I say this, unless they repent for the injustice they’ve caused and ask God for forgiveness for misleading and stealing from customers, they will receive judgement for their actions! And not when you see the righteous judge but right here on this earth. May you choose wisely. The Lord is not pleased with what you did to his servants. You ought to be ashamed for stealing from hard working people. And telling them to lie.

If I could give ZERO STARS I would. They’re outright THIEVES!

reviews.author: Kate Browning
reviews.text:
Schooley’s was awesome. I personally chose them over other jewelers after feeling like other stores treated shoppers with higher budgets with more attention and courtesy. Dave was incredibly nice and everyone else in the store was very welcoming.

I had  three pieces: 1) a loose mystery stone from my mother that I thought was glass  2) an old aquamarine ring that I inherited from my grandmother and 3) an engagement ring that was too big.

The loose stone was actually an aquamarine and I had it made into a pendant. Dave was awesome throughout the entire process and I love the final product.

I asked for the ring to be resized after contemplating having it reset — and even though it was less money for Schooley’s they respected my decision that the original setting was sentimental to me. The ring is amazing and so clean I hardly recognized it

My engagement ring was resized in just a few days and is flawless as well.

Overall 10/10 and 5 stars :)

reviews.author: David Bickford
reviews.text: So far, super disappointing.  I hate giving this place less than good review, but- I thought I was treated poorly by the employees .  Went to see a show at state theater.  We were initially put in the aisle where everyone walks by, and servers, too.. I declined to be seated there.  Seating lady said that they were saving seats because band was going to be there...Hours from now there might be a band?  Also others get the booths?  We were there at 4:30, having made reservations and- No one here...   No way for this place to disrespect a customer.  We ended up in a back room being used for storage of some bags of stuff.  With small flies circling around us , landing on our food while we ate.  Food was good.  But see pics.  Classic burger, pink inside.  Like it that way.  Fries good.  Server did come by to ask if we liked food, we acknowledged it was good.  Fish chips were good, but the skin was left on fish.  Didn't like that. Potato served with fish was good.  Chipotle tartar was too spicy,  did not have regular tartar?  Any way showed waiter a fly on plate.  No reaction.  No discount.  Not interested in going again.

reviews.author: Prestige Worldwide
reviews.text: Looking for a burger and I found a good one at Ithaca Ale House.  Started with the onion soup.  I give it high marks overall.  Tasty if not a little bit salty broth.  I finished the entire bowl which says something. Nice addition of crispy fried onions on the top.  The burger was also good.  They say it is award winning.  Maybe.....but it certainly did the trick that day.

reviews.author: Nate Hartrich
reviews.text: Right in downtown Ithaca was excited to try the food and a great location. Inside is a bit interesting -very sterile feeling. Our server Anthony was nice enough. I had the Ellicottville blood orange to start.  The food was ok. Here’s my issue with this restaurant they charge $5.00 for soda.  I don’t even think this included refills if it did we weren’t told. I have been around the world and this is most I have ever paid for a soda.  This is why our bill came to 87.48 for lunch.  Also when they give you the pay with cash option you always feel like you are losing out, this is a first while dining out.  Never have seen the pay with cash option at a restaurant only at gas stations.  Would I return to this restaurant, no. We all know that soda costs pennies to sell. Overpriced lunch two thumbs down

reviews.author: Gam Prangrarin
reviews.text:
My favorite fast-casual restaurant in Ithaca, located in Downtown. They serve middle eastern food, specialized in Malawach (flatbread).

I keep coming back for more than 10 times! The food is authentic and the price is decent. Staff here are also very nice.

They serve breakfast menu until 11 a.m. and all-day menu.

reviews.author: Johnson Song
reviews.text: This place is incredible. I am continuously blown away by the portions, flavors, and variety on the menu. Also, our most recent server Patrick was so friendly and attentive. I’ve gotten multiple malawach wraps for breakfast and dinner and each one has been divine. They do not skimp on portions. Get the zaatar chicken wrap and falafel wrap, and also any of the breakfast wraps. My favorite place in Ithaca

reviews.author: Jaime Erbach
reviews.text: Awesome restaurant. The food was excellent. They really care about the ingredients and preparation. Great char on the bread, juicy chicken and flavor was fantastic!! Great spot!

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text:
My husband and I went to Taverna Banfi to celebrate his 30th birthday and had a lovely experience. We enjoyed the brunch buffet with breakfast, lunch, and desserts. The ambience was beautiful, and the staff were incredibly warm and attentive.
We mentioned the birthday during reservation, and they surprised us with a big cupcake that said “Happy Birthday,” which was such a thoughtful touch! The food was good, but the overall experience was excellent. The brunch buffet costs $35 per person plus tax and is totally worth it.

reviews.author: Petal Elfwitch
reviews.text: First off, the bread given to us was so fresh and tasty. We ordered the octopus appetizer, the fried chicken entree (which I added potato puree to), and the salmon entree, and they were all delicious!! We also ordered a cheesecake for dessert, which tasted great. Most notable of our great experience was the wonderful staff and service. Our server was Kevin, who was so kind and patient. We had inquiries about breakfast the next day at dinner. He does not normally serve at breakfast, but he helped us by asking the staff and gave us good advice! I have a sensitive stomach, and Kevin, bless his soul, went back to the kitchen 5 times to refill my hot water. He was very accommodating and attentive! Would 100% return; thank you Kevin!

reviews.author: Mario Alex Gonzalez
reviews.text: A spectacular restaurant that is housed in the Cornell hotel management school, and it is clear that they live up to the expectations being in such a nice hotel. The service is always top tier, the food is delicious,  and their dishes are creative. I highly recommend the salmon, as it is cooked to perfection and comes with a spectacular sauce. Overall, for the ambiance, quality, and price, this place is an excellent place for a fun fresh dinner in the Cornell area.

reviews.author: Yunong Shi
reviews.text:
Beautiful and cozy space inside the Canopy Hotel, with friendly service and clear effort from the kitchen to deliver quality dishes. That said, the overall dining experience was mixed. Most of the food was just average—the flavors leaned too salty, and portion sizes were noticeably small. The coffee was inconsistent; one of the cappuccinos I had was unfortunately among the worst I’ve tasted. The pizza was fine, but nothing memorable. The serving time is quite long, most tables wait for 20-30mins to get their food.

On the positive side, the black bean burger and the pan-roasted shrimp stood out as well-executed and flavorful. There’s potential here, especially given the stylish setting, but it still feels like they’re working out some inconsistencies in both the kitchen and barista station.

reviews.author: Michael Apollo
reviews.text:
Consistently Excellent – A Highlight of Our Annual Stay

We’ve been staying at the Hilton Canopy in Ithaca annually, and The Strand Café has become a beloved part of each visit. After long drives and early mornings, it’s the warm, inviting atmosphere and reliably delicious meals that make this café a true haven for our family.

Breakfasts are especially outstanding. The cappuccinos are top-tier—smooth, rich, and perfectly crafted (we’re quite particular about our coffee!). The Roasted Tomato Omelette is a standout, and we appreciate the thoughtful variety of both meat and vegetarian options on the menu.

On this trip, we were especially grateful for Blythe, whose warmth, attention to detail, and genuine care elevated the experience even more. Her bright smile and attentive service didn’t go unnoticed—thank you, Blythe!

Looking forward to many more meals here.

reviews.author: Robbie
reviews.text: Really good vegetarian options. Excellent rigatoni. We enjoyed it. Even their cheapest wine is my best this week.

reviews.author: Matt McFarland
reviews.text: First of all this restaurant is not closed.  Google maps takes you to a location on the south west side of the mall that is all shut down.  But then we looked at the map again and you can see that the restaurant is inside the mall.  I put some videos in the review to help you recognize the entrance to the mall we went in.  When you first enter the mall most of it is abandoned but if you keep walking in to the left you will see a vibrant full of life restaurant.  Once you are inside the restaurant you can’t even tell you are in the mall.  The service was great and our food was very good.  I had the carne asada steak which was super tender.  It needed a little more salt for my taste though.  The pico and guacamole it came with were fresh and tasty.  My wife loved her huge plate of enchiladas.

reviews.author: London Kelly
reviews.text:
I love a good nacho and these chicken fajita nachos didn't disappoint... I could nit pick about the presentation but the flavor was there.. I'll just ask for some jalapeños next time. I like my dishes caliente! The chips and salsa came in clutch!!
#ForkJab All Thru This 🤌🏾🤌🏾🤌🏾

reviews.author: Sana Abuhandara
reviews.text:
Incredible food. Amazing dining experience. Food was tasteful, flavorful, and great portion size. Also, service was top notch. Waiters were fast and helpful. Very professional service.
I definitely recommend this restaurant 100%.

reviews.author: Ornwara Tritrakarn
reviews.text: My favourite place to dine in campus! It can be super crowded during peak hours and finding a table can be challenging. But the salad and wrap here are so good that I couldn't help but come again! The wrap's portion is indeed so huge that I can keep some for another meal!

reviews.author: Jiahao Luo
reviews.text: The staff at the burrito station and in  general were so kind. In addition, the food was fresh and high quality. This combined with the pleasant atmosphere created a perfect place for lunch.

reviews.author: Alan Fridkin
reviews.text: We had the misfortune of having lunch here during Reunion weekend. The staff are friendly, the outdoor patio is pleasant. But this is some of the most lackluster  and pathetic food we have had in a town which has plenty of mediocre dining establishments. I have always been proud of my alma mater, and accepted the fact we have a world class hotel school. Now I have my doubts.The orange chicken, falafel and watered down lemondade were all substandard. In the real world, this restaurant would crash and burn with the most modest competition. Ranking up there with "airline food" and unpleasant memories of student cafeterias, on;ly at a higher price., this was an embarassment. As to the "all you can eat" format, it would be far better to stay away.

reviews.author: mark Ash
reviews.text:
Our company has been working with duke on equipment and supplies while working near Ithaca NY. This company has fast friendly service and Luke and his employees have really knocked it out of the park with getting us whatever we need. They are definitely a customer oriented company, and we will be sure to use them in our future projects

Mark Ash
Applied Construction Solutions

reviews.author: Nicholas Robertson
reviews.text: The Duke company provides excellent service, competitive pricing, and a customer first mentality.  They have served us extremely well over the last year and a half.  I couldn't be more pleased with the experience and relationship we have developed with the Duke Company.  Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Breanna Barry
reviews.text: I work for a construction company and many times have to reserve some equipment! And work with many places. Let me just say I love working/calling Duke. So helpful, kind, and normally know what I’m talking about when I don’t even have a clue. Tim is great! And the service department as well!

reviews.author: Kashmala Feroze
reviews.text:
Just gave birth here two weeks ago. The birthplace is one of the best mostly because of how wonderful the nurses are. They really have the patient’s best interests at heart.
