We had kind of an emergency situation and the staff including the OBGYN and the anesthesiologist attended to me within minutes of us arriving there.

The nurses were amazing and went out of their way to form a connection with the patient which really helped during the stressful times. I couldn’t have done it without their calm guidance.

reviews.author: Candice Moor
reviews.text: This place is genuinely disgusting. Not even trying to sound like an ego pig, but out of all the hospitals I’ve been to, this is by far the most unprofessional and unhygienic hospital I’ve ever been to. The doctors do the wrong scans, get your name wrong, somehow add in symptoms you’ve never even said, and misspell words on documents. The nurses do not care about you. They forget amenities and requests very frequently. All of the reviews talking about billing experience and medical miscalculations are all true. YOU can be a doctor here. Thank god I knew something was wrong and went to an actual hospital. 3 days until my surgery 💪.

reviews.author: Ian Something
reviews.text: They saved my dad's life TWICE. This second time, everybody was sure we would lose him, I mean, it was total devastation. He's a wonderful father, a loving husband, an inspiration in my own life, and a great friend to many. Despite everything, he pulled through, and every step of the way, they did everything they could. They treated him with the utmost compassion and respect. Considering the burden placed on healthcare professionals and institutions throughout the country right now,  my family could not be more thankful for what you did for somebody we love so much. These folks, they are heroes.

reviews.author: Daniel Smith
reviews.text: Perfect service. 10/10 experience. Dr. Smith is always attentive and gives the best treatments!!

reviews.author: Lisa Richardson
reviews.text:
I have never seen the Doctor.
When I had my infusions done there. The nurse they had then was an absolute kind hearted person.

I was very disappointed at my last visit. Not particularly with the person that cared for me, but the way things were handled.

Then, today I called and somehow during making the appointment the receptionist was rude. She actually said she was not there to argue when the mistake was hers.

reviews.author: Daniel K.
reviews.text: Smith Allergy is possibly one of the worst medical institutions I have ever attended. The office staff are incredibly rude and unprofessional, and the medical assistants don’t seem to know what they are doing. I came in for a routine checkup as I had moved to the area, and despite reading about the significant progress I had made with my existing course of treatment, Dr. Smith completely changed my medications and I was no longer able to control my asthma as effectively. I incredibly disappointing given how much the doctor tries to emphasize his research and awards, when he can’t even recommend a decent course of treatment that will HELP! And don’t get me started on the billing department — you can never actually get in touch with them, and when you do, half the time they don’t know what they are talking about. Somehow, they billed my visits to the wrong insurance company! I have no idea how this happened, but it did and I was so confused when I heard. Overall, my experience with Smith Allergy & Asthma has been dismal. I highly recommend anyone looking for an allergist AVOID this office.

reviews.author: Milagros Cartagena
reviews.text:
Lover her so much. She’s so good; her attention to detail is one of the things I admire about her but there’s so much more. She kind, compassionate and funny. And she listens, really listens.
When she does an assessment on your skin, she checks EVERY inch of your body. Fantastic team as well. Can’t say enough good things about her.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.text: saw Dr. Garner a couple times as a student in the area. She was always patient and made me feel at ease.

reviews.author: Sid Astaire
reviews.text:
I am a chronically ill person who has been in and out of a LOT of doctor's offices, and this is one of the best. The facility is beautiful and clean with lots of natural light. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and prompt. Dr. Garner herself is direct and efficient in her evaluations, alleviating any awkwardness that might come from nudity in front of a new doctor, and delivers diagnoses without judgment or criticism. She is compassionate and kind and has offered me solutions to several problems I believed I would just have to live with indefinitely, helping to minimize the discomfort that comes along with my chronic conditions and treatments.

All in all, this office and Dr. Garner specifically should be commended for their exceedingly high standard of care.

Also, make sure you arrive promptly for your appointments! Dr. Garner will be on time, so you should be, too!

reviews.author: Juno P
reviews.text: I’m really happy to see Dr Jorgensen. He’s a young doctor who did his undergrad at Cornell. He’s easy to talk to and listens. My PA/nurse who administered the allergen test was legit amusing.

reviews.author: Eleanor Willard
reviews.text: Dr. Pieretti is so friendly and helpful. She listened carefully to my concerns and recommended various treatment options without pushing anything on me I didn't want.

reviews.author: Max Orestis
reviews.text: Would not recommend. Very expensive. They told me what I already knew and told me to find a lab somewhere else to get tested.

reviews.author: Joseph Holland
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible experience!!! They ignored red flags from my fiance who was a high risk individual! We lost our baby of 20 weeks. Afterwards, they are changing paperwork that I needed filled out when I asked for it to be corrected (from a typo) and now they are denying me the extra time to spend with her to take care of her! They didnt even re evaluate her first and probably don't even care that she still has an infection 2 weeks after her procedure. They told us multiple times the red flags were fine beforehand so just BEWARE. Some doctors were okay but the lack of respect and amount they were condescending me when I was trying to show their error on my PFL paperwork is ridiculous. No above and beyond from these people and you are safer elsewhere

reviews.author: The Throttles and Life of Dolly
reviews.text:
I love it here. My Dr. gelber retired and I made an appointment with Dr Dean. He's awesome and personable :) everyone was super friendly and helpful .
Despite that I have a lot of tattoos I had to get my blood drawn which I don't like. But the nurse was awesome. She was quick and i didn't feel anything :)

reviews.author: Liz Hartman
reviews.text: My regular doctor wasn’t available for as soon as I had been hoping to schedule. The office took the care to reach out when another doctor (Dean) had some openings. As usual, I was quickly in and out. I appreciate how well the office runs and how little time I spend waiting at appointments. I was very impressed by the time Dr Dean must have spent reviewing my patient records prior to our appointment- he was aware of small and important details and I felt like I was being treated like a real individual. Over the years I have had many positive experiences with this practice including pregnancy and delivery at Cayuga Med.

reviews.author: Jenna BEar
reviews.text: I really like Sarah Roach NP.  I feel like she cares. I really don’t like the lack of fresh air (why don’t you have windows that open!!!!) & that you have to wait sooo long for your appointment.  In a tiny claustrophobic room with no ventilation.  I get very sick just going in for a visit.

reviews.author: Dominic Tribelli
reviews.text:
Came here as a first-time patient today, and was left disappointed and frustrated. The front desk did not greet me when looking to check in and avoided eye-contact, and had the same experience with the check out desk. I also completed about 30 minutes worth of paperwork online the day before my appointment and was told to complete this lengthy paperwork again while waiting.

While the nurse and Dr. B were kind and professional, after the procedure I was left waiting in the patient room for 35 minutes without being told or guided to check out and I eventually left. I also was told to go to other facilities for work I must get done that could oddly not be done here (one being an x-ray, which even urgent cares have these), especially within the two hour duration of time I spent here. For the two hours I did spend here, it feels like nothing was accomplished as my reasons for coming in were not addressed. Disappointing experience.

reviews.author: Barry Derfel
reviews.text: They have become negligent and unresponsive.  I was a well-cared for patient, who trusted this practice, for over 20 years.  They had helped me through s number of serious health issues with compassion and professional expertise.  Not anymore!  Since the practice was taken over and a number of doctors & nurses have retired, the quality of care has been abysmal. For example, my new doctor barely looked up from the computer during my first physical with him, and a second time, while I explained my concerns about a significant health concern, I had to stop talking and wait three or four seconds for him to notice and actually look at me to see what I was pointing to. I have talked to many other patients who have had similar experiences.  In addition, we patients are routinely being told that no appointments are available for two to three months, when calling with flu-like symptoms, dizziness, or similar issues, and we are consistently told instead that we should "go to the ER if we need care."  Rather than patient phone calls being returned in kind, the practice texts us portal messages, usually a week or two later, with vague or trite responses.  Those front office staff who have remained are still professional and courteous with patients, but it seems they are not in a position to elicit more appropriate, timely, and thoughtful care from the providers.  I have communicated my concerns directly to my doctor, the office manager, front office staff, and the Cayuga Health patient advocate staff.   Nothing has changed for the better.

reviews.author: Feral Possum
reviews.text:
I was referred there for the TB vaccine because I work with people who are homeless & recently released from incarceration. I confirmed FOUR TIMES that I was coming for that vaccine, and someone at the front desk even reassured me that if they somehow didn’t have it in stock, they’d make sure to get it before my appointment. I confirmed this vaccine 4x: when I originally scheduled, when CCID called me with the reminder, when I arrived, and to the nurse who took me into the room. Yet… somehow… someway… when NP Kari Winkleblack-Schmidt entered the room, she didn’t even know what I was there for and seemed surprised that I was there for the TB vaccine! After 4 confirmations, there shouldn’t have been any surprises! Kari informed me that this vaccine “isn’t available in the US.” I responded that it was my understanding that it was available under specific circumstances and that my allergist thought I qualified due to my work. Kari responded no, this vaccine simply isn’t available anymore, period. I got up to leave, but Kari started asking me multiple questions about my work and our mission. She led me to believe that if I answered her questions, she would better understand my risks and could find a way to approve me for the vaccine, but then she still said it “wasn’t available anymore in the US, period.” I now believe she was simply “running out the clock” so she could still bill for this bait & switch appointment.

I immediately pointed out that’s not what I was there for, I was there for a vaccine, and the visit was all a hoax and shouldn’t be billed. Kari said she would have her office manager Kristina call me the next day. Kristina did call me, but said she couldn’t reverse my copay or any billing because I had been “counseled.” That is simply untrue, and it’s inappropriate to bill me & my insurance for this bait & switch appointment that amounted to nothing more than a social visit. If Kari was actually interested in my work, she could have visited or we could have had a professional coffee meeting or something. But no, she pretended to be interested to prevent me from walking out too soon, because it’s all about billing & $$$.

When my visit notes got added to my Patient Portal, the notes themselves were contradictory. They make it sound as though the TB vaccine IS possible (although rare), which is what I thought all along! I tried asking my questions on Patient Portal so I could get clarification in writing, and Kari and her staff office blocked me!

I believe this bait & switch rises to the level of insurance fraud.

reviews.author: Longze Yuan
reviews.text:
“Dr” Eli Finkelsztein is a liability for the Cayuga Health System. He is incompetent and indifferent to concerns. No concern for your well-being, just when your next appointment is. He doesn’t bother to check the medical procedures that HE orders. He ignores your questions and will not call you back. No, not just a delay, he completely disappears. There is no bedside manner, but he will try to make it up with his attempt at “humor.”

If you want actual expertise and treatment within days instead of anguish and frustration over weeks and months, go to Guthrie.

reviews.author: Melissa K
reviews.text: I'm so happy to see at least one other person who had the same experience with Kari. However, I thought Dr. MacQueen was great...until he wasn't. I had some complications to an infection and Kari was rude, dismissive, and condescending. One time she had her nurse call me back 4 different times in one afternoon as the "go-between" to answer questions. Her own nurse said, "I don't know why she just doesn't call you herself. I'm sorry." I was very frustrated. Very frustrated. I tried hard not to be mean when I felt dismissed. I asked to be switched to a different provider and was told that was fine, I was given an appointment with Dr. MacQueen...who then had his nurse call me back to tell me that since I had voiced my dissatisfaction with their services, he was discharging me and cancelled the appointment. He never even spoke to me. He did say he would be "willing to refer" me elsewhere. I have multiple other providers at CMA...and no one has ever had an issue with me being a difficult client. Imagine being discharged from a practice like a teenager being suspended from school??? "Dismissing" me right fron their practice. I've never had that happen. As irony would have it, I've recently steered two other friends away from this clinic. If you question reasons or care, or even expect someone to listen to what you're saying...please find somewhere else. The support and nursing staff are awesome though.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Very professional and kind staff. Never stayed longer than an hour for the overall care provided. 10/10

reviews.author: Taylor Potter
reviews.text: Incredibly kind staff. The doctor was easy to talk to, and I wasn't held up there for very long. The staff I dealt with seemed to actually care about you which is rare

reviews.author: May May
reviews.text: Incredibly rude, judgmental, and unkind staff. The staff will blame you for things out of your control and will treat you condescendingly. I cannot understate how much I would not recommend coming here if you have any self-respect for yourself.

reviews.author: Lucia song
reviews.text: The staff on the phone was unbelievably rude. I get that I’m a foreigner, but I’m still a paying customer, right? Even my American friend who overheard the call said the staff sounded extremely disrespectful. My English isn’t that hard to understand, yet they ignored my questions and spoke with an attitude. If you don’t want to work, just quit!!!! don’t take it out on customers.

reviews.author: Nozila Muminova
reviews.text: Doctors and medical staff are wonderful. Especially Yullia Margart is my son’s doctor.she Always answers questions. Especially nurses are very nice and caring. Never had to wait even if we waited no more than 10 minutes. Through the portal they immediately answer any of my questions about the child's health. Which near target. I recommend you. Unfortunately we moved and we don’t go to them anymore.

reviews.author: Lexi Hartley
reviews.text: We had our daughter here for three months after she was born and ended up switching providers. I'm posting this to remind parents that there are other options in Ithaca, even if NEP has what feels like a monopoly. We found our providers to be young and inexperienced, very quick to refer out (which is good) but not quick to provide services that are standard for a clinic that treats newborns (such as doing blood testing and diaper testing for a newborn with poor weight gain.) Most of our appointments were with a rotating cast of nurse practitioners, and when we tried to make an appointment for her actual primary care pediatrician, we had to wait over a month for just a phone call / virtual appointment. Lastly, they were quick to judge our family and thought our  daughters weight gain issuese were related  to socioeconomics (which they were not) and sent in a social worker before looking for medical reasons, which wasted valuable time when our daughter was literally starving due to food allergies and breastfeeding issues. Lastly, their so-called lactation support is awful and no one realized that my daughter literally was not getting any milk transferred her first week of life. They seemed to prioritize my breastfeeding experience over her health, which is unacceptable. When they did give us formula, they gave us bad advice on supplementing (suggesting only one bottle a day, which was not enough), gave us a case of expired formula, and suggested that we continue breastfeeding even though another provider had told me to stop due to a medication I was  on. Overall, we were really traumatized by our experience and are taking our daughter to another  doctor who respects our feeding needs and actually has the capacity to take new patients. Fed is best and anyone who prioritizes their kids health and wants a provider who prioritizes their kids health should avoid.

reviews.author: Megan Walsh
reviews.text: I had a great experience visiting my primary care physician. Elaina and Ashley at the front desk were absolutely wonderful, helpful and so kind. They greeted me warmly when I arrived, helped check me in quickly and efficiently and were very helpful answering all my questions. I have had great experiences every time I visit my primary care physician because everyone in the office is so nice and easy to work with. All of my medical needs are always met by Dr. Bodla and his team. And, Elaina especially was absolutely wonderful, pleasant and upbeat. She made my day!

reviews.author: Cayuga J
reviews.text:
Had a very important issue and was told I need a referral from primary. Cayuga Primary books out weeks and months in advance for your own Doctor but they said I could see someone same day, they booked the appointment 2-3 hours from that moment. Went home after a long day at work and then, came all the way back to the office.
When I came back at the time they told me 4:15 they said the appointment was gone and they booked it under someone else's name and they could no longer see me.

reviews.author: R Doo
reviews.text: CMC and Cayuga Medical, in various outpatient forms, are notorious for rapacious billing and procedural run-around glibness. The young, Indian physicians Dommaraju and Napit seemed as nice as any salaried workers on computers. An illicit Centralis scheduling for a next-year physical that I had declined upon exiting CPC was the last straw.

reviews.author: M M
reviews.text: These people will take 15 minutes to tell you why they Can't do something instead ten minutes to figure out How they can do something! The number of times I have heard "... That's because of Centralus Health.." Literally: a GM in a Dr. Office blamed their phone system because the nurses will not, or could not return a phone call within 16 hours.  How is being understaffed an excuse for willful ignorance?  I would love to know the percentage of people there who can actually Evolve and Adapt to Martin Stallone's exit strategy.

reviews.author: Bryce Damiani
reviews.text:
As others have said, trying to reach this office by phone is impossible. You will be placed on hold for at least 30 minutes if you are lucky. Otherwise the phone call will simply tell you to call back another time and hang up on you. The fact they do not have any sort of call returns is ridiculous. I have to wonder what the front desk does all day.

The two appointments I had there were decent. But each time I returned, the doctor I had seen before was no longer at that location.This locations turnover rate seems extraordinarily high.

Do not go to this office.

reviews.author: Jason C
reviews.text: Used Family Medicine and Dr. Darlow for 25+ year.  Never had a problem. I would send a message or make a phone call he (or someone) always got a quick and helpful answer.  Have had one appointment with new Dr. and new office and got wrong prescription called in and have spent days messaging on portal (which is useless) and calling (which takes forever) and cannot get it corrected. I've run out of meds and despite promises of a call back no one does. On the phone everyone I talks to says they see the problem, but its always someone else that has to fix it and they just don't. Unfortunately looking for a new provider. If this is how something that even they say is a simple fix is handled, then I don't want to be there if something complex comes up.

reviews.author: Evan Ogata
reviews.text: Last week I entered the City Harbor Urgent Care with some flu like symptoms. Luckily for me there was time on the schedule. I waited for a period and was admitted to a PA.  We had a good few minutes together and I felt better for the interaction plus I had marching orders to live by. Good experience all around.

reviews.author: Brian Earle
reviews.text: Krista D. was professional but personable. She understood my worries about infecting my 2 and 5 year-old grandchildren. She gave me a great set of instructions that I could take to the drug store and find exactly what was recommended. It was a great visit.

reviews.author: James Gantt
reviews.text: The staff at Guthrie was 100% amazing! I was visiting from New York City with soreness in the knee, making it difficult to walk. I was able to enter Guthrie, get x-rays, be seen by a physician who provided recommendations and prescribed medication, ultimately walking out within 40 minutes; possibly less! Each human I interacted with provided the maximum amount of care and concern to my needs. I highly recommend this space.

reviews.author: Albert Chaffee
reviews.text: Everytime I go to the Guthrie Clinic at Hanshaw, or any Guthrie facility, I am always treated with care, respect and dignity. Whether nit be for a blood draw, to see my PC or any ultrasound/ct I am treated with the highest, most competent  care. The people I see are always in good spirits, good natured and kind. Exactly what a patient need to calm their fears. I would recommend this Guthrie, and all of their facilities and care teams, to anyone who asks!!

reviews.author: Darlene
reviews.text: Needed an Echocardiogram before a surgery. The man that performed this was pleasant and professional. The problem was after that the info needed to get read, passed on to my Primary Care and sent to the surgeons. It was short notice due to an unforeseen issue. The surgeons office called Guthrie 3x checking for the release.  The echocardiogram results were obviously not read in a timely manner and the surgery needed to be canceled.  I had psyched myself up for this surgery and now I'm not sure when it can be put back on the schedule, since the results havent been read or a release has bern done.  Not happy.😒

reviews.author: Cedric Ulbing
reviews.text: I  had a good meeting with my primary care doctor (Dr. Kuntz).  He was able to address all my concerns and gave me sound advice.

reviews.author: Brian VanGo
reviews.text: I’ve been going to this office for over three years, and have had a great experience every time. They are professional, knowledgeable, and personable.

reviews.author: Yun Jiang
reviews.text: Really worth it to visit! The range of products are amazing, from frozen stuff to fresh produce and canned goods. Price wise, very affordable, better than the deals you can get at grocery stores in downtown ithaca.

reviews.author: yixianshuiesuan
reviews.text: Got to this little grocery before it closes for the semester. Small-scale but got very fresh local produce. Price is also significantly cheaper than the bigger grocery store in college town.

reviews.author: Vikram Shree
reviews.text: Well it's so close to the campus.

reviews.author: Kimberley Wemmer
reviews.text: Needed a script for my daughter for bad ear infection. Tell me their out and I would have to call pharmacies to see who had it then get a transfer or wait two days for it to come in. Call next day finally get help finding it elsewhere am told it will be transferred. Hour later went to pharmacy that was supposed to be transferred too nope they have no clue. Had to call back and get an oops didn't get transferred yet. I got a kid in alot of pain I don't need that headache and running around. Maybe do what you say you will the first time!!

reviews.author: H. Moy
reviews.text:
I 100% agree with the previous reviews regarding the women who work in the pharmacy. I honestly think its only one or two that are rude and lack customer service skills, but they are giving the rest of the staff a bad reputation. The pharmacists are always informative and helpful.
If I ever am a witness to any customer being treated poorly by a pharmacy staff member as previously mentioned in other reviews, I will NOT stand idly by. You will have a bad day.

reviews.author: M Travis
reviews.text: The pharmacist is always very good and treats me very well and takes care of my insurance and prescription issues with the doctor like a pro. The drive thru window lady was awful though. This was Friday night at 7pm at the Ithaca store. Bigger woman with blue shirt. She was very abrupt. When I received my prescriptions everything was just thrown into the canister. My insulin, my debit card and even the little brown bag, unopened. I understand being in a rush to close at 7 but if you can't keep your cool for 5 extra minutes at the end of the day then maybe try a new job.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: The NEVER pick up the phone. I watch them in store. At least 10 associates standing around. Nobody to pick up a phone.

reviews.author: Laurel Weber
reviews.text:
PHARMACY ONLY- THE STORE IS 👌
This is the 2nd or 3rd time a prescription gets sent over by my doctor, i get a notification from the pharmacy the day my doctor sends the script over- which is typically a good three or so days BEFORE the prescription is due but then on the day the prescription is actually due I'm getting a notification from wegmans that they are out of my prescription and they will need to order it and it'll be another 2 days. This is a fairly common medication.  And it's one I've gotten filled for YEARS. The fact that they wait until the day is due- CONSTANTLY- to tell me they are out and it'll be a couple more days, is getting old. I'm not the only person who deals with this issue and it's not the first time.

reviews.author: Rob L
reviews.text: I’ve had a wide variety of medications sent here and I only have an issue if it is related to syringes or testosterone. I’ve faced uncomfortable treatment and a total disregard for the importance of this for me. Honestly posting this because while trying to find a new pharmacy this one is coming back up, not that we aren’t already used to this but keep your guard up if you’re using HRT

reviews.author: Shanon & Matthew Morris
reviews.text: Hands down the best in Ithaca. Quick turnaround. Exceptional service. Fully stocked. Robert is thorough and kind.

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.text: Extremely extra friendly and caring staff (Hi Penny! Hi Tina!) and SUPER FAST on filling new prescriptions and refills. I like the text notifications to let me know my order is ready. They are great about proactively handling insurance issues (so I don't have to!) and have helped me a couple of times when I had to pay out of pocket -- to make sure I paid the lowest price possible. I have been a customer for about 20 years so the staff know me pretty well and we have a good rapport -- but honestly they treat everyone just as good. Wouldn't even think about going anywhere else!

reviews.author: Courtney Kelly Jett
reviews.text:
July 2024 this Tops pharmacy is sooo fast at filling prescriptions.
I’ve been using Ithaca downtown Wegman’s Pharmacy for a year, and they’re great helpful staff there, but it can also take days for refills, and at least 1-3 hours if you call directly. I’ve received texts from them that my meds are ready, and when I arrive that same day I still have to wait 15-30 min. for them to finish.
Versus this month now 4 times I’ve left a doctor appointment in downtown Ithaca and called the Tops from the parking lot to see when my med would be ready, and they announce each time it’s already done.
Tops staff isn’t as smiley/friendly as Wegman’s in person at the counter, but they are fast.

reviews.author: Nyufly81
reviews.text: This is Chipotle has some issues. The food is good and I actually got a chance to talk to. It was either a general manager or regional manager that happened to be there and he was very nice and accommodating so I had a pleasant experience with him. I noticed that this particular location that I always see a lot of workers in the background, but there's always only one person making orders. There should be at least two to three in order to get those lines through so people don't have to wait as long. Also, I noticed that this location often isn't very clean. Workers should be taking turns to make sure that the place stays clean when I want to sit down in there and I have to clean the table myself. Other than that, not terrible.

reviews.author: Oliver DiCarlo
reviews.text:
Very sad to say, but this was one of the dirtiest Chipotles I’ve ever been to. First of all, the front door and glass looked like it had never been cleaned and was smeared with food and finger prints. The trash cans were all overflowing. The counter where the employees serve the food from had so much food spilled on it that when we got our bowls the food was all stuck to the bottom. Every table looked about as good as the front door, and we had to clean our chairs to avoid sitting on spilled rice and sauce. But the worst was the bathroom which had no toilet paper and stuff all over the floor.

We almost walked out but we were starving. I’m honestly surprised we didn’t get sick.

It’s a shame because we aren’t picky people and we love Chipotle. But we might be second guessing it from now on because of this experience.

I think management needs to step up their game.

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: I'm not sure why it has only 2,6 stars from 1510 reviews, but my experience was great. When I came there, there was a big line (it was Sunday), but it took only 10 minutes. The staff was fast, and the food was pretty nice. If they ran out of some product, they immediately replaced it with a fresh one. I got a bowl with many different food in it, and all was delicious, except chicken. Some pieces were literally burnt... But, tbf, most of them were normal. The place was a bit dirty, but the cleaner literally cleaned it up in front of us. If you don't like to eat inside, you can eat outside - they have a terrace. Prices are good, but, tbf, it's not a restaurant, more like fast food :)

reviews.author: Elizabeth Welshans
reviews.text: We stopped by Pokelava when we were visiting Ithaca. The decor was very cute inside and a lot of seating was available. We went at a strange time to eat so there wasn’t a lot of people there. There were two ladies working and they both were fantastic. They carried our food for us and made sure that we were in the right seats. The food was so good and I didn’t realize how much food you really got with the bento box and we got a roll to share so I wish I wouldn’t have got that roll because of bento box would definitely fill you up. The only thing I didn’t like is that there was not ice for customer use. They did ask if you wanted ice and they would get it for you but then when I wanted to refill, I feel weird asking for more ice. Also, we got the juice there and they all were good and I combined a lot of them. The lady made sure that we got a refill to go, which was super kind of her. I thought this place was super neat and wish that we had one near us. So if they got ice, I probably would give it a five.

reviews.author: Dinesh Ghimire
reviews.text: Bowl is a healthy meal option but it didn’t hit the mark in terms of taste for me. Fresh fish smell in the meal is not great for me, but if you like that and sea weed, you might love it. I don’t remember the name but a crunchy toppings was great.

reviews.author: Roman Rabinovich
reviews.text: This place offers a fresh and satisfying poke experience, with customizable options that cater to diverse tastes. The ingredients are fresh, especially the fish. The restaurant’s clean, modern decor adds to the appeal, making it an ideal spot for a quick, healthy meal. The Fireball bowl is particularly recommended. Service is not always on point.

reviews.author: Anna Leader
reviews.text: We felt so lucky to come across this gem in the middle of nowhere! Incredible savory flavors, delicious flaky pastry, and unbelievable sweet treats as well. The pastries are a little pricey for their size at $6 each, but very worth it - we each got 3. There's a ton of seating, at tables and in armchairs by a roaring fireplace, as well as board games. Such a delight to have lunch here on a winter afternoon!

reviews.author: Shay Sadovsky
reviews.text: Delicious sweet and savory pies and delicious coffee! Also, there is plenty of seating, some board games and toys for kids, free wifi and a clean toilet. Such a gem!

reviews.author: EM
reviews.text: Errrmmmgod. Let's talk about those hand pies. The selection: so many. You have sweet and savory. Crispy crust, generous filling. Choose breakfast, lunch, and dessert ... Or how about all three?! These are hand pie containers of joy that you can dine in with or optimally designed for on the go consumption! I basically double fisted the sausage gravy and the cherry pie one sitting. Will not disappoint!

reviews.author: jacob fiaschetti
reviews.text: Owner did a great job on haircut and straight razor neck trim at the end with a little aftershave. Great atmosphere. Small business. I will be coming back next time.

reviews.author: Jack van Wesenbeeck
reviews.text: Genuinely the worst haircut I think I’ve ever gotten and I’m not even trying to be dramatic. Not sure how any barber could look at this and think it looks even remotely ok. The cherry on top is that this place is cash only which is irritating.

reviews.author: Jared Edwards
reviews.text: Should of renamed it quick cuts because that is what you are going to get with the new owner , dude needs to work on not rushing haircuts

reviews.author: Garrett R.
reviews.text: We had a great experience. The girl behind the counter with knowledgeable, friendly and happy to be working. Found what we needed, Have everything from rolling papers to cigarette lighters.

reviews.author: Arkham Lovecraft
reviews.text: Bought an item from this store using the app glass pass and they went above and beyond with my order. I bought a puffco peak pro. I ordered it on Saturday night and had it delivered by Tuesday afternoon. They also threw in some really cool freebies including an ooze silicone dab container, an ooze brand hot knife, and two shirts (which im sure were more for packing material purposes than on purpose) but they were conveniently me and my gfs size so we will for sure be repping this killer establishment all the way from Tennessee! 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Ruine Kisu
reviews.text: I had to call today to be sure if my favorite cashier was working at a store. I was given the best customer service on the phone. Then when I got in the store, my husband and I were amazed by the selection of glassware and all the various consumable product. Also Brian was very helpful and knowledgeable, not only for us because he assisted a few customers and even though he was taking good care of them, I still felt like a valued customer. Overall stellar experience. I will go here again.

reviews.author: Hillary Soule
reviews.text: I just ordered curry chicken and general Tso and the chicken was rubbery like it was raw in the curry and the sauce in general Tso tastes like its fermented.

reviews.author: EL.
reviews.text: My family and I have been enjoying the Garlic Tofu here for as long as I can remember, and it’s always been a favorite. I highly recommend it, as I don’t know any other place in Ithaca that prepares Chinese tofu as well. I also enjoy their Hot and Sour Soup (note that it's not vegetarian). While I haven’t explored the full menu, the dishes I regularly order are always delicious and well-prepared. I’m not sure why some people expect a gourmet experience here—what you see is what you get. It’s the perfect spot for take-out, and the staff is friendly and low-key.

reviews.author: TJ
reviews.text: I stopped in here for dinner. I ordered the orange chicken with white rice. The staff was very attentive and polite. The food was very good and super fresh. I am very satisfied with the food and service at this establishment.

reviews.author: Samantha Baker
reviews.text: Camden in the shoe department was extremely helpful. We came in to get my daughter shoes for track and he was very knowledgeable about what type of shoe is good for certain types of running. He also didn’t get upset at all when we didn’t get her size correct and he had to run back and forth to get us the right one. Thank you Camden!

reviews.author: The Throttles and Life of Dolly
reviews.text: I went in there for hunting and fishing supplies but there was none. What a disappointment. I suppose I'll go to a really outdoor store. They are more overpriced now that they have moved and some of the employees are rude and don't want to help or answer questions

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text: Poor quality products. Bought a pair of sunglasses from here that broke in 4 days. Went back for a replacement which broke in 8. They then had the nerve to tell me that since I didn’t buy the “protection plan” I didn’t qualify for a refund or exchange. Maybe have products that don’t fall apart in a handful of days and it won’t be an issue. The lady was nice enough to make an exception and refund it “this time only” but I shouldn’t be in a position to begin with that I need to be coming back and forth to get what’s rightfully mine.

reviews.author: Olivia
reviews.text: Such a cute spot! I found three pieces of decor here, including the sweetest little mirror with stained glass.

reviews.author: Sophia Sommers
reviews.text: Best bar in town! Perfect for a drink, plenty of room to socialize, and great live music. Lots of social groups meet up here too, so it never feels stale.

reviews.author: Colin Kelley
reviews.text: The best bar in Ithaca hands down!!! Fantastic selection, great spot and bartenders are super friendly. A little pricier than your average bar but the price is worth the product you’re getting.

reviews.author: Tom H
reviews.text:
A fantastic crew of friendly bartenders who are excellent at their craft. They always have a variety of tasty beers and cider on tap (note “variety” not just 10 IPAs that all taste the same) and a good selection of liquors and cocktails that are mixed with precision.

I never go to Ithaca without stopping at The Bike Bar

reviews.author: Jacqui G
reviews.text: Every time I’ve been here the food has been superb. It’s definitely a little spicy so be warned. There are a few vegan/vegetarian options. Service was very friendly!

reviews.author: Helin Wang
reviews.text:
This was hands down the WORST restaurant experience I have ever had.

The service was unbelievably poor, rude, and completely unprofessional. We were a large group and repeatedly tried to wave someone over just to place our order. The staff clearly saw us and deliberately ignored us. Not once. Not twice. Over and over again. Meanwhile, they were attentive, friendly, and responsive to other tables.

It honestly felt like we were being treated differently because we were a large Asian group. The contrast in service was obvious. Other customers were greeted warmly and helped immediately. We were ignored and given side-eye looks the entire time.

The server with glasses was especially rude. He kept telling us to “wait to the side” even though the restaurant was nearly empty. There was absolutely no reason to treat us that way. His attitude was dismissive and disrespectful from beginning to end.

To make things worse, it took ONE HOUR for the food to arrive. An hour — in an almost empty restaurant. Completely unacceptable.

And then the most outrageous part: they automatically added a 20% gratuity when we paid, without any clear notice or prior warning. There was no sign, no explanation, nothing. Forcing a 20% tip without transparency is extremely unethical. It feels like robbery when you provide terrible service and then demand a mandatory tip.

This place does not deserve your money. The service is discriminatory, disrespectful, and exploitative. I strongly do NOT recommend anyone go here.

Absolutely unacceptable.

reviews.author: Tobby Jiang
reviews.text:
I gave this restaurant two chances, and both visits were absolutely terrible.

The first time, the service was shockingly bad. We sat for over 30 minutes without being served water, appetizers, or even being properly greeted. No one came to take our order. We had to repeatedly get up and search for a server just to place it. It took forever for the food to arrive, and when the entrées finally came out, we still hadn’t received any water or appetizers. The lack of basic service was unacceptable and made the entire meal frustrating rather than enjoyable.

The second experience was somehow worse. We had a party of five in an almost empty restaurant, yet we were told to wait in line while multiple tables sat open and ready. Shortly after, a larger group walked in and was immediately seated while we continued standing in the corner waiting.

To make matters worse, we were forced to pay a 20% gratuity without any clear verbal notice or proper communication, despite the service being extremely poor. Charging an automatic tip for bad service is unacceptable and feels dishonest.

reviews.author: Aimee Dars Ellis
reviews.text: Mockingbird Paperie has wonderful cards that can't be found many other places. They also offer stationery-related gifts and fine wrapping paper. The selections are strongest for birthdays and blank cards. I went in for graduation cards and found few to choose from which surprised me given the time of year and that Ithaca is a college town. Usually, though, I can find the perfect cards for my needs.

reviews.author: Filip Galiza
reviews.text:
Love this store, love this staff, love the products as well as the art here.  When you want to buy something that is more meaningful, that doesn’t come from Amazon, that will have some meaningful usage then this is the place to visit.

Staff was SUUUUPER cool to chat with about the art and other things.  People like them is what makes Ithaca a very cool place!

reviews.author: Jeremy Boody, PMP
reviews.text: Sasha provided incredible customer service from when we first spoke on the phone to the in-store experience. This was my first time in a specialty store like this and their help made all the difference. The products had a great selection to choose from with even greater quality. I purchased a great card & envelope, a red fountain pen, wax, and a stamp for a nicer envelope seal.

reviews.author: Rarara
reviews.text: I’ve attended Cornell and frequented this store for over two years. On my last visit I was stopped by a middle aged white employee (i am brown) accused of taking merchandise into the restroom. After I clarified I had already purchased the T shirt I was taking in, the employee asked “What about the bag?” Referring to my school bag in an aggressive tone. My Nike school bag was bright orange, has been used for over 2 years, and most importantly, wasn’t even sold at the store. It had multiple pins and a keychain identifying it as a personal item. This bag has never been sold at this store, I’m just a non white student going to the restroom. It is disappointing to face such racial based micro aggressions. I have otherwise only had good experiences at this store and most of the staff are extremely nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Kurt Althoff
reviews.text: Three cheers for Linda! I couldn't find a particular item on their website so I called and luckily got a hold of a very helpful human. She was extremely familiar with the inventory and thought it may be on the clearance rack and no longer on the website. She contacted the storefront, found the item and took my order over the phone. You cannot ask for better customer service! Please give her a raise and a promotion. Go Bears!

reviews.author: Venice L.
reviews.text:
I haven’t been here in three years. I remember back then, the store wasn’t as big as it is now. They’ve done a great job renovating and expanding. There are more clothing options, though some are still of poor quality.

What I really like is how they’ve designed the space to connect the store with the post office and the coffee study area. I think it’s a brilliant idea.

reviews.author: Ashley Forest
reviews.text: Had a super fun time here while visiting my family in Ithaca! They have good music and it was decently crowded without getting too hot or to the point where it took too long to get a drink. The bartenders are on top of their game, only issue is the bar seems a little under stocked but the drinks that they do have are pretty good and pretty strong. Also if you go up on the stages to dance make sure you have good footing because they do get drinks spilled on them and get a little slippery (coming from someone who has a big bruise right now lol). Also there’s a very cute security guard so if you’re seeing this hit me up haha

reviews.author: Keith Kerfoot
reviews.text: This is the gods honest worst bar ever. With all the nastiness and mold in this place I am surprised I didn't get sick from just walking into the place. I understand catering to the younger, collage demographics but even they clean or pay someone else to clean for them. The bathrooms stink of stale urine while the rest of the place smells like rotting  a**. Don't mind all the flys and bugs the bug guy is coming however all the plastic cups with homemade bug catcher seem to have been around since the dark ages. The health department should shut them down and condemn this place.

reviews.author: Ethan Seltzer
reviews.text: I came here for a sorority date night and was having a great time until I tried to go to the bathroom. I was washing my hands when a bouncer came up to me and accused me of trying to wash the X off my hands. It did in fact fade and I understood his point so I offered to have him re-mark my hands but he insisted on kicking me out. I had no intentions to drink and asked to speak to a manager but he wouldn’t even let me. Extremely rude and disrespectful.

reviews.author: M Bailey
reviews.text: My wife and I stumbled upon this incredible outdoor bar last night, and it completely blew us away. The vibe was effortlessly cool… like stepping into a Moroccan tea room under the stars. Comfy, cozy, and beautifully styled, it was the perfect setting for a relaxing evening with great drinks and even better ambiance. We’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Ella Sway
reviews.text: This Clarified Lassi is JUST like a cocktail I had in Mexico City at one of the world’s best bars, Handshake Speakeasy. this cocktail is smooth, refreshing bright and brilliant. Wow.

reviews.author: Helen O
reviews.text: Highly recommend Jazz Night on Wednesdays! We ordered the nut and olive plate and the cocktails Hot Priest and Flora and Fauna. All were great! Service was very quick and no wait for seating.

reviews.author: Angelo Garcia
reviews.text: Well at first I was very excited to visit this location, the view from the balcony is amazing but only available during the warmer months!Coffee was perfect so I thought the food would follow suit. Nope! The home fries were a bit dry  , the eggs Benedict lacking sauce * not enough provided * so they sat on a dry English Muffin, the little sauce I got was tasteful. I ordered 2 pancakes, they looked good, not enough butter provided and if you wanted real Maple Syrup you pay $2.50 extra * should have been included in the price oh well! The gentleman who gave us a seat, young fellow, hardly spoke, mute? Shy? Who knows! No courtesy or manners? The waitress must have been having a hard day she also didn’t speak much! However the place still managed to bring a good crowd so they must be doing something right… right? Nevertheless I will not be coming back…

reviews.author: Jack Stanick
reviews.text: Not a bad spot at all. Fair pricing, quality diner food. Decent location and nice staff. Steak and eggs were good and worth it; you get what you pay for. Would recommend for a Saturday or Sunday brunch.

reviews.author: Joseph Burke
reviews.text: Definitely a great diner, the corn beef hash was very solid (although it could have been a bit crisper, so you might want to consider asking for that) and their cinnamon glazed toast was good, if a bit stiff. Great experience overall, and food left me feeling full and satisfied.

reviews.author: Zach Jaeger
reviews.text: If you are in South Hill and need booze, this is the place to go! The selection can be a little slim when school is not in session, but they usually have the big names you're looking for. They also tend to have a good amount of regional wines, so no need to go downtown to get your Finger Lake favorites!

reviews.author: Tyrone Barnett
reviews.text: Well... First of all when I got out of my car instantly the person, after her break said, "the kids (My kids) need to show ID to enter the store". My children are of age, however,  I told her they were not going to come in, so don't worry. In typically fashion in establishment like these, I presented my credit card and of course I had to show my I'D. Well, I had a friend of my enter 15 minutes after me and of course he (looking a little different) don't have show his I'D. You can't make it up! NO I WOULD NEVER SUGGEST THIS STORE TO ANYONE. You can find alcohol in the many other Liquor Store in Ithaca.

reviews.author: L R
reviews.text: Top Shelf Liquor store never lets me down. Such a variety of specialty liquors, and a great wine selection. I was on a low budget and was able to get a 1.5L bottle of.Pino Grigio for under $10!!! Love this place!

reviews.author: Nick Huber
reviews.text: Great people and fair prices. Brian did an excellent job with my vinyl letter install but they also handle all of our signage and marketing material. Great resource in the Ithaca area. Bravo!

reviews.author: Rod Lambert
reviews.text: Had to get some 8 1/2 x 11 copies done quickly - they were very kind and said no charge!

reviews.author: Armin Heurich
reviews.text: Gorges takes such great care of their customers, with an exceptional range of quality bikes and accessories. Also, service and advice is incredible! I couldn’t be happier with my Jamis Renagade. Gorges really supports the local cycling culture as well.

reviews.author: John Clark
reviews.text:
I never post reviews but felt the need to share:

I took my bike in to have work done, I use it everyday to get to work. They shop seemed good and knowledgable in bikes, however owner is fairly rude and tries to dominate younger people in a condescending manner (Such as college students).

I give two stars for the timeframe and customer service:
Bike was brought in Friday afternoon, I was told by the mechanic it would be started/looked at over the weekend,
-then I was told monday,
-then I was told later in the week (his reason was "it is a long job so we need to set time aside")

I called them to check when it would be done and if the parts I brought were compatible however they had not started yet, so I called a second time to see.

**The man proceeded to yell at me over the phone, he repeatedly told me:
that he "works 100 hour work weeks,"
I need to stop asking him for a timeframe
I should "take the bike back now"
and that I waste "10 minutes every time I call him"

He was not able to give me a timeframe and told me to wait to be called when he gets to it.

I was excited to work with them and have a reliable local shop, unfortunately that will be found elsewhere.

reviews.author: Mel G
reviews.text: My husband and I were in from out of town and had the unfortunate experience of having our bikes stolen while in Ithaca.  We looked up a place to buy new ones and came across Gorges.  Tom and his employee were gracious, insanely helpful, and an absolute delight to work with.  Highly recommend.  They really turned a bad situation good for us.

reviews.author: Astrid Radtke
reviews.text: I had an appointment with Jolene. I needed to get my 4 week old short bob a fresh shape. She did it perfectly! She listened to my concerns and wishes and did better than i expected. She knows the Art of cutting hair. I will be back to see her and recommend her work.Thank you!

reviews.author: Amy Gaines
reviews.text:
This team of women are truly the absolute best in Ithaca. The entire team are knowledgeable, kind and professional. The salon is chic and welcoming and the service is always 10/10.
I’ve received cuts, color, and multiple types of extensions over the years (note a service not all salons have the experience to preform) and have never left disappointed.
5 stars every single time.

reviews.author: sandia sandia
reviews.text:
I had roots from a diy and The Ivy took care of my hair, bringing it back from the brink and into a dye job that has grown out ever so gracefully.  Many moons later I still get compliments.
I also loved my experience in the salon...so inviting, beautiful, and friendly.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Fern
reviews.text: I had a great visit at Aspire. I already knew what I wanted, but the staff was glad to show me some alternates. I would be excited to see Silly Nice in there. I love their products and their Minority and Veteran owned mission.

reviews.author: Patrick Fowler
reviews.text: Wonderful staff and product selection! Very happy to have them here! Peace

reviews.author: Michelle Katz
reviews.text: My recent experience was the epitome of great customer service. My product was defective (to no fault of Aspire) and they gave me a new one right on the spot to avoid a hassle with going through the distributor. They also provided me with more education about the product and explained to me more of how to use it. I was so satisfied that I ended up buying more products from their store and signing up for a loyalty card. Thanks aspire!

reviews.author: Mushtewin Silver
reviews.text: I love the energy and vibes of the coffee shop, Everyone is so nice and welcoming. The prices are amazing, especially for being mostly organic and still tasty 😋🙌🏽✨ (+ I got a cute design on my coffee 😭 I was sad that I ruined it but it was too good 😭🤧)

reviews.author: Mike Kelley
reviews.text:
Great place to grab a quick bite and some awesome coffee.

Swing by and enjoy, snapped a picture of the pastries they had when we visited. I really enjoyed the Stargazer drip coffee.

reviews.author: Sierra Dawn Aumell
reviews.text: These guys came highly recommended however I've never really made a point to stop in until I had to use the bathroom so bad. I asked for decaf and she offered it in a latte (never had one before figured what the heck I didn't even want the coffee) she was SO pleasant even had dairy free options! ...but when I tasted that latte.. Drank it right down, couldn't stop! I AM SOLD!! This is my new favorite place!!  Cheers 😎👍

reviews.author: John
reviews.text:
A Polished Gem in College Town ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
If you’re looking for a sophisticated, clean, and modern retreat in the middle of the Ithaca student bustle, Fair Pour is it.
Even though we felt like the "grown-ups" in the room being in the heart of College Town, the atmosphere was incredibly relaxing and welcoming. The space is spotless, the aesthetic is on point, and the service was genuinely great—attentive without being overbearing.
The Standouts:
* The Food: We were blown away by the quality. The chicken salad was fresh and perfectly dressed, but the real star was the toast topped with diced apples, walnuts, and that rich balsamic glaze. It was as beautiful as it was delicious.
* The Coffee: Smooth, high-quality, and clearly made with care.
* The Vibe: It’s the perfect spot to decompress. Whether you're a student or just passing through, it feels like a high-end escape.
Highly recommend if you want a "grown-up" culinary experience in a great campus setting!

reviews.author: Natalie Cross
reviews.text:
Visited with a friend for breakfast. Nice atmosphere for something different in Ithaca. Tried the Carmel Cappuccino with oatmeal twice(small cup). Lol
Apple pastry and made my own selection of a plain avocado egg and sausage patty on toast.  Would love more food optionsfor myself personally, but would recommend to others.

reviews.author: Ally
reviews.text: Other reviews accurate! Really pleasant, and good for spending a while working. A very large and comfortable open space with multiple seating options (I actually really like the very large stools? They're very solid) and the coffee is delicious; I tried the lavender cardamom. Similarly, the sourdough panini I got, the berry brie, was fantastic. I don't live close enough to come every day but I'll definitely return on weekends!

reviews.author: Rasen Shuriken
reviews.text: Bank Coffee has a classy, elegant vibe that fits perfectly with Ithaca. The staff is warm and welcoming, and service was quick. I tried one of their specialty lattes—chocolate orange latte. It was good, though I’ve had better elsewhere. The milk texture could be better.  What really stood out was the atmosphere: calm, relaxed, and a great spot to sit for a while. Being right in Downtown makes it an easy place to stop by, and definitely worth a visit for the vibe alone.

reviews.author: Patrick O'Shaughnessy
reviews.text: Stopped in for a cappuccino at this cute coffee shop right on the commons.   My drink was perfectly prepared and hot.   Nice atmosphere with people of all ages enjoying drinks and treats.

reviews.author: tavers
reviews.text:
Friendly cafe in downtown with nice decor. good spot for a study session or catching up with friends. I personally find this place has a typical underlying smell which is not of baked goods or coffee beans, and I find it unpleasant. This smell/flavor lingers in the baked goods too, even if in have it next day. Although the texture of their pastries is good, the taste is knocked off by that weird smell/flavor. I hope they find the source and fix it.
The coffee was disappointing. It was a bitter flat white, with very foamy milk. The coffee was bad in both taste and texture. The espresso didn't seem to be dialed properly. Would not recommend getting standard espresso drinks.
The staff is very polite and service was quick.

reviews.author: Alexander Shyshla
reviews.text: Great rental place! Easy to rent a bike! We came without any reservation and were able to rent two bikes for adults and two bikes for kids. Service was good! Bikes in good condition! Great location. Prices are friendly!

reviews.author: Alex Shender
reviews.text: The bikes are in GREAT condition.  They are well maintained and clean.  These bikes aren't cheap bikes, they are higher end Fuji bikes.  The staff was friendly and knowledgeable about the local area.

reviews.author: Liz
reviews.text: Did a great job getting me on the right size bike, provided an excellent description of where to bike, and are right next to a really beautiful park. Good pricing too. Recommend!

reviews.author: Curtis
reviews.text: This is actually a review for their Lansing branch, but it doesn't exist in Google! We've been working with them for over a year on an estate, and they have been great the whole time. But at the very end, sending out final checks, it turned into a giant fiasco (because of me and math!) and the entire office was so kind and considerate. They walked us through the whole process, triple checked all of our math, triple checked when I realized I was completely wrong about something, and were exceedingly patient! I even had to go back today about an issue with the postal service which meant they had to do even more work, and they were so kind and worked so hard to assist me. Shout out to Shaylynn, who helped us out both times and was the kindest human through all of it!

reviews.author: Amelia Parseghian
reviews.text: I have used CLNB since I was a child opening my first savings account and they have always provided excellent service. When I was out of the country and my debit card was scammed, they blocked the transaction and contacted me immediately. We recently worked with Kelly Gavitt on a mortgage and she was excellent - she got us locked in at a great rate even though our closing was very much delayed.

reviews.author: Sarah Fessenden
reviews.text: An excellent bank. I've moved states twice and will always keep my hometown bank. They are prompt to answer any questions, have always have great customer service, and truly treat each customer as though they are the only customer.

reviews.author: C
reviews.text: Gave me a huge song and dance about rates. Conflicting info. about interest rates from local office and corporate. Will went so far as to say if I didn't like the rates then maybe I should close my accounts and move my money elsewhere!! My spouse almost walked out right there. Both told me my rate would not change but it did exactly when I said it would. I think they thought I was some stupid senior who wouldn't notice. So, this week they lost $500K and will also not be getting another $4-500k from other assets. If $1M means nothing to them, that's ok with me. I will be getting substantially more interest elsewhere. I will not be back no matter how good key bank rates go after the way I was lied to. Employees could sure use some customer service training!

reviews.author: Brien Colgan
reviews.text: I'm a small business owner, not a millionaire by a about one million dollars. And I have the bank managers personal cell number. And he answers that cell and he returns emails. That is kind of outstanding! This feels like a small town bank. In all the ways that it's good. Easy, personable staff. It was really easy to open a business account. They make it easy to run a small business and seem to understand the challenges that entails. M&T while having very a capable local manager does not allow him the same latitude for solving daily cash flow problems that I need solved.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Wall
reviews.text: We had a pretty sad experience with Key. Originally, I was excited to start banking with a larger reaching bank for the area. I thought it would compliment our more local banking.  Key was enthusiastic to bring us on board. They sold us on their travel friendly banking and investment advice.  It's true their customer service in the branch is generally good and these staff are well trained.  However, the good service all ended when I needed support from beyond the branch, when my card was fraudulently used while traveling. When we returned from Mexico, I spotted a suspicious charge. I identified it immediately and reported it.  I've had a few instances like this with a few different banks.  The resolution has always been straight forward. Not with Key.  Their fraud team refused to resolve the dispute. They accused me of providing contradicting information.  They sandbagged communication.  They promised review and escalation which never materialized. Branch  employees turned out to be helpless in the matter.  It's been months and I've figured out why I really just don't recommend Key for others: there's no real security.  They contract with bottom of the barrel card service packages.  Their fraud investigation contractor is similarly low quality. Their goal appears to be not to protect clients but to exploit them.  In summary, Key is hollow service.  No more reach than solid local banks and less security, if any. For those who want more reach and international support, better to travel to Buffalo or Albany to bank with TD or some other chain bank.

reviews.author: abbys crafty corner teeter
reviews.text: The staff at this branch is very friendly and helpful..always very patient especially when you have multiple transactions.. I would recommend this branch for any banking needs ... I've been a customer for close to 20 years and don't plan on changing banks any time soon ...have a blessed day 💖

reviews.author: E.C. Barrett
reviews.text: My partner's debit card was skimmed and used to purchase over $1000 in gas at a single gas station over a 40 minute period of time. Documents provided to us by the bank manager show that the charges were flagged as suspicious but processed anyway without notifying us. Community Bank refuses to refund the charges, even after suspects have been arrested, and even after the bank manager admitted via email that it was their error in not alerting him to the suspicious activity. Community Bank cannot be trusted with your money.

reviews.author: Ted Crane
reviews.text:
UPDATE: THIS BRANCH IS NOW PART OF COMMUNITY BANK
First impressions of the change: from best  to one of the worst.
- no longer provide paper statements unless you pay for them
- low interest rates on savings
- do not provide savings rates online, do not distribute rate sheets on paper; you can get them verbally in the branch
- do not appear to follow the "greet customers by name when you arrive" policy any more
- (added 7/31/2022) when you do receive paper statements, THERE IS NO DATE ON THE STATEMENT. Individual accounts have dates associated with them, but there is no overall statement date. I've never seen a bank statement without a statement date before!

I expect to close many of my accounts and move them elsewhere.

Original review:
Probably the best bank in Ithaca. The only bank where they greet you as you enter...and even by name once you know them.

Better rates than several local banks, but some of the same gotchas. On the whole, a better deal than most. Sure, they like you to bring in "new" money to get the best rates, but so does everyone else. So you move it from place to place...take from the rich and give to the poor...and get good rates everywhere.

Try 'em, you'll like 'em.

reviews.author: Kavir Doty
reviews.text: The sign on the door says both walks in welcome and to call for an appointment, and also says to enter through a back door barely marked. I have no idea if they're still open or not, the phone line is also disconnected, but I'm not getting stabbed today, I'll just disappoint my black ancestors and go to Supercuts.

reviews.author: John Vanderspek
reviews.text: Came here with my brother while visiting Ithaca for work and these guys hooked us up with the best fades we’ve ever gotten. 10/10 would return here if in the area again. When I get home I’ll be sure to show my barber what a fade should actually look like. Don’t play yourself. Get a cut, and make sure it’s supreme.

reviews.author: Ryan Benedict
reviews.text: Best barbershop in Ithaca! Umar always hooks me up with clean cuts. Usually takes 30-45 minutes for a very nice haircut. He’s always paying attention to detail to give me the perfect cut. Highly recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Peter Wallin
reviews.text: The Office Equipment Source has been our Xerox copier and print provider for many years and have done an excellent job in meeting both our requirements. They also service provide world class service and our quick to fix any problems that do arise.

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: Amazing restaurant! My food was delicious. I ordered Saigon Kitchen fried rice with shrimp, and it was very tasty. Shrimps were cooked well, and rice too. I loved the size of the dish. The restaurant and my table were clean, and the staff were fast and friendly. Strongly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Mostly Insane
reviews.text: Overall the food was good. They took a while to bring the food when we were out there. We bought the shrimp and chicken mainly for the curries. The shrimp was cooked very tender but felt the chicken were cooked little extra. Flavors were pretty good.

reviews.author: Rosy
reviews.text: As a party of 2, we entered around 9:45 pm, which is 45 minutes before they close. They still accommodated us and our food came out quickly. The only downside is that they took away the sauces even though it was still open hours, so we had to get them from another table. The pho was delicious and the meat was also good and tender. Would come again because it’s very convenient and good with a decent price!

reviews.author: Jenna BEar
reviews.text:
I would give 0 stars if I could.  The owner is extremely rude for no reason.  Doesn’t even want to answer a question about if they carry weed vapes.  Then yelled at me for taking a free cup of coffee & said ‘nothing is free!’  I said then where’s the sign with the coat of the coffee?  There’s no sign.  It’s supposed to be free but she just yells if you try to take any.  What’s the point?  To look like you have free coffee & good customer service & then to yell at potential customers?

I used to be a customer here.  Never again. Find another source for your products.

reviews.author: Robbie Rob
reviews.text:
The folks are always friendly and knowledgeable
Probably the best place to get smokes since Mayers closed years ago. If you are a cigar aficionado, you are in luck, the humidor is well stocked. If you roll your own, you are in luck as well, the selection is amazing

Smoke em if ya got em, you can smoke inside

reviews.author: Robyn Forkey
reviews.text: Great variety, friendly staff. Through pandemic stayed open and stocked. Is relieving, being from the city, that a local place has such great customer service and quality options at reasonable prices

reviews.author: Zach Jaeger
reviews.text: Excellent little liquor store! They have all the big name stuff plus a lot of local and regional products too. The wine section is a little small, but all top notch!

reviews.author: Phillip B
reviews.text: A quaint little shop that features wine more than spirits but the shop keep was knowledgeable and helped me on my bourbon hunt for fun and unique fair.  Would recommend for any bourbon hunter to stop in and see what's available.

reviews.author: Seth Sicroff
reviews.text: Chris, Adrian and Bill are knowledgeable and friendly. Good selection, and their $5.99 rack always has some excellent bargains.

reviews.author: Casey Smith
reviews.text: Fareed designed the most beautiful rose gold eternity wedding band for me, and I am absolutely obsessed with it! He took what I had in mind and made it a reality. This quality and amazing customer service is better than what you would receive at any chain jewelry store. I will most definitely be using Carla Bijouterie in the future!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Van Loan
reviews.text: Fareed cleaned the engagement ring I inherited and he created a wedding band to match it. He did an amazing job. I highly recommend going to Carla Bijouterie Gallery.

reviews.author: Elisabeth Bianco
reviews.text: Fareed is an expert in every sense of the word. He designed and made a setting/ring for a diamond I already had, and it exceeded my every expectation. Quality and workmanship is stunning (the old setting paled in comparison), he answered a million questions that I had during the process, and was timely and pleasant to work with. I will definitely be a returning customer.

reviews.author: Zoë Van Nostrand
reviews.text: Fareed is a master jeweler and can repair, design, or manufacture any new design brought to him. My family has worked with Fareed for years, and his craftsmanship is beyond compare.

reviews.author: Sarah Cory
reviews.text: Incredible jewelry created here!!  I will never go anywhere else for any jewelry needs. Fareed and his team are all amazing!!

reviews.author: Dionysys Entertainer
reviews.text: The highest quality craftsmanship of handmade jewelry

reviews.author: Christianne White
reviews.text: Eric has so much experience and can give a great cut quickly and expertly, and charges a reasonable price, which gives room for a good tip!

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: This place was recommended to my girlfriend and she loved it period. They actually understood what she meant by layering and everything she wanted. She's always telling me to go here for a haircut. I'm really bad at getting haircuts when I need to. But I think it was $25 for her haircut which is very reasonable especially for a woman's haircut.

reviews.author: Evelyn Weinstein
reviews.text: when you find somebody who could cut hair with her eyes closed and inside of a refrigerator you know you found the right place! Love you Amelia and Eric! Best place in Ithaca by far!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Clark
reviews.text:
Had a pleasant 1st experience here @ Hannah’s Hair Salon.
Came in for a wash and re-twist.As walk in.
She got me right in and I was out within 45min.Very experienced and you shows in her work.Definitely will recommend and I’ll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Johnny Davis
reviews.text: Just got my braids done, it was FLAWLESS. Her shop is very inviting and welcoming. Hanunah is very professional and I was very excited to get my hair done here. Her shop is very popular in the Ithaca area and I am very happy to have picked her shop. Excellent salon and excellent work.

reviews.author: Cat K
reviews.text: A really great experience💙 Keisha did a great job with my hair and she is so lovely! The custom resin jewelry and clip rave braids etc that they have are beautiful too!

reviews.author: kay LA
reviews.text: I’ve been to many Salvation Army’s around the state & this by far one of my favorites! It’s huge and the prices are better than some of the other stores.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text:
The hours of operation  at the time of this writing are : 9AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Saturday! But and a big but.... If you're looking to make a donation, and you have a car load of stuff,  and you drive to the back of the building.... you have to make their drop off window of between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Mon through Saturday.

Not very convenient for a professional working 9 to 5 in my opinion!Their donation hours are not the same as their store hours! If you  don't make that window, you will be taking that car load of donations right back home with you !

And if the thought crosses your mind to just leave the donation just outside the locked door, for them to pick up in the morning......that is considered dumping and you may be prosecuted! You are risking that your donation may be stolen any way over night as well.

What ever happened to those large red over flowing donation bins you would see in different parking lots?

reviews.author: Greg Wheeler
reviews.text:
This picture is how ridiculous they are there and when I said something the associate actually raised her voice the Ithaca NY Salvation Army has become an absolute joke of a place!
Do your research before buying anything and don’t bother asking for help the associates won’t give you the time of the day or are extremely rude when answering.

reviews.author: Meagan T
reviews.text: This used to be my absolute favorite store in all of Ithaca. I don't know what has changed but it's changed drastically and, unfortunately, not in a good way. Their prices have gone up majorly. Some items that I saw in reuse were actually more expensive than the same item brand new in another store. And they've gotten rid of the 75% off discount. There is also a lot of inconsistencies. On Elmira rd all of the games are $1. In the triphammer mall they're not and some of them are ridiculously expensive. I couldn't find a single wall decoration for a reasonable price. This stuff is donated. They're not spending money on it so I don't understand why my favorite store is now overcharging.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.text: Always a wonderful time!!! They have really been a huge help after my apartment flooded. When my credit was about to expire the staff was so helpful in extending the date to help me wait till I moved to my new place!!! And I found a nifty case for $1!!!

reviews.author: Jesse Bush
reviews.text: This is probably one of the best second hand stores in at least three counties. The people who work here are great and very helpful. They have everything and then some.

reviews.author: Scott Warner
reviews.text: Customers service couldn’t be better! Everybody I talked to was very polite and answered every question I had. They do everything over email and they answer them very promptly. When I picked my shocks up I was running 15 minutes late and when I called they said no problem and somebody stayed the extra few minutes so I could get them that night. Great business!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Simmons
reviews.text:
Highly recommended professional suspension machine shop. Hygear took on the challenge of lowing my Ducati. They methodically worked through the steps with good communication (and pics) throughout.
The bike now has a lower center of gravity and better road feel. This is the custom ride I was hoping for. The work accomplished allows me to now take my new bike anywhere with confidence.
Your work and efforts will be enjoyed for many years.
Jeff S
W Danby

reviews.author: Don Mullet
reviews.text: We were riding at Tug Hill and broke the eyelet off my center shock. I called Hygear and they had a replacement in stock. Being 2 hours away, I wouldn't make in time. However I was able to pay over the phone and they offered to leave it out for me. We made the drive to grab the shock. It was even professionally boxed up with my name on it. Got back to our base and swapped it in. Made my weekend. You have a customer for life.

reviews.author: Max Xyreus
reviews.text: I always go to Lisa for my haircuts and trims, and have been for 3 years. She’s easy to chat with, quick with the basics, and gives great coloring and styling advice whenever I ask. I’ve never been disappointed with her work. I especially love that she’s never taken off more length than I’ve asked during a trim, and knows how to work with my thick, straight hair. She does men and women’s cuts very nicely, and works well from a photo reference while also being honest if a style may not work/will take extra work for your hair type.

reviews.author: Don Hradisky
reviews.text: Lisa does a great job cutting or styling your hair.

reviews.author: Georgia Eastman
