reviews.text: I was able to get an appointment right away and she did a fine job .

reviews.author: Deb Myers
reviews.text: I have just recently changed to this office for primary care. I have lived in this region, basically, my entire life. In the last 5 years I have been with 5 providers- for primary care. With this many movements/transfers/retirements, I felt I needed to find a place that would be in the area for more than a few months/years as I know the importance of continuity of care. That said, my very first appointment at Pine Point office, Josh Hamilton, FNP, was so easy to attain- I called and had an appointment within 2 weeks. Every test discussed during our first office visit was ordered, most set up within 1-2 days and all within that week. Phone calls to me- not simply through a portal. Portals are great for some things yet it is refreshing to know a business understands human contact importance, especially within the healthcare field. I appreciate the multiple offerings that are available within the same office as well. I have a feeling I will wish I had switched much sooner.

reviews.author: Donna Bailey
reviews.text: I met with Sarah Missen, athletic trainer. She was easy to talk to. I answered a series of questions (it was my first appointment) and she had me do a few different movements to assess my form during exercise. She was very thorough and explained the importance of form and how that helps the effectiveness of each exercise.  We made a plan to meet again in a couple weeks so that she could create a specific program that meets my needs. In the meantime, she gave me some upper and lower body exercises to start with as well as some bands to help with some of the movements. I am looking forward to our next meeting.

reviews.author: Sahas Derf
reviews.text: Pine Point care givers are consistently responsive and compassionate.  They know me well, ask appropriate questions to  fully understand my health concerns, and provide meaningful insights and feedback.  I trust Pine Point to help me stay healthy and active as I move through my 60's and beyond.

reviews.author: Michael Bashta
reviews.text: Cathy (maybe Kathy?) is awesome!  And the best part is that this is a local place, so by going here, I'm keeping the money in the community.  I always look forward to getting a haircut here and having a nice chat!

reviews.author: John Sullivan
reviews.text: Cathy, formerly at Gene's in the Triphammer Mall, is simply the best barber in Ithaca, or anywhere.

reviews.author: Manny Flores
reviews.text: Cathy always provides sharp looking cuts for gents and boys. And the prices are a steal.

reviews.author: Laurence Walsh
reviews.text: Fantastic small shop for unique gifts and games, with a cozy back area for board games, puzzles, and friendly camaraderie. The owner generously took time to explain the globally sourced items. I highly recommend a visit to anyone in the area looking to support a local business with one-of-a-kind finds.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Davis
reviews.text:
always love stopping in, as a collector this store offers a great selection of blind boxes and games. my partner likes anime figurines and they always have new ones in stock. one piece, Pokémon, tokidoki, mitski, sushi cat, and more 💞
the owner is always friendly and knowledgeable about each product

reviews.author: Anna Lustig
reviews.text: Visiting Ithaca for the weekend and went in search of some last minute birthday gifts. Thalia was beyond helpful and kind. I saw the passion and dedication they have for creating a warm and welcoming environment for everyone. Definitely coming back, maybe for game night or two!

reviews.author: William Friedlander
reviews.text: I regularly visit Benjamin Peters  and am always impressed with the experience. The customer service is exceptional, with Sam, the owner, and Mickey offering personal attention and genuine care. They are up-to-date with the latest fashion trends, and stock a wide selection of stylish options for both casual and business clothes.What truly sets them apart is their honesty; staff provides sincere feedback on what clothing suits you best, ensuring you leave with pieces that enhance your style. My friends from all over, big cities and small come to shop here for a reason : good service and up-to-date clothes that fit. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: John Sullivan
reviews.text: This is the men's haberdashery you WISH you had in your town. I had a funeral in 3 weeks for which I needed a dark gray suit and I was leaving town the next day for Northern Virginia. I knew Ben Peters and thought my chances of getting a great fitting suit at a decent price was higher there than down in VA. Found a perfect suit there, but not available in my preferred dark gray, so had to be ordered. No problem, we can ship it to you, Sam said. Took my measurements for alternations, I paid for it and crossed my fingers. Suit arrived in plenty of time with no wrinkles, fit perfectly and looked great.

reviews.author: JR R
reviews.text: Personal service is a must! This is the store to get quality and focused service.  Great staff and quality material.

reviews.author: Sarah Smathers
reviews.text: I had samgye tang and enjoyed it very much! I typically eat this using spoon chopsticks and scissors but only had a spoon and chopsticks after a few seconds the server came over and cut the chicken for me which I appreciated greatly! Loved the atmosphere felt like I was in Seoul, Korea again!

reviews.author: Daniel Wander
reviews.text: We almost left because the atmosphere was off a little bit. It was about 45 minutes before their closing time and it didn't seem like they were very busy. But then this amazing waitress came and made us feel right at home. We got the vibe that the level of quality here was restricted by the owner or management... The waitress Evyn apologized for things that were out of her control, but we didn't mind at all. Ultimately, the food was amazing but the service is what makes this place what it is. Bibimbap sauce was dank!

reviews.author: Taylor Hittner
reviews.text: This restaurant blew me away. The service was great, the food was outstanding, and everything feels like it’s homemade. The Gyoza may seem like an item you would pass on, but do not! They are hand made and have delicious pork and glass noodles in them. Thanks for a great meal!

reviews.author: Maxine fallon-goodwin
reviews.text: Incredibly kind service, and the best dumplings I've had in years. A must try when in Ithaca and add it to your favorite spots if you're a local, I'll definitely be going back soon.

reviews.author: Ryan Bince
reviews.text:
The lady who took my order was a delight! She didn't speak a word of English, but she pulled out a handwritten paper menu and asked me to point. She was all smiles, very sweet. After I ordered, she gave me a complimentary cabbage fritter while I waited for my food.

The beef noodle soup was an absolute work of art. The meat was tender and flavorful, the broth was beautifully balanced, and the noodles were delicious. I am eager to return.

reviews.author: The Sticks
reviews.text: This place is as authentic as it gets.  They make all our their products on site, including Youtiao (savory crispy donuts), dumplings and buns.  The soup broths are rich and flavorful.   Prices are very fair so its great value. If you like Chinese food, its a must try.

reviews.author: Minsu Kim
reviews.text:
Goat Curry, L

Taste: A bit graphic description is that I was glad that I’m not vegetarian. Meat was so tender and well seasoned. Rice and veggies went really well the meat. I loved their mac n cheese!

Portion for a 5’1 woman : I got large to save a half for lunch tomorrow (posted pic). I couldn’t finish the first half today and am going into food coma.

I’m def going back to try the rest on the menu!

reviews.author: Amy Won
reviews.text:
At long long last! I've been driving to nearby towns for Jamaican but we finally have our very own and boy is it good! I tried the brown stew chicken lunch special and it comes with generous serving of rice and peas and chicken and some stir fry cabbage, and also a Jamaican soft drink! All so delicious! The homemade hot sauce is fruity, sweet and yummy spicy.

They have the works - jerk, oxtail, curry goat and also a nice selection of hard to find Jamaican groceries like canned ackee and callaloo.

Can't wait to go back and try the other options!! Please everyone go eat there and keep this gem open!

reviews.author: Kimberly N
reviews.text: Oh my goodness the curry goat with rice and beans and collard greens was soooo good. Very flavorful and the meat was so tender. Huge portions too. One medium size was plenty for me and my mom. My dad liked his curry chicken pastry too.

reviews.author: CRISTIAN ACOSTA
reviews.text: Omg, their food is SO GOOD! you have to come and try the chicken on rice and the gyros. Great flavor and the lady getting the orders is so nice. Great food and customer service. Recommended! ✅

reviews.author: Atlas Wu
reviews.text: Had chicken over rice here and it tastes stellar. The price is also unbeatable. A no brainer if you want to grab a quick lunch at Ithaca Downtown area. P.S paying by cash will be cheaper.

reviews.author: Benacio Antonio
reviews.text: The owners are so incredibly kind (It was my first time trying halal food, and I had never been here, so the owner decided to give me a free drink, which was so sweet of her!) and they *always* have a smile on their faces, and this top tier service is legitimately mirrored in their food. The lamb quite literally melts in your mouth and the portions are BIG! They are so very generous and it shows! There was a line for them when I managed to get here, and I hope this continues to be this way for ever. They deserve it! Thank you so much for the delicious food, I really recommend it! (I'm terrible at taking pictures, but it doesn't really do justice to this delicious plate they made for me!)

reviews.author: Tenzin Geygong
reviews.text: Really yummy! Had the beef dumplings and the lo mein. The hot sauce was not too spicy, very good pairing. The dough of the dumpling was soft and not chewy, very well steamed. Overall awesome!

reviews.author: Aakash Kapoor
reviews.text: The dumplings are far from authentic, the dough is not good, and the hot sauce is too tomatoey and not spicy.

reviews.author: Brock McCormack
reviews.text: Delicious Tibetan dumplings in the middle of Ithaca! Friendly service and ample seating in the mall food court make for a wonderful lunch!

reviews.author: Harkanwar Waraich
reviews.text: Amazing experience! The samosas were delicious and the food tasted just like home. But the best part was Narinder Uncle, such a genuine and kind person. He treated me like family and made the whole visit feel special. You can tell he really cares about his customers. Definitely coming back next time I’m in Ithaca!

reviews.author: Brittany Bond
reviews.text: The gentleman waiting on us was so nice and the food was absolutely delicious!! We had Butter Chicken, Chicken Curry, and naan bread! Will definitely go back!!

reviews.author: Maximiliano Hansen
reviews.text: Really nice guy who serves the food. Great place to get lunch from and not overpriced. Shout out Sangam!

reviews.author: Kundan Sen
reviews.text:
Lovely place to grab a quick bite. We tried a bunch of different things - pizza, gyros, falafel, calzone, meat over rice platters. The bomber calzone is highly recommended - fresh, flavorful, juicy. Lamb over rice was great. Falafels very amazing. The pizza slices may get dry depending on time spent on the counter.

Overall - highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marleny Acosta
reviews.text: Im a picky eater and I have a lot of stomach issues so I was hesitant. I ordered the chicken shawarma and asked for the sauce on the side. Omg…. Delicious. A must try. My friend ordered a lamb gyro and shes Middle Eastern and gave it a 5/5. Ingredients are fresh and like I mentioned it tastes delicious!

reviews.author: Raeef Syed
reviews.text: Good facilities and courteous staff. Food was tasty and of good quantity(I had a chicken over rice.) Good place.

reviews.author: Jen Drake
reviews.text: Picking up bread from Woodpepper is the one weekend errand I look forward to! Currently the Toasted Oat Porridge loaf is my favorite. Great for bread and cheese, sandwiches, morning toast, and makes fantastic French toast points!

reviews.author: Natascha B
reviews.text:
Very happy that I stopped by this bakery when I was in Ithaca for a conference. Not only did I get to try some of the best bread I ever had (and I’m saying that as a bread-fanatic German) - Dane also shared some of his sourdough starter with me and I’m now back in New York City experimenting myself with bread baking which is a lot of fun, even if the results are of course not as perfect as that loaf I got to take home.
Thanks Dane, if I’ll ever be back in Ithaca I will certainly stop by again!

reviews.author: Amy Won
reviews.text:
The most amazing naturally leavened bread I've had in recent memory and we used to live in Central Coast Cali, where sourdough reigned!

Perfectly crunchy, crispy exterior with an incredibly moist and tasty crumb. Just magical. We are so lucky to have Woodpepper here in Ithaca. Friendly baker and such a cute spot downtown too!

reviews.author: Devon V
reviews.text: Can't wait to visit Ithaca again, mainly to come here! We stopped in two mornings in a row, the first for special breakfast pizza and the second for the breakfast skillet/brunch wrap. Everything was delicious and we got to try a variety of pastries. I dream about the pistachio croissant! Something silly to appreciate, but worth mentioning - I loved the separate recycling and composting bins with clearly labeled signs; so many people do not know what is compostable. The staff was so friendly and welcoming, we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Shloka Hajare
reviews.text:
Ambience: Having changed from their previous location, it’s more of a takeout place than a diner now. There are a few seats with a wall attached table available but not a designed seating space, with an open vibe with natural light. The staff is super friendly and helpful with their suggestions.

Food: They have reduced their menu size to serving very particular dishes like their classics and tacos along with coffee and donuts. All their donuts are vegan and handmade. They have introduced new donut flavours like a raspberry filled one, and an apple jam donut along with chocolate croissant, cheese and pepperoni croissant, butter croissant and cinnamon roll.

Recommendations: If you are a coffee person, their Expresso Donut is a greatly balanced donut with a balance of coffee’s bitterness and sweetness of the glaze. The donut being handmade has a nice dark and crispy texture. If you are a fruit lover with a  sweet tooth, their raspberry filled original glaze donut has a little tart raspberry filling but is well balanced with the sweet sugar glaze.

reviews.author: Vegan Linked
reviews.text: Super trendy cool place! I hate they were out of the very thing I was hoping to get, the beet Burger. But the tofu scramble breakfast burrito was great. I got a walnut sticky bun dessert as well that was good and a mocha latte that was delicious, on the small side but delicious... They're really conscientious too with biodegradable utensils, containers and what not. Staff were really nice as well. If I lived near there I would probably try most things on the menu if not everything at some point and frequent the place for sure!

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: The photo on here from a previous review sold me on the oxtail and Mac and cheese. I was not disappointed. A creamy buttery Mac had a lovely combination of spices, and the oxtail was rich,  flavorful and fall off the bone soft. They stick to the ribs and feed the soul. Sweet plantains weren’t overly sweet and tasty. The patty had a good kick and had a buttery crust. Pasta Rasta chicken was creamy and rich, and the Jamaican festival were good, like large hush puppies.  I just wished I lived closer, so I could come here more.

reviews.author: Gideon
reviews.text: Went in for lunch and we were pleasantly surprised with a delicious meal, and experience. Generous portions, delicious flavors, and we will come back again. Rasta pasta with oxtails is a 10/10 meal. Perfectly cooked plantains and delicious vegetarian sides. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Juliana
reviews.text: Amazing!!! Please go here, the best rasta pasta and beef patty i’ve had in my entire life. Everything is absolutely amazing. It’s made to order and you can tell they truly care about the quality of every single meal ordered. 10/10 for every item.

reviews.author: Cortney j
reviews.text: Miscommunication about amount owed on mortgage from manager (Mike) and now I am liable for the fee and have to drive back down there in order to avoid another one. Last month was told inaccurate amount or it was applied incorrectly, I didn't bother asking because it's my fault for not looking at the bill to see escrow charge went up. I would pay the $14 fee I don't even care but learn to communicate when we ask how much is owed so I don't waste anymore of my damn time. If the manager wasn't so worried about trying to sell my husband a home equity line of credit while he was there on a loan and deed he isn't even on then maybe he could have figured out what we actually owed instead of having to call and tell me to drop off another $14

reviews.author: Zachary Sweet
reviews.text: Awful experience, the ATM was not functioning but not out of order. It took my withdrawal but did not give me the money I requested. The teller was terribly slow and unhelpful, I will think twice before using their ATM again.

reviews.author: Carolyn McGraw
reviews.text: Very pleased with my stay, definitely coming back next time I have to come to campus. Rooms and property are clean and safe. Staff was incredibly accommodating and welcoming of my two dogs that traveled with me. Location is quiet and very convenient to campus.

reviews.author: Julianna DiPinto
reviews.text:
I used to drive past the Springwater Inn frequently when I worked in Ithaca. It doesn't seem like much at first glance, but it truly is a gem. I traveled alone and as a single female I usually feel apprehensive about staying at a hotel alone. This Inn made me feel incredibly safe and comfortable! The folks operating the Inn are lovely and welcoming. The room was extremely clean and the linens were freshly laundered. The bathroom was updated and spotless. The bed was a nice size and comfy. The room was small but there was something about it that made me feel right at home. I would definitely stay here again!
The water took awhile to become warm in the bathroom sink and shower, however that is understandable as it has been in the freezing cold temps outside as of late. The pillows could have been a bit more firm. But otherwise it was a perfect stay.

reviews.author: Alexis Wegleitner
reviews.text: Rooms are clean and owners are kindly accommodating. Room was very spacious and includes WiFi. Good breakfast just had your typical hotel breakfast. Allows dogs for a good price. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Roy Johnson
reviews.text: Absolutely top notch shop. Purchased a zero turn here and it’s great. Had some issues with a chainsaw and they made sure to make it right. Will always be returning for all my equipment needs. Thanks Little’s!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: I recently purchased a mower that wasn’t adequate for my lawn. The company  I purchased from was not willing to take the mower back. Or willing to try and find another mower that be adequate. Even though it only had 1.2 hours and practically new. Quin was very sympathetic to my situation. He listened and helped me find a mower that I was completely happy with. In this day and age it is hard to find a stand up company that believes in customer service. I can assure you they are. I will only recommend them in the future.

reviews.author: James Moore, Jr.
reviews.text: First and foremost, the owner Quin and his staff are top knotch at customer service. Next, the Ferris Zero Turn lawn mower we bought is awesome. Made in America, it is tough and durable. The suspension is the best I have ever experienced. The cut is the most even I have ever had. 60 inch cut and 27HP. I am 53 years old and used a lot of mowers. This is the best. Littles Lawn Equipment Inc. Is highly recommended by me.

reviews.author: Cass Fox
reviews.text: I ordered the traditional pulled pork sandwich to go. The bread in my opinion is too greasy and there is too much in comparison to the amount of pulled pork, cole-slaw, and bbq sauce causing the sandwich to be too dry to be edible. The baked beans had a great flavor but reminded me more of chili beans than bbq beans. I was also not fond of the baked goods being open and exposed so closely to the register where customers order that I chose to not purchase any. The service was very quick.

reviews.author: Demi Perry
reviews.text: New favorite brunch spot. Food was OUTSTANDING. I got the brisket biscuit and it was phenomenal. My friend got the BLT with an egg and he said it was possibly the best BLT he has had in his life. We also got a couple pastries and they were delicious. Ample seating, friendly staff. Good cold brew coffee. Love this place. Do yourself a favor and give this place a try.

reviews.author: Mackenzie Grimes
reviews.text: State Eatery is one of our favorites! Everything I have tried has been amazing!! I highly recommend the Full Texan if you have someone to share it with. This way you can try a little bit of everything!

reviews.author: Deb Levine
reviews.text:
After we placed our order and paid, we had to hang around and wait for another 15 minutes -  for just for a small cone and a sundae. However, they still weren't even close to starting to make them.It seemed pretty chaotic behind the counter and looked like they still had five orders ahead of us. So we asked for a refund and left.
I'm glad some other reviewers had 5-star experiences, but we saw no evidence of that.

reviews.author: Margery Lipenski
reviews.text:
No impressed! Very unorganized. Lots of staff behind the counter but service was extremely slow. 22 minutes for two medium blizzards. In the time I was there, two orders were made twice because tickets weren't taken off the board where blizzards/ ice cream is prepared.
I personally think the little red plastic # card is crazy. Just call out the # on the ticket and be done with it.

reviews.author: Vendamae Harris
reviews.text: My family and I have stopped here a few times since they opened, and every time we come they are having issues. First it was no ice cream....how can DQ not have ice cream. The most recent, the fryer was down so no fries, chicken or anything else cooked in the fryer was available. If they cant get their act together they will not last in Ithaca. Don't waste your time and go to this location.

reviews.author: CDee3
reviews.text: The bread is excellent, super delicious. All of their other baked goods that I've tried are super yummy. The cookies are really very good, especially the sesame tahini cookies. The Pan Suisse also very delicious. All the staff here are super sweet and kind. Yes the line can be long but it's totally worth it. I find that their Instagram is a great resource for updates regarding the bakery's specials and availability.

reviews.author: Christian Mercado
reviews.text:
As a croissant aficionado, I'm always looking for a savory, flaky, and crunchy pastry to pair my morning coffee with. After years of looking all around Ithaca for the perfect croissant, I was all but disappointed and almost gave up. That was until I found Wide Awake at the local farmers market. Since then, I make it a point to grab a 3-pack of croissants to take home every weekend.

But, what happens when I need my croissant fix on a Thursday? Lucky for me, Wide Awake opened a brick and mortar location on Buck Hill road, just across the street. No more waiting for the weekend to get croissants!

This is the neighborhood bakery you dream of. They bake daily, have a surprising variety of breads and pastries, and make some decent espresso. Most of their baked goods use sourdough, except for baguettes and a couple of others. They're welcoming, knowledgeable, and are willing to provide recommendations. The new location has parking space, baking paraphernalia and good coffee.

Word of advice: They're still a small bakery with high local demand. Additionally, a large portion of their production is devoted to their bread CSA (community supported agriculture) program. If you want to reliably get the bread of your choice, you may want to consider joining their CSA. Otherwise, go in like me and be surprised with whatever loaves are available at a given time. For croissants, I recommend getting there early to snatch a 3-pack.

reviews.author: SoundScience AR
reviews.text: When I saw a line outside the door of the Wide Awake bakery, I thought to myself, a piece of bread can not be that good. I was wrong. With serious dedication to their craft and mindful selection of what ingredients goes in it, WAB has consistently surpassed my expectations for how good bread can be. I love all of their baked goods. My personal favorite is the Sunflower farmers. The staff are outstanding as well. A must stop in town.

reviews.author: Rowen Adonis
reviews.text: The best Chinese food I’ve had in the U.S. so far!! Both the bubble tea and the food are incredibly delicious and professionally made. They have a wide variety of bubble tea options—I’ve been looking everywhere for fermented rice milk tea, and I finally found it here!! The staff are super friendly, and the atmosphere is great too!

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.text: My favorite! I love coming here because they have so so many options and they are all freshly made and so yummy! They are also always so kind and friendly. I find myself coming back all the time! I especially love their tofu pudding desserts and the specialty teas. Boba is always the perfect texture :)

reviews.author: 徐雨彤
reviews.text: Got some bubble tea again! The blood glutinous rice milk tea tastes exactly like the one I used to love! All the milk teas are freshly made with real milk, and the fruits are all fresh too—no pre-made syrups at all. Great quality and taste!

reviews.author: Jordan Wrisley
reviews.text: I will NEVER EVER go here again. Jim lied to me and my husband never told us how things work with them nothing. We bought a 2016 dodge caravan from them for 14,000 and have had to pay it off 3 fricken times because they don’t tell you about all their hidden fees they have. As of November of next year I will have paid a total of 32,000.00 for my van. Horrible place horrible people will never tell anyone to go there

reviews.author: Angelina Falso
reviews.text: Terrible.  Do not trust them, especially Jim.  They sold me a really good looking car they are so wonderful….until I left and the same day the car started having a burning smell and brake noises.  Been back and forth 3 times only had the car 3 weeks…oil leak blown antifreeze leak bad brakes and now a blown turbo.  The guy who sold me the car hasn’t returned my message he hasn’t spoke a word to me since I handed him $6,000

reviews.author: Rod I
reviews.text:
Update to previous review. They made things right.
They are pretty good with helping people with bad credit get a decent vehicle. I had a Chevy from them and just before the 3 year lease was done, they realized the car was needing replacing. So they helped me get a better vehicle. Go see Jim at Maguire Credit, in the old Fat Jacks building next where Burger King was.

reviews.author: Michael Robin
reviews.text:
I recently did business with Young’s Coins and had a great experience. They were professional, honest, and very knowledgeable. Most importantly, they were more than fair with their prices — I walked away feeling confident I got a solid deal.

It’s not always easy to find trustworthy coin dealers, but these guys definitely earned my repeat business. Highly recommend whether you’re buying, selling, or just looking for honest advice.

reviews.author: Isabella Westcott
reviews.text:
My favorite place to go in Ithaca for coins and antiques! I purchased a beautiful glazed ceramic jardiniere with matching stand at a great price.
Chris and his son have such a wealth of knowledge and are eager to offer help.
My most recent purchase was two ancient Roman coins for my husband's Valentines day gift. My husband loved them, and is excited to visit the shop himself.
I know when I make a purchase there, I'm getting a fair price and the assurance of a longstanding trustworthy business.

reviews.author: Kathaleen Allen
reviews.text:
Chris is totally knowledgeable about what he trades. Equally importantly to us is that he was courteous & friendly. We cant say enough.
He's fair & makes the interaction enjoyable!
We were exclusively looking for precious metals & he would have new inventory daily!
I was OUR good fortune to have visited his store.

reviews.author: Chris Jose
reviews.text: Chicken cutlets sandwiches were great. The flatbreads are okay and would advise if you’re studying for an exam and want to eat something quick. Great place to get smoothies as well.

reviews.author: Ray Zhou
reviews.text: Great variety but overall, the food is not that great compared to terrace, trillium, etc

reviews.author: Ben Wells
reviews.text: I come here at least 3 times per week and it’s always delicious with great vibes. Flatbreads and deli station are my personal favorites; smoothies and Starbucks are also great. Probably my favorite spot on central.

reviews.author: Sommaya H
reviews.text: Gorgeous new cafe in a convenient spot on campus. It gets a bit busy around peak hours but theres so much seating and so much space + offers hot food and Starbucks drinks. I will definitely be back here every week when i’m on central!!

reviews.author: Taylor Lea Thomas
reviews.text:
🚨 Yummy Alert! 🚨
The crab and corn soup is soooooo tasty! Try it.
Layout of the food area is a bit odd which creates a bad logistical flow for people getting food and those exiting with their food. Also, the staff are seemingly unfriendly and I swear I thought the guy serving in the hot food section was going to drip sweat into the curry. The older lady next to him served the rice so sloppy. The dish looked ugly because of how it was served and presented and so I left it. But, the crab and corn soup is fantastic!

reviews.author: Yusong Jin
reviews.text: Gorgeous! Dandan noodles is awesome!

reviews.author: Yunong Shi
reviews.text: A surprisingly sweet café tucked inside the Cornell campus store. The coconut and pistachio macaroons were delightful — chewy, sweet, and full of flavor. Chocolate croissant wasn’t the fluffiest but still tasty, and the shortbread cookies were simple and satisfying. It’s a lovely, cozy corner to snack and study, surrounded by tributes to Cornell’s literary icons (Carl Sagan and Toni Morrison watching over you!). Plus, the prices are student-budget-friendly.

reviews.author: Sommaya H
reviews.text: I’m a Cornell student who also happens to work at the Cornell store so I order here often because it’s convenient. Their food is decent but the service is insanely slow, I’ve spent half my 15 minute break waiting on an order when its not even peak hours. Also one morning I had one of the adult staff (a blonde lady) scream at me and some other students for waiting for our food at the pick up area even though our buzzers were buzzing. I regularly order matcha lattes from them because they’re the closest cafe to me but they’re so much worse than the one you can get at Libe Cafe @ Olin Library or Goldies. The latte is diluted with milk even when you order regular ice, etc and it isnt worth your money/BRBS. I hope Cornell dining fixes the awful service at this cafe soon since so many parents/visitors come here after shopping at the cornell store.

reviews.author: Clifford King
reviews.text: Went here for a quick lunch while visiting the Cornell campus and I was really quite pleased. I got the tofu bahn mi and it was delightful! Just a well constructed and good-tasting sandwich. Comes with a salad, which is tricky to eat on the go. The actual dining area is small so it's usually VERY crowded, your best bet is to grab something and go like I did, even if that means it will be a tad colder. Pretty quick service and conveniently located right in the Cornell store.

reviews.author: JitkaKac
reviews.text: Beautiful halls, dining, clean restrooms, great space for students.

reviews.author: Sonia Bellajo
reviews.text: An amazing Hall. DEFINITELY WORTH the stop. A must see when in Ithica, NY

reviews.author: Claire Hebbard
reviews.text: Interesting historic building to visit. Dining options available. On the heart of Cornell campus. But I agree on ADA comments, yes it is wheelchair accessible, but it was not pleasant and we avoided the building leaving campus. Horrendous freight elevator gives me nightmares.

reviews.author: Tomáš Gregor
reviews.text:
Guys you should update your opening hours!
We came there during opening hours and it was closed. We wasted a lot of time on this, sadly. This is what you have Google maps profile for.
Looked like a nice area though.

reviews.author: Deep Thinker
reviews.text: Good place but Liam the employee is rude and condescending. All other people are very nice. But Liam goes out of his way to rush and talk down to you

reviews.author: Wenting Gao
reviews.text:
The latte here is way 🥵 too hot and no foaming on top at all.  They do not clean there tools to make coffee thoroughly enough as well.

The breakfast sandwich came out 20min after ordering which is insane as there is no line but waiting…

I do understand here might be a student-run cafe, but the quality of service need to be improved, otherwise it’s just like a “kindergarten” cafeteria for future “bartenders”.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.text: Staff is rude… especially compared to other cafés at Cornell. I understand but it’s a shock when I saw student workers yelling and screaming at customers who didn’t get their orders on time.

reviews.author: Roberto Delgado
reviews.text:
I stopped by Panera Bread in Ithaca (located at 748 South Meadow Street, right near the bustling downtown area) for a quick to-go lunch on a chilly February afternoon. As a local Cornell student always on the run between classes, I appreciate their efficient drive-thru and online ordering system via the app—super handy for avoiding lines. I opted for the Rustic Potato Soup and a salad with grilled chicken and banana peppers, both customized for takeout.
The Rustic Potato Soup arrived piping hot in a sturdy container, sealed to prevent spills during my short drive back to campus. It had that comforting, hearty texture with chunks of tender potatoes, smoky bacon bits, and a creamy base infused with subtle herbs—definitely rustic in the best way, evoking homemade vibes without being overly heavy. Portion size was generous for the price (around $6), and it paired perfectly with the complimentary baguette slice they tossed in. No sogginess issues, even after 10 minutes in the car.
The salad was fresh and vibrant, loaded with crisp romaine, grilled chicken, banana peppers, feta crumbles, kalamata olives, and red onions, all tossed in a tangy dressing. The banana peppers added a mild, tangy kick that balanced the savory chicken nicely, making it a satisfying meal under $10. Veggies were crunchy, not wilted, and the to-go packaging kept everything separate to avoid dressing overload. Overall, service was friendly and fast—my order was ready in under 5 minutes despite a moderate crowd. Panera's consistency shines here; it's not gourmet, but reliable for healthy-ish fast casual eats. Minor nitpick: wish they had more eco-friendly packaging options. Would recommend for anyone needing a quick, warm bite in Ithaca's unpredictable weather. 4/5 stars—I'll be back for soup season!

reviews.author: Joshua Banks
reviews.text: Recently the drive-through has been incredibly slow. I have waited over 30 minutes for food orders to be completed and brought out to my vehicle which seems insane considering this place costs more to eat at then sitting down at a restaurant. The last visit my family had an extra 30 minutes before an event so we stopped in considering we had the 30 minutes to spare. It took 45 minutes for two sandwiches, a grilled cheese and three smoothies to come out. They clearly made a little less smoothie than they needed so they topped mine off with about 60% water. I spent over $40 for this meal and most of it was terrible. The free muffin tops they gave us to compensate our time were so stale we couldn't eat them. The next time my wife mentioned Panera I took her down the street to Old Mexico and we spent $45 on two entree's and several drinks. Panera.... your kitchen service sucks and your far too expensive.

reviews.author: Colin McKay
reviews.text: I eat here often and quite enjoy the food, but I've decided to start leaving a 1-star review every time there is any chicken in my salad. I'm a vegetarian and regularly order a salad without chicken. If there's chicken, I can't eat the food, and have essentially wasted some or all of the $10 paid for the salad. This has happened multiple times now. Hope this improves.

reviews.author: Dawn Michael
reviews.text: Cute little old school place in a strip mall. I bet their regular pizza is great, I have to eat gluten free so that's what I got. I called the order in on the phone then decided to eat there, the person at the register was very polite both on the phone and in person. Gluten free crust is always a bit uninteresting, but the sauce was very nice. They served it in a metal pan which indicated to me they took precautions to keep it off the floor of the oven where the gluten would be. Would order from here again.

reviews.author: Nick Fanelli
reviews.text: I had gotten pizza here before and been happy, but we recently ordered a full tray of chicken parm catering for a party and it was AMAZING and got a lot of compliments. Could not have been an easier or better experience and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Matt N
reviews.text: A friend took me out for pizza, the pizza was great! BUT it’s the meatballs that will be bringing me back!  What a pleasant surprise dinner was tonight, thank you! I’m looking forward to a meatball sub and more meatball pizzas!

reviews.author: Emma Smith
reviews.text:
I was referred to Dr. Conte’s office when my orthodontist discovered bone loss. During my appointment, Dr. Conte discussed the differences between gingivitis and periodontal disease. After I left, I requested a summary of the appointment because I felt confused. His receptionist, Jenn, was very short with me. She simply forwarded the diagnosis that was sent to my ortho office and after googling some terms, I discovered that I have advanced gum disease. This was a huge shock to me as I have always had regular cleanings and brush and floss daily.

We went back and forth by email as I needed some clarity with a few things (what type of anesthesia is necessary,  codes for my insurance, etc.) and Jenn was very unpleasant, even using caps in her responses, clearly showing a lack of care and respect for patients. She made me feel horrible, so I looked around for an alternative consultation.

At my second consultation, I asked Jenn to forward my X-rays. She then started repeatedly asking me about cancelling my appointments because ‘she books Dr. Conte very far ahead and others really want these appointments.’ I understand that people probably cancel a lot and that can be frustrating, but I wasn’t sure which office to choose until I figured out the financial side of things. After sending the new office the X-rays, she went and asked them if I had future appointments there. When she discovered that I did, she cancelled my appointments. Despite my protests she sent me a dismissal letter and ignored my response. I guess it’s her choice where I get my dental work done.

Dr. Conte seemed ok and may be a great periodontist, but this receptionist’s behavior was awful, and my experience with her darkened the discovery of the fact that my regular dentist was extremely negligent. This is something that should have been handled with care and kindness and she made it feel like a hit and run. I felt shocked and horrified and to be treated like an annoyance on top of that was dehumanizing. My intention with this review is to prepare others for dealing with her, the way I wish someone could have for me.

reviews.author: Thomas Deneuville
reviews.text: I'm so grateful for Dr. Conte's gentle, expert care. I know that he's really invested in my dental well-being and has helped me navigate some serious issues over many years. He is surrounded by wonderful staff who also embody the values of kindness, compassion, and service. My life would be very different without Dr. Conte.

reviews.author: Jill Rosentel
reviews.text: I had oral surgery with Dr. Conte and he made me feel well informed and completely relaxed. The procedure was painless even thought it involved stitches!! If only he could be cloned! His staff is amazing too.

reviews.author: Blixy Taetzsch
reviews.text: I am very happy with the quality of service and the willingness to go the extra mile to meet my needs.  Staff are knowledgeable, professional, and a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Sharon Anderson
reviews.text: I appreciate that Kelly shared her computer screen showing me how the programming lined up with my hearing test and how she made adjustments based on our conversation. She listened well to my feedback and gave me clear answers to my questions.  She engendered my confidence.

reviews.author: Donna Callais
reviews.text: I highly recommend the Ithaca office.  Kelly is awesome!  She listens to what you had to say and made every effort to adjust my hearing aids until I was happy with them.  I've had my hearing aids for almost two years and have been happy with them.  If you have tinnitus like I have, these hearing aids are helping to reduce the noise I hear significantly. I can now hear all the birds singing around me.  Unfortunately, the tinnitus does return as soon as I remove my hearing aids.  So glad I finally made the choice to get help with my hearing.

reviews.author: Jennifer Anissi Kivisild
reviews.text: Great local company. They have made shirts for our music groups for a few years now. Lots of communication with artists, great shirt choices and prices, and super accommodating for our schedule needs! Never going anywhere else!

reviews.author: Nick Tubbs
reviews.text: Great local company to get custom printed apparel from. Always willing to try and meet tight time lines and happy to work with you on the many available options. hours make it a little difficult to get down there if you have a 9-5 job.

reviews.author: John Hatfield
reviews.text: I use these guys for all of my business shirts and apparel. They do great work. As a local business I appreciate a company that works with you to meet the needs of my company.

reviews.author: David Reeves
reviews.text: Highly recommend Sedgwick Interiors and working with Claire! She was patient, knowledgeable, and thorough in walking me through different options for my home office; the entire process was genuinely positive.

reviews.author: Wesley Panovec
reviews.text: Perfect cup of coffee  every time! I’ve always appreciated grabbing a cup at the farmers market and really glad  to see two locations in town ! I pick a cup up as I shop at greenstar and bring the beans home for the family especially during the holidaze ! This perfectly roasted coffee for me.

reviews.author: The AS Athlete
reviews.text: Best coffee shop in Ithaca, not even close. They served up an 8.2 cortado that blew all of the shops (like Gimme! or Press) out of the water. The milk work is what made it an 8.2 as the beans were on the 7.8 side. Overall, really good and holds up with some of the best I’ve had in New York.

reviews.author: Lily Cook
reviews.text:
THE BEST COFFEE IN THE AREA.

Forty Weight is the only cafe I've seen that pulls shots to the exact gram - with the freshest beans. Their baristas are well experienced in flavor, pouring and quality service. I remember the first time I had their coffee in November which was the best cappuccino I've ever had (this is after living in Italy), and to this day I have not been disappointed. Not forgetting to mention Gola Osteria and State Bakery, the blueberry scones are SOOOOO good, not too sweet, and baked fresh daily!
The Baristas here have been friendly and informative on tasting notes as well as the growing and roasting processes of the beans, when I need more help choosing a bag. There is nothing bad I can say about this business.

I love Forty Weight Coffee Roasters!

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: Very good bank! I've been here two times. The first time, I applied for a card and opened two accounts. The second time, I came because my card had been frozen due to suspected fraud. However, this wasn't a problem with the specific branch, but with the bank's security system. Nevertheless, both times, I received assistance very quickly. The first time, I came by appointment and was seen no later than the appointed time. The employee was extremely polite, explained everything as clearly and understandably as possible, and even offered several more favorable options regarding my accounts. This was extremely helpful for someone who had only been in the US for two weeks at the time. The second time, I came without an appointment because the notice asked me to come asap, but after a short line that lasted about 10 minutes, the employee sorted out my problem. It took about 15 minutes, as she had to call a larger branch or security (I'm not sure tbh), but I simply waited and finally confirmed my identity. The waiting area (the lobby) is very comfortable, with soft sofas, air conditioning, and even a little sudoku. Considering Chase's large and popular bank, the branch handles the customer flow well, and the lines are relatively short. The ATM is open most days, but not all functions are always available, especially for cash. Nevertheless, the branch is very good!

reviews.author: Erik Ninomiya
reviews.text: Shout-out to Elisabetta Ciurieo, who was so helpful when I lost my Chase credit card today while on the road for several months. She sorted everything out in a matter of minutes with empathy and a smile.

reviews.author: Scott Burke
reviews.text: ATM currently not accepting cash deposits on 9/3/2024. Machine says come back later. Tried two different days. Parking is a nightmare even on weekends and off hours. Staff won't answer the phone during the day. I'm at work when the bank is open and I shouldn't have to take a vacation day just to make a cash deposit! Edit: ATM still not accepting cash deposits on 1/11/2025

reviews.author: aej
reviews.text: Had mucho fun here. Wish the observatory was on the way though

reviews.author: Aakash Kapoor
reviews.text: The way to this place is absolutely gorgeous, even if it's easy for engineers to get lost here

reviews.author: Harold Superman
reviews.text: Mann is by far the best library at Cornell. Take the time to explore the entire thing. Use the first or third floor for quiet studying, or rent out a study room or workstation to work with friends. The Collaborative Center is great for group work as well. Manndibles Cafe is good but a bit inconvenient since they don't take BRBs.

reviews.author: Ann
reviews.text: Cool place to take kids to learn about the Earth, fossils and dinosaurs. My grandkids are 5 & 6. They were at the lower age of where the displays are targeted. They were interested for an hour or 2. I think once they're slightly older it will be a lot more interesting to them. Great place to take kids.

reviews.author: Charlie “Charmander” Lin
reviews.text: The exhibits were well put together and interactive highly recommend downloading the audio tour, but be aware that the audio numbers do not match the museum map. Liked digging for our own fossils and the large mammoth skeleton. Highly recommend for a rainy day activity with the family.

reviews.author: Lea Hurrell
reviews.text: Great place to visit. Was there for 1.5 hours and could have spent longer. Very informative and interactive. Good for all ages.

reviews.author: Tom Mulholland
reviews.text:
If you value your car, your time, or your sanity, steer clear. The parking lot is a nightmare—chaotic, mismanaged, and basically a crash course in vehicular terror. People back into each other like it’s a sport, tempers flare, and the “design” ensures everyone is a hazard to everyone else.

Inside? Don’t even think about it. Aisles are so narrow and poorly laid out that navigating them is like playing real-life Tetris with other people’s carts. You spend 99% of your visit dodging elbows and carts, and 1% actually finding anything you need.

Produce is a horror show—rotten, moldy, and clearly ignored. And if you value basic safety, good luck. I slipped and fell on a massive puddle near the coffee section because someone thought “wet floor signs” were optional. Spoiler: they are not.

This place doesn’t just fail—it actively assaults anyone foolish enough to enter. Management, take a good hard look: this store is a liability, and your customers deserve better.

reviews.author: Joseph Clink
reviews.text: This wegmans is very discriminating, that is all I have to say. I was profiled by the security and this is the first time and I have supported wegmans and shopped there for a very long time. I mind my own business while I am shopping and is no reason for the two goons to approach me, last time I knew it is a free country and no laws for carrying especially if I never started trouble or ever had problems before. It is kinda unnerving for two big security guards to flank a person on their way to checkout again never had this problem it was more a profiled incident. 2/10/2026 at 10:15 pm. I shop I get my stuff and leave. Plus every time I come here I get looked at like I am scum even followed around like I don't know they are. Is it because I am homeless and have money or black and homeless with money.

reviews.author: Aleta Jane N. Sullivan
reviews.text:
I love Wegmans! It’s usually not too busy, and you can find pretty much everything there. The cakes and other sweets they make adjacent to the deli are always delicious, and I’m lowkey addicted to their sushi.

The people there are very nice, and customer service is actually helpful as well. I think it’s a lovely place and a good grocery store (although they keep trying to push the start of Christmas season earlier and earlier!)

There’s also a lovely little cafe where you can eat your food, and a place where you can get sandwiches. Everything a person could ask for! Although sometimes they will rearrange the entire store, and that can be quite annoying.

Overall, though, really love it!

reviews.author: Lynn Ashbaugh
reviews.text: Ordered a washer/dryer set, day of delivery 1st truck brought the dryer with vent hose, WASHER connector and 3 prong dryer cord that was supposed to be a 4 PRONG,  dryer could not be installed! Then I called the Ithaca NY store about the dryer cord and was told I had to call a number- wrong this was your mistake! Then I find out a 2nd truck is bringing the washer, their dispatcher called the truck and they luckily had a 4 prong with them. The washer and dryer were installed by the guys from the second truck. Should’ve been told 2 trucks, dryer parts should’ve been with the dryer NOT the washer. Today 2 DAYS later a person from the Ithaca store thinks it’s ok to call me- 2 DAYS after the fact- bad business! Only good thing was the delivery guys! And please don’t send me to some phone number like in other reviews . But again delivery people were great, this review is not on them!

reviews.author: Jessica Casey
reviews.text:
Terrible experience purchasing a front door and having it installed.
I started this process over three months ago - the first delay was when the (really very lovely) installation consultant who worked for Lowe’s had to reschedule because his car had broken down. 2-3 weeks later he finally came and I made my choice and the door was ordered. That was three months ago.
Today the (sub-subcontracted) installers came, later than planned because it took Ithaca Lowe’s an hour to find the door. When they came to install it neither the handle I’d ordered nor the brick mold (I don’t know either) which were supposed to come with the door were in the box.
I have spent an unreasonable amount of time on the phone to facilitate this installation and the only reason I went with Lowe’s in the first place was to just have everything handled.
I guess this was the impetus I needed to get my new appliances at Costco.
(Pics of my door after the installers were “finished”)
ETA: Two weeks later and still not done with no projected date of completion.
Go somewhere else!

reviews.author: Chris Gleason
reviews.text: Great experience all around.  The fridge was on sale, so I got more than I bargained for there.  And the delivery guys went way above and beyond during a trickier than average scenario.  I'll definitely order the rest of my appliances from Lowe's!

reviews.author: Queen Bea
reviews.text: I love this place. The children's section is large and diverse, the teen section has a great variety, and both sections have fun and comfortable places to sit and read or play games and do puzzles. The librarians and staff are also super sweet and helpful. And, for those wondering, the teen section has a LOT of places for teens to plug in their phones and devices. The children's room also has a sensory section where you can pick up earmuffs, fidgets, and weighted lap pads.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Fantastic place! Everything is nice, clean, neat, and new. Excellent selection of everything it holds. The computers are fast and efficient. Conveniently located right in downtown Ithaca. Tom, the Digital Access Librarian, did a stellar job signing me up for a library card. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ji You Kang
reviews.text: This is a famous Italian restaurant in Ithaca. Everyone around me says that the pizza here is the best in Ithaca. If you don’t get in line before 5 o‘clock, you might have to wait a long time, so get in line early😆

reviews.author: shanna swartwood
reviews.text: This is the absolute worst pharmacy in town. Do not go here. Constant mistakes. Slow prescription refills. Lack of knowledge on how to bill insurance and general rudeness. Although I don’t completely believe this is the fault of the workers CVS as a company is ridiculously awful

reviews.author: Anna (annabunches)
reviews.text: I was in this CVS today and one of the pharmacy techs started shouting at a customer in the drive-thru. It was shocking, off-putting, and completely unprofessional. Definitely not inclined to return, and I'm very glad I don't use this store as my pharmacy.

reviews.author: Tiffany Doan
reviews.text: It is absurd that you cannot reach anyone without leaving a voicemail. I have a prescription that was due yesterday. It is not fun having to drive all the way down there when it is not ready or it cannot be filled due to insurance reasons waiting for authorizations! It makes no sense that we are not able to just pick up the phone and call you to find out what is going on with the status of our prescriptions! I’m getting ready to change from Cvs due to this issue. I’m over it.!

reviews.author: Sherin Joy
reviews.text: Overall, it was a disappointing experience. The restaurant wasn’t busy at all , just one other table besides ours, yet the food took quite a long time to arrive. We ordered the drunken noodles, and I was surprised that the dish wasn’t served hot. Some chicken pieces were actually cold inside, like food that’s been unevenly reheated in a microwave. The rice noodles were also clumped together, four or five layers stuck without any sauce coating. The potatoes in the yellow curry also tasted off. Overall, the food didn’t feel fresh or hot, and even the table we sat at was sticky. I wouldn’t recommend this Thai restaurant. I’ve tried plenty of Thai places over the years, and there are many others that are much better.

reviews.author: Andrea Mooney
reviews.text: Tried to order delivery via Door Dash.  I've been a customer of Taste of Thai Express for years but never again.  Food was over an hour and a half late.  Called the restaurant and was told the Door Dash driver had just picked up the food - that was a lie.  Called again half an hour later and another person arranged for the restaurant driver to deliver.  Then that driver could not follow specific directions and just left the food at a random door to my apartment building.  I'm done with Taste of Thai Express.  Food is good but not worth the hassle.

reviews.author: Darshan Kalathia
reviews.text:
Food:
Ordered two Drunken Noodles with tofu. The taste was good, but there was barely any tofu in my dish. The food was not hot enough—some items felt like they were at room temperature.

Service:
Service was noticeably slow.

Ambience:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere with large glass windows. There's also outdoor seating available.

Cleanliness:
Both the restaurant and restroom were clean.

Parking:
Free parking is available, but spots are limited.

Overall:
Good taste and clean setting, but the portion quality, food temperature, and speed of service could be improved.

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text:
My husband and I had quite a disappointing experience at Dunkin' today. We ordered a large iced coffee through mobile order. The staff member assisting us was a colored young man with curly hair. He was too inattentive and not welcoming at all. While picking our order, we asked about redeeming the “free donut with purchase of a large drink” offer, and it seemed like he did not fully understand our question even after we repeated it several times. He then abruptly said that we could not redeem the offer because it was not applied in the mobile order at the time of purchase and that we would need to buy another drink. Absolutely unreasonable and absurd! When we asked for clarification, he referred us to the manager. The manager was busy handling drive-thru orders and didn't talk directly to us. We heard her saying – "just give them a donut." Her tone came across as dismissive and disrespectful. The overall interaction made us feel unwelcome.

We truly enjoy Dunkin’ and usually visit the one at Pine Tree, where we consistently receive friendly service. This was our first visit to the one at S. Meadow, and sadly, it did not reflect the positive experiences we’ve had in the past.

We hope management can provide better customer service training to ensure a more welcoming environment for guests in the future.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Fabulous place! A clean, neat store. Prompt, efficient, friendly service. A good selection at stellar prices. Conveniently located right on Route 13 in downtown Ithaca. Delicious food served fast. Shenelle did a wonderful job checking me out. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gabriel Kerr
reviews.text: After multiple times coming in recently and experiencing orders that were consistently incorrect or missing items and getting attitude while trying to get it corrected? Attempted doordash order resulting in my dasher almost quitting due to same attitude turned on her all because she inquired about almost $ 20 in missing food from order. If you want Dunkin I would strongly advise using the one on Elmira road by Home depot or anywhere else beside this one. I seriously do not understand how this attitude towards customers has been allowed for so long....

reviews.author: Carolina Wierzbowski
reviews.text: First time visitor but I’ll definitely come back. What a nice store and super friendly helpful staff. Awesome fabric selection, nicely organized. nice classroom space as well. Ithaca is charming and bustling. If you visit they have parking but you’ll probably get caught up in the one way streets if not familiar with the area so beware.

reviews.author: Grace Ryder
reviews.text: Went in for the first time today and was absolutely blown away by their welcoming hospitality. They took the time to give me a full tour of the store (which is necessary because there’s SO MUCH to look at) and also gave me some great suggestions for my projects. I’m never going to buy fabric anywhere else

reviews.author: Lauren Wright
reviews.text: Wonderful selection of fabrics, patterns, quilting tools, extensive range of classes. Friendly,  helpful staff.

reviews.author: Thomas Davko
reviews.text:
Garbage experience, I stopped into the store after Verizon didn’t call me during our appointment to talk about their being your bill offer.

I was met right away by an associate that I’m still not sure understood what I was trying to do.

Anyway they said that before we could even talk about the bill comparison that they’d need my social security number to ensure financing? And that I’d have to have a Verizon account set up before any comparison too.

Why on earth would I sign up for anything through Verizon if they’re not going to do what they stated and review my current plan to see if they could offer something better.

Insanely bad/scummy experience.

reviews.author: Timothy Whitted
reviews.text: My mom recently passed away and the staff here was very supportive, helpful and understanding. They did an amazing job helping get things figured out so we could cancel her phone. I greatly appreciate everything...thank you

reviews.author: Isabella Blanco
reviews.text: I had the most fantastic experience. I went in with a completely broken phone, very lost, and no idea what to do. They were so patient, helpful, and kind. I don't think it would've been possible to have a better experience.

reviews.author: Teufel Hund
reviews.text: Parking is ample and wheelchair accessible. The atmosphere 8s lively. The server we had only had 3 days on the job and the first Tuesday she had worked for Texas Roadhouse so she had to ask the manager about veterans discount.  She was efficient and personable. Very attentive and caring. The food was great and the frozen mango margarita did not disappoint.  The new server is an asset to Texas Roadhouse and her enthusiasm for her job should be acknowledged.  Bravo to the proprietor and management team.

reviews.author: Rosy
reviews.text: We went to eat steak as a party of two and ordered a 12 oz New York strip and an 11 oz hand-cut sirloin. The mushroom and onions were awesome. We ordered medium rare, but the steak turns out to be more like medium, which was not ideal so I would try ordering rare next time for the medium rare texture. The mashed potatoes with brown gravy was especially delicious. Would come again!

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: Excellent place, must visit! Absolutely loved their bottomless bread. Cinnamon butter is also bottomless and tasty. Huge glasses of soda for only 2$ and some sauces. Every table has a screen where you pay for your order, also there're some games for kids (but you pay 2$ to play). I ordered smokehouse burger, and it was big and amazing! Very tasty, cheese was great and patty too. They also serve french fries and a half of a pickle with burgers. Prices are not high especially because you have bottomless bread! The only thing is that I visited during lunch time on Sunday, so I needed to wait for 15 minutes, but they have many seats inside to wait so it wasn't a big problem. I advise to make a reservation though.

reviews.author: Amy Montondo
reviews.text: We decided to give this place a try and so glad we did! What a nice little hidden gem. We went before 5 pm, and the craft beer was $4! Can't wait to go back when the weather is nicer to go to the beer garden. We didn't get food but we did have the free popcorn! Don't snooze on this place!🍻

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text: Definitely a local favorite! Awesome place with great people and drinks. Darts and pool inside, along with tables and games, lots of outdoor seating, too. Bathrooms are in the basement. They don't serve food, but often have complimentary popcorn. Water cooler and cups available to help yourself. They do allow outside food. $10 minimum the credit cards.

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.text:
One of the best bars in Ithaca.  Huge tap selection that is constantly rotating and they also have a great liquor selection.
Only one of three bars in all of Ithaca with any good rum.

Staff is always friendly and knowledgeable.  Bouncers at the door when it's busy to insure everyone is of age as well.  Thankfully 21 also means no children here (even a nice sign)

No actual food, but they do have a free, self-serve popcorn machine when you need a snack to balance out.  They also allow you to bring in food.

Large outdoor section outback as well (open all year, but no heaters).  Lots of picnic tables and they allow food from outside restaurants (grab some Franco's pizza a couple doors down) - also until the Winter came, they had an awesome food truck parked out back (Yxi’S Arepas & Gordito).

reviews.author: Jason Bell
reviews.text: Good people.  Diane sent an extra part back to us that she purchased from my company and asked us to donate it to a needy customer.  We're in the auto parts industry and my company offers a program that helps people who can't afford to fix their cars by sending them parts for free.  We never met Diane, but her donation to our program without any expectations shows that her company is better than the rest.  Many thanks!

reviews.author: Ithaca Carshare
reviews.text: We truly couldn't do it all without Diane's Downtown! They are friendly, reliable, honest, have fair prices, and do everything they can to get Ithaca Carshare's fleet back out on the road and available for our 1300 members as quickly as possible.  We can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Mandy Albert
reviews.text: I will never take my car anywhere else.  Diane and her staff are all extremely friendly and knowledgeable, and will listen to what you say about your car.  They won't try to pressure you into extra repairs or adjustments unless you say you want them.  Great location and eminently reasonable prices.  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jeremy Dang
reviews.text: Gas station pump has trouble with card and receipt.

reviews.author: Cameron Ashby
reviews.text: They towed our car as we were looking for a bathroom, not very nice. The only upside is that its in downtown, I would personally ask others to avoid unless solely getting gas...

reviews.author: Nick D
reviews.text: Pump handles broken. Other pump had no receipt paper. Poorly maintained

reviews.author: jeffrey Entin
reviews.text:
We specifically booked this hotel because it had a pool, and when we arrived, we were told the pool was broken. That was extremely disappointing, as the pool was the main reason we chose this property in the first place. Had we known it wasn’t operational, we would have booked another hotel for the same price — one with a working pool.

To make matters worse, the woman at the reception desk when we checked in was very rude and unwelcoming. After a long day of travel, that was the last thing we expected. Customer service sets the tone for a stay, and unfortunately, this started things off poorly.

The overall condition of the hotel was unacceptable for the price we paid. The room felt dirty, and common areas were not maintained properly. The coffee station in the morning was filthy, and the garbage looked like it hadn’t been taken out in days. For what we were charged, it was honestly disgusting.

I will say that the reception woman in the morning was very kind and did take $50 off the room, which we appreciated. However, even with that adjustment, we still could have stayed elsewhere for the same price and had a clean hotel with a functioning pool.

I have photos documenting the condition of the property. Very disappointing experience overall.

reviews.author: Galyna Shulimova
reviews.text:
I don't like to leave bad reviews, but this hotel has very poor management and needs to improve their service a lot.

During our stay on Thanksgiving, the pool was working, but it was so extremely cold that it wasn’t possible to use it. They had a heating system problem and didn’t know when it could be fixed.

The lobby area is tiny, especially compared to the size of the hotel. It was cold in the lobby as well as in the pool area, but the worst part was that it smelled very bad — like mold or a rotten plumbing system.

Our room was well-maintained and pretty clean, but the same light smell existed there as well…

The hotel itself has 2 different buildings connected by a huge hall. One building is called South Tower, the other North Tower. We stayed in North, but no one at the front desk provided clear directions, and we went to the South one first, which has a very fancy glass elevator where you can see Ithaca’s city.

The hotel is located in Downtown Ithaca, which is great if you take public transportation as we did. We came by FlixBus.

No complimentary breakfast, but they have the coffee station which is supposed to work 24/7

Because of the issues I explained above, we decided to stay in the Hilton Garden Inn for the next night. It is more pricey and doesn’t provide complimentary breakfast either, but the pool was in excellent condition, as well as everything else in that hotel.

It is very sad that such a beautiful hotel as Ithaca Hotel is running down the hill.

reviews.author: cody george
reviews.text: Wow, what a shame. I got the King executive suite. The most expensive room they had. The heat did not work so with it being 21 degrees outside and no heat in the room or for any part of the hotel it made it uncomfortable. I entered my room to find cups and drink stains all over the table and crumbs on the floor. I then find a door to a patio that has a broken handle and lock but doesn’t open. I decided to shower and found the shower floods from it coming from the faucet and the shower head. So stand in 3 inches of water to shower. Fun. Decided to take a bath in the extra large jacuzzi bath. It didn’t even work(jacuzzi features). The furniture is all scratched and the lamp shades are bent up. For $270 after taxes I definitely say this is not worth it at all. This was an awful experience. The remotes to the tv were broken and the backs were missing. They only have local cable for the tvs that are from 2010. They don’t plow their parking lot making it hard to find a spot to park. Even the elevator only had one light working in it making it dark and pretty dangerous. I do not recommend staying here. Absolute waste of money.

reviews.author: Piper Capreedy
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I have gone here a couple times before and it was always delicious, however they have now rebranded to ‘Maru Korea’ and have an entirely new menu! I was a bit worried at first because i was a big fan of their Tonkotsu, but the meal i got was SO good! The service was super fast and friendly, the restaurant was clean (although it always is!) and the server even brought us two complimentary courses while we were waiting on our food. 10/10 highly recommend!!

reviews.author: inggrit ifani
reviews.text: We love this Ramen PLACE!!!!! Its always a to go place for us when we visit the area. The food is perfect, quality and tasty! With affordable price, we feel like we got tons of the protein (the beef or the seafood). We are never disappointed! The servers were great, either the new girl or the older lady. The Korean Ice Coffee is soo delicious too. Love love love.

reviews.author: Michael Cheung
reviews.text:
Maru Ramen is a fusion Asian spot that blends Japanese and Vietnamese flavors. The vibe is nice, but for the price, I expected a bit more in terms of quality — though to be fair, the portions are solid.

I tried the Tonkotsu Ramen, Shrimp Tempura Ramen, and the Shrimp Tempura Crab Roll. The flavors were okay, but the chashu was overcooked, which definitely took away from the experience. Service was fine — nothing bad, but nothing memorable either.

Overall, not a bad place if you’re in the area and craving ramen.

reviews.author: George Poulos
reviews.text: I quite like this place and find myself gravitating back here whenever I visit Ithaca. It’s a large cafe with lots of seating and good coffee and pastries. It’s a nice spot to hang at for a while. It’s a spacious place that I think can get crowded - I happened to be here on a snowy day right upon opening when I took the photos. Staff are very kind.

reviews.author: LL C
reviews.text: Pricey but really excellent coffee. Wasn't expecting much since it's a chain, but my latte was delicious. Free wifi and lots of outlets plus seating spaces make it a great space to work.

reviews.author: Alan H
reviews.text:
Modern coffee shop. Staff is friendly, coffee is locally roasted, and they have some great looking pastries. Standard coffee and tea menu (espresso drinks, drip coffee, hot tea, etc).  And they have cold brew!

Unlike many other places in Ithaca, Gimme feels fresh and modern. It’s a great place to work, meet a friend, or read. There’s lots of outlets and free wifi.

reviews.author: Sagara Mati
reviews.text: Usually I have a good experience,  but today I had a card to pick up a letter, and I asked the lady if she could also give me the mail in the po box becausei didnt have the key with me. She said no, they don't give mail over the counter. This is not true, because I have done this 8n the past. She said they aren't supposed to be doing that. I have gone there over the years and never had this problem. I said, are you really goung to make me go all the way back to the office, get the key and come back? I showed my ID. She said no. So I had to make a trip all the Elway back and return. I feel since 8t never was a problem before, she could at least have given me a warning this one time and given me the mail. Anyway, I did google this question,  and it states that customer service CAN give you your po box mail, but may request ID.  So she outright lied to me.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: People love to rag on the Post Office, but I haven’t had much in the way of bad experiences. Every time I’ve come in the people here have been nice to me and quite helpful. Sometimes you have to wait in line for a bit but it’s not the workers’ fault that they’re understaffed. Overall, I can’t really complain.

reviews.author: Sherrhonda Ebony
reviews.text: My daughter and I received a notification that our packages were delivered to the mailbox. I went outside my package nor was hers there. The packages were coming from different locations. When I tried to call I was told that the package was scanned and delivered. When I tried to call the direct number to the downtown post office it just hangs up on you. Now I have no way of knowing where the packages are. I was told from one of the representatives (from the 800 number) that the carriers sometimes scan the packages before it gets to the location. That’s insane because if in the process the package gets misplaced it was scanned as delivered when it actually was not.

reviews.author: Sophie Lewis
reviews.text:
TLDR: Be aware your grocery pickup order will probably randomly disappear.

Quite honestly if I could give Walmart as a whole negative stars I would. In the past 5 months for grocery pick up there have been at least 3 incidents where, whoops, my order is not found. I call the store and they have no idea I even placed an order. I'm not blaming the store in this incident, but it keeps happening. The solution always ends up with me having to cancel my order and place another. At that point I end up having to place it 24hrs or days later due to the narrow window I have available to pickup. I get told, sorry here's a promo code. Cool, what's going to keep this from happening? Who flipping knows I guess. Who cares how a delay affects me or my life, certainly not Walmart. But we knew that I guess. If I had any better option for what I exactly needed at this point in time, I would NEVER return to Walmart.

reviews.author: Ted Crane
reviews.text:
Face it, Ithaca and Wal-Mart are not in the same universe. A lot of residents wouldn't touch the place with a 10-foot stick. You are flirting with being shunned if you admit to shopping there.
All that said, I've found it to be a useful source for selected items.
I found that automotive fluids and DIY parts are often cheaper at Wal-Mart than elsewhere. That led me to learn that, if you're going to buy something with a Brand Name, it's worth checking Wa-Mart for price. Some times they're more expensive, sometimes not, and sometimes enough cheaper to justify the expense and hassle of an extra stop on your shopping trip.
Then came COVID. Other stores in town completely stopped stocking Claussens Pickles and I was desperate. Not only did Wal-Mart carry them, the pricing was in the "a lot less than elsewhere" category. Imagine, actually buying FOOD at Wal-Mart!
Well, it turns out that you have to shop carefully. There are quite a few food items stocked at lower-than-anywhere-else prices. Caveat Emptor: there are also an awful lot of items at similar or higher pricing.
Besides Claussens, avocados, Great Value spicy tomatoes (compare to Rotel), G.V. chocolate bars, Turkey Hill ice cream, frozen shrimp, horseradish mustard (same bottle, same content as other markets, but 2/3 the price), and La Banderita tortillas make an excursion to Wal-Mart worthwhile.
Now, if they could just have a few parking spots within 1/4 mile of the front door...

reviews.author: Lois Anne Posluszny
reviews.text: Horrendous delivery  system.  So bad I have to no longer use them since they have zero over sight of delivery issues.  Almost EVERY DELIVERY had MAJOR PROBLEMS. NOT always able to even deliver at all. Leaving bags outside wrong door. Not knocking so you don't know they even came. Bags left in rain and snow rather than inside porch as directed.  100 % of emails asking for replies have "No Reply" addresses. Several drivers could not read or understand ENGLISH. Almost Every delivery had things not ordered in it. Today left bags and 8 gallons of water outside in the snow UNDER a sign stating I'm Handicapped and groceries need to be brought inside AND never attempted to make any indication they ever came to my home. UNBELIEVABLE.

reviews.author: Miriam Epstein
reviews.text: I stayed at the Super 8 Motel to stay safe during recent snow storm. The person at the desk was very helpful, gave me an automatic AAA discount (saved me 10%). They also plowed the parking lot, and dug my car out from the snow. I really appreciate the good service 🙏

reviews.author: Laura Miller
reviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel a few times over the years, but it just has not kept up with the times. It is definitely in need of an overhaul. The staff is nice enough, but the rooms are very dated. They are badly in need of new mattresses! I can forgive a lot, as long as I have a comfortable mattress and can get a good night of sleep. Unfortunately, this did not happen here. Also, we were on the ground floor but the window had no lock, the screen was bent out, and there were no privacy sheers on the curtains.
