There are a lot of new hotels opening up in the Ithaca area, so it will be hard for this hotel to stay competitive unless it seriously upgrades.

reviews.author: Dee Lyons
reviews.text: The check-in and check-out was fine and easy. The room was neat and clean as much as it could be, but you can smell the presence of mold. The air conditioner was moldy and you smelled it more if it was on. If you're sensitive, no go. The beds were clean. The bathroom needed more fixing up, but was tolerable.

reviews.author: Trisha F.
reviews.text: Has a.lot of good places there to shop or eat.

reviews.author: Sharon Allen
reviews.text: Parking can be difficult, as people speed through (even with the speed bumps), but many businesses here.

reviews.author: Eric Banta
reviews.text: I got some coupons in the mail for Dibella's subs and decided to use them. I ended up getting 4 different types of subs for a little over $20.00. Fed the family of 5 for dinner. Ordered online and picked up in store. Easy parking and stoplight to get in or out. Store was clean and staff was very friendly. I would visit them again, thanks!

reviews.author: Krishna Sudarshan
reviews.text: Attending a graduation ceremony at Bailey Hall in Cornell University was a moment of profound joy. The hall's architectural elegance complemented the significance of the occasion, creating a beautiful synergy. The vibrant atmosphere buzzed with pride and accomplishment, as graduates embarked on new chapters. Bailey Hall's grandeur added a touch of splendor to this memorable event, a perfect backdrop for celebrating achievements. The sense of unity and shared pride within its walls mirrored the sense of togetherness that marked this milestone. This beautiful hall encapsulated the essence of the moment, etching an indelible memory of celebration and achievement in the tapestry of life.

reviews.author: QuinnFord
reviews.text: Amazing Japanese drumming! What a building as well. Very clean all around, especially the bathrooms - nice tiling and a   nice calming light in each stall. I definitely hope to come back soon for more events.

reviews.author: Cady Fontana
reviews.text: We always enjoy the Cornell Concert Series shows- the music volume is always on point and the space is respectable. Parking is funky but you can figure it out in the evening around campus.

reviews.author: Laurence Walsh
reviews.text: Great meeting place for grad students during their happy hour specials on Friday afternoons. Hard to beat the $1 beers and free finger food. Also, a surprisingly good dance space for the monthly salsa night and semi occasional dance party.

reviews.author: Ellen
reviews.text: food is good, the place is large and comfortable. Employees are really kind!

reviews.author: pat shaffer
reviews.text:
You have to buy a $20 gift card to get a beer. Beers are only $1-2 so that means you either need to get incredibly drunk or you have to keep track of a card until the next time you frequent this poorly run establishment.

Also they random kick you out for 15 min and then let you back in. So don't come here if you are working on an assignment with a deadline. Good thing they have a monopoly in the area of they would probably go out of business.

reviews.author: Borui Wang
reviews.text: It's pretty easy to access than the UPS store at college town. But you WILL lose your package or have it signed by mailman, etc., when dealing with them. And agents here are particularly bad & unwilling to solve these problems. I was in the line for 20 mins only to be told my lost package was scanned in front of my apartment door and I should submit a request online. It's the second time the same thing happened in the last month.

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.text: From now on just go to the one downtown at least I get treated like a human being!!!!! So rude and refuses to give me my packages and tells me to wait until they are delivered but yet the websites I ordered my packages from states that they couldn’t deliver to my address for one reason or another and when I go to the post office to see what can be done they refuse to help me or hand them over

reviews.author: hana warrior
reviews.text: I’m so sick of the games they play they have done nothing to help answer any of my questions and they won’t pick up the phone just go to the downtown one they actually answer questions without yelling at you and making you feel small and worthless and they treat you with respect

reviews.author: Brian Oberther
reviews.text:
We’ve been using B&W for our small business for years and even though we’re a small account we are still treated very well.

Always great to shop local and be able to communicate directly with a knowledgeable human who is always willing to help.

Wether you’re a business of any size or shopping for home, I would 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: adam carignan
reviews.text: I am not I the restaurant business. That said, I have worked in a few when I was a kid and people seem to like the food I cook these days...except my ingrate kids...anyhow...This is exactly my type of store. They have the things, they don't have a fluffy theme, and their prices are good. We picked up and armload of professional grade tools for $120. The staff was helpful and efficient.

reviews.author: Dabio Budder
reviews.text:
Amazing customer service always. Clean and well organized store.  Excellent quality, well priced, and plenty of products other places in town don't have. 100% my go to store when I need to find things.

Great Small Business to deal with.

reviews.author: Aaron Jones
reviews.text:
I really can't say enough good things about the Ithaca harbor freight. I've shopped here 1-3 times a week for the past few years and I've always had a really amazing experience with not only my tool purchases, but more importantly the people working here.

I'll go out if my way to find an excuse to buy a specific tool from here instead of elsewhere because for a lack of better words the people working here are truly kind. I've had notably bad, insulting and seriously unprofessional interactions with workers at other similar types of stores over the years. Never once has a employee here been anything but exceptional to me. Nomatter what need at that moment in time. Employee turnover seems fairly low and whoever is doing the hiring when they do, is very good at choosing the right kind of people for this job.

Everyone working here doesn't have the same level of life or tool experience but Ive always been able to find really great advice if I need it. They're resourceful enough to find the person working who does know, if they dont.

These small interactions have always really brightened my day a bit, even if Im deep in a truly terrible, never ending project. The people here have always had my back and gone above and beyond to help equip me with the tools I need to finish the job.

reviews.author: Jesse Bush
reviews.text: This place is highly addictive for those of us who are into tools and hardware. They have most things and then some.

reviews.author: Zach Jaeger
reviews.text: I needed a tool set for regular household maintenance and small stuff, nothing crazy. I went to Lowe's and Home Depot and neither place had an all in one set like this and instead tried to sell me $200+ worth of tools. I came to Harbor Freight and within seconds was shown several things with different price points and quantities of tools in convenient storage boxes and was able to get what I needed for about $60. Plus! I got a lifetime guarantee on every item in the box! If a bit breaks, they'll give me a new one easy peasy!

reviews.author: kay LA
reviews.text: I’ve been to many Salvation Army’s around the state & this by far one of my favorites! It’s huge and the prices are better than some of the other stores.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text:
The hours of operation  at the time of this writing are : 9AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Saturday! But and a big but.... If you're looking to make a donation, and you have a car load of stuff,  and you drive to the back of the building.... you have to make their drop off window of between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Mon through Saturday.

Not very convenient for a professional working 9 to 5 in my opinion!Their donation hours are not the same as their store hours! If you  don't make that window, you will be taking that car load of donations right back home with you !

And if the thought crosses your mind to just leave the donation just outside the locked door, for them to pick up in the morning......that is considered dumping and you may be prosecuted! You are risking that your donation may be stolen any way over night as well.

What ever happened to those large red over flowing donation bins you would see in different parking lots?

reviews.author: Greg Wheeler
reviews.text:
This picture is how ridiculous they are there and when I said something the associate actually raised her voice the Ithaca NY Salvation Army has become an absolute joke of a place!
Do your research before buying anything and don’t bother asking for help the associates won’t give you the time of the day or are extremely rude when answering.

reviews.author: Andromeda Dickey
reviews.text: I didn't see much of the mall, but the space outside the bakery was open, airy, good atmosphere. Super cute and well lit, definitely a good spot to enjoy breakfast or take a break from shopping!

reviews.author: Malosia L
reviews.text: We have shopped by Ithaca bakery and coffee. Greats service,  fresh and tasty food. Huge variety of baked goods on top  of other items offered on the menu!

reviews.author: Saadia
reviews.text: Do get the Iced Chai Charger it's so yummy

reviews.author: Shelly Barhite
reviews.text: A great store!  Large selection of grocery items and snacks!  Clean and staff was super helpful!

reviews.author: E
reviews.text: Love Aldi's, this one is disgusting. Whatever they are cleaning the floors with smelled like absolute sewage, and upon arriving home my groceries reek as well. Unacceptable, salmon smells like bleach. Have never smelled this at other locations, it was the entire store.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: On Christmas Eve, I asked a manager for another bag because I underestimated the count. He goes, “how many?” I said, just one and smiled. He then ran over to a register and went out of his way to open it up and ring up cents for a bag. I’m only writing this because someone higher up should read this, bring it up in a team meeting and say… “maybe you can give an extra bag every once in a while if a customer needs it.” I know what I would do.

reviews.author: Peter Frazier
reviews.text:
They have a bottle and can redemption center off to the left of the front entrance. Put your cans and bottles into the machine and it gives you a ticket that you can redeem with a cashier. I didn’t see this info elsewhere on Google maps so thought I’d post it.

The grocery store itself is fine. Not special, but they sell reasonably good food at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Silochanie Miller
reviews.text: The produce is both overpriced and generally sad looking and every time I go there it feels like I pay twice as much as normal for some randomly selected item on my list. I also definitely got the vibe that I was being watched more than other customers buying a similar amount/value of stuff at the self-checkout. However, they are open later than anywhere else in this area.

reviews.author: Reliable Source
reviews.text:
That paints a pretty gnarly picture—like the produce section moonlights as a compost pile.  If the fruits and veggies are consistently that bad, it’s a huge red flag. Not only does it show poor inventory control, but it signals a lack of pride in what the store offers. No one wants to go treasure hunting just to find a decent tomato.

Sometimes calling out the issue with store management—or even in a review—can lead to better handling. But if the rot runs deep, it might be time to switch grocery lanes altogether.

That’s a whole vibe—and not the good kind. A store should feel like a place where you’re welcomed, not silently judged by zombie staff who act like smiling might void their warranty. When the cashiers can’t muster basic friendliness and the manager seems programmed to deflect concerns, it drains the experience of any humanity.

It’s wild how much a simple “hello” or a genuine smile can change a customer’s day. Instead, sounds like you got the retail version of a brick wall. If enough people feel the same, a detailed review or feedback might push for some retraining—or at least wake them out of sleep mode.

Is this the kind of place that’s convenient but soul-crushing, or do you think it's worth finding a new go-to?

reviews.author: Dalton Robinson
reviews.text: Mall is suffering, anchor stores, Target, Best buy, Regal, Michaels. and a couple of good restaurants and shops keeping it alive. Half of it's a medical center now. Come for Sicilian Delight they have great pizza. Zocalo is an excellent Mexican restaurant. Great Escapes game store. That's... About it

reviews.author: Anna M
reviews.text: We went on a bad day…student move in for Colgate AND Ithaca. But I spent some major time with this thing. Well stocked and organized. Well staffed as well!

reviews.author: Anthony W
reviews.text: Unfortunately there's not much to do here. I miss when GameStop, Sears, Dick's Sporting Goods and Glow Golf was still here. This rating is at no fault of the mall. Sadly malls aren't really a thing anymore

reviews.author: Amy Stoll
reviews.text: Jessica, the saleswoman was extremely personable, professional and supportive. I couldn't work the photo machine so she did it for me. I am grateful because I wanted to get the photos that day to send in my Xmas cards.

reviews.author: Ricky Stewart
reviews.text: Terrible customer engagement. I was trying to switch pharmacies and the guy literally tried to talk me out of it. Had an exasperated tone the whole time then basically it's gonna be a long time before it's available. Couldn't believe it. Now at CVS and the interacting was completely different and how I would expect it to be. Pleasant and helpful.

reviews.author: Francis DiMarco
reviews.text: Jessica at the Walgreens on meadow Street in Ithaca, NY was amazing. She was friendly, helpful and professional. Every store in needs an employee like Jessica. Thank you Jessica.

reviews.author: Tim Faroni
reviews.text: On a $3,500 Trex deck project, the quality of lumber & Trex decking supplies that were delivered to me from Home Depot, Ithaca, NY was poorest quality imaginable. After I complained, I was to receive a communication to arrange replacement pieces, but that never came. A second delivery was refused by the driver, claiming the residence was inaccessible. After another communication, the store representative admitted he forgot to contact me. $150 was offered as compensation at which I laughed at. $300 refund was then offered, which I accepted because dealing with incompetence is too time consuming.

reviews.author: Marco Ernest
reviews.text: I was in the store on Friday 1/2 / 2026 and was purchasing two electric heaters and a heat lamp. I went to the self-checkout area scanned one electric heater and one heat lamp. Proceeded on the checkout screen to enter my phone number and proceed to the payment for two of the three items. I was approached buy a little old lady (employee)with a mask on named Ann and she stated I was watching you and you did not scan the other heater sarcastically. I turned around and ask her if I was done with my transactions and headed out the door?She just glared at me and shook her head. She did not even wait to see if I was going to do another transaction for the remaining heater. She just immediately jumped on me. I have to do separate purchases for different properties for booking reasons to track by property. I am in the store everyday and I manage multiple rental units and am also a licensed contractor. To be looked at as a potential shoplifter or thief by a employee that basically just stands around and does nothing really makes me question if I want to continue to do business at this store. Is this the way that the employees are groomed to look at every customer as if they are a thief?

reviews.author: Aaron Jones
reviews.text: EVERY SINGLE TIME I order a same day delivery item from here, it is delivered to the wrong location or address. They do NOT read delivery notes or even go to the right address. It's beyond infuriating. There is nothing difficult about my delivery address or location.

reviews.author: Mary Henry
reviews.text:
Kudos to Alex and Cameron!! They were very nice to work with! They both had a great sense of humor and explained everything as simply as possible. They gave us an amazing deal and we NEVER felt pressured to do/buy anything other than what we wanted.
We will definitely send friends and family over to them when they’re looking to buy.
We are leasing a 2026 Hyundai Kona.

reviews.author: Laszlo Engel
reviews.text: The service was great. Jamie was very attentive and helpful. I really appreciated the attention to detail and answering all questions.  Everyone was very polite and made eye contact and was ready to help if needed. A very smooth transition to a new car.

reviews.author: Jessica K
reviews.text: The staff are friendly and efficient on the several occasions I've gone to this location to have my car serviced, and the prices were reasonable. Have never had an issue with any of their work. I also bought my car from this location in 2019, and the salesperson was extremely helpful and up-front about everything.

reviews.author: Margery Lipenski
reviews.text:
I was looking for deer corn but could find it. I stopped an associate and asked her
She took me right up where it was and even loaded it on my cart. I went to the register, cashier was extremely pleasant and courteous. I asked for help to my truck and he was right there to help me. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kevin Balok
reviews.text: Stopped into TSC in Bath to buy some ratchets. Rion took a ton of time to help me select and assemble the right ones for me. Great service! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Greg Clark
reviews.text: Called to see if I could get half ton wood pellets on pallet wrapped so I could put on trail was told no problem after a 30 mile one way drive went to pay was told no if I wanted them on pallet I would have to stack them told them I needed it wrapped even with a stap I would lose bags they lied to get my business not anymore people like that manager should be held accountable a month or two suspension without pay would help

reviews.author: Алексей Шевченко
reviews.text: I loved it! Not the best McDonald's I've ever been, but solid one. I got a new 6$ combo which they advertise everywhere. This combo includes a burger, a portion of French fries, a pack of sauce, 4 pieces of nuggets and a small drink. But the original size of the cup doesn't matter because you can drink as much as you want just using their soda fountain. Many drinks available. I also ordered a packet of salsa and a caramel ice cream. My wife ordered a frappuchino, but they forgot to give it to her. But I asked for it and they immediately corrected their mistake without questions. To be fair, they mistakenly gave us an extra packet of salsa. Also they forgot to give us a spoon initially, but we got it eventually. The place was a bit dirty but the employee was cleaning right in front of us. Music inside was great. The staff is helpful and friendly. Enjoyed my meal. Can't say anything about drive through though.

reviews.author: steven
reviews.text: old white dude who works nights had my boyfriend wait outside in the drive thru for an hour. i get wanting to keep your inside clean but there’s no excuse to have someone standing outside a drive thru for an hour. dude came from the back to lock the front door. no we don’t have a vehicle. literally placed a mobile order and waited an hr for it. every time we come here it’s dirty on the inside anyway but dudes giving people hypothermia when he’s supposed to be handing out mcgriddles.

reviews.author: Prem Yesudian
reviews.text: I didn’t get a patty in my burger…. This place historically makes a lot of mistakes with my orders and also workers have unpleasant attitudes. This was the wildest one

reviews.author: Sean K
reviews.text:
Not a bad hotel for the price if you're dropping in to see your kids at college. It's inexpensive and reasonably well maintained. Front desk staff was very friendly. Rooms were updated. Beds were comfortable and clean. Breakfast was fresh with a good variety. Great location surrounded by shopping and restaurants.

Gripes? Parking lot was really dark. Need a light out there. No daily maid service so it's fine for a night or two but can be a problem for longer stays. Told at check-in that breakfast on Saturday was until 10am but they broke it down at 9. And the biggest problem was the noise. It looks like when they updated the rooms they replaced the typical noise absorbing carpeting with vinyl plank flooring. There are huge gaps under the doors and sound from the halls echoes into the rooms. Definitely need to stuff a towel under the door to get any sleep.

reviews.author: Lynn Sosnoskie
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by my room. It was affordable and while the space wasn’t large, it was clean and all the furniture felt new. The pillows were uncomfortable which is my main complaint. The bathroom has a heated mirror that minimizes fogging, a nice touch. The shower head did leak a little, (on the side) getting some spray on the floor and toilet. But some of that is on me, as I didn’t pull the curtain fully tight. On the outskirts of Ithaca, but easy access to the town and Cornell. No fitness center, which was disappointing. The online description of the site needs to be updated. Friendly staff.

reviews.author: Katie L. Eades
reviews.text: Spend $30 more a night and save yourself the trouble of finding out what everyone else on the reviews have said to be true. Not clean rooms, you can hear everything, visible mold on the heating/cooling system, dust on the back of the toilet seat, rusted toilet paper holders, and stains on the sheets. Check in took forever and the only one key worked.

reviews.author: Lakshman Pusarapu
reviews.text: Was there for the first time. They have a nice collection of clothing 😍 and some on Black Friday sale. Good value for the money. They also have a nice collection of Christmas 🎄 jumpers and partyware.🎄 🇨🇽 🎅 🌲 🧑‍🎄

reviews.author: Mark J. Radzikowski
reviews.text:
I walked into this Kohls location and realized just how small it is compared to Vestal & Horseheads location.  The selection of items available from clothing to home decor is scarce.  (See Pictures)

There is so much room between racks and displays, it appears to be a mini dancefloor.  In the men's section, there were up to three pairs of pants on a rack with limited sizes available.  The shoe selection was disappointing as was the men's UnderArmor selection. I believe I own more UnderArmor then this entire store had for sale in Men's . (See Pictures)

As a Kohl's Charge Card holder, I frequent Vestal and Horseheads more often as I live close to Vestal.  I will continue to shop at those locations that have a better variety and layout.

reviews.author: Brenda VanVleet
reviews.text: I love kohls-I always shop the sale prices-never buy anything that is not on sale. I love the Croft and Barrow collection of clothes. Last week they were pretty well stocked up and so much to pick from.I have never had any issues at all and I shop Ithaca KOHLS MOST OF THE TIME.OH and the customer service and cashiers are very nice

reviews.author: Valery Lynn
reviews.text:
Took our riding mower (4 years old) to have it serviced because it wasn't running well. They kept it 2 1/2 weeks. Got it home and the engine was still dying after one pass at mowing. Visible hole in fuel hose not fixed. Oil and fuel filter not changed. When I called, the man told me "you wanted it to run and it ran", and "a lot can happen in 4 years" (when I told him it was a newer mower) and suggested that we were mowing grass that was too tall (even though I can mow it with our push mower). He never said he was sorry and didn't suggest bringing it back. Oh we won't! Don't waste your money!

UPDATE:  We took it to a local small engine repair. He had it 2 days. The fuel line had dead insects and debris clogging it. Runs like new!

reviews.author: M Avery
reviews.text: I didn’t know when they closed because I don’t often go there, and they were really patient with me even though I was very confused about why the lights were out in a certain department, but it was just right before closing and then five minutes after so they were very patient. Which is great because I have old lady with memory problems energy , thank you agway.

reviews.author: Chelsea Guy
reviews.text: Very helpful staff and good selection for many products. I was able to find an adhesive I couldn't get elsewhere.

reviews.author: AmukAkumA
reviews.text: Kind staff, good food, good prices. They have the best & cheapest instant ramen in town. Their veggies are always super fresh and they even carry refrigerated baked goods like buns, bread, and snack cakes. I would give them 6 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Sara Almosawi
reviews.text: small selection but it has all the basics. the cashier was very nice. amazing prices!

reviews.author: Asempe Kitchen
reviews.text: The lady owner was so sweet to me, offering me some medicinal oil for my carpal tunnel syndrome. Everything was reasonably priced and clean. Well lit and organized space. Will return.

reviews.author: Lilith Loriinae
reviews.text: Super helpful staff. Not much more i can say. For some stores, it feels like they'll go out of their way to give you a headache to get money out of you but this store is the opposite. Never going to autozone again😅

reviews.author: Melissa Thompson
reviews.text: HUGE shout out to Justin at the Elmira Tf location in Ithaca NY, he was very patient and informative, helping me with an online order that I had originally placed incorrectly.  He's a gem ♡

reviews.author: Simon Says
reviews.text:
I couldn’t close a deal with them because I found a better price at Walmart. Still, I appreciate their attitude and shout out to George.

I’ll come back again.

reviews.author: Aditya Rathi
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience at the store. My tires had dry rotted a bit earlier than expected. They were able to schedule me in for a inspection the same day and worked with goodyear warranty to get me a very good credit on my old tires towards the new ones.

reviews.author: Michelle Urra
reviews.text: Was a happy loyal customer for several years until recently. Had to reschedule some appointments due to health issues and was made to feel horrible. Some previous appointments I cam in and was told they were 1-2 hours behind and even asked me if I wanted to wait or reschedule. I don't mind waiting but sometimes you really can't when you're ill. The staff had always been understanding and flexible with me so I don't know what's going on there, but I was made to feel so bad that I will never be going back. :(

reviews.author: Mattison Lott
reviews.text: I have been in the auto business my whole life. Customer service in the last 20 years has gone down the tubes. I walk into this store I am always greeted like a friend or even go as far as family. If I am told something is wrong with my vehicle while there I tell them to fix it. People leaving 1 star have no idea what they are talking about. “Price too high can do it myself cheaper” Duh! Here you get trained technicians (yes they eat too), insurance, free coffee, heated garage/office, and assurance the job is done right. Thank you Justin L for always taking care of my wife. And I.

reviews.author: Mary Naughton
reviews.text:
This is a great Asian mart with a nice variety of options. They have fresh produce items of napa cabbage, bean sprouts, daikon radish, burdock root, galangal, Okinawan purple sweet potato, taro, and much more. They have a seafood counter, a large refrigerator section with lots of ready-made or quick heat food items. There’s also a great selection of frozen items for every kind of gyoza, dumpling, shu mai, bao buns, and so much more.

There’s plenty of dessert items from ice cream varieties and coconut buns to name a few. This mart also has a large selection within their aisles of every kind of ramen and noodle you could want, lots of herbs, spices, dried jujube, dried lotus seed, dried mushroom varieties, and a great choice for different teas. This is a wonderful place to come and get so many items, even if you’re from a different background, which I am, come here and shop. The only thing I would change is my approach. I will be sure I prepare a list of ingredients I would like beforehand, and then anything extra I buy is just a bonus.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Cerreta
reviews.text:
I absolutely LOVE this store! I found it by chance my first time visiting Ithaca two years ago.
It is so reasonably priced! We are gluten-free and this is the best place for pantry staples such as the variety of flours, sauces, and seasoningsIt's worth the 3+ hour drive for me a few times a year for this amazing store!

reviews.author: Christopher Smoker
reviews.text:
Great selection, reasonable prices, and very respectful and kind staff.

The seafood section was also fresh and maintained well, a true gem in Ithaca. With lots of classic Asian snacks all over.

reviews.author: TheRed Hill
reviews.text: We visited too late in the season, so the gorge trail was closed for the season and repairs. And although not as immersive as Watkins Glen or Robert Treman, it is so convenient to town that it can really add to a visit to the area. The upper falls parking area was a bit quieter and more intimate than the main lower falls parking. There were also stone picnic tables, and smaller, flatter trails near the upper falls parking.

reviews.author: Shana Durdin
reviews.text: Easy waterfall to visit. Plenty of parking spaces, picnic tables and clean bathrooms available. You can walk right up to the falls with no hiking required if that is what you are looking for. Hiking optional.

reviews.author: Shruti Sinha
reviews.text: Gorge trail is closed starting mid Oct this season except weekends. $10 parking fee. It was quiet wet and muddy trail so ensure to have hiking shoes and poles.

reviews.author: Ellie Liights
reviews.text:
Staff quiet but respectful. Pretty clean.  In need of a good amount of TLC. What I expected from the price ($125/night).
And supposedly they do a discount if you want to rent weekly if you pay cash. ($500/week cash, $625 card

reviews.author: ML
reviews.text:
A friend and I checked into our reserved room, and upon inspection found a cockroach on the curtains. When I called to report the issue to the front desk, a man informed me they would send someone to the room. About ten minutes later, the office called our room, and the woman who checked us in requested that we come to the office so they can assign us a different room. I denied this offer, since one cockroach is likely a sign of more, and I let them know we would be checking out. As my friend and I packed the car to leave, two male employees stood outside the office and watched us the whole time. It was uncomfortable. I reported the concern to Hotels.com, and they sent me a follow up email stating they could not help with a refund.

Aside from the cockroach, I also found grime and stains on the walls, light fixtures and cigarette burns in one of the comforters. I will be reporting the Econo Lodge in Cortland to the county health department. This hotel is unsanitary, uncomfortable and unhelpful to their guests.

reviews.author: eggburtho
reviews.text:
Do not stay here unless desperate. Bedbug heaven. Look for other places, not worth the stay, not worth the bedbug bites. The non-smoking rooms all have a scent of cigarettes and the management refused to help after we informed them of the bedbugs, though we didn't inform before we checked out since bed bug bites take a while to appear.

Management can also be very rude. I feel bad booking my family here.

reviews.author: Dhuha “Duha” Mohammed
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Best Western University Inn. The hotel was clean, comfortable, and the front desk staff were very welcoming and helpful. The location is excellent and very close to Cornell University, which made our visit easy and smooth.
Overall, a very pleasant and convenient stay. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Logan Williams
reviews.text: Hotel staff was very friendly and accommodating for us and our dog. Rooms were clean and beds comfortable. Shower was clean and had plenty of hot water. Location is convenient - just a short ride into the heart of Ithaca without the headache. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Melissa Dadich
reviews.text:
We booked rooms for the crew in this location for convenience to a job site. The rooms are spacious, clean, and the staff is attentive, helpful, and kind.

The breakfast room is clean and always stocked.

The location is so close to downtown Ithaca where there are shops and restaurants.

reviews.author: shane mcgraw
reviews.text: Full marks as a concert venue. I don't know that everyone could do it for a rock show, but Cowboy Junkies' foh made this place sound like a slightly overgrown house show. And what a joy these seats were compared to 90% of theater seats. Scoping put the aerial view beforehand I expected to fight to park, but for the (less than capacity) show I saw there was no problem getting right into the lot.

reviews.author: erzabet101
reviews.text:
A Christmas Carol cocktail experience…..

We had a really fun night , enjoyed the experience and it was wonderful to see everyone  relax, smile and laugh.
Our only con, the Uber Drivers around this area show up 10 mins early and after I rescheduled our pick up  to accommodate the late show start we still ended up missing the last 15 mins of the show  (not the fault of the show , my fault for not anticipating enough time)

In all  if you get a chance, check these little shows out!  Dress up !!! Enjoy the evening and leave your serious friends at home💕

reviews.author: Barbara Witek
reviews.text: We saw a christmas cocktail carol at the Hangar theatre. What a fun experience! The actors were great, as was their rendition of the classic tale. The crafted cocktails between acts were an added bonus. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rarara
reviews.text: I’ve attended Cornell and frequented this store for over two years. On my last visit I was stopped by a middle aged white employee (i am brown) accused of taking merchandise into the restroom. After I clarified I had already purchased the T shirt I was taking in, the employee asked “What about the bag?” Referring to my school bag in an aggressive tone. My Nike school bag was bright orange, has been used for over 2 years, and most importantly, wasn’t even sold at the store. It had multiple pins and a keychain identifying it as a personal item. This bag has never been sold at this store, I’m just a non white student going to the restroom. It is disappointing to face such racial based micro aggressions. I have otherwise only had good experiences at this store and most of the staff are extremely nice and helpful.

reviews.author: Kurt Althoff
reviews.text: Three cheers for Linda! I couldn't find a particular item on their website so I called and luckily got a hold of a very helpful human. She was extremely familiar with the inventory and thought it may be on the clearance rack and no longer on the website. She contacted the storefront, found the item and took my order over the phone. You cannot ask for better customer service! Please give her a raise and a promotion. Go Bears!

reviews.author: Venice L.
reviews.text:
I haven’t been here in three years. I remember back then, the store wasn’t as big as it is now. They’ve done a great job renovating and expanding. There are more clothing options, though some are still of poor quality.

What I really like is how they’ve designed the space to connect the store with the post office and the coffee study area. I think it’s a brilliant idea.

reviews.author: Beth Roberts
reviews.text: Hammond Health truly does deserve the terrible reviews. The visits themselves were, considering the one star rating, not terrible--however the cost is abysmal. The doctors and nurses were nice, however I was never told that the flu test I was recommended would cost $355. It would have been nice if when they asked if I would like them to run a flu test if I was made aware it was cost so damn much. I absolutely never would have consented to it at that rate.

reviews.author: Emily Penny
reviews.text: You would be better off not getting the school insurance because they literally don’t do anything.

reviews.author: Eren N.
reviews.text:
The actual care I got from the doctors and nurses here has been fantastic - much more thorough than what I recieved at the nearest urgent care

However, I do have to knock off 2 stars for 2 things
1) This place has the most asinine way to make appointments I've ever experienced. Either you call at exactly 8am and get an appointment for the same day, or you can't get an appointment until 2 weeks later. If you call even 15 minutes after 8am, you'll probably be out of luck.
2) The provider change makes students pay more than they did before

reviews.author: Cindy Collado
reviews.text: I don’t usually do this but food and atmosphere was amazing. From the Sunrise Selections I had Seasoned Country Style Potatoes, Scrambled Eggs with Hardwood Smoked Bacon and a Fresh Tropical Fruit Cup. My Husband had the Hawaiian Style Loco Moco. As Breakfast Accents we had Ham Steak Bon-in along with Butter Biscuits with Sausage Cream Gravy. Can’t wait to go again definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Izabela Zamboni
reviews.text:
Sooo good! We tried the ahi tuna taco- amazing
Kaluha pork sandwich- very good (I miss a little kick of a salad like the taco had it)
Kaluha pork taco- perfect!! 💯
My husband ordered the mussels and was his favorite and he loved the passion fruit creme brulee
The coconut pie was fenomenal
We will be back 😊

reviews.author: Melissa Silenzio (RedApple93)
reviews.text:
Modern Ohana, formally MIX, was a delightful surprise. As a big fan of Mix, I was worried about this change, but I must say that Modern Ohana is official in my "favorite restaurant" list of Ithaca.
The uplifting atmosphere created with the renovations were beautifully on theme with the new tropical direction of the restaurant.
We ordered a Blacked ahi tuna benedict and a Hawaiian loco moco and both were amazing quality, balanced in flavors and made with attention to detail. An amazing introduction into what was our first hawaiian meal, and it will not be our last at Modern Ohana!

reviews.author: Cam Roy
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jess, She helped tremendously with any questions I had and if I didn’t know something. She is very kind and honest. Very responsive too, she would very reliable to answer all texts/calls, and would assure me the proper vehicle and support. Highly recommend coming here for non pushy car purchasing, very wide selection of all honda models, prices are low here too! A+ Experience overall and highly recommend to anybody!

reviews.author: Lisa St. John
reviews.text: I am so furious with this dealer.  They didn't honor a warranty repair, and when we escalated to Corporate (its a major repair) - they lied to corporate and told them that there was no evidence of the issue. My van was acting up a while back, and I took it to my local mechanic - he said that my spark plugs were fouled and I needed new plugs and fixed them.  Shortly after, we get a letter from Honda saying this is a known issue and they've issued an extended warranty to fix it.  Fast forward and my van starts acting up again - I take it this time to Honda, they say they see oil on the spark plugs (meaning the problem is happening again) but won't honor the warranty, because the plugs aren't fouled yet. I have my mechanic provide a detailed letter saying what he did to fix the problem, and that the problem I have is in fact the problem covered by the extended warranty. They still refuse to cover it.  We call corporate to file a ticket with hopes to get it covered. They have a conversation with Maguire Honda and the Maguire folks lie and say there was no oil on the plug. Now, I have to incur the cost of constantly changing plugs and watching my car for years to come - because they refuse to honor a warranty.  Its really terrible.

reviews.author: Andrea Blodgett
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at Maguire Honda with Jess!
Jess made purchasing my daughter’s car smooth, stress-free, and easy from start to finish. She was patient, honest, and really listened to what we needed for safety, budget, and reliability. The entire process was seamless, and we absolutely love the car. Highly recommend Jess at Maguire Honda!

reviews.author: Amy Stofenberg
reviews.text:
I never leave reviews this long but this is the culmination of years and years of frustration and disgust.

This bank’s policies are the LEAST friendly to low-income people of any bank I have ever come across. The employees are great - kind, helpful, funny. But the bank’s policies are straight up immoral and repulsive— particularly when it comes to overdraft fees.

They once charged me *EIGHT HUNDRED DOLLARS* in one year in overdraft fees. There should be a cap. I would obviously prefer if they declined the transactions that overdrew my account. BLOCK THE CHARGES. But they would rather make $38 a pop off of someone who is clearly struggling.

I have talked with the bank about this so many times over my 7 years of having an account with them. I had one very kind employee at the Elmira Rd. location who said he understood, and didn’t want to “kick someone while they were down”. He refunded about 4 overdraft fees. I wish the bank had the same moral fiber as that employee.

They slightly altered their policy this past year. Now, if your account is overdrawn less than $50, you have 24 hours to make it right before being charged the fee. If your account is overdrawn $50+, you are charged $38, AND $38 for every single withdrawal after that—no matter how small. The amount of times I’ve been charged $38 for a $3 overdraft - you wouldn’t even believe.

I’ve gone to sleep at night and not realized my account got overdrawn. By morning, I’ve been charged $160 in overdraft fees due to a $50 charge, followed by a $3 charge, a $5 charge, and an $8 charge.

Is the bank *really* so put-out, having to temporarily cover a small transaction for me? Again, block the charges. But they prefer to make $38 off of someone who is poor. What a scam. I have some choice words for this bank that I will keep to myself. Do better. “Community” bank-- hilarious.

I’m moving away from Ithaca and will be closing my accounts this week. Good riddance. *FYI* - my boyfriend has an account at Chase and has never been charged an overdraft fee, even when his account has been accidentally overdrawn by $300. That’s where I’m opening a new account.

reviews.author: Kitty Hall-Thurnheer
reviews.text: Absolutely worst customer service ever at Trust Co. Very difficult to get someone to answer the phone! Extremely difficult to get info out of them--they say they are asking security questions for my own good, but when they ask what branch did I open the account (40 years ago), I'm not able to answer correctly, then they deny info. Closed my mortgage and all accounts with them and moved to Elmira Savings Bank. Best decision ever.

reviews.author: Eric N
reviews.text: Would not recommend.  Went to Tompkins because they are a local business.  Unfortunately they don't treat you like a local business.  BONNIE  is the assistant manager of mortgage yet will act like she is a new hire. On many different occasions she actually acted more like a mob that was holding money over my head then a loan office that I am bringing business to.  Vary sad that this is how any one would get treated.  Much happier now with the customer service at CFCU.

reviews.author: Timothy Greenwalt
reviews.text: Only gas station that pumps your gas and cleans your windshield! Plus the cheapest in price along having their card. No problem getting a card! This station is in Ithaca NY

reviews.author: Heather Woodie
reviews.text: Always friendly, sometimes they get your back window and they fill the tank for you! Woot!

reviews.author: Eric Fenchel
reviews.text:
They assisted in putting air in my tires/best deal on Gas too.
Yesterday’s gas prices with Service from the old days.
Priceless

reviews.author: Mark Gilbert
reviews.text: The young lady who manages this store is very helpful.   I had to get a car battery during this -10F deep freeze.   She was knowledgeable, efficient and friendly.   Also I saw her training a newer team member and I thought she did a good job there too.

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! A clean, neat store. All of the products I wanted to purchase were in stock at low prices. Friendly, hospitable staff. Conveniently located right in downtown Ithaca with plenty of free parking. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: John Kingsboro
reviews.text: Just stopped by here for windshield wipers and got full white glove service by their employee Eric. He even went as far as to install them for me. Such a nice thing to do. All the employees here are super kind and would have helped me out. Thank you Eric!

reviews.author: Samantha Lampman
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a 2026 Jeep Wrangler from Friendly Dodge in Penn Yan, and I cannot say enough good things about our experience. From start to finish, the entire team was absolutely amazing.

Our salesperson, Cassidy Case, was knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in helping us trade in my current vehicle and get into our new vehicle — not just making a sale. At no point did we feel pressured or pushed into anything. Instead, we felt heard, respected, and cared for. It truly felt like they were focused on us as people, not just customers.

The efficiency of the team was also impressive. Everyone worked together seamlessly, making the process smooth and stress-free. The atmosphere at the dealership is calm, welcoming, and inclusive — they truly live up to the name “Friendly.”

One thing that meant so much to us as a family was how Liz Morea stepped in to entertain our six-year-old so we could focus on the paperwork and details of the sale. She was attentive, kind, and genuinely caring. It made a huge difference and showed that they care about the whole family experience, not just the transaction.

We will absolutely be returning to Friendly Dodge for future vehicle purchases and will happily recommend them to others. If you're looking for a dealership that values people over pressure, this is the place to go.

reviews.author: alex howser
reviews.text: Stopped in today a day after Christmas of all dealing with a shudder feeling in my truck service tech named Mike took a ride with me very respectful and professional. Was able to get the truck to do the problem im having we took it back and between him and the service manager both are trying to help me out very impressed with the service especially in today's world where no one wants to put in that extra effort

reviews.author: Tylerdm
reviews.text: Bought a 2023 Grand Cherokee with Maguire. When I purchased the vehicle they informed me I would receive 3 free oil changes, apparently it’s 2 now that I need one done. I bought the extended warranty and they switched the deductible to $200 from $100 without saying anything as we previously discussed a $100 deductible. During install of their appearance protection plan they scratched the paint and covered the vehicle in swirl marks (black shows everything). I specifically asked if the vehicle came with a tow harness only to find out that it didn’t. Maguire actually installed the harness at no cost but scratched my vehicle even more during the process. And good luck getting ahold of their service department, they NEVER pick up the phone.

reviews.author: Karanjit Kamboj
reviews.text:
I travel to Ithaca from work and stay at this hotel when I am in town. I have been a guest at this location every week since mid-June 2025. Despite my loyalty, I have received poor customer service from this hotel's staff. On January 18th, I brought my dog with me and was assessed a pet fee of $81. Although I did not bring her with me for any of my subsequent stays, the hotel staff continued to charge me an additional $75 for a pet incidental fee on 2/5, $75 on 2/19 and $90 on 2/23. I called multiple times to alert them to this issue and was instructed to speak with their manager, Caitlin.

After finally reaching Caitlin this afternoon, I was told that there was only one pet charge of $81 and the other charges were holds on my credit card that would eventually be reversed. I informed her that these were not - in fact - holds because those would have been marked as "pending" in my credit card history; rather, my credit card statement had them marked as "purchases". Moreover, I reminded her that I had been a guest of the hotel since June of 2025 and never had any issues with holds not being reversed for previous stays; this was a new observation that started occurring after I brought my pet with me on 1/18. Caitlin then altered her response and asserted that these additional fees were actually assessed for a pet and that she allegedly reviewed camera footage and found that I had a pet on each of these dates. I can assure you that this was not the case and that she fabricated this lie about the surveillance footage. She then proceeded to hang up on me. When I called back, my call was refused once again. After calling a fourth time, the person who answered the phone informed me that the charges would stand and that I would have to dispute them with my credit card company.

I cannot believe the manner in which this has been handled. As I mentioned, I visit Ithaca for work and stay at this hotel each week from Sunday evenings to Thursday mornings. You would expect that such customer loyalty would be appreciated; instead, the hotel's staff has erroneously charged me multiple times, denies any culpability and refuses to provide a remedy. I am so incredibly frustrated. What an absolute disaster. I will be reporting this incident to the Marriott Corporate office, and it should be expected that there will be some very significant staffing changes after I am done speaking with them.

reviews.author: Elena Armstrong
reviews.text: Booked a room here thru USAA perks and paid for it. After checking in, they charged an $80 fee and somehow couldn't produce a receipt. The next morning they charged smooth another $65 and again, wouldn't give a receipt. I've now paid $195 for a room that was worth $120 and they won't contact me back about what the charges are for.

reviews.author: Katherine Morris
reviews.text: Our stay started off disappointing. When we arrived we were told there weren’t any clean rooms because of oversold. I made my reservation way in advance, and called three weeks Pryor multiple times to make sure everything was in order.. I was highly frustrated and didn’t have patience to go elsewhere. As we got settled in, my husband asked were we rude to the gentleman, I forgot his name but he’s the Kappa working..we went back down and apologized because it wasn’t his fault and he tried to do everything possible. That’s why I’m leaving such a good review because other than the room situation, for an outdated hotel it was well kept and beds were comfortable. Just the right location to Cornell.. I would stay again… and thanks again Mr. Kappa for putting up with our frustration. Love to see young men at check in

reviews.author: Teufel Hund
reviews.text: Consistent quality food and the quantity is more than filling.  The parking is ample, the serving staff is not only efficient but very receptive to guests.  3 times we have eaten there every time the pitcher of  frozen mango margaritas has been perfectly blended, more importantly, consistently top notch with a distinguishing amount of tequila and not some water downed mango watered down purée other places provide.  The food is  expertly prepared and expeditiously delivered to your table piping hot. Bravo to the proprietor.  It’s rare that a customers experience spread out over 12 months and 3 visits where each time the food has the exact same quality and the frozen mango margaritas are NEVER watered down like other restaurants.  Oh and I also forgot to mention that their complementary in house salsa and corn chips are  so tasty.  Their combo gordo dish is so big it comes out in two full size platter type plates.  I get that every time!

reviews.author: Michelle Rath
reviews.text: We moved here from Texas and couple years ago. We haven't found many restaurants we love and hadn't found any Mexican food we loved, until Old Mexico. My husband got his favorite dish, the carne asada, and had the chilaquiles. Both of our dishes were so, so good! The only thing we both found a little underwhelming was the salsa. We prefer something spicier, but if you like a very mild salsa, it's good. Our server was great, too. He was there when we needed anything, but not overbearing. We'll definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Dongyun Ho
reviews.text: Huge portions and a great atmosphere! I haven’t had much Mexican food before, but I found the carnitas a bit dry and with a strong porky smell compared to what I’ve tried elsewhere. However, the seafood fajitas were quite good.

reviews.author: Michael McFail
reviews.text:
This was our second trip to Gray Barn in as many years. My wife and I had an absolutely lovely time. The vegan breakfasts are delicious, the beds are comfy, and everything is exceptionally clean. The sanctuary tour and getting to spend time with the animal residents is always a highlight.

We love hiking at the Mohonk Preserve, just a short drive away.

This trip we found the Tuthilltown Spirits Distillery. They have a great tasting room and outdoor seating area. Rye the distillery cat comes and goes as he pleases, at least when he can get someone to open the door. It's a spot we'll definitely be back to on our next trip to the area. Visiting the sanctuary is becoming an annual tradition for us.

reviews.author: Christine M
reviews.text:
The Gray Barn is such a hidden gem. It's so cozy, serene, and quiet with stunning views of the sanctuary. We stayed in the Curly room, which was a bit more secluded than the other rooms. The vegan breakfast each morning was prepared by an incredible chef. The carrot bacon was to die for.

Being able to walk around Woodstock Farm Sanctuary and spend quality time with the animals was so special. Anna gave us a private tour. I learned so much about the animals and the WFS mission. As a vegan person myself, it felt so wonderful to stay at a place and have my money go towards helping care for the animals and the costs of maintaining the sanctuary.

Staying at The Gray Barn is an experience I'll never forget. I can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: isabel e
reviews.text:
I celebrated my honeymoon here and it was even better than I could have imagined. Extremely easy to check in and out, the homemade breakfasts were divine, and the whole sanctuary is a dream! We came Valentine’s weekend, and it was a winter wonderland.

The Gray Barn is extremely modern with a focus on the stunning view. Everything about it was cozy- relaxing beds, warm fireplace, ceramic mugs for never ending coffee & tea, and the comfiest couch I’ve ever sat in!

But nothing tops the sanctuary- spacious barns filled with happy animals living out their lives with care, community, and peace. It was extremely moving and an honor to see such beautiful animals being so cared for.

I can’t wait to come back

reviews.author: Jake Shulroff
reviews.text:
Ithaca in general is going downhill fast with no signs of stopping but this place is decent. It is in the commons where crime has been on the rise. I feel safer walking alone in NYC at night than I do in the parking garage for this building. The parking garage attached to the building (which is owned by the city) is disgusting. It is constantly full of human waste (literally every form you can imagine) and needles which will maybe get cleaned up 2x a year, no matter how many times you complain to the booth workers or city. Even once they clean it,  it’s quickly replaced by more needles and human waste. I personally had to call 911 MULTIPLE times after finding someone ODing in the staircase.

As far as the apartment building itself goes, the tenants are nuts. My first year in the building I had an ongoing issue with my neighbor who would constantly bang on the shared wall, file noise complaints against me and call the cops on me. There were multiple occasion where the cops were called about the noise coming from my apartment and I wasn’t even home (I lived alone and had no pets).

This past winter we lost heat for multiple weeks in February, the coldest month of the year. Management did their best to rectify the issue but it was not enough. The space heater they provide was insufficient for the size of the apartment and I did everything I could not to be home. They did not provide a discount in rent or offer a hotel room until the problem was fixed. The apartment got so cold the thermostat (which was super old and dated) was unable to even read how cold the apartment was, the needle was as far as it could be to the cold side.

Once it got hot again the central air would not work. My apartment was 95° for 2 weeks before they even offered me a portable AC for my apartment. Again not sufficient for the size of the apartment. It was another 2 weeks before that issue was resolved and at that point my lease was up and I had no intention of renewing it.

I would say avoid at all cost but hey it’s Ithaca, that’s 5⭐️s for that city’s standards.

reviews.author: Eduardo Poblete
reviews.text:
It’s an amazing place to live in. The staff is great and really nice,  everybody was always available and happy to help with anything. Dream team.

It's also a great location, everything is within walking distance (restaurants, convenience stores, coffe shops, bus stops, Cornell campus, etc).

I totally recommend Center Ithaca.

reviews.author: JC Christiansen
reviews.text: Originally planned as a high end walking mall with plenty of nearby parking it is becoming a more and more rundown neighborhood with high crime, low occupancy of stores, and crowded access.  Some things worth going to but they are becoming scarce as the local government mismanages even simple things.  More often I find somewhere else to get what I want.

reviews.author: Information Withheld
reviews.text: Amazing experience in a historically beautiful theater. The show was one of my all time favorite experiences and the staff was incredibly welcoming.

reviews.author: Tommy Propane
reviews.text: Beautiful venue, relatively comfortable seats. Cordial staff. Great acoustics. Been here twice now and looking forward to returning.

reviews.author: Ron M
reviews.text: I give it 4 stars because of the great variety of entertainment they bring in and the friendly staff. The building itself is pretty warn down...but again,  it's all about the entertainment, the ambiance is tertiary for me.

reviews.author: Thomas Robinson
reviews.text:
A fun little spot to do some kitschy shopping or grab a light bite to eat.
Downtown Ithaca is best for walking. There is street parking and several garages. Check out this little mall in a repurposed building.
We got some great tchotchkes and a few Christmas ornaments.

reviews.author: Tellyour Stories
reviews.text: Neat little city-vibe joint in hippie town. Lots of shops, checked out the ukulele stock at guitar works while a breakfast sandwich was made and got a key to use the restroom to take a whizzz. Life don't get any better!

reviews.author: John Spannbauer
reviews.text: The food was great, a bit pricey but who isn't. When Molly began this about 50 years ago it certainly wasn't white napkin, I wonder what she would think about her creation now? Food was good, service good, I just think I would have liked it better when she was involved. Maybe just nostalgia.

reviews.author: Sara Dovichi
reviews.text: A must stay! For anyone looking to make their stay in Ithaca more memorable and feel like a truly unique experience, I highly recommend the Argos!! We found this Inn online, booked it for the approximately to the commons and walkability to where we wanted to be and were SO HAPPILY surprised by the unique, warm, inviting character of the place! We had espressos in the solarium, had a delicious cocktail in the lounge, played cards in one of the many cute nooks, wandered the building enjoying the unique decor, and felt very welcome! We had just as much fun staying in as we did going out! We will definitely return!

reviews.author: J van der L
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel which has been restored in an unique way with a high attention to detail. Very special vibe and nothing compared to the standard hotels.  The rooms and beds are comfy as well although some of the rooms upstairs (above the bar) can perhaps be a bit noisy. We unfortunately had an issue with a reservation via booking.com and because of a disconnect between systeem there was no third bed in one of the rooms. It was taken care of by the staff but it gave us the feeling that we made the mistake. Could have been handled better imo. Still the hotel is great and can recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Carissa Ralbovsky
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Argos Inn after traveling to Ithaca for a job interview. I wanted to be able to walk to the Commons and the interview location from my hotel and the location was excellent for both, and I found it helpful to just leave my car at the hotel parking lot the whole time. The staff were very friendly and accommodating and had offered to help carry my bags upstairs, which I didn't need but appreciated the offer. The bed was very comfortable and the room was perfect for my short trip. I really enjoyed the sunroom with water and coffee, it was a great spot to work for a couple of hours in the afternoon between check-out time and my interview. I stayed in one of the rooms above the bar and while it was noisy until 10:30p, I was working on interview prep so it was no problem for me, and then the noise immediately died down at 10:30p and I slept very well. Would definitely stay here again for the charming atmosphere in a charming city!

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text: I'm tired of having to call and get a new card just because I simply need a refund, and then that refund can take months for me to receive. Like why are you just allowing my card to be used for anything, especially if I don't have enough in my account? And then even though I call for it to be canceled, my money to be refunded, they say nothing can be done then the next day they give me some bs charge and steal more of my money that I don't have.

reviews.author: David Herrmann
reviews.text: I was always told 9am to 5 pm was bankers hours but now it’s 9 to 4 I get out at 4 so only can do banking on Saturday nice

reviews.author: Amanda S.
reviews.text: We use Chemung Canal Trust Company for everything. We have had small personal loans, car loans, and our mortgage with them. We have needed them for savings for the kids, our personal account and when we suddenly lost multiple  family members  they were right there with assistance with Estate management. For every financial need life has thrown at us Chemung Canal has been there to help! With the familiarity of a small town bank and the knowledge and experience of larger firms Chemung Canal brings the best of both worlds to its customers.  We Could not ask for a better bank!!

reviews.author: Kait Goad
reviews.text: Stopped in after flying in to Ithaca at midnight, hungry and looking for some pick me up. Unfortunately the sub shop was closed and I settled for frozen pizza. Before checking out Chris happily informed me that he’d make me a sandwich right then and there. It really made my night and just made the start of my trip awesome. Thank you Chris for your kindness!

reviews.author: Vivian King
reviews.text:
Stopped in to use the bathroom and was immediately with greeted with a customer who held the door for me.

Then when I walked into the gas station, back towards the bathroom, there were a few employees stocking shelves and having PLEASANT CONVERSATION with each other WHILE continuing to do their jobs.

I was pleasantly surprised when I entered the bathroom as it was very clean and neat. That’s amazing for a gas station bathroom!!

I was searching for a snack before getting back on the road and all the shelves were very well stocked and neatly organized. Not a thing out of place! I found what I was looking for very easily.

When I asked the cashier how to leave a review she was unsure so directed me to the manager on duty.

The manager on duty was a very pleasant woman and she was also WORKING ALONGSIDE her team!! I could tell she really cared about the store and that it wasn't just a job to her! It's very rare to witness a manager who not only works alongside her team but who also has respectful conversations with them and strives to do the best job she can. When I gave her compliments she was very humble.

Great experience from pulling into the gas station to leaving the gas station. Every employee I saw was working, including the manger, and everyone including fellow customers were all super nice. No employees were on their phones or talking negatively. Very pleasant atmosphere! I am very easily overstimulated but this gas station was excellent! No blaring music and no loud noises.

I wish there were more gas stations like this around! Other places need to take notes!!

I was only in here for about 10 minutes but had such a wonderful experience I needed to leave a review. They did not beg me for a review or pressure me in any way.

Thank you to everyone at Mirabito located 32 Peruville Rd in Lansing, NY!! Blessings to you all. ⛽️ ⛽️ ⛽️

My visit was 10/7/25 @ 12:30-12:40pm

Corporate, please acknowledge this team for their outstanding and extraordinary work!!

reviews.author: Claire F
reviews.text: I had a staff member directly sexual harass me and then when you stand up for yourself they passive aggressively harass you. He remains employed and is left alone unsupervised despite management being aware ( corporate and general manager). I had to stop going to this location due to this. Absolutely horrible situation and experience.

reviews.author: Paul Dorio
reviews.text: Wonderful place. Easy. Comfortable. Audio from stage is easily heard

reviews.author: Alyce Geanopulos
reviews.text: My friends and I attended the Pandora Dance Troupe Performance and the space was phenomenal! We really enjoyed the acoustics and the lighting was quite professional. It's amazing the resources that an ivy league school like Cornell has comparatively! We will definitely attend another performance here! And hopefully it's for Pandora!! Loved every minute!

reviews.author: Aarathi Sharma
reviews.text: Beautiful theater! We went to catch a show of—Hamilton. Great location in Tampa, FL by the river to walk around the center too!

reviews.author: Taylor Snow
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautifully located on Cornell University’s central campus. We stayed for two nights and had a wonderful time. The student workers are lovely and so helpful. Alessandra, a freshman at Cornell, was especially outstanding. She was incredibly quick and attentive every time we needed our valet car parked or retrieved, which made going in and out of the hotel effortless. Her warm attitude, efficiency, and professionalism truly stood out and elevated our experience. We were impressed by how she handled everything especially given the business of the hotel.
We would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.author: Arindam Basu
reviews.text:
**Disappointing Decline from a Once-Reliable Property**

We've been guests at The Statler multiple times over the years and always had positive experiences. Our October 25-26 stay was unfortunately a stark departure from those standards.

The problems began with a delayed airport pickup and continued through a disorganized check-in process. When I requested to switch from a queen bed to twin beds, the staff member asked "For the same money?" as though this standard configuration change was an upgrade request.

Billing issues were particularly concerning. My credit card was charged twice for incidentals ($50 and $32.50) despite confirming the first transaction was approved. More troubling, my card was compromised shortly after these charges were processed, requiring me to order a replacement. At checkout, there was a discrepancy between my bill and the terminal amount that no one could explain.

We were promised a rollaway bed that never arrived despite waiting over four hours. When I logged complaints through the hotel's app as they had suggested, an associate named Randy requested my email but never followed up. The app chat feature then became inaccessible.

During checkout, I referenced these issues, but no staff member had any knowledge of my communication with Randy or my logged complaints. Staff seemed unfamiliar with their own systems and were unable to help. When I asked for a manager, I was given a phone number rather than on-site resolution.

The room itself was well-maintained, but everything surrounding it revealed significant gaps in training, internal communication, and service standards. It appears experienced staff may have been replaced with inadequately trained personnel who lack basic hospitality skills.

For returning guests familiar with The Statler's previous standards, this visit was particularly disappointing. For first-time guests, I'd recommend considering other properties until these operational issues are resolved.

reviews.author: Ryan Neff
reviews.text: Great stay for parents and kids,  Restaurant at the hotel was amazing.  Pleasantly surprised as we changed hotels last minute and was a great move!  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: JitkaKac
reviews.text: Amazing space combining old and new structures. We checked out the A.D.White library and the modern study built into the hill. We also caught the chimes at 1:10 pm playing What a wonderful world.

reviews.author: Yunong Shi
reviews.text:
Not just a library, but a sanctuary of history, architecture, and quiet inspiration.

Walking into the White Library feels like stepping into a 19th-century scholar’s dream — wrought iron spiral staircases, two-story stacks of books, carved woodwork, leather armchairs, and a stunning chandelier-lit meeting table by the windows. Every corner invites quiet contemplation. You can practically hear the echoes of philosophical debates and the scribbles of early days.

reviews.author: Shana Durdin
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning! I wish I’d had more time to explore and take it all in, but since it’s an active library filled with students hard at work, I didn’t want to interrupt their quiet focus.

reviews.author: Gerard Farmer
reviews.text: I came here on a business trip and the people and staff are so nice. I liked they had Canadian beer on tap but they can use an arcade machine besides the dart board. I wanna go as soon as the leaves fall again.

reviews.author: Kaylee Oliver
reviews.text: New ownership has this place making food as good as… actually, even better than before. The wings are the ones you’d expect from UJ and then some, plus the best bleu cheese in Ithaca. Burgers cooked to your temperature can’t be beat, and the quick service is great! It’s not a party spot, but a place to catch a game or have a solid dinner and be surrounded by great locals, great beer, and great vibes.

reviews.author: Kellie M
reviews.text: We ate here back in November. Was hesitant to stop. It wasn't busy when we got there. The food was really good. Best burger I'd had in a long time. We would go back.

reviews.author: Walt Mann
reviews.text:
$200 later and I'm tossing some Steak and cheese crunch rolls in my toaster oven because the food i got was inedible.  Didn't want to cause a scene because I was on a "nice night out" with my gf. Will never come back here but hey the cake was good. Just look at my medium rare steak and zoom in on that blubber. The lobster was overcooked and dry.
Service was fine.

reviews.author: Diana Argueta
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at The Boatyard Grill!!! We did not make a reservation and we were quickly seated. The server was kind and attentive. She came just enough times to make sure we were okay. We ordered the Spicy Tuna Roll, and made a combination of the Maker's Mark Sirloin and the Campfire Ribeye dish. The Ribeye was cooked to perfection. The portion sizes were more than enought to feed my husband and I. The prices were affordable for the meal that was served.

We enjoyed our trip and would definitely come back, if we are ever in town again.

reviews.author: Micah Dunham
reviews.text: Would recommend incorporating a stop here into your plans to visit the area. The food was excellent, atmosphere was great with a beautiful view of the water, and the service was also exceptional. Our waiter, Mark F. was courteous and professional and did a fantastic job!

reviews.author: Walter Whyte
reviews.text: Let me tell you something….if you come ti Ithaca, your lodging choices will be limited. But if you stay here, all is well! Great property, friendly staff. “Spike” will hook you up at breakfast…and that’s the most important meal of the day. Rooms are modern and updated. 10 of 10. Time for bed.

reviews.author: Anna Golichenko
reviews.text: We stayed one night from Jan 10-11. Three people and two service dogs. Room 407 was with an amazing window view. Breakfast was delicious, a lot of variety of food and fantastic customer service. Coffee machine was broken at the reception, but I believe they will fix it as soon as possible. NO charger for the EV vehicle in the huge underground parking. The hotel was very clean and looked very well managed.

reviews.author: Y.H. Kang
reviews.text:
Great hotel in a great Ithaca Commons downtown location.
Walk to shops+ restaurants nearby.
On-site restaurant= pretty good.
Valet and self-parking available.
Rooms big and clean.
Shower+water pressure good
Staff= very friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Angelo Garcia
reviews.text: Well at first I was very excited to visit this location, the view from the balcony is amazing but only available during the warmer months!Coffee was perfect so I thought the food would follow suit. Nope! The home fries were a bit dry  , the eggs Benedict lacking sauce * not enough provided * so they sat on a dry English Muffin, the little sauce I got was tasteful. I ordered 2 pancakes, they looked good, not enough butter provided and if you wanted real Maple Syrup you pay $2.50 extra * should have been included in the price oh well! The gentleman who gave us a seat, young fellow, hardly spoke, mute? Shy? Who knows! No courtesy or manners? The waitress must have been having a hard day she also didn’t speak much! However the place still managed to bring a good crowd so they must be doing something right… right? Nevertheless I will not be coming back…

reviews.author: Jack Stanick
reviews.text: Not a bad spot at all. Fair pricing, quality diner food. Decent location and nice staff. Steak and eggs were good and worth it; you get what you pay for. Would recommend for a Saturday or Sunday brunch.

reviews.author: Joseph Burke
reviews.text: Definitely a great diner, the corn beef hash was very solid (although it could have been a bit crisper, so you might want to consider asking for that) and their cinnamon glazed toast was good, if a bit stiff. Great experience overall, and food left me feeling full and satisfied.

reviews.author: Reed Mizener
reviews.text: I had spent nearly $1000 dollars on new tires and scheduled an appointment a week out to have them installed at 9:30 am I had to move things around in my life to make this happen and as I show up the tire center has a paper sign saying it is closed and the door is locked. I go to a customer service for them to tell me they have no staff. I can understand that but what I couldn't understand is why I had multiple confirmation emails reminding me of my appointment but no one has the wherewithal to contact me even before the appointment to notify me I would have to reschedule. The soonest they could reschedule me after all of this is another week away and I've been riding on a spare tire for the last week. Completely inconsiderate and poor business practice. I am taking a refund and will never use their tire center again and may just cancel my membership altogether.

reviews.author: Dan Forquell
reviews.text:
••••••Update•••••
After several emails and phone calls I finally got a response from management. The tires had a 45 day satisfaction guarantee and I was able to return the original set and have a different brand installed. I changed my rating from 1 to 3 stars because they finally did something to address the issues I was experiencing.

The tire center at this location is nothing short of a joke. Shop is way understaffed and under tooled- they couldn't properly air up my tires after installation. Now I am having issue with tire balance and vibration. I have left several voice mails in an attempt to contact someone which remain unanswered. I cannot endorse using this location for any of your tire needs. (Ithaca, NY)

reviews.author: Buff Orpington
reviews.text: BJs just isn’t a deal anymore.  A few years back, buying bulk often meant lower price overall.  I’ve done the math - for most items, BJs just doesn’t offer discounts vs Aldi and Walmart.  And even if there is a slight discount for some items, you end up spending money on produce or meats that go bad wayyy before the expiration or sell-by date.  Meat section has especially gone downhill, I opened a corned beef roast a week before the sell-by date and it was rancid, not the first time either.  Staff and service in this location had always been good. But if you’re looking to actually save money, BJs just doesn’t serve this function anymore

reviews.author: Jeremy Faulk
reviews.text: Competent caregivers within the context of rural, university-based offerings. There are limitations to their offerings (ex., hours of availability, some prescriptions, doctors [it’s mostly nurse practitioners]) when compared to other, off campus options. The triage nurses are sometimes unfriendly, but usually helpful regardless. I’ve had amazing experiences with mental healthcare and primary care folks at Cornell Health. I choose to contextualize their offerings as good for being rural and at a convenient location. Been going there for 5 years for everything except for dental and eyecare.

reviews.author: Brad Brennan
reviews.text: Went into my appt and found out their software issues didn't have me on the schedule. They said I could see the doctor really fast and they wouldn't charge me since it wouldn't be a full visit and it was their mistake.
