I was just doing the stupid "establish care visit" that is required. Both doctor and front office confirmed I wouldn't be charged. My Bill? $450

reviews.author: rexkins
reviews.text: Don't accept most major insurance companies. Hit with large surprise bill.

reviews.author: Crystal Weiner
reviews.text:
My husband is posting this:
We drove up to drive thru @ 645 pm Sunday night 3/1/26. There was one car at pickup, one car ordering and us. No one was inside. The car in front of us left after waiting 6 minutes to order. We pulled up, waited another minute and a half then decided to back up and go inside to order. After entering and waiting at the register another minute and a half decided to enter our own order at the kiosk which took another couple minutes. While doing that someone came in after us and was waited on. I asked staff what was going on. They said they were busy. I was tired of waiting and went outside while my wife stayed to get our food. I noticed drive thru was backing up but starting to finally move. Waiting 10 minutes outside, I went back in because another customer was not happy either having to wait 12 minutes for one sandwich. We finally got our food after a half hour. Management was decent explaining they were busy and had grub hub and door dash orders. All fast food restaurants need to prioritize customers who come in (take your order within 1 minute - the customer should not feel like they are imposing or bothering you) and at most it should take 10 minutes to order and get your food especially if it is not busy at the time the customer arrives on drive thru or inside! Corporate needs to change the way they prioritize customers and run the business.

reviews.author: Nicole Gabriel
reviews.text: Typical Wendy's chain/ fast food chain food. Was around 4:40 pm when we went. Restaurant appeared clean. Ordered food on kiosk and paid. Food was out promptly. Everything appeared and tasted hot and fresh. Ample parking in parking lot.

reviews.author: Mathew Mcintosh
reviews.text:
I stop here for lunch, and this location regularly takes up way too much of my break. I only get an hour, and more often than not, a Wendy’s run eats up a big chunk of it.

Today I paid almost $10 for a “large” chili and a drink. For clarity, the large chili cup is about 3¾ inches tall. For that price, it’s essentially a small chili and a small drink, just not priced like one.

I asked for less ice, and the cup was still filled completely with ice. The chili came with two small packs of crackers, which doesn’t exactly help justify the cost.

There was zero communication at the window, not a hello, not a thank you. My card declined once, worked the second time, and there was no apology or explanation, just attitude.

Slow service, overpriced portions, ignored requests, and poor customer service. Not worth the money and definitely not worth stopping here if you’re on a lunch break.

reviews.author: Jeanine Reese
reviews.text:
I stopped here because the Chicken Cordon Bleu I had at another location was so good that I couldn't resist getting another. The one I had here was so-so, but overall pretty good.

Shout out to the new guy who served us on his first day today - you're doing good buddy!

reviews.author: Matt K.
reviews.text: Ordered Online 4/21/25 @ Ithaca NY Elmira Road location.  Upon arrival the chicken sandwich was in the bag waiting.  After trying to get an employee’s attention the shift manager came to the counter.  However it was not to help me.  The manager ignored me and yelled to a worker who was off the clock “ …. I know your off the clock, but could you change the menu for me”.  She then started to walk away.  I asked openly as she was leaving “I ordered a chicken sandwich and fries can someone please help me?”  A employee grabbed a bag off the counter and took it over to put what was suppose to be a large curly fry in the bag next to the fryer.  The employee accidentally dropped the receipt when the manager asked to see the online order.  The manager then bent over and grabbed the receipt off the dirty floor.  Looked at the receipt, I’m not sure why.  Perhaps to see if I was stealing?  Either way this manage then placed the receipt i side my bag with the food.  I began to ask why she would put anything that fell on the floor into a bag with fresh food.  She seemed to ignore me and go about her business.  So I then told her it was nasty that she would put anything in the bag which was on the floor and added that it was illegal to ask an employee who was off the clock to work in any capacity.  She finally acknowledged me as I was leaving saying “YOUR NOT MY BOSS.  YOU CANT TELL ME WHAT TO DO.  HAVE A NICE DAY”.  Once outside I immediately called Arby’s corporate and reported this violation.   After completing my report I went home and tried to eat my food.  It was completely cold.  It was also completely horrible.  The bacon was burned and so was the top of the bun.  Pictures speak louder than words so here you go.  I usual enjoy the food from Arby’s.  Now I’m very concerned of health standards after seeing this happen right in front of me.

reviews.author: Diane Scofield
reviews.text: not happy, when you order one item and get another. didnt order Beef and cheddar or curly fries but that's what I got. just wish theyd get it right. my older was a classic and krinkle fries, never told the amount and no sauce. just hoping they get it right next time

reviews.author: Nunu
reviews.text: Their ice cream is delicious and they offer some unique flavors. They have soft serve and hard ice cream as well. Staff is friendly. There’s a small parking area in the front. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Ryan Smola
reviews.text:
Great selection and friendly service.
Had the hard serve Peanut butter, cookie dough, and caramels ice cream.
A unique flavor I have never seen before.

reviews.author: Daphne Vaughan
reviews.text: Great little place! Super fresh and delicious ice cream! Had a soft vanilla cone with sprinkles.  Classic! My son's had waffle cones, one with soft vanilla and black raspberry, the other with mint ting a ling. All were great! Great service and tables to sit and enjoy on a nice sunny day!

reviews.author: Bald-kugo
reviews.text: Amazing service, great food, Wonderful vibes! Definitely would come back! We ordered the 3 for me, the triple dipper, and the Alex Santa Fe which were all super cheap in comparison to what you were actually getting. The 3 for me came with a choice of soup, chips or salad for the first part. We chose the chips and they were so big! The salsa was a little watery, but  very good. The 3 for me also came with drink, and a whole meal from 10.99 to 16.99. You really get a bang for your buck at chili's!! The pink lemonade wasn't the best, but it was still very good and we were even given a refil! I thought it was amazing that you could get refills on all sodas, and that really goes to show how great the deals are here.  I got a cup of hot water for free, since I brought my own coffee in my bag, and they were even nice enough to bring me some sugar! Everyone here was so nice, coming to check on us from time to time and making sure we were having fun. The cheese pull on the mozzarella sticks so was great, and not only was it amazingly seasoned but so were the fries. The molten lava cake was soo good as well! The ice cream paired so great with the softness of the cake, it was like a reward for my taste buds. The interior was nice and chill, the lighting was so inviting and the presentation  of both the food and the tables was amazing. Definitely would come back!!

reviews.author: Vigorous
reviews.text: My partner and I frequently visit the Ithaca Chili’s. We visit just about once a week as the food is very consistent, service is great, and it’s a great option when we’re feeling hungry. Anyways, today we visited and had Anita as our server. She was not only one of the most personable servers we’ve ever had, but she was extremely attentive and helpful. Anita made our night great and just to top it off, the food was an easy 11/10. On our next visit we will definitely be looking forward to hopefully having her again!!

reviews.author: Dean O
reviews.text: Drove a 30 min ride to eat here... One side of the restaurant was very loud. I had to ask to not be by a speaker or the TVs as I wear hearing aids and like to conversate with the family. The accommodated this without issues. The waiter was on point and friendly. The food came out hot and flavorful. We all left so full and satisfied.

reviews.author: Aaron Schantz
reviews.text: This place has a great menu and accommodates vegetarian and gluten free customers.  We had a large party of 12 and everyone was more than satisfied.  We had margaritas, apps, entrees and dessert.  My son had the chocolate cake and says it was awesome.  My niece, Rubyz,,  took the pics for this review.  I highly reccomend if you are in the mood for good food and a light hearted atmosphere.

reviews.author: Martin Feehan
reviews.text: Good selection of healthy food and indulgences.  Best for a casual night out.  Unfortunately, highly inconsistent. Sometimes it's great. I have also had my worse restaurant experience every there. 2 hrs waiting for food. Bugs on vegetables. Baconless bacon bloody Mary.  A raw burger.  I have been a regular be for years but the last couple visits have been so horrendous, I can't imagine going back.  They need to turn this around, because the concept is great.

reviews.author: Abby Davis
reviews.text: the environment is pleasant and comfortable. the food was great. I had the carnitas tacos and I LOVED THEM. it was the exact amount of food I wanted, but I think most people will need to get something else as well as the tacos since you only get two and they aren't huge. the service was attentive, and helpful! I told them when I came in that I only had twenty minutes to eat and they got me my food and still ensured I had a great experience! so happy.

reviews.author: 1123JGilbert
reviews.text: Recently remodeled to a "no cashier" layout.  Of course you can just ring the bell for someone to take your order if you wish.  Service is a little on the slow side, but not unacceptable. The food taste like burger king.  Overall atmosphere gives the impression of a generic waiting room, as most "modern" remodels of any business.

reviews.author: Mahir Hakic
reviews.text: I’ve been to this Burger King twice recently, and both times multiple items were missing from my order. On top of that, the wait time for food was extremely long. What made it more frustrating was seeing about four people standing in the back instead of working. If everyone had been helping, it would have been much quicker. Very disappointing experience overall. I like the remodel but they need to remodel the employees

reviews.author: Chris C.
reviews.text: Took them 5 minutes to give me 3 “shakes” with a full crew and no line, or other customers. $12 for 3 undrinkable shakes at that. Should be paid less than minimum wage for that bare minimum work ethic and service. So thick they didn’t even bother to give us straws. Pathetic at best.

reviews.author: John Cisne
reviews.text: Definitely five stars.  I’ve been Dr. Patrick’s patient for decades.

reviews.author: Nick Huber
reviews.text: We have financed several self storage projects with Jason Moore in the commercial banking department. It has been an amazing experience! They know the industry well and Jason is very professional. Quick responses, excellent communication and overall just great service. They close loans on scheduled timelines and you always know what to expect. I highly recommend them for commercial lending!

reviews.author: Tyr Wiesner-Hanks
reviews.text: I had a pretty good experience here. Went to open an account, and the person I talked to was efficient and polite. Had an issue enrolling in digital banking because I was in the system already (had an account with Tompkins years ago), called the main help desk, and immediately got transferred to someone who could fix it. Overall pretty good.

reviews.author: Kitty Hall-Thurnheer
reviews.text: Absolutely WORST bank ever. They NEVER answer the phone. You WILL always wait. Ask for information-- they ask security questions "Which branch did you open your account at?" 45 years ago? I have no idea! "Oh, then we can't give you the info you need." I can't say enough bad about this bank! Only have my mortgage left there. Absolute displeasure every single time I have to contact them!!!!!!!!!! All other accounts moved to Elmira Savings Bank--great customer service, always answer phone, know customers by name, etc. etc. etc.

reviews.author: Emily Walker
reviews.text: This has been my bank for the last 13 years! They have always greeted me by name and have always bent over backwards to help me with whatever I need!   I have use them for personal checking and savings accounts, home equity loans,  Girl Scout troop accounts and I love their online banking options as well!   There is always someone there with a smiling face!

reviews.author: David Skrypnyk
reviews.text:
Useless personal. I asked twice to close my bank account they told me that it is done. But it is not. So i got charge for their terrible service. Ridiculous.
If you have so much time and no stress in you life you can use this bank they provide of it.

reviews.author: Tessa Hopt
reviews.text: The absolute worst bank I have ever had. Bank will not allow you to deposit or withdraw money inside, all transactions must be done through the drive through ATM. The bank, as a whole, charges you for everything and has exceptionally poor customer service. Pick a different bank, or better yet, a credit union.

reviews.author: Andrew Antony
reviews.text: This practice is professional, kind, and gentle in the most sincere way. Every time I go it feels like a spa treatment for my mouth. Friendly staff and prompt service highlight their ability to provide quality care to patients. My dental cleaning was so relaxing that my garmin watch recorded the activity as a nap (no, I am not kidding). Kudos to the team for their outstanding service and considerate dispositions!

reviews.author: Jenna Lamb
reviews.text: Dr. Manunts and the whole staff were amazing. Everyone was friendly, caring, attentive, patient, and open. Dr. Manunts thoroughly explained things, showed me and talked through my x-rays, answered all my questions, and gave me advice on how to care for my teeth better. It was a wonderful experience. I’m happy to find a great dentist in the area that really cares.

reviews.author: Matt Ruland
reviews.text: Northeast Family Dental is truly exceptional! Dr. Manunts and her staff provide top-notch care with a personal touch. The dedication to patient comfort and comprehensive dental expertise is evident. Special shoutout to the world's BEST hygienist – their skill and attention to detail make every visit a positive experience. Highly recommend this dental practice for outstanding care!

reviews.author: Robyn Forkey
reviews.text: Prescriptions never ready on time. They accidently filled a prescription of mine 2x in 24 hrs and handed it to my boyfriend who had no clue they had made a mistake and wasn't even leaving with the correct meds. I never got an apology and was without my daily nerve pain medicine I've been on for years for almost a week because of their mistake. Pharmacist thinks he needs to police your medicine more than dispense medicine safely to customers. Despite all these problems I was still willing to be a customer until I called in for another medication refill and he asks about another medication and begins to scream at me when I suggest he should focus on the question at hand instead of attempting to police what medicine has been prescribed to me.. he told me I was not allowed to speak with him that way and hung up on me. I immediately had my entire family's prescriptions transferred and was able to talk 4 other families into changing pharmacies for their families safety as well. No one deserves the outrught disrespect and possible sickness or death due to their incompetent and unprofessional staff in the their 100% staff owned business. Shameless, and dangerous business that would only be able to operate in rural communities of upstate NY and VT bacuse they would be run out of business anywhere else

reviews.author: Eric Brodie
reviews.text: Great place! Conveniently located right next to the Shops at Ithaca mall. Plenty of parking. A clean, neat store. Friendly, kind employees and I found what I was looking for very well. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cecily Cox
reviews.text:
I’m new to the area and often visit drugstores, so I was hoping Kinney Drugs would become a regular stop. Unfortunately, after my experience yesterday, I won’t be returning.

The cashier, Melissa, made me feel extremely unwelcome. I was dressed in sweats and noticed right away she was giving me unfriendly looks. I greeted her with a “hi” and got no response, which I initially brushed off, thinking maybe she was just shy or having a bad day. But then I saw her being warm and cheerful to other customers.

Throughout my visit, she stared at me with a look that made me feel completely out of place. When I checked out and wished her a good day, she rolled her eyes and looked visibly annoyed. It was incredibly uncomfortable and disappointing.

Customer service like this shouldn't be tolerated. I’ll be taking my business to CVS or Walgreens instead.

reviews.author: Telephone
reviews.text:
I always have an excellent time shopping at Target in Ithaca! The store is clean, well-organized, and has a huge variety of products—whether I’m looking for home essentials, clothing, electronics, groceries, or even fun extras. You can find just about anything here, and it’s easy to navigate through the aisles.
The selection is always impressive, especially for everyday items. The grocery section has a good range of healthy food options, snacks, and pantry staples, and I appreciate how well-stocked the shelves are. It’s my go-to place for stocking up on household essentials and personal care items.
The staff at this Target are friendly and helpful. Whenever I’ve needed assistance, they’ve always been quick to point me in the right direction or offer advice. I also really appreciate the self-checkout lanes for a faster and more convenient experience when I’m in a rush.
I’m a big fan of Target’s clothing section as well. They have stylish, affordable options for both kids and adults, and I can usually find great deals on trendy items. Plus, their seasonal home decor is always on point—perfect for adding a little extra touch to your space.
Another perk is their order pickup and drive-up services. It’s incredibly convenient to be able to order online and pick it up in-store or have it brought directly to my car.
Overall, Target Ithaca is a great place to shop. It’s consistently reliable, the prices are competitive, and the customer service is always friendly. Highly recommend it for a quick errand or a full shopping trip!

reviews.author: James Vogel
reviews.text: Today I was helped by a store employee by the name of Ryan.  He tried to help me pick out a coffee maker.  He was very helpful and did it with a smile and some conversation. A few minutes later he was in the snack isle and I had yet another question on a hard to get item.  He checked his handheld and saw some were out back.  He went and got my items for me.  Ryan is a great asset to Target and I hope he is treated well.

reviews.author: J. Reviews
reviews.text: Nobody at the return counter, and nobody is coming over to help. Various employees have walked by me and saw me waiting, then looked away and pretended to not see me. They could at least call someone else to help… And then I asked a young man at checkout if he could find someone to help me. He said “uhh I don’t know who’s supposed to be there, ask the girl in the vest.” I walked over to her, and she told me to wait longer and continued what she was doing. It’s been a while now, and I’m really disappointed by the poor service. If it’s a staffing issue, then Target should have enough staff to help with customers!!

reviews.author: Sherry Chiu
reviews.text: My family of 5 stayed here for one night in 2022 summer, and it was one of the best experiences we have had. The staff was very welcoming. They offered BBQ party when we arrived and a great breakfast the next morning. Everything was beautifully decorated and arranged. I remember a staff member, Maurice, was friendly and helpful. I've always recommended this hotel whenever people ask about it.

reviews.author: MARCEL CARON
reviews.text:
I had a good experience with the staff here. From Michael, the face at the front desk, to the folks handling the evening snack/drinks, and breakfast in the morning. I arrived in the afternoon and was able to get into my room right away. The hotel is off the beaten path and not lots of loud traffic like many hotels. I went across the street for dinner at a local pizza place. The food was decent but nothing to write home about.

The rooms are older, and the shower was odd. Seemed like it took a few minutes for the hot water to come through. The room had the basics. I'm not a big breakfast eater, but I did have a bagel and some oatmeal. Simple. Met some nice people also in travel mode. I wish the folks here all the best. Like I said, Michael was good to speak to.

reviews.author: Dr S
reviews.text: As a long standing hilton hotels rewards member this location is extremely clean and well managed. We were pleasantly surprised on the cleanliness and quality of the rooms. Our son attends cortland university and this will be my go to hotel in the future. Its a bit off the highways but well worth the extra time. The breakfast buffet was one of the best we have had and the employees were constantly cooking and restocking fresh foods. The pillows are probably the best we ever had in a hotel. King suite had a full mini kitchen with dishwasher and fully stocked with dishes, utensils, pots ,pans and brand new sponge with soap and dishwasher pods.If we stayed longer than 1 night we probably would have utilized.

reviews.author: Kara Mehnert
reviews.text: We stayed here for our wedding weekend, and it was absolutely perfect! The staff went above and beyond to make everything feel so special and personal. They were incredibly accommodating and made us and our guests feel right at home. The Inn was beautiful, the service was top-notch, and the entire weekend felt magical thanks to their hospitality. Highly recommend for any special occasion or getaway!

reviews.author: Teri-Ann Carryl
reviews.text: Such a beautiful inn, we loved our stay! Took a cozy winter vacation upstate from the city and loved everything about the inn. Immediately upon arrival we made hot chocolate for ourselves and had some of the yummy treats available in the dining room. It's so conveniently located too, we walked over to see the nearby gorge before coming back for breakfast. And breakfast was warm, filling, and a delightful way to start our day. We even bought a mug to take home with us to remember our time here. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Ken Yan
reviews.text: My husband and I recently stayed at the inn for 2 nights and had a great experience. It was conveniently located between the town and the gorge, the breakfast and desserts were really good, the room was perfect, and the self check in and out was easy and hassle free. We would love to go back again.

reviews.author: Shruti Sinha
reviews.text:
Not a popular state parks so we came here with less expectations and were pleasantly surprised with the beautiful hikes. Gorge trail was pretty flat hike. Lots of waterfalls to see till the 115 ft Lucifer falls.
We saw folks taking the rim trail too to view the Lucifer falls from the viewing deck.
Trail to the swimming hole Enfield Glen falls has a pretty flat trail. Not very crowded too. But swimming was closed when we reached at 4 pm.
Folks can take the trail from the lower to the upper entrance but we drove as they have parking lots in both places.

reviews.author: Greg Mazzeo
reviews.text: Well worth the hike to see the upper falls! Take the gorge trail to see the best view of the upper falls. It is a nice hike with lots of stairs, tree roots and rocks. There are about 100 steps when you get Close to the point with the best views... But worth the hike!

reviews.author: Mostly Insane
reviews.text: We went here on a weekday. Pretty quite and less crowded on a weekday. The Gorge trail was little treacherous but it was worth it. A great view of the waterfalls. Make sure you do this hike on a pleasant weather. Sunny day might kill you

reviews.author: Joanne Leary
reviews.text: Bell's in Varna gave us great service the other day when we had a flat tire. They got the tires we needed same day, replaced the flat, and made sure nothing else on the car had been damaged. The woman at the desk (Bridget?) could not have been nicer or more helpful.

reviews.author: Brian Harrington
reviews.text: Have gone here a couple of times for inspections and once for a repair to a Honda Pilot. Good service at fair price. Bridget, the customer service rep is always very helpful and polite.

reviews.author: Adrienne Masler
reviews.text:
I've brought cars to Bell's for 10 years and have consistently gotten good or excellent service. They're honest, respectful, and not pushy. They make solid recommendations for services they don't provide. And they'll go the extra mile.

Some of the highlights of 10 years:

This summer, I called at 8am Monday to ask if they could get me a new tire since I got a flat over the weekend. They had me in at noon even though they were extra busy. I bought my tires through them just a couple months before, and the local supplier they work with replaced the tire at no charge.

A few years ago, an employee accidentally scraped the paint on one of my doors. They told me immediately and paid to have the door replaced.

They take time to explain things and answer questions. As a woman who knows very little about cars, I have always felt respected and that they treat me fairly. I've never once felt like they were trying to take advantage of my ignorance. They readily make suggestions for second opinions if I ask, and are just as accepting if I want to ask a friend for their advice before committing to expensive work.

If I ever move, I would dread finding a new mechanic. Bell's would be a tough act to follow.

reviews.author: Herm
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience at this office.

It started with a rude interaction over the phone while making my appointment, and I was not informed that my pupils would need to be dilated. After driving myself there, I felt very uncomfortable driving home afterward but had no other choice. I believe patients should be informed in advance so they can make other travel arrangements.

When I arrived, the front desk staff and nurse were pleasant, but the doctor’s care was unacceptable. I came in for a stye that had developed into a chalazion. Instead of discussing proper treatment options, the doctor forcefully squeezed and pushed on my eyelid with her fingers and a Q-tip in an attempt to “pop or drain” it. From everything I’ve read and been told, this is not an appropriate or safe method, as it can cause further irritation or spread infection. I had already completed a 10-day course of antibiotics, yet she tried to prescribe another. I declined the antibiotics and asked why I would need another course and she didn’t really have a good reason for it.

My eyelid, which was not painful before the appointment, became sore and inflamed afterward due to the rough handling. It’s still sore now hours later. I left feeling worse than when I came in and very concerned about the standard of care here.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.text: Really poor experience.  Always decent until a recent sale to Cayuga Med.  Most recent experience had me waiting 45 minutes past my appointment time before even being called back.  Got to the room and they informed me that they scheduled me for the wrong appointment so I waited all that time for nothing.  Definitely not going back here again.

reviews.author: Maria Devan
reviews.text:
I have had cataracts for years and was too afraid to have them removed until I could no longer see out of one eye. I had Dr. Zablocki for surgery today on the first eye and I feel silly for how scared I was. The procedure was painless.  Thestaff at surgicare was great. Arleo's office is big but very efficient and made everything very easy. Thanks for making that so easy.

I just had the second eye done and I  can say the same great things about Dr. Zablocki and surgicare.

reviews.author: Shannan Hannula
reviews.text: Although we love the Port Watson Street branch in Cortland, since the change from CFCU to Beginnings we have had trouble with recurring payments. Our vehicle loans were corrected after one month of issues, but our credit card is now only serviced by the Ithaca branch and has been a continuing issue for 7 months. Although we turned off the Autopay when we paid off the balance in May, Beginnings has continued to take out an autopayment each month. Because we had a negative balance (credit) we used the card, charged more than the credit, paid the difference so back to zero balance, but they took out an autopayment anyway. Despite being told "it definitely won't happen again" for the first two months, their reply changed to "it's your other bank's fault" for a couple months, and recently to "I see the problem but can't fix it so I need to talk to my supervisor and call you back." No callback received and money was taken out of our checking account again despite $0 being due this month.

reviews.author: Yulduz Vahobova
reviews.text: I was in a hurry during my visit, and unfortunately my experience at the bank was disappointing. The associate repeatedly interrupted our transaction to chat with a friend, even when she needed to recount the money. This made the process take much longer than necessary. I also noticed her manager gave her a subtle reminder to focus, but she continued the conversation instead of prioritizing her responsibility. As a customer, I felt my time and needs were not respected, and I hope this issue can be addressed so others don’t experience the same.

reviews.author: Stacy Wilder
reviews.text: This is a review of the entire Beginnings system.  They have started closing the branches on Saturdays leading up to a Monday federal holiday, in addition to the federal holiday. That is an unacceptable level of customer service.

reviews.author: M
reviews.text: Our stay at the Grayhaven was really wonderful.   The room was tasteful and beautifully decorated with period furniture.  It was also very clean and bed was super comfortable.  The staff was very helpful and kind.   Coffee and simple breakfast options were delicious.  Location is great too.  We would love to return.

reviews.author: Ashley Webb
reviews.text:
Husband, dog and I really enjoyed our stay at Greyhaven. They had all the things my pup needed in the room ready for him and having a fenced dog run was much nicer than walking him in the limited grass of a hotel parking lot like usual. Mid century modern furniture and giant window with birds constantly at the feeder made it super cozy. Location is excellent.

10/10 would recommend for anyone traveling with their pup.

reviews.author: Judy Turner
reviews.text:
We were blown away by this charming “motel”!  It’s so much more than a motel and we’d rather stay here than some of those other fancy hotels!! The staff were very welcoming and helpful, and the setting is picturesque with beautiful flower gardens, and outdoor patio overlooking a stream and woodland area in the back. Walking into our room, we were pleasantly surprised to see a doggy water bowl and cookie for our dog as well as his own towel!  They thought of everything - even an extra sheet (with DOG written on it) to put on bed as a cover. The other “special” treats which were provided were all the makings for s’mores and fire starters to use in the fire pits on the grounds!  I mean, WOW!!
The room was super clean, the bed was comfortable and outside our picture windows were bird feeders!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will definitely be back!  Hope to see the proposed art gallery next time!

reviews.author: Christopher Dunn
reviews.text: These guys, Steve and Bill, are amazing.  I have brought them a number of pieces of high-end audio gear for repair and service.  They are knowledgeable, careful, respectful, and caring.  They know their stuff and do not over charge.  I trust them completely with my gear and would unconditionally recommend them.

reviews.author: Josh Eckenrode
reviews.text: This place is like heaven if you love audio and video gear.  Always super helpful and knowledgable!  Their used gear selection is awesome, you can find anything from a $50 used CD player to a $1000 amplifier.  The new gear selection is fantastic too, they have pieces for the average listener and the seasoned audiophile alike.  I have purchased almost all of my gear from them and will continue to do so. Thanks Stellar!!!!

reviews.author: Dan DeCamello
reviews.text: Went to Stellar with a home theater system that I thought was having some problems and he went through everything with me and explained how to make it work properly. Not only did he not charge me anything (OHM and some other places wanted 30-50 just to look at it) but when I asked to pay him something he refused! Really great guy and cool store.

reviews.author: Nick Thijssen
reviews.text:
What a nice place.

Good location, easy parking and very friendly service. Business is run with passion. I as a dutchie definitely recommend visiting here.

reviews.author: R Fewox
reviews.text: Very clean and inviting atmosphere with very nice and knowledgeable staff. Great selection and quality beyond expectations. Well laid out dispensary with many different mediums to choose from. Would definitely recommend to anyone to check out.

reviews.author: Hal Rosensteel
reviews.text: Beautiful place! The staff were very friendly.

reviews.author: caleb simwale
reviews.text: His food co-op store is the best for business and personal produce resource management. Totally great for picking up last-minute mushrooms that we need for for our business whether it be picking up Satake or possibly picking up other mushrooms is a great opportunity for them as a business and us as a business to potentially collaborate when it comes to mushroom sales and mushroom produce so in general, this place is top-notch, especially for our company and it’s purposes Would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a quick nice and easy to get around shop for all your essentials Staff are great and I’ve had good time here over the past few Weeks definitely recommend five out of five if there was a possibility for more stars I would

reviews.author: Turtle
reviews.text:
Other than the parking lot, we had a great visit from Rochester.

This is a very clean, well organized store with a bunch of lunch options.

We will definitely be back to try more things!

reviews.author: peedublyou
reviews.text:
There are a lot of grocery choices in Ithaca, but this place has some real advantages. I like the value of the bulk selections, especially granola, spices and eggs. The produce is beautiful. The specials bring organic items to prices comparable to non-organic. Plus, the people are friendly and helpful. I don't feel tired after shopping here.
Update: I shopped here two times more and found more features to appreciate. They have a coffee bar and a food bar, as well as indoor seating with tables. We enjoyed both hot and cold lunches of fresh, healthy dishes, which is hard to get travelling. I also got a pre-packaged salad for our flight out, and it was very tasty and filling.

reviews.author: Aaron E.J O'brien
reviews.text: This is the best Thai food I’ve ever had. The food is absolutely delicious, and the interior is spacious, clean, and quiet. The staff are kind, and the overall environment is welcoming. I highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Mostly Insane
reviews.text: We went here for the dinner and got the green and red Thai curry with shrimp and chicken meat. The curries were cooked very well and the meat was tender. Highly recommend if you are a big fan of the Thai cuisines.

reviews.author: Kurt Weber
reviews.text: We do like this place, but in the last, they seemed understaffed. Last night, they had additional help and things went smoothly. Small dining room, but excellent food. I recomend you call for a reservation. BYOB allowed.

reviews.author: alex howser
reviews.text: Worked with Ben there on buying a vehicle with the wife he was great was not pushy worked with me even on his day about about crunching numbers. Ben definitely went above and beyond to make the sale even gave us chevy hats I cant say ive ever got anything from a sales man other then the car note. And after going back and forth about numbers I accidentally made him chase me down for the keys to the car we traded in. Ill deal with Ben again might even looking look into a gmc 3/4 here in a couple years. Thank you for the new ride

reviews.author: Andy Dennison
reviews.text: We were met at the door by katie, very rude questioned us on why we're there like we were intruding. We had talked to someone via text message the night before about a vehicle we wanted to look and set up an appointment to look at the vehicle the next morning. When we arrived no one knew who we talked to or where the vehicle was. After waiting for about 20 minutes we were told the vehicle had been sent to the auction. Drove an hour to get there just to find out it wasn't there after we made the appointment less than 24 hours before. Will not be going back again and won't be recommending anyone to go there as well.

reviews.author: Chelsea Ryan
reviews.text:
I like my car.
Katie at Chevy was very pushy and over confident. She answered questions quickly but incorrectly and then had to correct herself. She was rude to the other Maguire staff in front of us. She told me, "I want to sell a car today" and hurried through the process. I have now made 3 separate trips back to the dealership to complete tasks she forgot. I was not offered all the Chevy discounts that I could have had. She did not have any knowledge of them and pushed the problem to others.
Maguire is local and convenient, but I would recommend family and friends not buy a car with Katie.

reviews.author: Brian Cook
reviews.text: I went in to get a wrap at the Ithaca Byrne Dairy. I stood at the counter as the person behind the counter continued to do varous tasks. After ten minutes of being ignored, i went to the other counter and asked to speak to the manager. It turns out the person ignoring me was the manager. I proceeded to tell her that the customer should take priority over stocking the areas behind the counter, and when a customer is waiting they should stop what they are doing, help the customer and then return to stocking after. She had no responce, so i left.

reviews.author: Melissa Hawley
reviews.text: John who works at this location keeps starting stuff me my man and our friends wasn't doing anything he tried to start a fight with my friend for no reason and threatened my female friend who is pregnant several times. We are getting tired of this childish stuff it happened on 2/16/2026 around 10:26pm. I heard that he started things with other customers. He is a loose cannon and dangerous.

reviews.author: Kurt Becker
reviews.text: This place is amazing, super friendly and the sandwiches are insanely good. It’s so nice to find a place where people care about what they do. I wasn’t expecting this level of service - much appreciated.

reviews.author: Tucker Rossi
reviews.text:
Rarely leave reviews of anything but I would feel guilty if I didn’t document my experience with Monroe in Ithaca. I can only speak to my situation but from the general feeling of how this went down I imagine it is not limited to a single occurrence.

I made an online appointment for 11pm to swap my existing summer tires for snow tires that I already owned. This swap was on a brand new vehicle with

reviews.author: Elle Tinnirella
reviews.text: Monroe was overall amazing. They got us in for an appointment quickly, were fair and upfront with their pricing, and completed everything way earlier than we anticipated (a rarity!). I will definitely be visiting them again. Minus one star because when we did pick the car up it smelled very strongly of cigarette smoke, and it took a whole day for the smell to subside. Other than that, super happy with the quality, service, and prices.

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.text: My experience With Monroe was varied. I was very happy with the service that was provided in store. I was very happy with the staff in the store. I was thoroughly frustrated with the customer support that I received from the call center. I was about to cancel my appointment and not even use Monroe due to my frustrations with the call center. I am glad that I did keep my appointment. In the future, I will definitely go there in person or make sure I speak with someone at the location, not through the call center.

reviews.author: Dara Riegel
reviews.text: We have been going to the Midas in Ithaca for about 5 years now and consistently have a positive experience. They are transparent about what needs to be fixed immediately and what can safely wait a bit. They have gone out of their way to get us in and out quickly, even when low staffed. Today, they took amazing care of both of our cars and figured out a way to fix mine in a budget-friendly way three days before Christmas. The very experienced mechanics made sure the fix was high quality while still being mindful of cost. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Sandifer
reviews.text:
I had been taking my car to this Midas location every six months like clockwork. On the most recent visit they overlooked the fact that it had an expired inspection sticker, leading me to get a ticket.

I’d like to stress, this is not the reason for my one star review. Mistakes happen. Lord knows I’ve screwed plenty of stuff up over the years as a small business owner myself. I’d never leave a bad review for a mistake that got fixed—I’m more likely to e-mail management and praise whatever employee took care of me when that happens. No, the reason I’m leaving a one star review and taking my business elsewhere is what happened when I called to ask how this had happened.

My intentions in calling were modest. I mostly wanted an apology and maybe a small credit towards my next service—not even the cost of the ticket, just something. Instead I was told by whoever answered the phone that they simply did not look at inspection stickers when working on cars, and that this was entirely my fault for not specifically asking for an inspection when I brought it in. (Despite the fact that, when I bring it in, I always expressly ask them to look and see if there’s anything else it needs) They then hung up on me.

This is simply an unacceptable way to treat a customer, both in its active refusal to provide good service by glancing at an inspection sticker and saying “hey, do you want us to perform this inspection that’s due” and by, I repeat, hanging up on me. I cannot imagine any circumstance going forward where I would ever pick Midas over its many competitors in town, and I would strongly encourage anyone reading this review to take your business to someone who actually cares about their customers.

reviews.author: David Hajjar
reviews.text: Recently had a good visit at Midas for an oil change and heat vent check. The free inspection found a dirty cabin air filter that needed to be changed. Also, the technicians gave me a 'heads up'  about a future control arm job; as they observed signs of wear in that area. Price was right, as I received discounts for various things involved in the job; for example cabin filter was $19.99 with free install. Finally, front desk staff was attentive to customers and managed communications well via text and in person.

reviews.author: Ian A
reviews.text: Great place to stop for a quick trip to Ithaca. Good rates during off peak weekends with one night being

reviews.author: Kellen Calale
reviews.text: I stay here often whenever there’s anything going on in Ithaca, and this weekend we stayed for the Deck the Halls wine tasting event. This Marriott always goes above and beyond for its guests. From the moment we checked in, Tinsha and Shanel were incredibly warm, personable, and truly delivered that exceptional Marriott experience. Stephen during the day is phenomenal, always making eye contact, greeting everyone with a smile, and genuinely making sure every guest feels welcome and comfortable. The entire team consistently reflects what hospitality should be, and they are absolutely the reason we keep coming back to Marriott properties. Truly, a Marriott experience   Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Cat Cat
reviews.text: I usually stay here when visiting . The front desk seems confused maybe because they have a big turnover never see the same people. Rooms are clean and tidy. Breakfast is simple but good to grab something light. It's in a very good location too.

reviews.author: Ivy Stevens-Gupta
reviews.text: I had my first hydrafacial treatment yesterday with Crystal. She is a total sweetheart and my skin looks amazing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Hannah McUmber
reviews.text:
I don’t ever leave reviews but this is one I just have to!!
All I can say is WOW! This was the best salon experience I’ve ever had. I felt so comfortable and welcomed. She did not make me feel bad for my lack of hair care or inexperience. She gave me so much helpful advice to benefit only me. she wasn’t just there for a paycheck. I had an absolutely amazing time and experience and can’t wait to come back. Thank you so much for everything!! My extensions are PERFECT.

reviews.author: Melanie Cole
reviews.text: I booked an appointment online and received a confirmation text message. My appointment was on time, and lasted as scheduled, with both a customer before and after me. Crystal is professional and I left with a new haircut, of which I only provided a "vision" - that she was able to bring to fruition. Highly recommend! Note: cash discount over credit card.

reviews.author: kay LA
reviews.text: I’ve been to many Salvation Army’s around the state & this by far one of my favorites! It’s huge and the prices are better than some of the other stores.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text:
The hours of operation  at the time of this writing are : 9AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Saturday! But and a big but.... If you're looking to make a donation, and you have a car load of stuff,  and you drive to the back of the building.... you have to make their drop off window of between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. Mon through Saturday.

Not very convenient for a professional working 9 to 5 in my opinion!Their donation hours are not the same as their store hours! If you  don't make that window, you will be taking that car load of donations right back home with you !

And if the thought crosses your mind to just leave the donation just outside the locked door, for them to pick up in the morning......that is considered dumping and you may be prosecuted! You are risking that your donation may be stolen any way over night as well.

What ever happened to those large red over flowing donation bins you would see in different parking lots?

reviews.author: Greg Wheeler
reviews.text:
This picture is how ridiculous they are there and when I said something the associate actually raised her voice the Ithaca NY Salvation Army has become an absolute joke of a place!
Do your research before buying anything and don’t bother asking for help the associates won’t give you the time of the day or are extremely rude when answering.

reviews.author: John O'Reilly
reviews.text:
Guy told me it would be a week. Came back two weeks later, he hadn't touched my bag...

Came back later that day as instructed, and found he'd done the work of a beginner rushing through his job. This was my grandfathers bag and I thought he'd do a decent job. Instead he hacked it open, stitched it up with twine, and charged men $80 for the pleasure.

The price wouldn't bother me if he'd done a good job. Instead he did poor work, and he did it late. 1/5, to say the least.

reviews.author: RedRyderHD
reviews.text: I love this place! The owner is extremely knowledgeable and wonderful to work with! I needed a quick leather job done and he did it while I stood there. He is very experienced across the range of leather work and is very, very helpful! I would highly recommend his shop to anyone in need of any leather work!! I definitely will be returning to have him dye a set of boots for me

reviews.author: David Syracuse
reviews.text: The owner is incredibly knowledgeable and helpful.  He was able to repair the zipper and snap on a set of leather motorcycle gear quickly and professionally.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hesat 2030
reviews.text:
I've been seeing Zach Miller for years for massage therapy, and he has consistently helped me manage chronic hip and shoulder issues that stem from years of computer work and the physical demands of childbirth. His deep understanding of the body and intuitive approach always left me feeling better, more mobile, and more at ease.

Recently, I tried his new offering—Neural Reset Therapy (NRT)—and I have to say: this works. It’s different from traditional massage. Using light stretching, targeted pressure, and muscle manipulation, Zach helps the body essentially "reset" tense muscles. It’s surprisingly gentle but incredibly effective.

After just one session, I felt a significant difference. My hip and shoulder tension—problems I’ve dealt with for years—eased up in a way that even deep tissue work hasn’t always accomplished. It’s like my body remembered how to move more freely.

Zach is truly a gifted therapist and always evolving in his practice. Neural Reset Therapy is a game changer, and I highly recommend giving it a try if you deal with chronic tension or pain.

reviews.author: Anita Resch
reviews.text:
The Deeply Devoted Massage studio is a truly relaxing and clean place. I am so happy I chose them. I have never had a massage before and I feel like I am in the best hands. Zack Miller is a conscientious massage therapist and an amazing person. Before I met him I never thought I would ever feel pain relief. I have stiff muscles in my neck and back. Zack uses the Trigger Point Release NeuroMuscular Technique on me and continuously communicates to monitor the passing of the pain during the massage. I am truly grateful to Zack for helping me.
I highly recommend him to anyone!

reviews.author: Stephanie JH Deppe
reviews.text: About a month and a half delayed, but my massage with Jacinta was one of the best I've had. The pressure was exactly right, and just one session was enough to relieve the headaches my neck and shoulders were causing. I will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Geoff Bradshaw
reviews.text:
This facility is absolutely disgusting.
These photos were taken at 8:00 PM, on a weeknight. The photos show that the restaurant was obviously not very busy. Though, it was apparently too busy to clean up a bit.

I didn't capture any photos of the kitchen area, but I'm sure that you can imagine... French fries all over the floor, and just a general disaster.

reviews.author: Marylen Chamorro
reviews.text: I first went to the drive thru the person on the head set was very rude. Then came inside to use the bathroom and it’s  super nasty in there. The lobby completely dirty. Couldn’t find a seat that wasn’t dirty. Over all bad experience

reviews.author: Riris Harningtyas
reviews.text:
Last night around 10 pm, I tried to pick up my mobile app order #1644 at this location. I ordered through the app and by the time I got there, I picked the "counter pick-up" option since the app allowed me, and I still saw someone sitting inside.
I tried to go inside to the pickup area, where the McDonalds app said to go, but all of the doors were locked. I tried every door but they're all locked.
I tried to get the attention of the employees working there. They all either ignored me or didn’t see me. Another customer was there too with the same problem.

We knocked on the door and employees approached (the one who we saw sitting inside was turn out an employee as well) but refused to open the doors for us despite the fact that we showed them that our orders were not drive-thru order but "PICK UP COUNTER" option and despite we're standing outside in 19-degree freezing cold.

The employees were giving us a signal "Wait" so we waited for around 15 minutes but they didn't give us clear direction on what to do, the other person there didn’t have a car, so there's no way to do the drive-through!

I showed them that I had paid the order through the app, and couldn't cancel it nor changed it to drive through option,
They then told me and the other customer to literally stand in the very long line with the cars in the freezing cold to wait for our orders (mind you, she didn't have a car). The drive-thru line was insanely very long so I left, but I saw the other customer waiting in the line because she was so hungry!

They also apparently blamed this on only having three people working there.

This was insane and dangerous to customers’ health and there’s no excuse for it. You need to refund me my order because at the end I didn't get my food and please stop this from happening again.
1. If you're short staffed, then make sure you update the app so customers can't choose the "pick up counter" option.
2. If you know the customers already paid and chose the "pick up counter", it literally took the staffs less than 5 mins to the door and gave our food.
3. Asking customers that already chose "pick-up counter" option to do a drive-through line when they are on foot and don't have cars is very dangerous.

I already file a complaint through the McDonald's app but they haven't contacted me.

reviews.author: Nick Schweitzer
reviews.text: Wow, this place actually is terrible. The employees seem to do a good job with the initial pressure spray, but the wash tunnel is horrible. Big areas of my car were totally missed, the soap wasn't rinsed off and left streaks everywhere, the vacuums had very little suction, and the compressed air didn't work at all. Resist the urge to come here no matter how convenient. It's not worth $5 not to mention the ridiculous prices they want (starting at $20).

reviews.author: Susan D
reviews.text:
Worst car wash ever! I've tolerated my car not getting clean here for years. Yesterday morning was the last straw. $20 for basic wash and my car is so dirty after wash. Young woman taking money refused to put my car through a second time. Pictures attached. She gave no real instructions on getting into track.
Said no manager or owner there.
Save your money and go somewhere else.  Would give this a negative 10 rating if possible.

reviews.author: Michael Piela
reviews.text: $20 for an undercarriage wash, the pictures directly after speak for themselves. The underside looks untouched and still caked in filth like it didn't even happen. Wrote to customer service and they blew me off twice. Wash your own car and don't waste your time and money.

reviews.author: Paul Martin
reviews.text: Excellent experience at this barber shop! She really took her time and it didn't feel rushed despite being busy!

reviews.author: Jason S
reviews.text: Jenn is so sweet and she did an amazing cut! Highly recommend this place as a college student in the area

reviews.author: Kevin Paxton
reviews.text: This is a real gem. It is a little barber shop with great potential. Jen is a fantastic barber  with an awesome memory. She always knows what I want and always delivers a great cut. If you need an outstanding haircut, take a few minutes and stop by. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: CHRISTIAN MAPHIS
reviews.text: I wanted to take a second to give credit where credit is due to the Ithaca New York Airgas location. I have done a lot of business with them over the last 2 years for various CO2 related items for Beer Brewing Etc. The competency and the customer service of employees has been less than stellar until recently. They are now extremely knowledgeable, passionate about making sure your purchases are correct and that you're taking care of in a speedy fashion. Obviously there are other options out there for CO2 and or Welding Supply but I'm glad I do business with them especially now. Keep up the great work and thank you for being a model of what customer service actually should be!

reviews.author: Nicholas Pettis
reviews.text: Great team! Can always trust Airgas in Ithaca to get me what I need. Love doing business with this place!

reviews.author: a bruce
reviews.text: Super friendly staff.  Good stock of TIG consumables.  Wooden handle SS brushes and welding gloves.  Great stock of cut off wheels and flapper grinding discs.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.text: cool spot for thrifting! they get a lot of stuff from ithaca reuse so it's cool to see what ends up on the shelves

reviews.author: Joan Lazar
reviews.text: The store is really quite wonderful, filled with items ranging from the 19th century to pretty much today. Staff was friendly, ample parking. Great selection of mid century, modern pieces, in excellent condition. As a reseller, though, I walked away, empty-handed, as everything is a little pricier than what I expect. I couldn’t find anything to add to my collection either but regardless, great spot. Took me about an hour to go through the whole store.

reviews.author: Leah
reviews.text: It was hard to leave this place, and I spent the next 24 hours trying to figure out how to get a truck so that I could buy more! Such a good selection of homegoods, clothing, furniture, and jewelry. And so much more. Prices were super fair and reasonable and the staff was friendly and very helpful. I will certainly be back!!

reviews.author: Danny Ruiz
reviews.text: This has to be the best mechanic shop I have ever had an interaction with. Super honest and super friendly and professional. I will be bringing my car here and only here moving forward.

reviews.author: Jenna BEar
reviews.text: I would leave negative 10 review if I could.  Louis tried to sell me a new serpentine belt when I just had it replaced & it looks brand new …. Thankful I went back to my original mechanic who said I just replaced this belt & showed me the new belt.   Don’t let them rip you off

reviews.author: Abdullah Abdulaziz
reviews.text: Took my Nissan in for a P0101 code. They checked everything thoroughly and were very honest told me everything looked good and didn’t try to upsell or charge me just for an inspection. Really appreciate the transparency. Definitely recommend Taber Street Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Shaun Peden
reviews.text:
The wife and I went here on a Friday night early (4pm) glad we had reservations because this place was hopping moments after we arrived. Incredibly attentive service from the moment we walked in.
As far as food goes.. wow. Clearly fresh and quality ingredients used with all of their dishes. My fish fry was easily one of the best I've had in years. Nicely battered, not too thick and great taste. Fries are hand cut which means they are already 100times better than most out there. Great corn bread to start as well. Can't say enough good things. This is a new place on our list.

reviews.author: Ava Metzger
reviews.text: The best food in Ithaca hands down (and the only good seafood). I’m from Alaska so my bar for fresh seafood is high and Maxie’s had some of the freshest oysters and fish I have ever had! Cooked to perfection and the ambiance is so nice. Delightful experience. Do yourself a favor and step outside your comfort zone here. The shrimp&grits and jambalaya are delicious but their fish dishes (Ahi, specials, etc) are where they really shine.

reviews.author: LL C
reviews.text:
Loved this Southern spot!

Ordered a lot of food but loved the gumbo, clams and the fried chicken -- the latter wasn't too oily and was delicious. The raw platter was also super fresh and tasty. Didn't care for the crabcake, but everything else was great. A little pricey but came away very satisfied.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: I just bought and ebike from these folks and Jeff was amazing.  I did a lot of research online and decided on Momentum, but wanted to shop local.  Jeff ordered the bike for me and assembled everything and delivered it for me as soon as it came in.  At delivery he gave me a complete tutorial and made sure I was comfortable riding the bike before taking off.  I have NEVER had better service.  My son and I have been loving riding all over in this great bike!  Thank you guys for your great service and patience with me!  You went above and beyond!

reviews.author: J. Reviews
reviews.text: Nice and helpful bike mechanics, but the owner was not very nice. I witnessed him being very rude to two girls who were trying to return an e-bike; he was telling them that it was their own fault if they felt like the bike wasn’t powerful enough.

reviews.author: Daniel Wnorowski
reviews.text: Went there after researching my options for a pro ski boot fit, necessitated by a subtle change in my foot alignment after foot surgery. Jeff did not disappoint. He spent plenty of time, educated me, discussed my options, answered my questions, and solved my problem. Great job: 6/5!

reviews.author: Kevin Brown
reviews.text: Alternatives is a very terrible bank. They don't answer their phones, ever. They lock your account if you pay a bill but let hackers use my card to make purchases in Texas. I've been on the phone over 2 hours to speak with a representative to replace my debit card. Still on hold.The moment I regain access to my funds I will be closing my account with Alternatives Federal Credit Union and doing my business with their competitor. Absolutely atrocious customer service.

reviews.author: canmicjen1 xxx
reviews.text: Such a pathetic credit union!! It doesn’t even try to do better. What “bank” in today’s age doesn’t have card controls!!! You can’t turn your card off or on. Doesn’t have the basics. I believe they aren’t even going to attempt to get a better system even after many complaints.If I have a problem with an online order and do a charge back or dispute you have to get a whole new card. Very behind the times!!!

reviews.author: James Crumley
reviews.text: When you schedule an appointment and can't keep it or entirely miss it for any reason, let someone know, don't just let an automated email survey go out. You used to be my absolute go-to but now I don't have the confidence that you're even here to begin with considering no-shows.

reviews.author: Meghana Guturi
reviews.text:
I got a balayage done here in October, and unfortunately I’ve been unhappy with the results since then.

From the beginning, I mentioned that my hair does not lift easily without bleach based on prior experience. I was advised to trust the process, but the initial lift did not work as expected. The stylist then proceeded to tease and bleach my hair while it was wet. I specifically asked whether this would be okay and was reassured that it would be.

While the hair did lift, the teasing wasn’t done evenly, which resulted in visible patchiness in multiple areas. The final color also turned out very copper/orange, whereas I had clearly asked for a brown tone. Since then, I’ve had to rely on semi-permanent glosses just to make the color presentable for school.

The stylist herself was very kind and pleasant, but the technical execution was disappointing. I was also charged a higher tip because I was told I have “a lot of hair,” which added to the frustration given the outcome.

Overall, lovely service personality-wise, but the quality of the work did not meet expectations.

reviews.author: Mark B.
reviews.text: Joyce is an amazing woman and even better  hair stylist. She has helped me prepare my hair for donation and have greatly appreciated her help. The salon is very clean and relaxing, I really love the weekend hours! And would recommend this place to anyone!

reviews.author: Susan Svihula
reviews.text: I was absolutely shocked and disappointed with this salon, after having gone for a haircut the first time and being happy, to having my appointments (color and cut) rescheduled, due to their error, for two separate days, then show up not even being addressed by name, to be turned away and told sorry there is nothing we can do 😳 Their lack of professionalism is astonishing!

reviews.author: Alaya Kimbrough
reviews.text: Never had a bad experience with a AAA tow company until now. They took 12 HOURS to tow my car one street over. We put the tow request in at 1209 pm. By 322pm it was assigned to Koskinens. I was called all the way at 1030pm saying we could leave our keys in the car for the driver. My boyfriend left the keys in it as suggested. I tried to stay up as long as I could to wait for the driver, just for them to finally come at 331 am, we were sleep. Woke up at 630am and looked outside to find our car on the wrong side of the road FACING TRAFFIC, sideways sticking out in the road, with our bumper SNAPPED OFF. Oh and blocking the driveway to where my neighbors can barely get out. When I called Koskinens, I was nice ..didn’t yell. Jamie decided he was going to hang up on me, called again & he told me I don’t need to call again that he was calling AAA, and hung up again. I called again to ask for an explanation of what happened with my vehicle and this time a female butted in. She was of NO help at all and they tried to turn the situation around on me & my boyfriend. When Jeremy the tow driver left me a voicemail he didn’t mention anything about snapping our bumper off or any damage. The customer service SUCKS. Not a good look for AAA having a contract with this company. Looking at their recent past reviews, it just shows that I am not the only person that has had trouble with these people. Highly advice that you don’t accept a tow or assistance from them!!!!! If I could give 0 STARS I WOULD!!!

reviews.author: Christina Torres
reviews.text: Called for a AAA tow. Received an email that  Koskinen's was the tow company towing. I called to ask if I needed to be there present with the vehicle. I was told that I didnt have to be present and to just leave the key in cup holder.(so thats what I did). All that was wrong with my suv was a broken CV shaft. Fast forward to the drop off my suv. Now my suv will not move out of park mode. I called to ask what happened to my suv. Dispatch told me the driver said there was NO KEY in the suv. Which was a lie. I have it on camera of me putting the key in the suv, from my work parking lot. I asked for the owner to call me. He never called. So I called back again. All for a man to cuss me out and tell me its not his problem and they didnt break my vehicle. Told me to file a claim through AAA. Like I already didnt plan to. I just thought id Receive some honest answers. If you want to do something right in life, dont get a tow from them. It will cost you more in the end, as my suv now needs a new transmission.

reviews.author: Jose Jasmins
reviews.text: Lewis is a horrible human and employee. Worst experience ever. Was being told with a contract from AAA. This guy shows up 14 hours later. AAA told me I didn’t have to be there. He insisted that I had to be there and made me drive all the way back to where my vehicle was after waiting 7 1/2 hours. Then it was around 8 p.m. He called me and insisted that I went back. I told him we would take 15 minutes to get there. He said that I needed to get there as soon as possible. He would leave. I got there just as he was leaving and refused to tow my vehicle. It took me about 16 minutes to get there with the weather. The worst part is that AAA told me I didn’t need to be there and he insisted that I needed to be there to show him ID. He just didn’t want to do the work because I called AAA afterwards to call another service. In the end, the guy wound up coming at 2:30 in the morning without me having to be there. He told it and took it to the place that needed to be no questions asked. He just called me to ask me why the other driver refused to take my vehicle. I explained to him this whole ordeal and Sal told me that he used to work with Lewis and he was a horrible employee for them and this is why he was let go. You guys are allowing this guy to work for you and he’s causing you to have an even worse reputation. Your reviews on here are not favorable.

reviews.author: Thomas Robinson
reviews.text: Convenient location, good selection and not too expensive.

reviews.author: Emma
reviews.text: Go up the road to ExxonMobil. The gas is cheaper and the stuff is nicer. This place bathroom is out of order so If you are getting off the highway to get gas and pee skip this place and go a little further for cheaper gas. Bathroom out of order is usually code for we don't want to clean it which is gross considering they sell food.

reviews.author: Zach Jaeger
reviews.text: If you need gas, this place has it! I'm not really how to write a review about this other than... I needed gas, and when I pulled in here, they had and let me pay them for it!

reviews.author: Jason Guilbeault
reviews.text: Stains on the walls and furniture. Holes in the wall. This place is a dump. We stayed here a couple years ago and it was so much nicer. Now it’s gross. Also, if you’re late they consider you a no show and will cancel your reservation with no refund. We were a day late and figured we’d just loose that day but still pay for the night. Nope, they canceled the reservation and we ended up paying for the same room on the same night twice. Then we saw the condition of the rooms. Never going back.

reviews.author: Paul Munson
reviews.text:
I arrived at 1:30pm, and the room was not ready until the 3pm check-in time.  I understand, that was fine.  However, since I could not check in, I asked to use the bathroom and was told "No, its dirty and we lost the key."   This honestly sounds illegal, but at the very least is incredibly disrespectful.

The room itself was fine.  It's a bit of a dump, sure, but for the price its acceptable.  Several of the staff were very nice - the gentleman on the cleaning staff, and the lady checking me out in the morning were the only good points of the trip.

In the end, the disrespect and the weird extra charges will make me not return.  $12 to park (not $10 as advertised), and they asked for a crazy expensive fee in order to check out at noon.  Both of these are free at 98% of hotels I have stayed in.  And bathroom access is just common decency that this place lacks.

reviews.author: TERRY Chaw
reviews.text:
Strategically located .ex Quality inn. Coffee from 630 to 930am. Byo breakfast. Equipped with microwave.

Two times...access card unable open the door. Bad system needs to be upgraded

reviews.author: Buff Orpington
reviews.text: Excellent local appliance shop.  Why go to a giant megacorp when these folks are friendly, helpful, knowledgeable and less expensive?  They helped us avoid some massive repair bill by getting us into brand new appliances for less money than the repairs.  Highly highly recommend

reviews.author: Mary Scott
reviews.text: I bought 2 washers, 2 dryers, a range, and a dishwasher from Thayer, because I like to support local businesses.  A year and a few weeks after I bought one of the dryers, it stopped working.  I called Thayer and the person on the phone said they would see what they could do and would get back to me.  Three weeks went by, and I didn't hear from anyone.  I called back, talked to someone else, who also said she would get back to me, but never did.  I guess next time, I'll just go to the big box store.  They get a couple of stars because their delivery is convenient and the guys are nice.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: My wife and I recently purchased two appliances: a clothes washer and a dish washer from Thayer. We were impressed with the knowledge of the salesman that helped us. Delivery was timely, and the installer was outstanding. We were provided with service that exceeded our previous experiences purchasing appliances from  box stores.

reviews.author: J D
reviews.text: I called and got to speak to the manager Kayla at the Ithaca store, and asked if they had a few parts I needed. She was very knowledgeable and answered all questions. When I went inside they had the parts at the counter, the assistant manager Bill went outside and helped install a customers wiper. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Harold Can
reviews.text: They got the parts but That tall guy's got a massive attitude if he don't like his job he should find Something Else .

reviews.author: Lenny Elliott
reviews.text: I came down to the Napa store to get some rear rotors for my vehicle. Worker named Rob introduced himself to me and was very helpful with questions I had. He was really respectful and understanding. Overall great customer service. I would definitely recommend people to go see rob if you need help with anything.

reviews.author: Christine Sisson
reviews.text: Great dealership. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. Best pricing around. Willing to go that extra mile for you. We had Kassidy and she was amazing! She even donated to the SPCA in our name.

reviews.author: chris maroney
reviews.text: Purchased a used 2023 truck with 40k miles. I contacted Maguire within the used warranty period when the vehicle had no power and would not start in my garage (had a malfunction in the electrical system that drained the battery). I was stranded and couldn't get to work so I called the service department early at 7:30 when they open. I was told they needed manager approval and I would receive a call back after 9am. They didn't call. At 10:30 I called my sales person who said she would check on the status and would get right back to me. I am still waiting for a call back from Maguire. They completely ghosted me and their responsibility to warranty a used vehicle under NYS law. I needed the truck in working order fast, so I replaced the battery myself and then drove it to Royal Chevy who diagnosed and repaired the faulty electrical component for $250. It isn't the Money. It is the way Maguire gave me the run around and then snuck out the back door like any sleazy low rent used car salesman. I won't buy from them again.

reviews.author: Meagan T
reviews.text:
Maguire did deliberate, irreparable, damage to my vehicle before I even drove off the lot with it and then literally covered it up! Whomever attempted to correctly put on my license plate after purchasing my vehicle failed to do so. Instead of fixing the problem correctly they just drilled holes into my bumper, permanently destroying the bracket the license plate attaches to, and then literally covered it up with the plate itself. Thank god that I bought and went to install red license plate holders otherwise I, very likely, wouldn't have realized the problem until my vehicle was out of warranty. Just in the way that you have to attach a license plate, there is absolutely no way whatsoever that it was possible for whomever installed it to not see the damage that was done, even if they hadn't done it themselves. When I called to talk about it with someone at the dealership they tried to say "oh, it must have been like that when you purchased the vehicle." That's absolutely 100% incorrect. You can still see the shavings of pieces of my bumper from where they drilled it, in some of the photos posted below. When I brought my car in for them to look at they admitted that "someone" must have done that there but they didn't keep records of who does what work?
A few months later, that's how long it took for them to replace my bumper, when dealing with ANOTHER problem with my vehicle, (that they refused to fix despite ample black and white evidence that the problem was already occurring before the purchase) when talking to the store manager, I brought up the issue with my bumper and the store manager was completely unaware of it. If this really were a business of integrity, that cared about its customers, do you really think that parts/service would be hiding flagrant disregard for customers property by it's employees?
I grew up here and I, personally, have never once heard anything good about Maguire from anyone I know who has purchased a vehicle from them. Clearly, they have a monopoly on dealerships here in Ithaca but, trust me, they will not care about you or your vehicle. They only care about their bottom dollar.

reviews.author: edf fr
reviews.text:
Great place right on rt 13. Clean, quaint, reasonably priced rooms which include a modest complimentary breakfast, small coffee pot with coffee, small refrigerator, microwave, TV, telephone, alarm clock, AC & heat, and access to outdoor and indoor seating areas, as well as other amenities not mentioned above.

Don't forget to head across the parking lot to their inviting long-standing restaurant with excellent food options when open throughout the day including breakfast and alcoholic beverages.

All food I've tried at the restaurant is cooked to perfection at a very reasonable price.  Boothes, tables, etc.  Inviting atmosphere and staff make the Meadow Court Inn a no brainer on you next stop through Ithaca, NY.  Walkable distance to vibrant downtown area with much to explore.   Short walk to the renound State Theater of Ithaca a huge plus when attending shows ranging from poetry events, comedy, world famous musicians, and local groups as well ranging a multitude of genres (Ive seen classical, musicals, projected films, rock concerts such as Modest Mouse) and much more. Close access to public transportation amd a plethora of opportunities to experience the unique world of the gourges of Ithaca and other unique natural landscape and history.

ADA accessable. And AAA and Veteran discounts may be available.

Would recommend to people of any age or any occasion.  Weather it's anything listed above, or just simply for it's extreme convenience directly on RT. 13 passing through Ithaca.  Nearby access to public transit and medical facilities as well.

reviews.author: Lois Edwards
reviews.text: Stayed here because we had family getting married at Lodi point park. Stayed 2 nights .Rooms were pretty clean, floors could of been cleaner and staff was very nice. Free breakfast of bagels, cold  cereal , Danish and coffee and teas .  only thing was they never had extra toilet paper in the room. I would stay here again for sure. Also very quiet which we like.

reviews.author: Nik Nik
reviews.text: Oh boy. I woke up with a swollen face and congested nose. The mold in our room was so bad. I do not ever wake up that way otherwise. We hardly slept because we were so grossed out by the beds. Numerous stains. Blankets were so weathered the pattern was practically invisible. Front desk lady was incredibly kind and helpful though. We came for some hiking and waterfalls. Wanted something cheap because luxury wasn’t the priority for this stay.
