You do indeed get what you pay for, but I have to say, 120 with tax for this was absurd. Should’ve been max $30. And the term “continental breakfast” is used incredibly loosely here. We got a danish (because they put one out at a time for a family of three), a stale little bagel and cereal. I did feel safe though, but idk if I’d do this again. At the very least, bringing my own blanket. Never traveling without my blanket again!

reviews.author: J van der L
reviews.text: Super friendly service. Nice sandwiches as well! Old style ordering via a paper form but the result is good. The place looks a bit old and had no toilet for customers.

reviews.author: Rosy
reviews.text: Had a quick stop for lunch here and the ordering process was smooth and fast. You circle what you want on a ticket. The sandwiches are decent, a little saltier and tougher than expected. Their chicken noodle soup was delicious. The inside is decorated with neon signs and old-fashioned menu, making the atmosphere retro and enjoyable.

reviews.author: The Suave Sultan
reviews.text: Shortstop Deli has been a local institution since 1978. They operate a deli counter and convenience store with a large selection of sandwiches and snacks. They use a ticket system for ordering, which can be a little confusing if it’s your first time here. What you want to do is go up to the counter and grab a ticket. If you want a regular sandwich, you’ll want the one labeled “Ithaca style sub.” They also have tickets for breakfast sandwiches (which are really delicious) and pizza subs. Once you have your ticket, mark down what you want and give the white copy to the person making sandwiches and the yellow carbon copy to the cashier to pay. They’ll call your name when your sandwich is done. I usually take mine to go and eat it in the park, but they have tables there if you want to eat inside. I really can’t recommend this place enough! The sandwiches are always delicious and you absolutely have to try their giant cookies! I’d go so far as to say that they’re the best sandwich shop in town.

reviews.author: Jean Pecquet
reviews.text: Highly recommend this location. The process of booking the unit and checking in was super fast and easy, and a lock is provided. I moved out a few days after the start of a new pay period and fully expected to pay for the full period as stated in the FAQ on their website, but Danielle kindly offered to prorate the rent. Great customer service!

reviews.author: allen ellsworth
reviews.text: Very convenient they called me when I had a late payment to make sure everything was ok. The area was always perfectly clean and I never had a problem getting into my unit. PLUS they let me keep the very sturdy lock that came with the unit!

reviews.author: Ellie Pojarska
reviews.text: I booked a storage unit and then had to cancel it last-minute in the middle of the first month because of changed circumstances. Danielle was incredibly gracious and refunded our first month charge even though she absolutely did not have to. I loved the personal attention and her prompt and compassionate response. Amazing customer service. We are definitely coming back here for next summer!

reviews.author: Scott Updike
reviews.text: I've called this man several times with a handlebar job, running issue with one of my bikes. Never has any time for anything doesn't want to talk all he says is call me in a few weeks and I get the same B/S. Running your business from Tuesday to part of Saturday and don't answer the phone until 1 pm is NOT the way you run a business. The photos show how much of my money went someplace else and I did all the customizing and engine work myself.

reviews.author: Gabe Newhart
reviews.text: Aaron is the best. He put a cam and oil pump in my m8 we had a mishap with the new oil pump and he got on it right away and made it right. He had my back through the whole process.There is no question that he is the best around and I wouldn't take my bike anywhere else but Miller motorworks! Thanks again Aaron!

reviews.author: Kevin Anthony
reviews.text: Aaron did a great job tuning my thunder max. He scheduled me with a prompt appt and addressed my concerns and explained how and why things worked. Bike runs awesome.  Thanks Aaron.

reviews.author: Beth Ishmael
reviews.text: The cutest, coolest hotel ever! We had a wonderful stay at The Dorm Hotel while in Ithaca for a Cornell campus visit. The theme and details made our stay so fun! Property manager Joanne was wonderful and she made our stay even better! Her hospitality is unmatched. She was so helpful and kind to us, providing recommendations and tips about all things Ithaca while we were there. The Dorm Hotel is a gem and we definitely plan to return in the future!

reviews.author: Dr. Debra Berke
reviews.text: Location was great! Hotel was quiet and small. Room was good, nice wooden floors and cute decor. Spacious shower, large king bed with built-in storage under the bed. I reserved the sophomore room which didn't have a refrigerator and coffee maker (which I regretted). Only other negative for us was the bed height (very tall and challenging to get in and out of and we are not short) and mattress softness. We prefer a firmer mattress. Overall, loved Hotel but would get different room next time.

reviews.author: Ali
reviews.text: Great location, very close to campus. Rooms are very clean, with modern amenities. Cozy, welcoming vibe. Shoutout to Joanne at the front desk She is always so warm and welcoming and goes out of her way to make every guest feel special. She is one of the reasons I keep returning. She really makes a difference in my experience!

reviews.author: Erik Z
reviews.text:
It's a cool place to checkout. It has a pretty big tree house built by students decades ago.  There's not much to do here besides hike some trails and see the treehouse. There are way better hikes around there area if that's what you're interested in.

I don't think it's worth going out of your way to come here to see the tree house. The top is covered with hard plastic so there isn't a great view. It's cramped and pretty dirty. I'd say it's worth checking out for like 15 minutes and it's on the way to something else.

reviews.author: Heather S.
reviews.text: Tree house was super cool, but the nature center closed during the pandemic and now sits abandoned. I was a little disappointed bc I was looking forward to seeing the animals. The nature center building is beautiful and has a lot of history, so it’s sad to see it just sitting abandoned, as well as the things around it. Trails have A LOT of ticks so beware!

reviews.author: Karen S
reviews.text:
I arrived at 3 pm on a Monday.  I was the only visitor in the parking lot.  An employee was standing outside of the building.  She advise me how to access a couple of the trails and said that the Nature center was closed.  😐 It wasn't supposed to close for two hours.  Disappointed in that.

The grounds, especially  around the nature center, needs upkeep.  What a shame.   I don't know anything about this place.  Maybe they run on donations and don't have the money/manpower to keep it in top shape?  The peeling paint in the rear makes it look derelict.

Taughannock Falls is right down the street and was busy so I was floored that no one else was here for the trail and Nature Center.  (She said they are busy in the summer).  A couple people showed up as a was leaving.

The adult/kid tree house was pretty neat.  Only a short walk from the parking lot.

There seems to be a few trails but I didn't do much hiking on them.  Cool gorge and shaded trail.

Nice view  from the parking lot.

reviews.author: Erica Hopper
reviews.text: It’s a Taco Bell so I’m not expecting to be blown away but compared to the other Taco Bell in Ithaca, this place is pretty great. They do have a tendency to forget one item with nearly every order I get, so I encourage people to check their orders before leaving. But, the food has always been warm and what I expect. The staff have all been incredibly pleasant every time I go through. And if you’re going during expected busy times the line moves slow, but only in that it’s a funnel and they can only get through a big line so quickly. When there’s few people on line it’s quick.

reviews.author: Alison
reviews.text: This location went down the tubes real quick. When they first opened we would come on our 30 minute lunch break and always marveled at how quick the service was. Well that didn’t last unfortunately. My last 3 visit the service was insanely slow and I just sat in the drive thru  for 45+ minutes. Felt like one car was holding it up- they should have been told to pull to the side. The guy at the window was nice and friendly.  Very disappointed with the chicken nuggets and this visit overall.  If you are looking for fast…do not come here.

reviews.author: Jason Beauvais
reviews.text: After waiting for about 20 minutes for our food to be made, we watched one of the workers retreat to the bathroom. He emerged from the bathroom wearing the same gloves he entered with, checked his phone and began preparing food. Not wanting to cause a scene, I requested a refund and to cancel my order, saying it was taking too long. I was told the transaction couldn't be canceled, but my food would be ready soon. I wasn't going to eat food prepared by the guy who wore his food prep gloves while using the bathroom, so I just left. I will never, ever return to this location.

reviews.author: Daniil Linnik
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with Dr. Bonniwell. My wife’s consultation appointment, which we had scheduled two weeks in advance, was cancelled at the very last minute. Her teeth have been causing her significant pain recently, so we were counting on this visit to address the issue. Because of this appointment, we had rearranged or cancelled several other important commitments.
We were told the cancellation was due to notes in our file indicating multiple no-shows. This is completely untrue. As responsible adults, we have never intentionally missed an appointment without cancelling beforehand, and we do not believe we have ever done so—even once, let alone multiple times. We were previously seen by Dr. Bonniwell for a consultation, but we either hesitated to proceed with the recommended tooth extraction (as we were reluctant to lose a tooth) or had to cancel for a legitimate reason. In any case, we strongly object to being falsely accused of multiple no-shows.

reviews.author: Melody Lateer
reviews.text: I dont usually reveiw much but as someone who went somewhere else for my lower wisdom teeth and here for my uppers, my experience here was much better! Everyone was so helpful and kind and the surgeon was amazing, called to check in as well the day after with reminders of what I should be doing and to call of have any issues. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Catalin Julian Machidon
reviews.text: I have gone to Dr. Bonniwell  for 2 surgeries so far. The first one was for removing my two molars. The process was so fast and smooth. He is truly the best. This is the first dentist that did the removal with no pain what’s so ever. I barely had to take any over the counter Tylenol. All the nurses and the stuff are very polite and truly amazing people. The second surgery I had was to remove all 4 wisdom teeth at once. I can’t believe how fast and smooth he did this. I feel 0 pain. All my friends were telling me this is going to suck and hurt after but it does not at all. This proves how amazing this doctor and the staff are. I believe he is truly the best in this area. Thank you Dr. Bonniwell and thank you to the staff. Don’t hesitate to book with him. He will take very good care of you.

reviews.author: Victoria Reap
reviews.text: Bill and Jeff at Automotive Consultants are the best! I recently found myself in need of a vehicle that will tow my small travel trailer across the country safely and reliably and stopped in and talked to Bill about my needs and he went out of his way to get me into the perfect vehicle for me. He even let me change my mind on which vehicle I wanted after I had made a commitment to buying a truck when my dream vehicle appeared. He provided me with a well maintained, immaculate vehicle at a fair price and made sure it was safe and sound by having new brakes installed at no extra chrage to me. I now feel that I will be safe and comfortable as I wander about the country in my new to me Jeep Grand Cherokee. Bill and Jeff both went out of their way and were very patient while waiting for my loan to come through and connected me with Jamie at Warren Insurance who was also very accommodating and understanding. In some ways, it feels like Ithaca has been changing alot, but these guys make it feel like the small town community that attracted me and enticed me to come here 45 years ago still exists here. Thank you for making me so comfortable and for your understanding and honesty and your willingness to go out of your way to make sure I have a safe journey forward! I dont give five star reviews often, but you guys deserve it!

reviews.author: Mike Carey
reviews.text: We bought cars for several decades through Bill at Automotive Consultants, and we always got terrific help and deals.  When we relocated to California the distance became too great, so we were no longer able to do that.  BUT - fast forward to now, and when I needed advice in picking a hybrid SUV (my first hybrid), I decided to call Bill for input.  He was terrific - he looked at the offers we were getting out here, told me which models were the best and most reliable, and made a call and arranged a sales-pressure-free appointment with a dealer near me that led to my most recent new car purchase.  You will not find a better, more honest, or more helpful automotive consultant (hence the name) anywhere!   Two thumbs up (and five stars)...!

reviews.author: Shirley Engman
reviews.text: First time I shopped for a car without my son but I gave it a try because the representative, Mr Card, came highly recommended by 2 friends.  He has such a knowledge of cars that he can find exactly what you are looking for at a much better price than I would have obtained from a dealer with no pressure at all to make the sale.  He is so customer oriented, goes above the normal sale to be sure you are pleased with your purchase.  I highly recommend him and will use only him should I need to purchase another car.  Would gladly give him 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: John Carberry
reviews.text:
Mike and his team were great. They took my truck in on time, mounted and balanced five 37-inch tires and had me out the door by lunch. Good communication throughout the process, and more than a fair price at the end. I’m very glad I found Finger Lakes Automotive, and I plan to be back.

UPDATE … Came back two plus years later, and I’m happy to report Mike and the crew are still rock solid and a pleasure to work with. I bought 4 new tires to replace the last set, which saw 78K miles of cross-country highways and hard off-road trails. Mike matched the best price I could find anywhere, mounted and balanced these big wheels at by far the best price I could find, and had me in and out in 90 minutes. We’re talking about 37-inch Jeep tires that weigh 80 pounds a piece. Trust me, getting them all mounted and balanced and installed in that time is very impressive. And the balance is perfect. Like riding on a cloud. Another major feat for wheels this big.

Hands down this is the best place I’ve found for tires anywhere Upstate NY.

reviews.author: Erik Johnson
reviews.text: Great experience!!! The guys at the shop were very helpful and knowledgeable in making a decision on which tires to go with . Not only are we safe we are looking good for All the Upstate New York Weather  !!!! Thanks again Mike & Kevin !!!

reviews.author: Dan Miller
reviews.text: Price for the tires I wanted was under that of Tire Rack, installation was done when convenient for me, and the work was first rate! Everything torqued exactly to specs. Will  absolutely use them again. Thanks Finger Lakes Automotive!

reviews.author: caitlin spry
reviews.text: I'm tired of having to call and get a new card just because I simply need a refund, and then that refund can take months for me to receive. Like why are you just allowing my card to be used for anything, especially if I don't have enough in my account? And then even though I call for it to be canceled, my money to be refunded, they say nothing can be done then the next day they give me some bs charge and steal more of my money that I don't have.

reviews.author: David Herrmann
reviews.text: I was always told 9am to 5 pm was bankers hours but now it’s 9 to 4 I get out at 4 so only can do banking on Saturday nice

reviews.author: Amanda S.
reviews.text: We use Chemung Canal Trust Company for everything. We have had small personal loans, car loans, and our mortgage with them. We have needed them for savings for the kids, our personal account and when we suddenly lost multiple  family members  they were right there with assistance with Estate management. For every financial need life has thrown at us Chemung Canal has been there to help! With the familiarity of a small town bank and the knowledge and experience of larger firms Chemung Canal brings the best of both worlds to its customers.  We Could not ask for a better bank!!

reviews.author: Robert Shaw
reviews.text: Disappointing stay.  While it may be "recently renovated," it stinks like an old cigarette-soaked motel.  The room was clean for what it was and you can tell that they recently replaced some fixtures.  However, new fixtures or not - it smells.  I can't say whether this is unique to the room I was in or is property-wide.  As other reviews have noted, if you are on the road side you will hear loud traffic.  I was awoke in the middle of the night from a tractor-trailer riding its air-brake by the property.  And lastly, perhaps most infuriatingly, this is the only Hampton Inn I've ever stayed at that charges for parking.  It's around $4 but it is not prominently disclosed and certainly not expected - it is a naked money grab.  I would not stay here again when there are so many other nearby options.

reviews.author: Manoj Kumar Pradhan
reviews.text: Location is what makes this a perfect stay, right at the middle of the Ithaca. Rooms are standard, ours has a “hard to close door”. 24 hours coffee isn’t great, don’t bother. Breakfast spread was standard and well stocked. We visited during a busy race time and hotel was fully booked and it was quite expensive too. Kids had some good time in the pool.

reviews.author: Jason Cali
reviews.text:
Rooms were clean and nice. Road noise was loud. I stayed two nights, and when I came back at the end of a long day at a conference my room was not made up. I asked about this at the front desk, and there was nobody in the lobby to help me out. When I asked the next morning, they said they only turn over the rooms every other day.

What?!?!?!

I'm a Hilton Honors member, paying an average price of over $375 per night before taxes. You can't even make my bed?

Indoor pool was closed for maintenance. I was switched out of the room type I booked for maintenance. Nobody was in the entire lobby when I checked in (had to wait almost 10 minutes), and the next night when I wanted to ask about my room not being serviced.

Hidden fee of $4 per day to park in their parking lot. Not a dealbreaker, but come on folks. For this price, do better.

reviews.author: Lisa Johnson
reviews.text:
I pulled right in to an equipment return Lane and within a few minutes the staff was there and took a brief look at the U-Haul to confirm fuel and supplies rented were returned.  They emailed me a receipt and I was in and out within five minutes.

I also found the 26 foot long U-Haul much easier to drive than I expected. I drove 800 miles on interstate, Tulane roads and through small towns without any issues. You do have to be very careful before you commit to going into a parking lot to make sure you have a way out :-) These vehicles suck down the fuel. It's a good opportunity to use your fuel points!

reviews.author: Georgie Goldstein
reviews.text: Denise was the absolute best!! She was so personable and helpful; she definitely has solidified our decision on sticking with U-Haul for any of our moving needs. Denise’s sincerity and kindness made all of the difference in our experience renting a truck and has left us with such a positive memory leaving Ithaca! We can’t thank her enough!!

reviews.author: Dave Heck
reviews.text: Great customer service!  Easy pick up of trailer.  The attendant set me up with the correct size ball for my hitch, hooked up the trailer and got me the road quickly!

reviews.author: Sharon Allen
reviews.text: Mobil 1 has been a trusted business, of mine, for many years. I have gotten oil changes and yearly inspections here; and, they're always professional, thorough and honest. I would definitely recommend taking your vehicle to them!

reviews.author: Howard Silcoff
reviews.text: Came here for oil change and star inspection. They couldn’t do the inspection because of a problem with the lug bolts on my front tires. They found this out quickly so instead of running through the inspection and risking a problem being able to get tires back on they suggested I get those addressed first then return and didn’t charge me for the inspection service. I dealt with the problem, returned a week later and they completed the inspection quickly and without issue. There was a bit more to the story but long and short is the service was top notch, the technicians were extremely pleasant and do not try to tell me I needed things like new wiper blades or what not which has been typical when I had inspections done elsewhere. I will surely come back when I next need similar service.

reviews.author: Tanya Parsons
reviews.text:
I refuse to take my car any place else for a oil change. Tyler is my car doctor as we call him. We were experiencing a major issue with our vechile that not one auto shop out here could tell us the issue let alone what to do to fix it. We went for a oil change and Tyler instantly heard a alarming sound so he investigated for us and found out we needed a new front drive shaft and also informed us that he wouldn't drive it let alone put children in our car till we got it fixed. THANK YOU for always having your customers upmost safety at heart! Tyler saved us in a major way then. I recommend EVERYONE to come here.
Updated 12/5/25
Tyler and his team yet again have had our safety at heart and informed me of the fact that my current vechile had the wrong oil and to have the timing chain checked( new engine just got installed yesterday) at this point I owe Tyler my life lol. His team and him are the best and most respectful crew iv dealt with. I recommend them to all and anyone in need of their services. Keep up the amazing work guys! Ill see at the next oil change 🥰

reviews.author: Tiffany Doan
reviews.text: Every single time that I’ve gone To this location for gas, you have have to run in to grab the gas receipt! It is completely frustrating because in my line of work you’re running as fast as you can. I truly hope that someone can fix this issue. The cashiers always seem very nice and pleasant, but there’s almost always at least two employees working at the same time so it doesn’t make sense though. One of them can’t go out to fill the machines full of receipt paper.

reviews.author: TBIRD
reviews.text: K love the hot pizzas you can get on food stamps! Awesome!! ( Technically u are buying a cold uncooked pizza and they throw it in the oven for you for free and is cooked perfectly in under 5 min!) Super cool!

reviews.author: oconaddify
reviews.text: I was there last night with my fiancé. The older gentleman who made our pepperoni pizza and mild Buffalo boneless wings was cool. He did a good job making our food. It was delicious.

reviews.author: Red
reviews.text: I stayed here in Ithaca this week with my husband and two small children. The pool was nice, but we couldn’t use the bathtub because the drain plug wasn’t attached, so the tub wouldn’t hold water and on top of that, we had no hot water for a shower due to the steady stream of water leaking out of the faucet. After swimming, we were covered in chlorine and couldn’t bathe the kids or even shower properly. I reported it to the front desk that evening and again at checkout, and was told the hotel already knew about the leak. Really disappointing and a major inconvenience for our family trip.

reviews.author: Roey Maor
reviews.text:
We had a very good stay. The rooms and bathrooms were clean, comfortable, and pleasant. Breakfast was good and had everything we needed to start the day.

The hotel is located at the entrance to the city, so there isn’t much to do within walking distance and you need to drive to most places. But after a long journey from JFK, the location was perfect for us - quiet, convenient, and easy to reach.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily return.

reviews.author: David Mussari
reviews.text: An outstanding choice for your stay in Ithaca.  The pricing is fair and the staff is absolutely wonderful.  The rooms are clean and comfortable and the breakfast buffet is excellent with many tasty options.  The complimentary coffee, tea & water is well stocked and open 24/7 and the entire hotel is well kept and nice.  Not much more you can ask for from a hotel.  A+++

reviews.author: caleb simwale
reviews.text: His food co-op store is the best for business and personal produce resource management. Totally great for picking up last-minute mushrooms that we need for for our business whether it be picking up Satake or possibly picking up other mushrooms is a great opportunity for them as a business and us as a business to potentially collaborate when it comes to mushroom sales and mushroom produce so in general, this place is top-notch, especially for our company and it’s purposes Would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a quick nice and easy to get around shop for all your essentials Staff are great and I’ve had good time here over the past few Weeks definitely recommend five out of five if there was a possibility for more stars I would

reviews.author: Turtle
reviews.text:
Other than the parking lot, we had a great visit from Rochester.

This is a very clean, well organized store with a bunch of lunch options.

We will definitely be back to try more things!

reviews.author: peedublyou
reviews.text:
There are a lot of grocery choices in Ithaca, but this place has some real advantages. I like the value of the bulk selections, especially granola, spices and eggs. The produce is beautiful. The specials bring organic items to prices comparable to non-organic. Plus, the people are friendly and helpful. I don't feel tired after shopping here.
Update: I shopped here two times more and found more features to appreciate. They have a coffee bar and a food bar, as well as indoor seating with tables. We enjoyed both hot and cold lunches of fresh, healthy dishes, which is hard to get travelling. I also got a pre-packaged salad for our flight out, and it was very tasty and filling.

reviews.author: Greg DuBois
reviews.text: 1st time at this shop and am pleased with the service compared to three other garages I have been to before. The waiting room is certainly larger than most. The time waiting for the service needed was fine

reviews.author: Joseph Samosky
reviews.text: Our car had a major brake failure while we were on vacation in Ithaca and we're extremely grateful to John and his team for their fast, professional service. He was able to schedule us quickly (next day) and we were back on track for exploring the area and driving 300+ miles home. We also had a slow leak in a tire which John fixed and didn't charge us. A great guy and a great shop -- we're very glad we found them and recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.text: Honest and straightforward business practices. They checked my issue in advance and explained they couldn't guarantee a fix due to proprietary scan software, letting me know before I brought the vehicle in or spent any money.

reviews.author: Arcenis Rojas
reviews.text: The food was great. The bread tasted really fresh. But the service was lacking. When I ordered my food I felt like I was burdening the person who took my order. I wouldn't discount this place as a choice to get a sub, but it likely wouldn't be at the top of my list. There are a lot of places to get a good sub.

reviews.author: Selina
reviews.text: My 2 sub order was delayed by a long time because of people placing 10 sub + orders. They need to introduce a limit on in person and online ordering. They have catering for a reason, I mean seriously people? Those poor workers are working hard enough. They don’t need to deal with your 20 sub order with no preparation. Normal people like me can’t get my order at a normal time because of people like this.

reviews.author: Brookdale Ave
reviews.text: Dibella's is certainly one of the best sandwich shops I have been to.  The cold cuts are of high quality as is the bread that is baked in house.  The fact that they offer kid's meals is a delight to families who have younger children.  My only wish is that they would offer meal pricing for addons such as drinks and chips.  However there is a 5 inch meal deal for about $9.99 which is reasonable for the product they offer.

reviews.author: Brookdale Ave
reviews.text: Royal Court serves American cuisine in an environment trapped in the 70s which is just fine with me.  Having stopped by for breakfast our last day in Ithaca, the courteous server who probably has been working there since the 70s tended to our every need with diligence and kindness.  The prices for breakfast were very fair and although it took some time, the food was delicious.  Hoping this place stays here for years to come and is not replaced with another Chick-fil-a or Starbucks.

reviews.author: Alina Gleockler
reviews.text: Fish Fry Friday! The atmosphere and service here are phenomenal! Friendly and polite wait staff. The salad bar is yummy with great selection of dressings that taste homemade. Could have some more options, like bacon crumbles. The fish was tasty! The Mac and cheese was alright. Overall a great place for fish fry!

reviews.author: Sherwin Safir
reviews.text: Old school cool! Saturday prime rib special was fantastic, I highly recommend it! This is a local culinary treasure! Enjoyed the salad bar and service. Milky Way pie and lemon meringue were delicious too.

reviews.author: Norine Delong Jarrell
reviews.text: A friend took me to an early dinner. Neither of us had ever been there so we didn't know what to expect. We both had General Tso's chicken and an egg roll and were very pleased with the amount and taste of everything. Service was great and price wasn't bad. We would definitely go again and I recommend the place.

reviews.author: M Miller
reviews.text: Excellent Chinese food, prepared promptly, reasonable and always hot. I wish it could put out a larger "open" sign because I expect many people don't realize it is there, and that it is open.  Most recently we had shrimp with garlic sauce, delicious! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Dalton Robinson
reviews.text: Fantastic execution of standard American Chinese you're used to. Got the sesame chicken lunch special for around $11. Good portions very pleased, and staff were super friendly. Will absolutely come back for lunch again. (P.S. Stewart Park is 5 minutes away and a great spot to crack open your lunch and relax)

reviews.author: Telephone
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Regal Ithaca for a movie night, and I was thoroughly impressed with the overall experience. The theater is well-maintained, comfortable, and has everything you’d expect for a modern cinema.
The seating was comfortable and spacious—plenty of legroom, which is a rarity in most theaters these days! The sound quality and picture were top-notch, providing an immersive experience for the film we watched. I particularly enjoyed how bright and crisp the images were on the big screen. Whether it's an action-packed blockbuster or a dramatic film, you’ll feel completely engrossed in the experience.
The staff were friendly and efficient, making it easy to get tickets and find our seats. The concession stand had a variety of snacks and drinks, including classic movie favorites like popcorn, candy, and soda, as well as more unique options for those with different tastes. They also have some gourmet options like pretzels and nachos, which are a nice touch.
Additionally, the location is convenient, located right near the Ithaca Mall, so it’s easy to grab a meal or do some shopping before or after the movie. If you’re looking for a deal, I highly recommend going on Tuesdays, when you can get 50% off tickets—a fantastic way to enjoy a movie for less!
Regal Ithaca also offers a rewards program for frequent moviegoers, which is a great way to earn points toward free tickets, upgrades, or discounts on concessions. I highly recommend signing up if you plan to visit often.
Overall, Regal Ithaca provides a clean, comfortable, and fun place to enjoy the latest films. I would definitely recommend it to anyone in the Ithaca area or those visiting.

reviews.author: R. Wood
reviews.text:
Clean and comfortable seats and some of the staff are helpful. This lady, though, the manager, is atrocious. One of the moments I was unfortunate enough to share with her today, I saw her publicly shaming employees in the lobby and being insulting toward one in particular. It created an uncomfortable atmosphere and isn’t the kind of leadership that reflects well on the theatre nor anywhere else. Even my kid, trying to celebrate their birthday at a film, noticed and found it unacceptable. And she's 10. Lady also said some iffy stuff about the customers and clearly is desperate to sell popcorn.

Too many other options in the area to see this childish behavior, I know that much.

reviews.author: Nakiaha Garrison
reviews.text: Very nice experience lots of concession options and no line not a packed theater by any means when I went. I watched the 3rd movie in the Avatar series had a great experience. Pricey snacks but I gotta have my popcorn. Everything’s pricey these days! Overall great experience.

reviews.author: Helin Wang
reviews.text:
The most disappointing experiences I’ve ever had with any hotel — absolutely unacceptable.

I’m not even a guest at this hotel, and after what happened, I honestly wouldn’t recommend anyone stay here. My car was towed from a spot that had NO signage at all — nothing indicating “hotel property,” “tow-away zone,” or “reserved.” Just a bare pole where their sign clearly fell off. Maintaining proper signage is 100% the hotel’s responsibility, and their failure to do that caused this whole mess.

Instead of acknowledging their mistake, the front desk staff were rude, dismissive, and acted like it wasn’t their problem. They kept repeating excuses instead of showing even basic courtesy. And the general manager’s attitude was equally poor — no empathy, no ownership, no professionalism whatsoever.

It’s ridiculous that a hotel would tow someone’s car when there is absolutely no way to know you’re not allowed to park there. And the way they handled the situation afterward made everything worse.

Even though I wasn’t staying at this property, this incident alone tells me all I need to know about how they treat people. If this is how they manage their parking lot and interact with the public, I can’t imagine the level of care guests actually get inside.

I strongly recommend avoiding this hotel.

reviews.author: Corey Watson
reviews.text: Overall, a beautiful hotel in a great location (right next to the Commons and just down the hill from Cornell). The rooms could use some minor upkeep though. We had water damage to the bathroom ceiling, and the shower bench mounting was very loose. I didn't dare sit on it. The in-room cable worked intermittently and the little buttons to control the curtains didn't seem to work. The restaurant and lounge area looked great, though we ate out at other places during our visit. The staff we interacted with was very helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: Moran Reshef-Deri
reviews.text: An excellent hotel — clean and in a great location. Pleasant design with attention to every detail, and friendly staff. There was an issue with the internet (the connection wasn’t working, which also affected the ability to watch TV).

reviews.author: Thomas Griebel
reviews.text: Came here for a group field trip for dinner and had an excellent meal here. Service here was quick and easy and prices seem reasonable compared to other Asian places that I’ve been to. Our food we all enjoyed are meals and we really liked the overall presentation of them, especially the meals with eggs.

reviews.author: HMT
reviews.text: I have been to Koko a couple times and tried Bibimbap with Calamari as well as Budae Jigae with ramen. It gets the job done for Korean food craving, but not as great as the reputation of the best Korean restaurant in Ithaca. The calamari bibimbap had a lot of lettuce in it, which made it almost like a salad. The budae jigae could have more ingredients in it. The side dishes are not bad at all.

reviews.author: Tianling Wan
reviews.text: (This review is based on a previous experience in 2022, I can't speak for what it is now) Very grateful that they remain open on Thanksgiving. Not a big fan of Bibimbap but the Pajun (kind of like pancake with vegetable) is quite good.

reviews.author: Drew Garrity
reviews.text:
Incredible food, great beers, awesome atmosphere. Glenwood Pines was our harvest host for a night so we came in for lunch as well as dinner.

For lunch I went with the pineburger and wings combo. Wow. Every component of this plate stood out. Extremely fresh roll, juicy delicious burger, and 1000 island dressing is a new favorite burger sauce for me. The wings were perfect, juicy and tender, crispy on the outside, and they have an awesome smokey flavor.

Dinner was the fresh fish fry, also incredible. The fish was definitely fresh, cooked perfectly. Flakey on the inside, crispy batter. Same goes for the fries. Topped off with a great local IPA. Also, you cannot sleep on that slice of peanut butter pie for dessert.

Owner and staff were really great, service was excellent and friendly. Very relaxed and inviting atmosphere. Overall a really awesome place I wish I was closer to, and will go far out of the way to visit again.

reviews.author: LL C
reviews.text: Came on a weekday and still had to wait 30+ mins for food, so you know it's a popular spot. Nothing fancy here, just straightforward food and a lovely view of the lake. The fried fish is excellent!

reviews.author: Bryan Hutcherson
reviews.text: Great food and atmosphere! The breading on the onion rings and fried mushrooms was sooooo good. Glad we stopped here!

reviews.author: Bryan Wakeman
reviews.text: Great friendly service and the best rental price we found anywhere! They were very helpful advising us which specific tool we needed. We ended up with a cart saw, which was in great condition and worked incredibly effectively. We were able to return the tool early after hours, which was very convenient for us. I can safely recommend using Carson for your equipment needs anytime!

reviews.author: Shawn Vass
reviews.text:
Their SC40 stump grinder is going to get someone hurt! I'm not the type of person that even does these reviews as it takes me a bit to get fired up but I have used this machine a number of times over the last few years. For some reason they don't feel the need to replace the vermeer debris skirt. The original has been long gone and been replaced with some cobjob cheap plastic. The last time I used it it was held on with two bolts and the plastic was brittle and full of holes and almost falling off the thing. The section that covered the back side of the grinder was gone!
You are constantly being showered with debris because of this. I try my best to take the time and pull the inevitable rocks as I progress, but I ended up finding one that shot straight at my face and don't want to know what it would have done to my eye hadn't I had a faceshield on my helmet down. Seems like a petty fix that has been ignored for so long for what they charge daily for this thing.
It's had a pevious hydraulic leak (that I was told from carson) that I inquired about the last time rented and was assured was not an issue. I get the machine home to take a look and there wasn't even fluid on the dip stick.
The machine is decent as I've personally put my share of hrs on it but Carsons maintenance is terrible!
Just use caution if you rent this machine.

reviews.author: Jane Canfield
reviews.text: We pick out the color of the mulch we wanted, pointed to the pile, warched Mike Simmons load it and did an excellent  job doing so I might say.  Happy with the price and service.  Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Loung Thammavongsa
reviews.text:
The property itself is absolutely beautiful. The common areas are warm, cozy, and thoughtfully designed the fireplace lounge, stone walls, and soft lighting create such a relaxing atmosphere. The surrounding area is lovely as well, peaceful and scenic, which makes it a great place to unwind. The spa is also beautiful and offers a very calming environment.

However, there were a few issues that really impacted our stay. The walls in the rooms are extremely thin you can hear everything. We could hear conversations clearly, doors constantly slamming when neighbors were coming and going, and even housekeeping in the morning while they were cleaning nearby rooms. It made it difficult to truly relax or sleep in.

The spa itself is lovely, but it seems to be so fully booked that even hotel guests can’t get appointments. If you’re staying at the hotel, you would expect some type of reserved availability for guests. It was disappointing not being able to get in despite being on the property.

The restaurant also needs some improvement. The menu felt limited and could use more variety. The burger we ordered was extremely overpriced for the quality, and we were also charged extra for fries something we weren’t informed about ahead of time. For the price point, the quality and portion didn’t match expectations.

Overall, it’s a beautiful property in a lovely area, but the noise levels, spa availability, and restaurant pricing/menu selection took away from what could have been a perfect stay.

reviews.author: Mary Thornton
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for two nights to celebrate my birthday. The location is perfect, right outside of the city with stunning views of the countryside, but still very close and convenient to everything. The girl working at the front desk, Alissa, was very friendly and helpful. Our room was exceptionally clean and the bathrooms looked like they were remodeled recently. They always had a fire going in the lobby which made it so cozy along with their snack and coffee bar. They had a really cute and cozy bar and lounge that I wish we made time to enjoy. The only thing I would suggest is softer sheets. I felt like I was going to get rug burn, but I have sensitive skin and am sure most people wouldn’t mind them. I can’t wait to come back again in the summer and hopefully enjoy the spa next time as well as the fire pits they have outside!

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.text: This Inn is charming and cozy! And, the staff are pleasant. There is EV charging available on request. I found the location fairly convenient. There's a small but adequate spa with a sauna and a steam room and two relaxation rooms. It's clear they prioritize cleanliness. I truly enjoyed my stay and have no complaints

reviews.author: DF
reviews.text: The pizza and Ithica beer here are AMAZING! They are all so friendly! You feel like family each time you come in. They make you feel special. It’s a must visit while in Ithica.

reviews.author: Amy Ruta
reviews.text: I had bought a half chicken tender sub last week. Got home and there was only one tender in it. Disappointed.  Tonight my husband and I went and bought another WHOLE chicken tender sub. We told him that the last time there was only one in a half and there should be more than that. He agreed. Got home and only 2 chicken tenders in a whole sub!! Will not be ordering that again.

reviews.author: Scott Wages
reviews.text:
Thank God those horrible "Dandy" people finally went away. This place is legendary, and now they have some of the old employees back, which means we can now expect the quality that used to exist when they were the original "Rogan's Corner"
These guys are just now getting their feet wet. I think they need to realize that these kids expect a lot of variety, and you just cannot be running out of things...they will get annoyed and start going somewhere else.
Listen to the old man...he was the major impetus over there for years, so he knows what he's talking about!!
Bring everything back to exactly what it was, and you should make money hand over fist ✊

reviews.author: JBT
reviews.text:
This campground has several things going for it and yes there is a “but” below.   Its location to Ithaca, Corning, Watkins  Glen, the Seneca and Cayuga wine trails is good.   Ithaca is a few minutes away with all the food and beverage options you would want.  I would say the vast majority of sites are seasonal campers.  I met several who were pleasant and helpful .  Many kids are in camp but all is quiet in the evening.  Each weekend has a different event like Christmas in July and Halloween the first weekend in October.  Large play areas are available for the kids and a good fenced area to take your dog.

So high ratings on that, but I cannot understand why a good facility doesn’t update the restrooms.   Others have posted they had but one of the two was open aired, no HVAC nor system to move air in the summer or block the cold breezes in the fall.   Showers are old and feel like an old Boy Scout camp.   Spider webs, bugs in lights, trash taken out but no other cleaning.   I know this isn’t a high end campground but basics should never be overlooked.

The pool was covered but is a fair size for an RV park and there is a community center for games and live music on some weekends.

The staff is friendly but not deeply knowledgeable for things in the area. They do have two areas for laundry and yes one set washer/dryer is just outside the toilet as in one of the pictures.  The other in the more modern area behind the community center which has 2/3 washer and dryers working.

The hookups are close so easy to use.   Sites are a good size but are not level. They are grass/dirt.   Many seasonal campers have patios, fences, and other living areas created around their site.   I have ATT and not good service here.  The camp has a pay service which I used and was adequate.

During the week most seasonal people disappeared so very quiet. While mostly clean, the camp does have a couple of “junk” piles that could be dealt with in a different way.

To conclude, the stay was fine.   Had all we needed but with a little effort this could be a great place to stay.

reviews.author: Dan Catherwood
reviews.text: I had a great off-season stay here for a week while visiting my daughter at Cornell, in Ithaca, which is a 25-minute drive away. The camp ground is surrounded by the Robert Treman State Park, which I didn't visit this time through but will next time. Since late October is off-season, most of the park was empty and the remaining travel trailers parked there were winterized and unoccupied so not surprisingly the park had a very empty feel to it. I can imagine it is hopping in the summer season. Charlotte was very responsive when I reached out about the spot and getting my empty propane tank filled (twice!). Jim was kind enough to pick the tank up from my site, fill it, and deliver it back to my doorstep. I'm looking forward to another visit next year when I come through again.

reviews.author: Catherine Coats Musselman
reviews.text:
We spent two wonderful weeks at Pinecreek Campground and absolutely loved it! The location is ideal—just outside Ithaca, NY and close to hiking trails, waterfalls, lakes, and wineries. The campground is clean, well-maintained, and very family-friendly.

There’s a beautiful swimming pool, weekend activities, and the bathrooms, showers, and laundry room are all updated and spotless. Our site had a shady tree, picnic table, and fire ring—everything we needed to relax.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the seasonal campers made us feel right at home. We only wish we could have stayed longer. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Nonna
reviews.text: Gorgeous little find. Very friendly service, fresh dipped, incredible value ice cream. Creamy and super delicious lemon ginger snap, the texture was maybe a little grainy/icy on the others in comparison - all still very delicious. Nice candies pecans in the maple pecan crunch. Cash or Venmo only. Would absolutely come again. Nice to be able to have 2 flavours in the small.

reviews.author: Michelle Horton
reviews.text:
You might think you’re driving up to someone’s house but in fact it’s Dennis Pond . There’s a big sign in front of th house and a small garage like structures to the right where they sell ice cream. The flavors are a little different and delicious. I had mandarin orange and my wife had butterfinger crunch. They were $5 each.

Service was prompt and friendly. We paid through Venmo.

reviews.author: Heather Robson-Griffin
reviews.text: This is a very small business, and I am delighted that we stopped by. It wasn't busy when we went on a Friday afternoon, and the staff was friendly, the tables clean.  I had maple walnut ice cream that was really delicious.  Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Sundeep Venkatesan
reviews.text: We had a fantastic family visit to the Sciencenter in Ithaca, NY! It’s one of those places where both kids and adults can learn and have fun at the same time. The interactive exhibits kept all of us engaged, and the reptile pets were definitely a highlight — our kids loved seeing them up close and learning about them. We also attended a special event on wildfires, which was well organized and educational. The kids came away with a real understanding of how wildfires start. It was hands-on, informative, and perfectly suited for all ages. Overall, this is a wonderful spot for families to spend a few hours exploring, learning, and having fun together. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Chena Tucker
reviews.text:
We brought our family with two kids and a teenager, and it was a great experience. We spent about an hour and a half exploring, but honestly could have stayed longer—there was plenty to do. The kids loved the hands-on activities and creative play areas, and even our teen stayed engaged with the interactive exhibits.

Overall, it’s a fun and educational way to spend an afternoon together. Highly recommend for families looking for something both entertaining and meaningful.

reviews.author: Red
reviews.text: The kids loved it and are already begging to go again! As a parent, I just wish there was a little more guidance or signage for some of the activities, we weren’t always sure what the kids were supposed to do or what they were meant to learn from each station. With a bit clearer instruction, it would be even better.

reviews.author: Amy Stofenberg
reviews.text:
I never leave reviews this long but this is the culmination of years and years of frustration and disgust.

This bank’s policies are the LEAST friendly to low-income people of any bank I have ever come across. The employees are great - kind, helpful, funny. But the bank’s policies are straight up immoral and repulsive— particularly when it comes to overdraft fees.

They once charged me *EIGHT HUNDRED DOLLARS* in one year in overdraft fees. There should be a cap. I would obviously prefer if they declined the transactions that overdrew my account. BLOCK THE CHARGES. But they would rather make $38 a pop off of someone who is clearly struggling.

I have talked with the bank about this so many times over my 7 years of having an account with them. I had one very kind employee at the Elmira Rd. location who said he understood, and didn’t want to “kick someone while they were down”. He refunded about 4 overdraft fees. I wish the bank had the same moral fiber as that employee.

They slightly altered their policy this past year. Now, if your account is overdrawn less than $50, you have 24 hours to make it right before being charged the fee. If your account is overdrawn $50+, you are charged $38, AND $38 for every single withdrawal after that—no matter how small. The amount of times I’ve been charged $38 for a $3 overdraft - you wouldn’t even believe.

I’ve gone to sleep at night and not realized my account got overdrawn. By morning, I’ve been charged $160 in overdraft fees due to a $50 charge, followed by a $3 charge, a $5 charge, and an $8 charge.

Is the bank *really* so put-out, having to temporarily cover a small transaction for me? Again, block the charges. But they prefer to make $38 off of someone who is poor. What a scam. I have some choice words for this bank that I will keep to myself. Do better. “Community” bank-- hilarious.

I’m moving away from Ithaca and will be closing my accounts this week. Good riddance. *FYI* - my boyfriend has an account at Chase and has never been charged an overdraft fee, even when his account has been accidentally overdrawn by $300. That’s where I’m opening a new account.

reviews.author: Kitty Hall-Thurnheer
reviews.text: Absolutely worst customer service ever at Trust Co. Very difficult to get someone to answer the phone! Extremely difficult to get info out of them--they say they are asking security questions for my own good, but when they ask what branch did I open the account (40 years ago), I'm not able to answer correctly, then they deny info. Closed my mortgage and all accounts with them and moved to Elmira Savings Bank. Best decision ever.

reviews.author: Eric N
reviews.text: Would not recommend.  Went to Tompkins because they are a local business.  Unfortunately they don't treat you like a local business.  BONNIE  is the assistant manager of mortgage yet will act like she is a new hire. On many different occasions she actually acted more like a mob that was holding money over my head then a loan office that I am bringing business to.  Vary sad that this is how any one would get treated.  Much happier now with the customer service at CFCU.

reviews.author: Gregg Houck
reviews.text: I went to The Frame Shop to have a painting from a friend custom framed. Shop owner, Emily, attentively listened to what I was looking for and pulled a bunch of options for me to consider and then helped me narrow it down to the perfect fit. I was SO happy with the finished product! This is a special shop and a gem among Ithaca's small businesses. I will be going there for my future framing projects.

reviews.author: Robin Roger McKenzie
reviews.text: I brought in an antique map of New York State to be framed, and the staff helped me pick out the perfect frame and matte and UV protective glass. They didn’t even try to upsell me on the museum glass, but I called back the next day to have it added. They did a beautiful job, and I love how the map looks in my office.

reviews.author: Marcus Kelly
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here! I needed a gift for my brother and was on a tight deadline. Emily went above and beyond to work it out and provided advice on the best frame choice and made sure everything was perfect. The attention to detail was exceptional, and the quality of the frame was top-notch. I’m beyond grateful for the outstanding customer service and would highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for beautiful, personalized framing. Thank you for making my gift extra special!

reviews.author: Megan Wheeler
reviews.text: This shop has always been great and always treats me well.  This morning on my way to work I noticed a lot of shaking in my car that wasn't there before.  I also saw that my tire pressure was low.  I called as I got close and Tyler told me someone would be right out.  They came right out and put air in my tires and re-torqued my lug nuts for me.  Said the shaking was likely due to snow packed into my wheel wells, but it was good to come in and get it checked out.  Also did this at no charge!  Very much appreciate it! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Alain Giroux
reviews.text: This is the most honest pleasant service that you can get in the area. The guys are competent, and the work gets done efficiently and quickly.

reviews.author: Joseph Holland
reviews.text: I finally found a place where I feel safe to bring my car with any problem. Not only are they trustworthy, but they are the cheapest in labor I could find in the area. I highly recommend that if you are having problems, at least give this place a chance and see for yourself what they can do for you.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text:
I chose this place for my inspection because of the convenient location. They got me an apt quickly and my inspection was done within 1.5 hours. I was very satisfied with my experience until I got in my car.

I have two car seats and when I got in my car I saw that one of them was unhooked and upside down on top of the other car seat, my third row was up ( it was down when I dropped it off ) and all of the seatbelts in my car were fastened. I was quite confused. I’m assuming they had to detach the one car seat to get into my third row ?? Not sure. I wasn’t given a heads up that they detached the car seat and that I would need to put it back. I feel like they should have taken the extra  TWO seconds to unbuckle my seatbelts, put my third row back down and let me know if they aren’t legally allowed to reattach the car seat ( not sure if that’s the case or someone was just being lazy???) One of the latches to the other car seat was also detached and I didn’t realize it for a whole day as well.

reviews.author: Amy Tran
reviews.text: Don and Les truly went above and beyond with my car. I came in just for an oil change, but they were incredibly kind and took the time to help me with a separate door issue as well. Both of them were friendly, patient, and happy to answer all of my questions. I really appreciated how honest and transparent they were with everything, especially the billing — they gave me a clear heads-up before charging anything so I felt fully aware of what was being worked on and comfortable the entire time. You can tell they take pride in their work and in keeping the shop well-organized and running smoothly. Thanks to Don and Les, this was a great experience, and I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: M
reviews.text: We were desperate just before closing time. Had a soft tire and needed it checked out as we live 60 miles from Ithaca.  The staff helped us out - and discovered the tread was coming off the tire.  Had they not found that we could have had a wreck.  We had them order new tires and we are very happy.

reviews.author: Jacob Young (Jake)
reviews.text:
Do better.

Drive thru speed is one thing, quality is another. Just because you can get 2-3 vehicles through in 2 minutes doesn't mean you should. Customer service and food quality still applies even in the drive thru.

This company prides itself on speed of service, but I'd rather wait longer so I'm not wound up eating "floor chicken".

reviews.author: Jesse Bush
reviews.text: This is a very handsome new KFC in town. It's clean and well lit. The people working here were great and the food was really good. The only thing I'd change is to turn the music down or off. The music was way too loud and obnoxious, Two different radio stations were playing at the same time. I'd go again but sit away from the loud music

reviews.author: kristoff pettaway
reviews.text: My experience at this KFC has been underwhelming. The food quality is lacking, and most employees seem disconnected, while a dedicated few strive to provide adequate service. To those hard workers, thank you, but this place needs an overhaul, or it's not going to last much longer.

reviews.author: Nicole Gabriel
reviews.text: Update 1/23/26 went here ordered the special bbq pulled chicken nachos.............Opens at 4 we arrived at 4:10 it was already busy. They have two lines. The one on the left is food and drinks. The one on the right is just food. Ordered the pretty fly for a white pye pizza, macaroni & cheese and a root beer. They give you a pager . Our order came out quickly. Within 10 minutes.The pretty fly for a white pye was good. You can really taste the smokey mozzarella yum. The dough is very thin. The bit of char on the crust from the wood fire was delicious. The Mac and cheese was creamy on the bottom and had a smidge of melted cheese on the top. Overall that was just ok. Would pass on it next time though. If you get a soda stay inside. The wasps outside liked it a bit to much. Will definitely be back again sometime. Definitely recommend trying out some pizza.

reviews.author: Davian Gekman
reviews.text:
Great atmosphere and food!
Got the beef chicken nachos which were very tasty and easy to share with people. Got two pies of pizza which was enough for 4 people (recommended the margherita pizza).
I wish there was a bit more spice to the margherita pizza, but the sriracha they provided fulfilled that need. Also a great place to get to go food!

reviews.author: JitkaKac
reviews.text: Amazing people working here! They have live music as well. A flight of 4 beers costs $12, we loved all that we tasted - Hefeweizen, Pilsner, Oktoberfest and Stout. They also make delicious pizza. Plenty of seating and clean restrooms, a big parking lot.

reviews.author: Stephenie Monroe
reviews.text: I switched to Visions a few years ago and it was absolutely the right thing to do. The online banking portal is quick and easy. The financial advisors are personable and helpful. And I like the products, including the Lucky Savers CD. What makes me want to write a review, though, is the fact that today my partner and I left the bank and realized that we always same to receive help from the same associate and we always find ourselves saying how nice and cheerful she was. She’s incredibly quick, knowledgeable, and efficient. So we wanted to say a big thanks to “Mairi” at our Ithaca visions who was a small but cheerfully positive and impactful part of our day today.

reviews.author: Y din Diiin
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience working with Mr. Michael at Vision Federal Credit Union. From the beginning, he was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to helping me understand my options. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident in my decisions. His customer service was top-notch—friendly, patient, and responsive every step of the way. Thank you

reviews.author: Mark Rich
reviews.text:
We would like to acknowledge Jordan Corter for her excellent service in navigating the end of our vehicle lease.  It was confusing to us & she walked us through every step.  Jordan went way beyond good customer service & kept in close communication for each step.  She is definitely an asset to your financial institution and deserves recognition for her excellent service.  Thank you, Jordan!!
Marie & Mark Rich

reviews.author: Latifah Abdur
reviews.text:
I’ve been ordering from Lavender in Luxe since they first started online in 2020 and it has become my go-to shop for client gifts and luxury candles. Every order is beautifully packaged and shipped with care, and everyone who receives them absolutely loves them.

I’m so happy the candle maker Ashantia is opening her first candle store and workshop experience in Ithaca, NY.
It’s exciting to see such a thoughtful, black woman-owned brand growing right in ithaca’s community.

If you are looking for elevated gifts, artisan candles, or a local business that delivers exceptional service, Lavender in Luxe is the one. I can’t wait to visit the new store when it opens.

reviews.author: Robin C. Dennis
reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience working with Gary at Bangs for my father's funeral service in Ithaca & transportation for burial out of state. My family was especially pleased with Gary's embalming services - we only wanted the casket open for the family, but he made my dad look so good we could have left it open the whole time! Gary provides the best of everything you need in a sad & stressful time - kindness, attention to detail, skill & knowledge of his profession & a sense of humor when appropriate. Everyone at Bangs has been very polite, professional and thorough with every little detail that we needed taken care of. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Heather Mulligan
reviews.text: I cannot sing Gary's praises highly enough. My father died unexpectedly and the last 5 days have been an absolute nightmare. Of all of the things that my family has been through,this was one of the things I was dreading the most. It's another level of finality that your parent is truly gone. But by the time my brother and I left Bangs,we felt at peace. He made a really traumatic experience anything but. He has a way about him that puts you immediately at ease. The process was smooth and it was handled very gently and efficiently. He really was such a comfort and just a pleasure to be around. So,a huge thank you to Gary and the folks at Bangs for taking care of my family and my father at a very difficult time.

reviews.author: Sherry Pardee
reviews.text: Jeff Bangs and Bangs Funeral Home were wonderful to work with.  Patient and very helpful through the whole process.   He gave me also a lot of great advice in writing the obituary and planning the memorial service.  Highly recommend using their services.

reviews.author: Farhana Yasmin
reviews.text: One of our most favorite dining rooms on campus. There’s a great variety of food every day, so it never feels boring. The halal and kosher stations are a big plus and not something found in other dining halls. The vibe is always lively, and the space is big enough that even when it’s crowded, we can still find a nice spot to sit and enjoy our meal.

reviews.author: Yunong Shi
reviews.text:
Hands down the best university dining hall I’ve ever experienced. Open to the public at $16 for adults and ~$7 for kids, it’s an absolute steal considering the quality and scale. The space is massive and beautifully designed, even equipped with a “Discovery Kitchen” for live courses and cooking demos.

The food stations are incredibly diverse: halal, West Side Grill, East Side Market, North End Pizza and Pasta, salad bar, dessert bar, fruit bar, yogurt bar, ice cream (from Cornell Dairy!), and more. Even in summer break, with some stations closed, the options were overwhelming in the best way.

Highlights:
•	The pizza was top notch – fresh from wood-fired ovens.
•	Blueberry and banana yogurt? Dreamy.
•	The grilled fish was surprisingly delicious.
•	Tater tots and salad bar were far above average – packed with thoughtful toppings like artichoke, chickpeas, beets, and tuna salad.
•	Desserts were solid; the brownie was rich, and we had fun making waffles ourselves.
•	The ice cream options, while not mind-blowing, are generous and fun to explore (and hey, it’s Cornell Dairy).

If I were a student here, I’d never want to eat off-campus. Absolute envy.

reviews.author: Teng Ren
reviews.text:
Best dinning hall in US universities. Totally blown away by the quality and variety of the foods. I had the best pizza in America so far. There are red pizza, white pizza, all kinds of toppings, and the crust is made perfect, all freshly from the real fire oven. Price is also very reasonable.
All foods are made to high quality restaurants standards.

reviews.author: Alexis Scheepsma
reviews.text: Just tried to go on my lunch break. Very busy and signs were confusing so I made a wrong turn and had to drive around the customers and workers. Not one but TWO workers threw their hands up at me screaming you can’t go this way….obviously I knew I made a mistake. Having two employees throwing hands up and giving me attitude and dirty looks? Unacceptable coming from a business owner. I will take my trucks and vans to be washed elsewhere after this encounter. Hire people that have good attitudes.

reviews.author: Ed
reviews.text: Great service and super clean vehicle, even with the basic wash. But the BATH is the best. A place I'll take all my trucks and cars.

reviews.author: Bill R.
reviews.text: I used the Cortland location and washed by hand. The total was $10 and now almost a week later they now charged my card $25! I don't know what's going on but I'm calling tomorrow.

reviews.author: Gabriel Hicks
reviews.text: The guy charged me double what was on the sticker and then claimed he had no way to refund me. Be careful here.

reviews.author: hookah lounge
reviews.text: Came back after a long time and saw a big change . Good luck for new owner nice service and good price

reviews.author: Kathy L.
reviews.text: Despite not being around this area, my husband and I would always gravitate to this gas station to get gas. Has everything we need and good gas prices compared to others.

reviews.author: Jaeda
reviews.text:
Went here for a volleyball camp at Cornell University.
The hotel was ok, but there was clearly mold  everywhere and it is extremely dated. The hallway walking to the rooms was absolutely filthy and water damaged, as well as dark and unsettling. Lights on the walls were literally knocked down and some were just not working. Their form of surveillance was just a blink camera. Staff was nice, and breakfast was pretty good. The hotel should just be destroyed and rebuilt honestly. The ceilings clearly had mold damage in the rooms but other than that it was clean. Very creepy, haunted feeling. Staff tried their best but it just isn’t a hotel you should stay at if you can’t help it.

reviews.author: Marissa Corwin Manitowabi
reviews.text: This place is a great deal! We went because we were traveling on a budget, expecting a basic motel-type experience but were pleasantly surprised at every turn. The staff is professional and friendly. The rooms were clean with no smell (something I’m sensitive to). The breakfast was above average with fantastic homemade pumpkin bread and a solid continental spread. This will be our go-to spot whenever we are in town!

reviews.author: Ashley Polikoff
reviews.text: Water pressure that'll blast the skin from your bones. The heated indoor pool was actually heated! Great price, clean. Attentive front desk. Decent breakfast too!

reviews.author: Angelo Garcia
reviews.text: It’s been my first visit although I have been in the same vicinity for several months when visiting from Canada! I liked the retro look of the place however the stalls are very small and confined thus not allowing one to be comfortable specially a large man like myself who has trouble sitting on tight spaces! I barely fit today in the small booth surrounded by plexiglass windows… sorta reminds of when we were under the COVID pandemic and isolating in tiny spaces… the coffee was excellent, my eggs and toast were fine, the ham was a bit over cooked , grits were a bit dry and the sausage patty I ordered extra was not worth the price! I don’t think I will be coming back…

reviews.author: Noel
reviews.text: Ordered a hot chocolate with a steak and egg breakfast. Not only was service fast, but the food was amazing and the staff is super friendly!! THANK YOU FOR AN AMAZING CHRISTMAS EVE BREAKFAST!! MERRY CHRISTMAS Y'ALL!

reviews.author: Ya Yay
reviews.text: Very generous portion sizes. The chicken wrap was very good, and the breakfast food is what you’d expect from your local diner. Overall, very solid.

reviews.author: abbys crafty corner teeter
reviews.text: The staff at this branch is very friendly and helpful..always very patient especially when you have multiple transactions.. I would recommend this branch for any banking needs ... I've been a customer for close to 20 years and don't plan on changing banks any time soon ...have a blessed day 💖

reviews.author: E.C. Barrett
reviews.text: My partner's debit card was skimmed and used to purchase over $1000 in gas at a single gas station over a 40 minute period of time. Documents provided to us by the bank manager show that the charges were flagged as suspicious but processed anyway without notifying us. Community Bank refuses to refund the charges, even after suspects have been arrested, and even after the bank manager admitted via email that it was their error in not alerting him to the suspicious activity. Community Bank cannot be trusted with your money.

reviews.author: Ted Crane
reviews.text:
UPDATE: THIS BRANCH IS NOW PART OF COMMUNITY BANK
First impressions of the change: from best  to one of the worst.
- no longer provide paper statements unless you pay for them
- low interest rates on savings
- do not provide savings rates online, do not distribute rate sheets on paper; you can get them verbally in the branch
- do not appear to follow the "greet customers by name when you arrive" policy any more
- (added 7/31/2022) when you do receive paper statements, THERE IS NO DATE ON THE STATEMENT. Individual accounts have dates associated with them, but there is no overall statement date. I've never seen a bank statement without a statement date before!

I expect to close many of my accounts and move them elsewhere.

Original review:
Probably the best bank in Ithaca. The only bank where they greet you as you enter...and even by name once you know them.

Better rates than several local banks, but some of the same gotchas. On the whole, a better deal than most. Sure, they like you to bring in "new" money to get the best rates, but so does everyone else. So you move it from place to place...take from the rich and give to the poor...and get good rates everywhere.

Try 'em, you'll like 'em.

reviews.author: Christianne White
reviews.text: Eric has so much experience and can give a great cut quickly and expertly, and charges a reasonable price, which gives room for a good tip!

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: This place was recommended to my girlfriend and she loved it period. They actually understood what she meant by layering and everything she wanted. She's always telling me to go here for a haircut. I'm really bad at getting haircuts when I need to. But I think it was $25 for her haircut which is very reasonable especially for a woman's haircut.

reviews.author: Evelyn Weinstein
reviews.text: when you find somebody who could cut hair with her eyes closed and inside of a refrigerator you know you found the right place! Love you Amelia and Eric! Best place in Ithaca by far!

reviews.author: Mark H. Anbinder
reviews.text: Even the architecture of this museum, including its relatively recent addition, is art! But the permanent collections and rotating exhibits really makes a place. There’s something for everyone, including modern photography and ancient artifacts. Views around the Cornell campus and City of Ithaca are exceptional.

reviews.author: Telephone
reviews.text:
The Johnson Museum of Art is a charming little museum on the Cornell University campus. While it’s not the largest art museum I’ve been to, it does have some beautiful and interesting collections. The exhibits rotate regularly, showcasing both local and international artists. The museum also has a great view of the surrounding campus and the Ithaca area, which adds to the overall experience.
That being said, the museum is quite small, and depending on what exhibits are up at the time, it might not take you long to go through the entire collection. While it offers some wonderful pieces, I was hoping for a little more variety and depth in the exhibits. The staff were friendly, and the museum itself was clean and well-organized, but it didn’t have the same WOW factor that some larger museums might offer.
Overall, Johnson Museum of Art is a nice spot for a short visit, especially if you’re already in the area or on Cornell’s campus. If you’re an art lover or just looking for a quick stop to admire some works, it’s worth checking out. But if you’re expecting a large, world-class art collection, you might be a bit disappointed.

reviews.author: RJ Lackie
reviews.text: Masters, students, ancient artifacts, modern media, and everything in between. I was pleasantly surprised by this place. I expected only some modern art but it's a world class collection. The representation of different cultures/places, time periods, and materials is amazing. I highly recommend going here even if it's out of the way of your plans. There are even some great views of the city and surrounding mountains and adjacent lake. There's also an outdoor deck area with light-art on the ceiling and benches designed for lounging to look up at it. The architecture is also striking and memorable. A must-see finger lakes experience, and it's free!

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text:
I like the Chinese bbq ribs and the nachos are always fire.

This dining hall is smaller , which I like because I can actually find where things are. I appreciate the easy to find trash can.
Good food choices, aesthetic atmosphere.

The only issue is that the desserts are pretty bad. The brownie tasted like dirt and the cake had overly sweet icing. Also lack of ice cream.

reviews.author: Leon Burbank
reviews.text: Poor selection of fruits and vegetables and pathetic attempt at Mexican cuisine— this place will be the reason why I will cry myself to sleep tonight. If God truly exists, he would not have allowed this non-air-conditioned, sour-smelling Satan’s armpit to exist. If you are looking for food that looks and tastes like this, I think Walmart’s pet aisle has cheaper and better options. As I shoved spoonful after spoonful of this barely edible concoction down my abused mouth, I wished that I am the chandeliers that dimly illuminated this place— hanging motionlesly from the ceiling.

reviews.author: Tanuj Chawla
reviews.text: Must go place for gluten and lactose intolerant. The all you can eat diner offers a variety of starters, salads, soups and main course items. The staff is courteous and will happily take requests. You also get Cornell dairy ice cream(not sure if that was lactose free)

reviews.author: Daniel Filler
reviews.text:
A decent variety of dishes that changes from meal to meal and day to day. You can see specific offerings online, but they always have pizza, a salad bar, chicken (usually grilled breast), and baked goods + ice cream for dessert. The appearance of Mexican and East Asian is common, but not garunteed. Highly recommend if you are looking for clean protein (chicken breast) or some crispy, greasy, sheet-stle pizza. Not for those seeking an exciting or particularly seasoned experience.

P.S. the best meal is usually the Sunday brunch.

reviews.author: Toby Young
reviews.text: Let me begin by saying the staff of the North Star dining hall is not reflected by the food they serve. The staff is consistently patient and helpful, however nothing they can do to counteract the horrible experience in terms of food I had tonight.
